feats.name: A Home in Every Port
feats.notes: You have a reputation in towns and villages you've visited, and residents are always willing to open their doors to you.

feats.name: A Hush Falls Over the World
feats.notes: Sound is absorbed in your waking world, covering everything in a shroud of quiet until the start of your next turn.

feats.name: A Miracle of Science!
feats.notes: Once, you dreamed of creating life. Now you know that merely creating life lacks ambition.

feats.name: A Tale to Believe In
feats.notes: You recite a tale of prowess that rewrites the combat unfolding around you.

feats.name: A Thousand Cries For Help
feats.notes: You’ve learned to communicate with creatures from all over the world, overcoming language barriers to lend a hand and help where you’re needed.

feats.name: Aberration Kinship
feats.notes: Your mind resonates with the inscrutable thought processes that inhuman aberrations use to communicate.

feats.name: Abjure Harm
feats.notes: You’re nigh invincible, and it’s clear that your foe is so far beneath you that they have no hope of winning.
feats.trigger: You would take damage from an enemy’s critical Strike .

feats.name: Abjure the False Kin
feats.notes: Your vow reminds you that there can be brackish vinegar hiding within honeyed words, helping you detect attempts to influence your mind.

feats.name: Able Ritualist
feats.notes: Your readings on rituals make you a skilled participant.

feats.name: Aboleth Transmutation
feats.notes: You have tapped into the ancient magic used by alghollthu masters to mold the flesh of your ancestors.
feats.source: Absalom, City of Lost Omens, Azarketi Ancestry Web Supplement

feats.name: Abscission Shards
feats.notes: You twist your claw, breaking off a piece in your target.

feats.name: Absolve Sins
feats.notes: Your forgiveness is without limit, though the path to penitence can be painful, especially against those who have trespassed against your current mortal form.

feats.name: Absorb Spell
feats.notes: You absorb a spell and store it in your body.
feats.prerequisite: Spellmaster Dedication; spell repertoire or ability to prepare spells
feats.trigger: You critically succeed at a saving throw against a foe’s spell, and that spell is of a level you can normally cast.

feats.name: Absorb Strength
feats.notes: You consume a piece of your enemy, absorbing their strength.
feats.trigger: You are adjacent to an enemy's corpse who has been dead for no longer than 1 minute.

feats.name: Absorb Toxin
feats.notes: Your skin readily absorbs poison and can consciously draw toxins into your body to spare others.
feats.prerequisite: You are not immune to diseases or poisons
feats.trigger: You attempt a saving throw against a disease or poison effect that affects an area.

feats.name: Accelerating Touch
feats.notes: Your healing energies are infused with bounding energy.

feats.name: Acclimated Mount
feats.notes: By the grace of your god, your mount can overcome the natural challenges and hazards present in a specific terrain.

feats.name: Acclimatization
feats.notes: Your time spent in the hostile parts of the world has inured you to extreme climates.

feats.name: Accommodating Mount
feats.notes: You've trained to serve as a mount, if only for your most trusted allies.

feats.name: Accompany
feats.notes: You use your performance to supplement an ally’s spellcasting, providing magical energy for their spell in their stead.
feats.trigger: An ally within 30 feet Casts a Spell

feats.name: Accurate Flurry
feats.notes: You refine the precision of your unbelievable storm of blows.

feats.name: Accurate Swing
feats.notes: You strike cleanly with wide, sweeping attacks to inflict maximum damage
feats.prerequisite: Vigilante Dedication; Harsh Judgment; member of the Gray Gardeners

feats.name: Accursed Claws
feats.notes: Your claws carry your mother’s hag magic.

feats.name: Accursed Clay Fist
feats.notes: You have replaced one of your forearms with one made of clay and infused with cursed arcane magic.
feats.prerequisite: Golem Grafter Dedication; expert in unarmed attacks

feats.name: Accursed Magic
feats.notes: When the curse within you spills out, you can lay curses on others and claim them for yourself with ease.

feats.name: Accursed Touch
feats.notes: You've learned to harness the supernatural curse that animates you, imbuing your most powerful attacks with a terrible curse.

feats.name: Achaekek's Grip
feats.notes: You sense if a creature you have slain in the last year has been restored to life

feats.name: Acknowledge Fan
feats.notes: Your reputation as a Firebrand precedes you, and you need only make a simple gesture or give a look of recognition to amaze those around you.
feats.access: Members of the Firebrands at the rank of second mark or higher have access to this feat.

feats.name: Acquired Tolerance
feats.notes: A small amount of poison taken at nonlethal doses, can help the body build up resistance against a more deadly dosage.
feats.trigger: You fail a save against a poison.

feats.name: Acrobat Dedication
feats.notes: You become an expert in Acrobatics .

feats.name: Acrobatic Performer
feats.notes: You're an incredible acrobat, evoking wonder and enrapturing audiences with your prowess.

feats.name: Acupuncturist
feats.notes: You’ve studied the routes by which qi flows through the body.
feats.access: Tian Xia origin

feats.name: Acute Scent
feats.notes: When your anger is heightened, your sense of smell improves.

feats.name: Acute Vision
feats.notes: When you are raging, your visual senses improve, granting you darkvision .

feats.name: Adamantine Body
feats.notes: With your strong will and even stronger body, you shrug off an otherwise devastating blow.
feats.trigger: An attack or effect would deal damage to you.

feats.name: Adamantine Fists
feats.notes: You imbue your unarmed strikes with one of the strongest metals.

feats.name: Adamantine Mantra
feats.notes: You attain your true potential as a tutelary spirit.

feats.name: Adapted Cantrip
feats.notes: Through study of multiple magical traditions, you’ve altered a spell to suit your spellcasting style.

feats.name: Adaptive Adept
feats.notes: You’ve continued adapting your magic to blend your class’s tradition with your adapted tradition.

feats.name: Adaptive Mask Familiar
feats.notes: Your mask familiar adapts quickly to material form, allowing it to gain more familiar and master abilities.

feats.name: Adaptive Stratagem
feats.notes: Your constant training and strong bond with your allies allow you to change tactics on the fly.
feats.trigger: You roll initiative.

feats.name: Adaptive Vision
feats.notes: After years of using black powder weaponry in dimly lit spaces, you've become accustomed to dazzling flashes of light and sudden shifts in illumination.
feats.access: You are from Dongun Hold or Alkenstar.

feats.name: Add Element
feats.notes: Choose a second kinetic element to add to the one you already have.

feats.name: Additional Circus Trick
feats.notes: You gain an additional signature trick.
feats.source: Come One, Come All, to the Extinction Curse Player's Guide!
feats.prerequisite: You must have a signature trick

feats.name: Additional Companion
feats.notes: Another animal joins you in your travels.

feats.name: Additional Follower
feats.notes: Another follower joins you in your travels.

feats.name: Additional Ikon
feats.notes: Your story has grown rich enough that three ikons can’t contain its full complexity.

feats.name: Additional Lore
feats.notes: Become trained in another Lore subcategory

feats.name: Additional Recollection
feats.notes: You scan the battlefield quickly, remembering critical details about multiple opponents you face.
feats.trigger: You succeed or critically succeed at a check to Recall Knowledge on your hunted prey

feats.name: Additional Servings
feats.notes: Your number of versatile vials per day increases to 5.
feats.prerequisite: Wandering Chef Dedication; Expert in Crafting or Cooking Lore

feats.name: Additional Shadow Magic
feats.notes: Choose an additional shadowdancer focus spell you haven't already selected from Shadow Magic.

feats.name: Adept Storyteller
feats.notes: Your ability to tell stories rivals those of the finest bards.
feats.prerequisite: Uzunjati Storytelling; master in a Recall Knowledge skill

feats.name: Adhyabhau
feats.notes: You descend from the rare psychic vampires known as vetalaranas.

feats.name: Adopted Ancestry
feats.notes: Gain access to ancestry feats from another ancestry

feats.name: Adrenaline Rush
feats.notes: In the heat of battle, you are capable of amazing feats of strength.

feats.name: Adroit Manipulation
feats.notes: You’ve fiddled with knots, locks, and blacksmith’s puzzles since you were a child to give your hands something to do.
feats.access: Mihrini ethnicity

feats.name: Advanced Alchemy
feats.notes: You gain the advanced alchemy benefits

feats.name: Advanced Arcana
feats.notes: You gain one wizard feat.

feats.name: Advanced Blood Potency
feats.notes: You gain one sorcerer feat.

feats.name: Advanced Bloodline
feats.notes: You draw more power from your bloodline.

feats.name: Advanced Bow Training
feats.notes: Through constant practice and the crucible of experience, you increase your skill with advanced bows.

feats.name: Advanced Breakthrough
feats.notes: You gain one inventor feat.

feats.name: Advanced Concoction
feats.notes: You gain one alchemist feat.

feats.name: Advanced Construct Companion
feats.notes: You've upgraded your construct companion's power and decision-making ability.

feats.name: Advanced Death Dealing
feats.notes: You gain one necromancer feat .

feats.name: Advanced Deduction
feats.notes: You gain one investigator feat.

feats.name: Advanced Defender
feats.notes: You gain one guardian feat.

feats.name: Advanced Deific Power
feats.notes: Like a muscle, the more you flex your divine power, the stronger it gets.

feats.name: Advanced Deity's Domain
feats.notes: Through your conviction, you have glimpsed the deeper secrets of your deity's domain.

feats.name: Advanced Devotion
feats.notes: You gain one champion feat.

feats.name: Advanced Dogma
feats.notes: You gain one cleric feat.

feats.name: Advanced Domain
feats.notes: Your prayers have unlocked deeper secrets of your deity’s domain.

feats.name: Advanced Domain Spirit
feats.notes: Your connection with your domain spirit has deepened.

feats.name: Advanced Efficient Alchemy
feats.notes: You make an even-larger batch of alchemical items each morning.

feats.name: Advanced Element Control
feats.notes: You gain one kineticist feat .

feats.name: Advanced Elemental Spell
feats.notes: Your connection to one of the great elemental aspects of nature deepens, allowing you further control over its powers.
feats.prerequisite: flame order, stone order, storm order, or wave order

feats.name: Advanced Field Training
feats.notes: You gain a commander feat.

feats.name: Advanced Firearm Familiarity
feats.notes: You have familiarity with advanced firearms, treating them as martial weapons for the purposes of proficiency.
feats.prerequisite: Gunslinger Dedication; expert in any kind of weapon or unarmed attack

feats.name: Advanced First Aid
feats.notes: Use First Aid to reduce frightened and sickened condition values

feats.name: Advanced Flair
feats.notes: You gain one swashbuckler feat.

feats.name: Advanced Fury
feats.notes: You gain one barbarian feat.

feats.name: Advanced General Training
feats.notes: Over the long course of your adventuring life, your adaptability has let you pick up numerous useful abilities.

feats.name: Advanced Glory
feats.notes: You gain an exemplar feat.

feats.name: Advanced Hallowed Spell
feats.notes: You dig deeper into the magical tools found in wizard schools and divine domains.
feats.prerequisite: Hallowed Necromancer Dedication; necromancer initial school spell or death initial domain spell

feats.name: Advanced Herbalism
feats.notes: Your herbalist talents continue to grow with use and you have become potent at making even more remedies from less.

feats.name: Advanced Hunter's Trick
feats.notes: You gain one ranger feat.

feats.name: Advanced Kata
feats.notes: You gain one monk feat.

feats.name: Advanced Maneuver
feats.notes: You gain a fighter feat.

feats.name: Advanced Martial Magic
feats.notes: You gain one magus feat .

feats.name: Advanced Monastic Weaponry
feats.notes: Your rigorous training regimen allows you to wield complex weaponry with ease.
feats.source: Tian Xia Character Guide, Player Core 2

feats.name: Advanced Muse's Whispers
feats.notes: You gain one bard feat.

feats.name: Advanced Mysteries
feats.notes: You gain one oracle feat.

feats.name: Advanced Order Training
feats.notes: You gain the greater order benefit for the Hellknight order to which you belong.

feats.name: Advanced Poisoncraft
feats.notes: You can create up to 6 poisons per day with advanced alchemy.

feats.name: Advanced Qi Spells
feats.notes: Your talent at controlling your qi has reached new heights.

feats.name: Advanced Reanimated Companion
feats.notes: Your corpselike construct companion becomes much more powerful and can act with limited autonomy to follow your greater directives.

feats.name: Advanced Revelation
feats.notes: Divine power reveals greater mysteries to you.

feats.name: Advanced Rune Magic
feats.notes: You gain a runesmith feat .

feats.name: Advanced Runelord Magic
feats.notes: Your ability to use magic associated with your chosen sin grows.
feats.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star

feats.name: Advanced Runic Mind-Smithing
feats.notes: Your mind can hold onto more complicated patterns than ever before.

feats.name: Advanced School Spell
feats.notes: You gain access to the advanced teachings of your arcane institution, learning a powerful new school spell.

feats.name: Advanced Seeker of Truths
feats.notes: You have unlocked deeper secrets to uncovering and hoarding lore.
feats.prerequisite: Eldritch Researcher Dedication; Seeker of Truths

feats.name: Advanced Shooter
feats.notes: You’ve dedicated your training to mastering even the most complex and weird firearms and crossbows from across the world.

feats.name: Advanced Shooting
feats.notes: You gain one gunslinger feat.

feats.name: Advanced Synergy
feats.notes: You gain one summoner feat .

feats.name: Advanced Targeting System
feats.notes: Your ocular processors are augmented with advanced targeting systems, which allow you to more easily pinpoint your enemy and read their movements.

feats.name: Advanced Thaumaturgy
feats.notes: You gain one thaumaturge feat.

feats.name: Advanced Thoughtform
feats.notes: You gain one psychic feat.

feats.name: Advanced Trickery
feats.notes: You gain one rogue feat.

feats.name: Advanced Warden
feats.notes: You unlock more powerful primal spells.

feats.name: Advanced Weapon Training
feats.notes: You’ve studied the art of wielding an advanced weapon.

feats.name: Advanced Weaponry
feats.notes: Your eidolon’s attack evolves.

feats.name: Advanced Wilding
feats.notes: You gain one druid feat.

feats.name: Advanced Witchcraft
feats.notes: You gain one witch feat.

feats.name: Advantageous Assault
feats.notes: After compromising your enemy’s movement, you deliver a more deadly blow.

feats.name: Adventurous Outfitter
feats.notes: You tinker, create, and repair gear as you adventure. You can spend part of your daily preparations adjusting your group’s equipment.

feats.name: Aegis for the Innocent
feats.notes: You transfer a portion of your divine spark to an ally, temporarily dimming your nimbus to encase an ally in a barrier of light that repels attackers.

feats.name: Aegis of Arnisant
feats.notes: Inspired by the tale of Arnisant, you transform your shield into a magic ward.
feats.prerequisite: Knight Vigilant; Shield Block; Master in Religion

feats.name: Aegis of the Dissolution
feats.notes: You are a friend of shadows and know how to avoid the troubles they bring.

feats.name: Aeon Resonance
feats.notes: You gain the resonant power of one embedded aeon stone as if it were placed in a wayfinder.

feats.name: Aeonbound
feats.notes: Your lineage is influenced or directly tied to the supernatural inhabitants of the Perfect City of Axis, a realm of pure and absolute order.

feats.name: Aerial Boomerang
feats.notes: A blade of shearing wind races away from you in a 60-foot line.

feats.name: Aerial Flash
feats.notes: Even creatures who take to the air can’t escape you.

feats.name: Aerial Piledriver
feats.notes: Heaving both yourself and your opponent into the air, you bring them crashing to the ground.

feats.name: Aerobatics Mastery
feats.notes: You move with grace in flight and can perform amazing aerial stunts.

feats.name: Aether Beam
feats.notes: You can open your internal nexus, unleashing a destructive beam of magical energy that emanates from your hand, eyes, or chest.

feats.name: Aether Blast
feats.notes: You channel some of the raw magical energy in your internal nexus into a devastating blast.

feats.name: Affliction Mercy
feats.notes: The divine grace that flows through you grants reprieve from an affliction.

feats.name: Affliction Resistance
feats.notes: Your diet has strengthened you against diseases and poisons.

feats.name: After You
feats.notes: You allow your foes to make the first move in a show of incredible confidence.
feats.trigger: You’re about to roll initiative.

feats.name: Afterimage
feats.notes: You leave behind an afterimage of yourself in your previous square.
feats.trigger: You use an action or cast a spell with the teleportation trait.

feats.name: Agathion Magic
feats.notes: The harmonious magic of Nirvana flows through you.

feats.name: Ageless Patience
feats.notes: You work at a pace born from longevity that enhances your thoroughness.

feats.name: Ageless Spirit
feats.notes: You remember more about your previous incarnations than most leshys.

feats.name: Agent of All Holds
feats.notes: Orcs across Belkzen recognize you as an honored lorekeeper.
feats.trigger: You critically fail a Diplomacy , Intimidation , or Performance check.

feats.name: Aggravating Scratch
feats.notes: Your claws carry an irritant that is harmless to you but can be damaging to others.

feats.name: Aggressive Block
feats.notes: You push back as you block, knocking your foe away or off balance.
feats.trigger: You use the Shield Block reaction, and the opponent that triggered Shield Block is adjacent to you and is your size or smaller

feats.name: Agile Grace
feats.notes: Your graceful moves with agile weapons are beyond compare.

feats.name: Agile Hand
feats.notes: When you cast mage hand , you can modify it to control a set of thieves' tools.
feats.prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _mage hand_

feats.name: Agile Maneuvers
feats.notes: Your easily maneuver against your foes.

feats.name: Agile Shield Grip
feats.notes: You change your grip on the shield, allowing you to combine rapid attacks with your shield boss or shield spikes and your main weapon's Strikes in a series of swift motions.
feats.access: Knights of Lastwall have access to this feat.

feats.name: Agonizing Rebuke
feats.notes: When you terrorize your enemies, you also cause them painful mental distress.

feats.name: Air Cushion
feats.notes: Air currents flow upward to slow the target's fall to 60 feet per round.
feats.trigger: A creature within 60 feet is falling.

feats.name: Air Shroud
feats.notes: Turbulent air suffuses your kinetic aura.

feats.name: Airborne Form
feats.notes: Your eidolon can fly.

feats.name: Airy Step
feats.notes: You create a blanket of fog in a 5–foot burst centered on one corner of your space.
feats.trigger: A creature targets you with an attack or other targeted effect, and you can see the attacker.

feats.name: Alabaster Eyes
feats.notes: In place of the normal vishkanyan golden eyes, you were born with especially perceptive snow-white eyes.

feats.name: Alacritous Action
feats.notes: Your eidolon moves more quickly.

feats.name: Alarming Disappearance
feats.notes: Your ability to move unseen is startling for one your size, causing panic among your enemies.

feats.name: Alchemical Assessment
feats.notes: You can identify alchemical items quickly.

feats.name: Alchemical Crafting
feats.notes: Craft alchemical items

feats.name: Alchemical Discoveries
feats.notes: You've devoted extra time in the lab to improve your knowledge of alchemy.

feats.name: Alchemical Familiar
feats.notes: You have used alchemy to create life, a simple creature formed from alchemical materials, reagents, and a bit of your own blood.

feats.name: Alchemical Power
feats.notes: You become an expert in the alchemist class DC.

feats.name: Alchemical Revivification
feats.notes: If you die while under the effect of at least one elixir , the alchemical compounds in your bloodstream bring you back to life at the start of your next turn.

feats.name: Alchemical Scholar
feats.notes: You gain the Alchemical Crafting feat.

feats.name: Alchemical Shot
feats.notes: You've practiced a technique for mixing alchemical bombs with your loaded shot.

feats.name: Alchemist Dedication
feats.notes: You put your alchemical interest into practice.

feats.name: Aldori Duelist Dedication
feats.notes: Your Aldori duelist training teaches you martial techniques and increases your dedication to the Aldori dueling sword.
feats.access: You are from the Broken Lands region.

feats.name: Aldori Parry
feats.notes: You can parry attacks against you with your Aldori dueling sword.

feats.name: Aldori Riposte
feats.notes: You riposte with your Aldori dueling sword when your enemy leaves an opening.
feats.trigger: An opponent within your reach critically fails a Strike against you.

feats.name: Aldori Swordlord
feats.notes: You are an Aldori swordlord.
feats.prerequisite: Aldori Duelist Dedication; you have taken the last name of Aldori, sworn to the Aldori swordpact, and demonstrated skill at swordplay by winning a duel using only a sword in the presence of an Aldori swordlord.

feats.name: Aldori's Retort
feats.notes: You can flow through combat reactions with graceful ease.

feats.name: Alghollthu Bound
feats.notes: Although you may not even be aware, the alghollthus your ancestors once served maintain a stranglehold on the deepest, tethered parts of your mind.
feats.source: Absalom, City of Lost Omens, Azarketi Ancestry Web Supplement

feats.name: Align Qi
feats.notes: The power of your qi soothes your wounds and energizes you for battle.
feats.trigger: You Cast a Spell that has the monk trait.

feats.name: Alkenstar Agent Dedication
feats.notes: You put on the persona of a rough and tumble outlaw, but your real goals are to report threats to Alkenstar back to the grand duchess.
feats.prerequisite: Trained in Deception; trained at least one firearm
feats.access: You have been initiated by the grand duchess of Alkenstar or one of her agents.

feats.name: All in my Head
feats.notes: Using your occult connections and incredible powers of persuasion, you convince yourself that the triggering damage is a figment of your imagination.
feats.trigger: You would take damage from a Strike or spell that doesn’t have the death trait or otherwise cause instant death (such as disintegrate)

feats.name: All in your Head
feats.notes: Flames scouring at your body, venom coursing through your veins—you refuse to believe they exist, and nothing can affect you if you don't believe in it.
feats.trigger: You’re about to attempt a Fortitude save or a Reflex save.

feats.name: All of the Animal
feats.notes: You know how to make the best and most efficient use of a hunted animal's carcass.

feats.name: All Returns to Slumber
feats.notes: Your waking world returns to slumber, and lays the peace of deep sleep on all within it.

feats.name: All Shall End in Flames
feats.notes: White-hot fire consumes everything in a cataclysmic sphere of death.

feats.name: All the Time in the World
feats.notes: Your firsthand experience of the subjective nature of time and space has given you new observational insights.

feats.name: All This Has Happened Before
feats.notes: You instantly recall a memory from one of your countless past lives that heightens your awareness of your surroundings and quickens your response.
feats.trigger: You're about to roll initiative.

feats.name: All This Will Happen Again
feats.notes: Even in the face of overwhelming tribulation, you find solace in the notion that this feeling is fleeting; all things are merely part of a never-ending cycle.
feats.trigger: You fail or critically fail a Will save against an emotion effect.

feats.name: Allegro
feats.notes: You can quicken your allies with a fast-paced performance.

feats.name: Alloy Flesh and Steel
feats.notes: Elemental energy replaces every cell of your body with raw metal.

feats.name: Alluring Performance
feats.notes: You command the attention of those around you with an elegant display.

feats.name: Ally's Shelter
feats.notes: You follow your allies' example.
feats.trigger: You attempt a saving throw while adjacent to one or more allies, but you haven't rolled yet.

feats.name: Along the Deep River
feats.notes: Once per year, when you die, you turn into an immaterial ball of light.
feats.access: Tian Xia origin, or you're a follower of Sangpotshi .

feats.name: Alter Admixture
feats.notes: Sometimes, you need to adapt your alchemical mixtures to new situations.

feats.name: Alter Ego Dedication
feats.notes: You make yourself into a living mirror, becoming a double of someone unremarkable, and you slip into exactly the role that can get you past security or into a sensitive facility.
feats.prerequisite: Trained in Deception; Trained in Stealth

feats.name: Alter Resistance
feats.notes: You focus on your protean forebears to change your energy resistance.
feats.trigger: You take acid , electricity , or sonic damage.

feats.name: Always Ready
feats.notes: Extensive training against undead has taught you to cover your weak points, even when you think that you're alone.

feats.name: Amalgamate
feats.notes: You create a single mighty abomination using the pieces of two expendable thralls.

feats.name: Ambersoul
feats.notes: Your elemental heritage is reflected in the oils and fragrances of plants, in tree resin that fossilizes into amber, or in the gentle smell of a flower.

feats.name: Ambush Awareness
feats.notes: You gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Perception checks attempted as initiative rolls.

feats.name: Ambush Bladderwort
feats.notes: You plant the seed of a giant bladderwort in an unoccupied square of ground or water within 30 feet.

feats.name: Ambush Hunter
feats.notes: You are always searching for the perfect opportunity to ambush your enemies.

feats.name: Ambush Tactics
feats.notes: You've made a study of the best practices for laying ambushes in terrains you've spent time learning about, be it the best way to ambush foes or the best methods of reacting to surprise attacks in those terrains.
feats.prerequisite: trained in Lore about a specific terrain

feats.name: Ambushing Knockdown
feats.notes: You emerge from hiding and deliver a blow that can knock an enemy sprawling to the ground.
feats.access: Side with the Washboard Dogs in the gang conflict.

feats.name: Ammunition Thaumaturgy
feats.notes: You're so used to handling your implement, weapon, and esoterica in the heat of combat that adding a few bullets or arrows to the mix is no extra burden.

feats.name: Among Humanity
feats.notes: Your talents in shapechanging allow you to pass unseen.

feats.name: Amorphous Aspect
feats.notes: Your body is supremely flexible.

feats.name: Amp Focus
feats.notes: You've glimpsed the furthest recesses of your mind.

feats.name: Amphibious Form
feats.notes: Your eidolon adapts to life on land and underwater.

feats.name: Amplifying Touch
feats.notes: Your healing energies empower attacks.

feats.name: Anadi Lore
feats.notes: You've learned how to provide for your community, be it through hard-earned sustenance or useful crafts.

feats.name: Analyze Idiolect
feats.notes: You break down a specific individual’s idiolect, memorizing their speech mannerisms and habits.
feats.prerequisite: Linguist Dedication; Expert in Deception; Expert in Society

feats.name: Analyze Information
feats.notes: You can stoke your mind into a burst of analytical prowess.

feats.name: Analyze Magic
feats.notes: Your intuitive understanding of magic allows you to read the energy of a spell in the air.

feats.name: Analyze Weakness
feats.notes: Your knowledge of a creature’s physiology helps you attack with pinpoint accuracy.

feats.name: Anarchic Arcana
feats.notes: The magic in your blood is unpredictable.

feats.name: Anatomical Quartering
feats.notes: You briefly separate into four forms that share your space.

feats.name: Ancestor's Rage
feats.notes: You transform into an enormous, otherworldly hyena.

feats.name: Ancestor's Transformation
feats.notes: You can commune with ancestor spirits to assume the form of an enormous primeval strix.

feats.name: Ancestral Blood Magic
feats.notes: The magic of your bloodline mixes with that of your ancestry.

feats.name: Ancestral Form
feats.notes: Casting your memory back deep into the past, you take the form of an ancestral guardian.
feats.prerequisite: Bakuwa Lizardfolk heritage or Makari Lizardfolk heritage

feats.name: Ancestral Healer
feats.notes: Following the traditions of those who came before you, you’ve learned how to banish effects that cloud the mind, body, and spirit.

feats.name: Ancestral Insight
feats.notes: You have extensive knowledge of your ancestors' ancient origins.

feats.name: Ancestral Linguistics
feats.notes: Over your extensive lifespan, you've studied many languages.

feats.name: Ancestral Longevity
feats.notes: You have accumulated a vast array of lived knowledge over the years.

feats.name: Ancestral Mage
feats.notes: The magic of your ancestry and bloodline are one and the same.

feats.name: Ancestral Mind
feats.notes: By unraveling memories and connections passed down from your progenitors and buried within your unconscious mind, you learn to convert your inherent magic into psychic power.

feats.name: Ancestral Paragon
feats.notes: Gain a 1st-level ancestry feat

feats.name: Ancestral Suspicion
feats.notes: Long-lived elves have seen civilizations rise and fall, often at the hands of outside forces. As a result, they have developed a wariness of others who might seek to influence or control them.

feats.name: Anchor Stance
feats.notes: You tense your muscles to make yourself neutrally buoyant and more difficult to move.

feats.name: Anchoring Arrow
feats.notes: You can prevent demonic foes from fleeing your wrath via teleportation .

feats.name: Anchoring Roots
feats.notes: Small roots sprout from your feet, steadying you as you move.

feats.name: Ancient Memories
feats.notes: In the long years since Ghorus's day, you've done pretty much everything at one time or another.

feats.name: Ancillary Motes
feats.notes: You can use Crystalline Dust one more time per day.

feats.name: And Will Do So Once More
feats.notes: You’ve learned how to let go of most worries and move past them.

feats.name: Android Lore
feats.notes: You have a keen interest in the origins of your people.

feats.name: Angel of Death
feats.notes: All your Strikes against a creature you have Marked for Death have the death trait, causing the mark to be instantly killed when reduced to 0 Hit Points.

feats.name: Angel of Vindication
feats.notes: To aid with your mission of destroying undead, you've specialized in techniques to destroy them, much as other assassins learn to kill the living.
feats.access: Knights of Lastwall have access to this feat.

feats.name: Angelkin
feats.notes: You descend from an angel, a winged messenger from Nirvana or one of the other celestial realms.

feats.name: Animal Accomplice
feats.notes: You build a rapport with an animal, which becomes magically bonded to you.

feats.name: Animal Actor
feats.notes: You participated in a performance of The Leaping Lion , a play focusing on Cyricas, the animal-loving adventurer who traveled with his ape friend Mardu and remains a favorite hero among Taldan youth.

feats.name: Animal Companion
feats.notes: You gain the service of a young animal companion (page 206) that travels with you on your adventures and obeys any simple commands you give it to the best of its abilities.

feats.name: Animal Elocutionist
feats.notes: You hear animal sounds as conversations instead of unintelligent noise, and you can respond in turn.

feats.name: Animal Empathy (Druid)
feats.notes: You have a connection to the creatures of the natural world that allows you to communicate with them on a rudimentary level.

feats.name: Animal Empathy (Ranger)
feats.notes: You have a connection to the creatures of the natural world that allows you to communicate with them on a rudimentary level.

feats.name: Animal Fleetness
feats.notes: You're adept at using your animal shape's natural means of locomotion.

feats.name: Animal Magic
feats.notes: Your shapeshifting grants you a magical connection to the animal world.

feats.name: Animal Rage
feats.notes: You transform into your animal.

feats.name: Animal Senses
feats.notes: You gain one of the following senses available to your inherent animal: darkvision, low-light vision, or scent (imprecise) 30 feet.

feats.name: Animal Shape
feats.notes: You have full control over your shape and can transform into your inherent animal.

feats.name: Animal Skin
feats.notes: Your proficiency in unarmored defense increases to expert.

feats.name: Animal Soul Siblings
feats.notes: Your eyes have been opened to the spiritual essence suffusing the world.

feats.name: Animal Speaker
feats.notes: You can speak to all animals, not just a particular subset.
feats.prerequisite: ability to communicate with some type of animals (such as bats or arthropods)

feats.name: Animal Strength
feats.notes: You tap into the primal strength of your animal feature .

feats.name: Animal Summoner
feats.notes: The connection between you and primal magic deepens.

feats.name: Animal Swiftness
feats.notes: You move like an animal.

feats.name: Animal Trainer Dedication
feats.notes: You gain a young animal companion.
feats.source: Pathfinder #152: Legacy of the Lost God

feats.name: Animalistic Brutality
feats.notes: You deepen the connection into your animal instincts.

feats.name: Animalistic Resistance
feats.notes: Your animalistic connections help you resist natural afflictions.

feats.name: Animate Net
feats.notes: When you cast animate rope , you can modify it to animate a net.
feats.prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _animate rope_

feats.name: Animist Dedication
feats.notes: You have formed a bond with an apparition and can cast divine spells.

feats.name: Animist's Power
feats.notes: You gain one animist feat.

feats.name: Ankle Bite
feats.notes: Whenever someone grabs onto you, you instinctively bite down hard.
feats.prerequisite: Fang Sharpener or Razortooth Goblin heritage
feats.trigger: A foe gives you the grabbed or restrained condition using a part of its body.

feats.name: Ankle Biter
feats.notes: You fight just as well on the ground as you do standing up.

feats.name: Annihilating Compound Invocation
feats.notes: Each tradition of magic holds sway over two of the four essences that make up all of creation, and so by invoking runes from each tradition at once, you can pull from the four corners of magic to unravel anything.

feats.name: Annihilating Swing
feats.notes: You have embraced brute destructive power.

feats.name: Annotate Composition
feats.notes: By putting composition to paper, you can create a source of stirring words or song that others can read and understand.

feats.name: Anoint Ally
feats.notes: You forge a mystical connection with an ally using a drop of your blood, allowing them to benefit from your magic.

feats.name: Antagonize
feats.notes: Your taunts and threats earn your foes' ire.

feats.name: Anthemic Performance
feats.notes: Your music, speech, or other performance inspires your allies to dive into battle.

feats.name: Anthropomorphic Shape
feats.notes: Humanoids’ supposed place apart from animals is folly—taking on their forms just requires some extra practice.

feats.name: Anticipate Ambush
feats.notes: You keep watch for any hidden creatures or dangerous sites, moving at half your travel Speed.

feats.name: Antler Rush
feats.notes: Stride twice.

feats.name: Apex Companion
feats.notes: Gain the apex companion focus spell.

feats.name: Aphet Flash
feats.notes: Your swarm can emit a bright flash, much like aphet beetles, a genus of flash beetles once used by Osirian miners as sources of light.

feats.name: Apocalypse Rider Dedication
feats.notes: In the darkest hour of the night, a fearsome and terrible steed arrives as a gift from a powerful daemonic patron.

feats.name: Apocalyptic Visions
feats.notes: Your runelord may not have lived long enough to need to retreat into hiding in the face of Earthfall, but the apocalyptic echoes of this event nevertheless reached their soul all the way in the Boneyard.
feats.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star

feats.name: Apparition Cloud
feats.notes: With a mere thought, you discorporate your familiar into a thousand shards of spiritual magic, protecting both it and yourself from physical harm while making it difficult for enemies to move near you.
feats.trigger: You are targeted by an attack.

feats.name: Apparition Magic
feats.notes: You can cast more divine spells each day.

feats.name: Apparition Sense
feats.notes: You can see and interact with things others can’t.

feats.name: Apparition Stabilization
feats.notes: Your attuned apparition ensures that even if you would be distracted or disrupted , your magic does not go to waste.

feats.name: Apparition's Enhancement
feats.notes: Spiritual power encases your weapon or unarmed attack.

feats.name: Apparition's Quickening
feats.notes: If your next action is to cast a cantrip or a spell that is at least 2 ranks lower than the highest-rank spell slot you have, you can draw power from one of your attuned apparitions to reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (minimum 1 action).

feats.name: Apparition's Reflection
feats.notes: Your apparition infuses your body with additional power.

feats.name: Appraiser's Eye
feats.notes: You have experience handling and evaluating magical items, which are common in merfolk society.

feats.name: Apprentice Sea Witch
feats.notes: You're familiar with the basic spells that most educated merfolk know.

feats.name: Aquatic Adaptation
feats.notes: If you and up to four other creatures are in contact with a body of water deep enough for you to fully submerge, you can spend 10 minutes adapting the creatures to that specific body of water.

feats.name: Aquatic Camouflage
feats.notes: You blend into the waves.

feats.name: Aquatic Conversationalist
feats.notes: You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with animals with the amphibious or aquatic traits.

feats.name: Aquatic Elf Warrior
feats.notes: You have trained in the use of weapons both above and below water.

feats.name: Aquatic Eyes
feats.notes: As your connection to water grows, you can see more easily in places with less light, such as the depths of the ocean.

feats.name: Aquatic Passage
feats.notes: You can move through water as easily as you walk on land.

feats.name: Aquatic Pirouette
feats.notes: You spin in the water to avoid the attack.
feats.trigger: A creature targets you with a ranged attack and you can see the attacker.

feats.name: Aqueous Dragonblood
feats.notes: Your blood surges with the might of dragons who master the waters, and you can move freely in their domain.

feats.name: Arboreal Conversationalist
feats.notes: With your close connection to primal energies and the First World, you can communicate with trees.
feats.prerequisite: Kijimuna Gnome heritage or at least one primal innate spell from a gnome heritage or feat
feats.access: kijimuna gnome heritage or Tian Xia origin

feats.name: Arc of Destruction
feats.notes: You redirect an incoming weapon or projectile and send your enemy’s own attack roaring back at them, increasing its accuracy with a surge of mythic power.
feats.trigger: An enemy you’re observing targets you with a ranged weapon Strike .

feats.name: Arcana of Iron
feats.notes: You eschew wands and staves for more advanced weaponry.

feats.name: Arcane Breadth
feats.notes: Your thorough studies allow you to cast more arcane spells each day.

feats.name: Arcane Camouflage
feats.notes: You have developed magical techniques to aid you with stalking your prey.

feats.name: Arcane Communication
feats.notes: You can deliver silent messages.

feats.name: Arcane Dragonblood
feats.notes: You descend from a dragon that wields mastery of their magical abilities, such as a fortune dragon or mirage dragon .

feats.name: Arcane Evolution
feats.notes: Your arcane legacy allows you to perceive how magic affects everything.

feats.name: Arcane Eye
feats.notes: Your eye has been magically enhanced to pierce darkness.

feats.name: Arcane Fists
feats.notes: Your physical training encompasses unarmed combat forms.

feats.name: Arcane Locomotion
feats.notes: You've modified your body to allow you to augment your movement.

feats.name: Arcane Propulsion
feats.notes: You redirect energy from your core to ports on your back or feet, allowing you to fly for a short time.

feats.name: Arcane Safeguards
feats.notes: The magic powering you makes it difficult for outside magic to affect you.

feats.name: Arcane School Spell
feats.notes: You gain your school’s initial school spell.

feats.name: Arcane Sense
feats.notes: Cast detect magic at will as an arcane innate spell

feats.name: Arcane Sensitivity
feats.notes: You can sense the presence of the supernatural, even if you don't have any magical ability yourself.
feats.source: Pathfinder #157: Devil at the Dreaming Palace

feats.name: Arcane Shroud
feats.notes: Your magic has a powerful aftereffect, briefly granting you a certain spell.

feats.name: Arcane Sight
feats.notes: You've trained yourself to constantly be on the lookout for magical effects, even when focusing on looking out for other things.
feats.prerequisite: ability to cast the _detect magic_ cantrip

feats.name: Arcane Slam
feats.notes: You channel magical power from your core into your arm, empowering your attack as you attempt to slam your foe into the ground.

feats.name: Arcane Tattoos
feats.notes: You have tattoos on your body corresponding to one of the ancient Thassilonian schools of magic.
feats.access: Varisian ethnicity or New Thassilon nationality

feats.name: Archaeologist Dedication
feats.notes: You are a student of peoples and their histories, and are in constant pursuit of knowledge and artifacts from the past.
feats.prerequisite: Trained in Society; Trained in Thievery

feats.name: Archaeologist's Luck
feats.notes: You are more than just skillful; your drive to find the secrets of the past manifests as a strange kind of luck.
feats.trigger: You fail a check against a trap, such as a Thievery check to Disable the trap or a Reflex save to avoid its effects.

feats.name: Archaeologist's Warning
feats.notes: You visually or audibly warn your companions of danger, granting them a +1 circumstance bonus to their initiative rolls.
feats.trigger: You are about to roll a Perception, Society , or Thievery check for initiative.

feats.name: Archer Dedication
feats.notes: You have familiarity with all weapons in the bow and crossbow weapon groups.

feats.name: Archer's Aim
feats.notes: You slow down, focus, and take a careful shot.

feats.name: Archfiend Dedication
feats.notes: Driven by your Calling, you’ve begun to make plans for your own personal realm from whence you’re destined to rule over an army of fiends.

feats.name: Architect of Flame
feats.notes: Flames rise and shape to your will, forming a wall or dome of your design.

feats.name: Archwizard's Might
feats.notes: You have mastered the greatest secrets of arcane magic.

feats.name: Ardent Armiger
feats.notes: You've trained to resist the manipulations of fiends , and your Hellknight discipline makes you difficult to influence.

feats.name: Area Armor
feats.notes: The armor you wear protects you and shelters your allies against explosions and other large-scale assaults.

feats.name: Arise, ye Worthy!
feats.notes: A touch of valkyrie magic in your blood lets you hold back death’s grasp.

feats.name: Aristocratic Arms
feats.notes: Through consistent (and often punishing) practice, you’ve learned how to use your house’s preferred weapons.

feats.name: Armament Paragon
feats.notes: Add the following property runes to the list you can choose for your blessed armament: animated, greater fearsome , grievous , keen , and greater vitalizing .

feats.name: Armed and Armored
feats.notes: You're used to juggling defensive equipment and your firearms.
feats.prerequisite: Golden Legionnaire Dedication; trained in martial firearms

feats.name: Armiger's Protection
feats.notes: You've learned to wear the iconic Hellknight armor.

feats.name: Armor Assist
feats.notes: You are practiced in helping yourself and others don heavy gear.
feats.prerequisite: Trained in Warfare Lore or Trained in Athletics

feats.name: Armor Break
feats.notes: You flex your muscles to crack your damaged armor, blasting jagged shards into nearby enemies.

feats.name: Armor in Earth
feats.notes: Stone encases you like armor.

feats.name: Armor Proficiency
feats.notes: Become trained in a type of armor

feats.name: Armor Regiment Training
feats.notes: You've trained for grueling marches in full battle kit.

feats.name: Armor Rune Shifter
feats.notes: You learn the secrets of armor runes by viewing them through gems and can alter them at your discretion.
feats.source: Pathfinder #148: Fires of the Haunted City

feats.name: Armor Specialist
feats.notes: You have trained hard to optimize your armor's unique protective qualities to maximize the materials used in its creation.

feats.name: Armored Counterattack
feats.notes: With the might of your armor behind you, you hit back at a foe who would dare try to hurt your allies.
feats.trigger: You use Intercept Attack against a melee Strike and are adjacent to the creature that made the Strike.

feats.name: Armored Courage
feats.notes: You take comfort in the safety of your armor.

feats.name: Armored Exercise
feats.notes: You've spent time training in your armor alongside other agents from the Swords.
feats.prerequisite: Swordmaster Dedication; trained in light, medium, or heavy armor

feats.name: Armored Rebuff
feats.notes: You rebuff puny attacks with your armor, knocking back your foe.
feats.trigger: An adjacent enemy critically fails an attack roll to Strike you with a melee weapon or unarmed attack.

feats.name: Armored Resistance
feats.notes: While you are wearing medium or heavy armor, you gain resistance to physical damage equal to half your character level when you use the Intercept Attack reaction to take damage instead of your ally.

feats.name: Armored Rest
feats.notes: You've slept many nights in your armor and gotten used to it.
feats.prerequisite: Swordmaster Dedication; trained in light, medium, or heavy armor

feats.name: Armored Stealth
feats.notes: You have learned techniques to adjust and modify your armor and movements to reduce the noise you make.

feats.name: Arms that Cut the Waves
feats.notes: River, lake, sea, or ocean, the water calls to you, and you don’t fear its depths.

feats.name: Army of One
feats.notes: Even alone, you’re a force to be reckoned with— an army of one, so long as you have your celestial armaments.

feats.name: Aroden's Innovation
feats.notes: As befits the god of humanity and innovation, Aroden left teachings that continue to inspire.

feats.name: Artery Map
feats.notes: While you’ve learned all the places a scalpel can cause extensive bleeding to avoid disasters in surgery, such knowledge can serve other purposes.

feats.name: Artillerist Dedication
feats.notes: Artillery is a team sport, where every member of the crew has to rely on the other members.

feats.name: Artisanal Crafter
feats.notes: Like many minotaurs, you take pride in creating items made from stone or metal.

feats.name: Artist's Attendance
feats.notes: Your runes call you to better attend to your art.

feats.name: Artokus's Fire
feats.notes: Artokus developed a mixture of volatile materials that burns hotter and longer than typical alchemist's fire.
feats.trigger: You use Quick Alchemy to craft an alchemist's fire , and that bomb's level is at least 2 levels lower than your advanced alchemy level.

feats.name: As a Thousand Soldiers
feats.notes: Though you may have stolen from the hive, you’ve nothing but respect for the armies guarding it, and you borrow their strength to overwhelm your foes.
feats.source: Pathfinder #217: Death Sails a Wine-Dark Sea

feats.name: As in Life, So in Death
feats.notes: Specific memories of your old life are hard to hold onto, but you know things without remembering why.

feats.name: As on the Board, so on the Battlefield
feats.notes: You’re a master of strategy games, able to translate strategies and mechanics from these games to the actual battles they were created to simulate.

feats.name: Ascend
feats.notes: As you strive to ascend to the ranks of celestials, the pull of gravity loosens on your body.

feats.name: Ascendant Blood
feats.notes: Twice per week, you can cast interplanar teleport as an innate spell of the tradition corresponding to your draconic exemplar.
feats.prerequisite: draconic exemplar associated with a specific plane (such as a diabolic dragon or empyreal dragon)

feats.name: Ascended Celestial Dedication
feats.notes: Your Calling has driven you to perform mortal deeds that will result in your ascension to the ranks of celestials.

feats.name: Ascended Dragonet Heritage
feats.notes: You’ve awoken the power of your draconic heritage.

feats.name: Ash Strider
feats.notes: You discorporate into a cloud of whirling ash and Stride.

feats.name: Ash-piercing Gaze
feats.notes: Neither cinders nor winds shall prevent you from seeing those who need help.

feats.name: Ashen Veil
feats.notes: By smearing ash or tainted earth over your skin and armor, you shroud yourself from the dead.
feats.prerequisite: Knight Reclaimant Dedication; Expert in Religion; Master in Stealth

feats.name: Ask the Bones
feats.notes: You keep the bone of an ancestor or a friend to call upon for advice.

feats.name: Assassin Dedication
feats.notes: You've trained to assassinate your foes, and you do so with tenacity and precision.
feats.prerequisite: Trained in Deception; Trained in Stealth

feats.name: Assassinate
feats.notes: You strike with one swift movement, trying to instantly slay your mark.

feats.name: Assisting Shot
feats.notes: Using your last shot to gauge your accuracy, you can fire off a quick shot to interfere with a foe in combat.

feats.name: Assume Earth's Mantle
feats.notes: Enormous pieces of rock cluster around your body.

feats.name: Assume Godhood
feats.notes: You complete your apotheosis into living godhood, allowing you to empower more followers.

feats.name: Assurance
feats.notes: Receive a fixed result on a skill check
feats.prerequisite: trained in at least one skill

feats.name: Assured Identification
feats.notes: You rarely misidentify an item.
feats.prerequisite: Expert in Arcana, Expert in Nature, Expert in Occultism, or Expert in Religion

feats.name: Assured Knowledge
feats.notes: You can procure information with confidence.

feats.name: Assured Ritualist
feats.notes: You can cover for a secondary caster's error.

feats.name: Astonishing Explosion
feats.notes: Your bomb incorporates an explosive spark of wonder that leaves witnesses dumbfounded.
feats.trigger: You use Quick Alchemy to craft an alchemical bomb that deals splash damage and is at least 2 levels lower than your advanced alchemy level.

feats.name: Astral Blink
feats.notes: You've attuned your core to allow you to phase in and out of the Astral Plane, allowing you to teleport periodically.

feats.name: Astral Compound Invocation
feats.notes: Invoking runes from two schools of magic that both manipulate the intangible realm of thought results in waves of mental interference that stagger your foes.

feats.name: Astral Tether
feats.notes: You spin out a thread of psychic energy that connects you to an ally, using it as a conduit for your abilities.

feats.name: Asura Magic
feats.notes: You can cast blood vendetta and death knell once per day each as 2nd-level divine innate spells.

feats.name: Athamaru Lore
feats.notes: You've immersed yourself in community learning, particularly around navigating the waters and tending to animals.

feats.name: Athamaru Weapon Familiarity
feats.notes: You wield weapons designed to work underwater with ease.

feats.name: Athlete's Ally
feats.notes: You channel the power of your warshard through your weapon to better perform athletic maneuvers.
feats.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star

feats.name: Athletic Might
feats.notes: Surviving in hostile terrain has given you a great talent for mobility.

feats.name: Athletic Strategist
feats.notes: You know how to calculatedly manipulate joints and body weight.

feats.name: Attuned Electroreceptors
feats.notes: You grow specialized organs that allow you to detect even the faintest of heartbeats.

feats.name: Attuned Stride
feats.notes: You can move freely through terrain you're attuned to.

feats.name: Attunement Shift
feats.notes: The magic of your spell floods into you, overriding your connection to the land around you.

feats.name: Attunement to Stone
feats.notes: You can feel vibrations through the ground.

feats.name: Augment Senses
feats.notes: You open vestigial eyes, unfurl tympanic flaps of skin, or otherwise enhance your senses.

feats.name: Aura Enhancement
feats.notes: You’ve enhanced your training with your battle magic, allowing you access to a more potent divine font.

feats.name: Aura Expertise
feats.notes: You’ve become so accustomed to maintaining your battle auras that it’s become second nature to you.
feats.trigger: Your turn begins

feats.name: Aura of Confidence
feats.notes: Your will and your faith in your nation is unassailable, and the feeling is contagious.

feats.name: Aura of Courage
feats.notes: You stand strong in the face of danger and inspire your allies to do the same.

feats.name: Aura of Despair
feats.notes: Your presence as an avatar of evil makes your foes more susceptible to terror and makes it almost impossible for them to shake off fear when you are near.

feats.name: Aura of Determination
feats.notes: Your aura protects against powers that would twist the mind and body.

feats.name: Aura of Faith
feats.notes: You radiate an aura of belief that imbues your attacks and those of nearby allies with divine power.

feats.name: Aura of Life
feats.notes: Your aura protects against the power of the Void.

feats.name: Aura of Preservation
feats.notes: Your aura protects against the twisting powers of aberrations.

feats.name: Aura of Righteousness
feats.notes: Your righteous aura dampens evil's might and prevents the unholy from escaping you.

feats.name: Aura of Unbreakable Virtue
feats.notes: Overwhelm evil creatures with your aura.

feats.name: Aura of Vengeance
feats.notes: When you call upon others to take retribution, you also guide their aim.

feats.name: Aura Shaping
feats.notes: You control the size of your kinetic aura.

feats.name: Aura Sight
feats.notes: You've learned how to read the natural auras of other living creatures.

feats.name: Aurochs-Headed
feats.notes: Your words and body language can subconsciously unsettle orcs, giving you an advantage when convincing them to see things your way.
feats.prerequisite: Trained in Diplomacy or Trained in Intimidation

feats.name: Auspicious Mount
feats.notes: Guided by your ongoing care, your steed has developed incredible intelligence and skill.

feats.name: Automatic Knowledge
feats.notes: Recall Knowledge as a free action once per round
feats.prerequisite: expert in a skill with the Recall Knowledge action; Assurance in that skill

feats.name: Automatic Psychic Action
feats.notes: Your power wants to be free.

feats.name: Automatic Writing
feats.notes: When confronted with the unknown, you can receive knowledge beyond your own experience via written messages delivered by your hand.

feats.name: Automaton Armament
feats.notes: You've been provided a body part designed for combat.

feats.name: Automaton Lore
feats.notes: You have come to better understand the process that made your body and the magic that powers it.

feats.name: Autonomous Arms
feats.notes: A portion of the ancient grasping spirit that infuses your being spills over into a spear or polearm you carry.
feats.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star
feats.prerequisite: Avenging Runelord Dedication; expert proficiency in a spear or polearm

feats.name: Avalanche Strike
feats.notes: You attack all nearby adversaries.

feats.name: Avatar's Audience
feats.notes: Your extensive service affords you certain divine privileges.

feats.name: Avatar's Protection

feats.name: Blaze of Revelation
feats.notes: Your mind and body can, for a short time and with great peril, surpass the final limits of your curse.

feats.name: Blazing Aura
feats.notes: You explode in flame.
feats.trigger: Your turn begins.

feats.name: Blazing Spirit
feats.notes: Your apparition grants fiery defenses.
feats.trigger: A creature damages you with a melee attack

feats.name: Blazing Streak
feats.notes: Stride twice, making Strikes against up to four different creatures within reach at any point during your movement.

feats.name: Blazing Talon Surge
feats.notes: You rush forward and latch onto your enemy with talons of hungering fire.

feats.name: Blazing Wave
feats.notes: Flames flow out of you in a cascade, engulfing everyone in a 30-foot cone.

feats.name: Bleak Humorist
feats.notes: You’ve watched dozens of morbid comedies depicting Beldam I, Taldor’s prankster emperor whose wife accidentally killed him when she struck him with a marble bust after he jumped out from behind curtains to frighten her.
feats.trigger: You are reduced to 0 Hit Points by a creature within 30 feet, but not immediately killed

feats.name: Bleed Out
feats.notes: You channel the residual energy from the last spell you cast into a ranged bloodletting.

feats.name: Bleeding Finisher
feats.notes: Your blow inflicts profuse bleeding.

feats.name: Bless Shield
feats.notes: Your uttered prayers become an aegis, drawing the blessing of your deity across the surface of your shield.
feats.prerequisite: Lastwall Sentry Dedication; you worship a good-aligned deity

feats.name: Bless Tonic
feats.notes: You channel positive energy into restoratives that ward against harm
feats.prerequisite: Master in Crafting; deity who grants _heal_ divine font

feats.name: Bless Toxin
feats.notes: You pour negative energy into toxins you create to further debilitate your targets
feats.prerequisite: Master in Crafting; deity who grants _harm_ divine font

feats.name: Blessed Blood (Nephilim)
feats.notes: Your spilled blood is sanctified, with effects similar to those of holy water .

feats.name: Blessed Blood (Sorcerer)
feats.notes: Your deity’s blessings manifest in your blood-borne power
feats.prerequisite: bloodline that grants divine spells; you follow a deity

feats.name: Blessed Counterstrike
feats.notes: You call upon divine power and make a weapon or unarmed Strike against the enemy who triggered your champion's reaction.
feats.prerequisite: champion’s reaction that grants an ally resistance to an enemy’s damage (including the grandeur, justice, liberation, and redemption causes)

feats.name: Blessed Denial
feats.notes: You exude peace and protection, lessening a harmful condition as it falls upon an ally.
feats.trigger: An ally within 30 feet would become frightened , drained , enfeebled , sickened , or stupefied .

feats.name: Blessed Medicine
feats.notes: Your experience battling undead has uniquely prepared you to fight the diseases they inflict on the survivors, and you know that leaving these maladies untreated for long will eventually lead to more undead.
feats.trigger: You fail a check to Treat a Disease that was inflicted by an undead (such as ghoul fever or mummy rot).

feats.name: Blessed One Dedication
feats.notes: You are touched by a deity and gifted with the ability to alleviate the suffering of others.

feats.name: Blessed Sacrifice
feats.notes: You gain the protector’s sacrifice domain spell

feats.name: Blessed Sentinel
feats.notes: You infuse a weapon with the blessing of Ketephys and attack.

feats.name: Blessed Spell
feats.notes: When you focus your magic on an ally, you can remove harmful conditions.
feats.prerequisite: Blessed One Dedication; Mercy; ability to cast spells from spell slots

feats.name: Blessed Thorn Strike
feats.notes: When you see a foe hurt one of your allies, your righteous retribution causes your weapon to sprout holy thorns.

feats.name: Blessing of the Sun Gods
feats.notes: The Old Sun Gods share their power with you.
feats.source: Pathfinder #172: Secrets of the Temple City

feats.name: Blind-Fight
feats.notes: Your battle instincts make you more aware of concealed and invisible opponents.

feats.name: Bloc Tactics
feats.notes: You have experience in undertaking direct action and know how to protect the identity and health of you and your allies when doing so.

feats.name: Blood and Spirit
feats.notes: Your connection to the divine has sanctified your blood, but the power only manifests when you are shedding it.

feats.name: Blood Ascendancy
feats.notes: When you would benefit from a blood magic effect through Blood Rising, you can choose to benefit from two different blood magic effects you know.

feats.name: Blood Calls Blood
feats.notes: The magical potency of your blood will not be denied.
feats.trigger: You fail a flat check to Cast a Spell or your spell would be disrupted by another creature’s reaction.

feats.name: Blood Component Substitution
feats.notes: You can bypass the need for incantations and gestures by drawing energy directly from your blood, causing you to visibly glow the color of your blood and crackle with magical energy.

feats.name: Blood Frenzy
feats.notes: Your eidolon flies into a frenzy.

feats.name: Blood in the Air
feats.notes: Once you've locked on to a target, little can obscure your aim.

feats.name: Blood Like Water
feats.notes: The watery fluid in your veins doesn’t flow in the same way as traditional blood.

feats.name: Blood Must Have Blood
feats.notes: You tap into a bottomless hunger for carnage.

feats.name: Blood Pool
feats.notes: You use the lifeblood of your enemies to heal your allies.
feats.trigger: A creature with blood within 30 feet of you dies or takes bleed damage.

feats.name: Blood Rising
feats.notes: The magic in your blood surges in response to your foe's spell.
feats.trigger: A creature targets you with a spell of the same tradition as your bloodline.

feats.name: Blood Shield
feats.notes: You raise a barrier of your own blood to protect you.

feats.name: Blood Sovereignty
feats.notes: You wield blood magic masterfully.

feats.name: Bloodletting Claws
feats.notes: Your eidolon inflicts bleeding wounds on a telling blow.

feats.name: Bloodletting Fangs
feats.notes: You emulate your vampiric parent's techniques for drawing blood from a victim.

feats.name: Bloodline Breadth
feats.notes: Your repertoire expands, and you can cast more spells of your bloodline’s tradition each day.

feats.name: Bloodline Conduit
feats.notes: Your inborn magical nature lets you redirect ambient energies to fuel your spells.

feats.name: Bloodline Focus
feats.notes: By listening to the beating of your heart, your focus recovers faster.

feats.name: Bloodline Metamorphosis
feats.notes: Swap out spells from your repertoire more easily.

feats.name: Bloodline Mutation
feats.notes: You permanently mutate to become more like the creatures of your bloodline.
feats.prerequisite: a bloodline based on a specific type of creature

feats.name: Bloodline Perfection
feats.notes: You command the ultimate powers of your bloodline and tradition.

feats.name: Bloodline Resistance
feats.notes: Your magical blood makes you more resistant to magic.

feats.name: Bloodrager Dedication
feats.notes: Drinking powerful blood has awakened magical potential within you.

feats.name: Bloodsense
feats.notes: You’re extraordinarily sensitive to the presence of blood.

feats.name: Bloodsoaked Dash
feats.notes: Injuries don’t bother you anymore—in fact, the pain invigorates you.

feats.name: Bloody Blows
feats.notes: Your lethal unarmed attacks leave bloody gouges or cause severe internal bleeding.

feats.name: Bloody Debilitation
feats.notes: Your attacks slice arteries and veins.

feats.name: Bloody Denial
feats.notes: You strike a foe with force to prevent them from reacting.

feats.name: Bloody Tendrils
feats.notes: You create three immobile tendrils made of blood that lash out at your enemies.

feats.name: Bloom Cabaret Entrance
feats.notes: In socially exclusive venues like the Ivy District's Bloom Cabaret, you've learned how to make an entrance.
feats.trigger: You’re about to roll initiative.

feats.name: Bloom of Health
feats.notes: You shout a rallying cry that inspires the well-being of your kingdom’s protectors.

feats.name: Blossoming Gore
feats.notes: You create a field of bloody roses.

feats.name: Blowgun Poisoner
feats.notes: You can capably deliver toxins with a blowgun .

feats.name: Boarding Party
feats.notes: You're practiced at scaling ships, and even a wet and slippery exterior won't stand in your way.

feats.name: Boaster's Challenge
feats.notes: You call out a foe, causing them to become flustered and easier to defeat.
feats.prerequisite: Expert in Deception, Expert in Diplomacy, or Expert in Intimidation; Firebrand Braggart Dedication

feats.name: Bodily Disintegration
feats.notes: You have such complete control of your component atoms that you can momentarily separate them far enough apart for you to pass through solid material.

feats.name: Body Barrier
feats.notes: When your allies are in danger, you don’t hesitate to take the brunt of the blow for them.
feats.trigger: You and at least one ally are in the area of an effect that requires a Reflex save.

feats.name: Body of Air
feats.notes: Your gathered air consumes your body, leaving only a cloud of living vapor.
feats.trigger: An enemy you can observe targets you with an attack or other damaging effect.

feats.name: Body Shield
feats.notes: You throw an adjacent thrall in between you and the attacker.
feats.trigger: A creature targets you with an attack , and you can see the attacker.

feats.name: Bodyguard
feats.notes: You swear a vow to protect one of your allies at all costs, regardless of the risk this might pose to you.

feats.name: Bodysnatcher
feats.notes: Your secret-stealing maggots reveal how to devour more than just the flesh and secrets of a victim; you can ingest and assume their whole physical appearance.

feats.name: Bold Defiance
feats.notes: You harden your form as you dance between shapes.
feats.trigger: You Change Shape .

feats.name: Bolera's Interrogation
feats.notes: You can force a creature to tell the truth
feats.source: Pathfinder #157: Devil at the Dreaming Palace

feats.name: Bolster Ally
feats.notes: You shout encouragement to your embattled ally.
feats.trigger: One of your allies within 30 feet is targeted by a spell or ability that allows a saving throw.

feats.name: Bolster Soul Cage
feats.notes: Your constant efforts to augment and perfect your soul cage have bolstered its efficiency.

feats.name: Bolstered Recovery
feats.notes: Whenever you rest, you recover with remarkable speed.
feats.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star

feats.name: Bombing Run
feats.notes: Using your elevation and speed to your advantage, you deliver aerial payloads with greater force.

feats.name: Bon Mot
feats.notes: You launch an insightful quip at a foe, distracting them.

feats.name: Bond Companion
feats.notes: You form a close bond with a companion, similar to that of a master and familiar, that lets you gift them with a touch of your inherent magic.

feats.name: Bond Conservation
feats.notes: By efficiently and carefully manipulating the arcane energies unleashed by your bonded item, you can conserve just enough power to cast another spell, though this second spell is slightly weaker.

feats.name: Bonded Animal
feats.notes: An animal becomes permanently easier to command

feats.name: Bonded Focus
feats.notes: Your connection to your bonded item increases your focus pool.

feats.name: Bonds of Death
feats.notes: You sway with the motions of your spells that animate the dead, channeling your power to sustain two at the same time.

feats.name: Bone Burst
feats.notes: You destroy the thrall in an explosion of bone shards that fly toward the triggering creature, dealing 2d10 piercing damage with a basic Reflex save against your spell DC.
feats.trigger: A creature adjacent to one of your thralls uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack , or leaves a square during a move action it’s using, and you are within 30 feet of the thrall.

feats.name: Bone Caller
feats.notes: Using a mixture of dinosaur bones and the bones of your ancestors to focus your magic, you animate lizards and dinosaurs to carry messages or serve as mounts.

feats.name: Bone Investiture
feats.notes: You encase yourself in spiritual dinosaur bones to become a Huge dinosaur.

feats.name: Bone Magic
feats.notes: Your connection to your iruxi ancestors manifests as a simple primal spell that you cast using a fragment of an ancestor's bones.

feats.name: Bone Missile
feats.notes: You can remove your ribs to use them as arrows or bolts.

feats.name: Bone Speaker
feats.notes: To truly understand the mechanical advantages of an undead skeleton, you must understand how it functioned in life.

feats.name: Bone Spikes
feats.notes: Sharp shards of bone tear forth from your elbows, wrists, or other parts of your body.

feats.name: Bone Swarm
feats.notes: You scatter your body and transform into a whirling storm of bones for up to 1 minute or until you spend a single action to return to your normal shape.

feats.name: Bonekeeper's Bane
feats.notes: Whenever an enemy starts its turn adjacent to you, it must attempt a Will saving throw against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is highest.

feats.name: Boneyard Acquaintance
feats.notes: Before your soul returned from death, you interacted with a host of other souls on their way to the Boneyard .

feats.name: Boneyard's Call
feats.notes: You have a powerful connection to the Boneyard and its courts, granting you the ability to travel to and from the Boneyard.

feats.name: Bony Barrage
feats.notes: You launch a massive barrage of tiny bones.

feats.name: Boost Modulation
feats.notes: You aren't satisfied with keeping to just one kind of boost from your constant tinkering, so you've learned to modulate between several possibilities at once.

feats.name: Boost Summons
feats.notes: Augmenting your eidolon extends to creatures you summon.

feats.name: Born to the Trees
feats.notes: You adapt a creature to live among the trees, improving its ability to climb , balance , and leap .

feats.name: Borrow Memories
feats.notes: Knowing how someone thinks makes it much easier to know where they'll be, or even replace them altogether.

feats.name: Borrow Time
feats.notes: You reach ahead and make use of time that's yet to be.
feats.trigger: Your turn begins.

feats.name: Borrowed Ability
feats.notes: Your touch opens a conduit into the mind of your target, the emptiness within you pulling skills and memories through

feats.name: Boulder Roll
feats.notes: Your dwarven build allows you to push foes around, just like a mighty boulder tumbles through a subterranean cavern.

feats.name: Bounce Back
feats.notes: You recover from near-death experiences with astounding resilience.
feats.trigger: You lose the dying condition

feats.name: Bounce Boost
feats.notes: You’ve learned to use your own athletic abilities and springy legs to help others who need a boost with their leaps.
feats.trigger: An adjacent ally attempts to High Jump or Long Jump .

feats.name: Bouncy Goblin
feats.notes: You have a particular elasticity that makes it easy for you to bounce and squish.

feats.name: Bound in Ice
feats.notes: You become a hybrid of your ancestry and a saumen kar.

feats.name: Boundless Reprisals
feats.notes: With a sixth sense for the flow of combat, you can quickly react to any situation as required.

feats.name: Bounty Hunter Dedication
feats.notes: When focused on finding your quarry, you’re relentless.

feats.name: Brain Drain
feats.notes: With a wresting of will, you siphon off a creature's mental energy to replenish your own.

feats.name: Brains!
feats.notes: You consume the brains of your foe, causing synapses long rotten to fire and enabling you to shake off your mental torpor.
feats.trigger: You Feast upon a humanoid's brain. The humanoid can't be mindless (or, if you're Feasting on a corpse, can't have been mindless while alive).

feats.name: Branched Tree Of Pain
feats.notes: The blade of your ikon takes one or more notches, capable of dealing mortal pain to your foes. Immanence When you Strike with the ikon, you critically succeed if you roll a 19 on the die as long as that result would be a success.

feats.name: Branding Spell
feats.notes: The flames of your magic mark a target as an enemy of order.

feats.name: Brandish Authority
feats.notes: With a terrifying pronouncement, you manifest a visible sign of your authority and fiendish power, such as a crown of flame upon your brow, a scepter forged of solidified souls, or a throne comprised of a dozen dragon skulls.

feats.name: Brandishing Draw
feats.notes: You draw and attack with the same motion.

feats.name: Brastlewark Snare Engineering
feats.notes: You've trained with the Brastlewark gnomes or studied their teachings, and learned the art of crafting their more magical snares.

feats.name: Bravo's Determination
feats.notes: Your confidence borders on self-delusion, but it keeps you going against overwhelming odds.
feats.prerequisite: Expert in Deception; Firebrand Braggart Dedication
feats.trigger: A foe’s Strike reduces you to 0 Hit Points; you were not at 1 Hit Point and you would not be killed.

feats.name: Breached Defenses
feats.notes: You can find the one weak point in a creature's scales, wards, or armor to get past its resistances.

feats.name: Break Curse
feats.notes: Use your knowledge to break curses
feats.prerequisite: Master in Occultism or Master in Religion

feats.name: Break the Causal Chain
feats.notes: Something terrible has happened.

feats.name: Break the Cycle
feats.notes: Sometimes people with no underlying quarrel have been fighting each other simply out of spite.

feats.name: Breath Control
feats.notes: Hold your breath longer and gain benefits against inhaled threats

feats.name: Breath Like Honey
feats.notes: You smell of honey and savory things.

feats.name: Breath of Calamity
feats.notes: Your roar shakes the earth and splits the heavens.

feats.name: Breath of Hungry Death
feats.notes: You have uncovered occult mysteries that allow you to unleash the devastating hunger of Kabriri upon your foes with a single exhalation, releasing a massive cloud of flesh-eating gas that glows with a sickly green light.

feats.name: Breath of the Dragon
feats.notes: You can use a powerful breath weapon, much like the dragon you emulate.

feats.name: Breath of the Dragon
feats.notes: Tapping into the physiology of your draconic ancestor, you can exhale a torrent of energy in a 15-foot cone or a 30-foot line, dealing 1d4 damage.

feats.name: Breath of Vital Ash
feats.notes: Reddish ash stains your ikon, impossible to clean off.

feats.name: Breath Unleashed
feats.notes: You’re able to channel more of your draconic benefactor’s power and focus it into your Kobold Breath, increasing its effectiveness but requiring more time to recover.

feats.name: Briar Battler
feats.notes: When you're in difficult terrain from an environmental feature, you can Take Cover , even if the feature wouldn't ordinarily be large enough for you to Take Cover.

feats.name: Bridge of Graves
feats.notes: You create a massive line of grave dirt that thralls can easily traverse.

feats.name: Bright Lion Dedication
feats.notes: You are one of the Bright Lions, part revolutionary warrior, part undercover spy.
feats.source: Pathfinder #172: Secrets of the Temple City, Legends
feats.prerequisite: member of the Bright Lions; not a worshipper of Walkena; Trained in Stealth
feats.access: Bright Lion background

feats.name: Brightness Seeker
feats.notes: Once per day, you can spend 10 minutes studying your surroundings in search of omens related to a particular course of action to cast augury as an innate divine spell.

feats.name: Brightsoul
feats.notes: The fire inside you asserts itself as beaming, radiant light.

feats.name: Brilliant Crafter
feats.notes: Your skill at crafting is unparalleled.

feats.name: Brilliant Flash
feats.notes: Your light cleanses souls of fear.

feats.name: Brilliant Vision
feats.notes: You ignore concealment from clouds, dust, fog, mist, smoke, and similarly loose matter.

feats.name: Brine May
feats.notes: Your mother was a sea hag , granting you one sea-green or blue eye.

feats.name: Brinesoul
feats.notes: Your elemental ancestor's legacy asserts itself as brackish water, like the seawater of the ocean.

feats.name: Bring into the Fold
feats.notes: Not all who oppress are irredeemable, and given encouragement and some time, they will abandon their cause and join your fight against the very system they used to uphold.

feats.name: Briny Beverage
feats.notes: You can survive off the sea as well as gain insight from its waters.

feats.name: Bristle
feats.notes: You curl into a posture that splays out your bone spines.

feats.name: Broad Snare
feats.notes: You can create longer snares for quick deployment, creating lines on the battlefield.

feats.name: Broadside Buckos
feats.notes: Shimali Manux trains every Salt Breaker to fight in the cramped quarters below deck, and you've learned how to use these techniques with your crew.
feats.access: Members of the Firebrands at the rank of second mark or higher have access to this feat.

feats.name: Broken Chain Dedication
feats.notes: Your Calling was sparked by your outrage at tyrants, after having witnessed a brutal act of oppression that you could no longer abide.

feats.name: Brutal Beating
feats.notes: Your critical hits shakes your foes’ confidence.

feats.name: Brutal Bully
feats.notes: You push your foes around and leave bruises.

feats.name: Brutal Critical
feats.notes: Your critical hits are particularly devastating.

feats.name: Brutal Crush
feats.notes: You've learned how to cloud your foes' minds with the brutal impact of your repeated attacks.

feats.name: Brutal Finish
feats.notes: Your final blow can make an impact even if it rebounds off a foe’s defenses.

feats.name: Brutish Shove
feats.notes: Using the momentum of your last attack to throw your weight into another, you make your opponent stumble back.

feats.name: Buckler Dance
feats.notes: You spin your buckler defensively toward every attack.

feats.name: Build the First Walls
feats.notes: The powers of creation that run through you allow you to conjure a temporary wall.
