feats.name: Built-In Tools
feats.notes: You've built tools into your innovation so you can access and use them easily.

feats.name: Bullet and a Broadside
feats.notes: You’re familiar with ranged weapons of all sizes, and can efficiently move to use them in tandem.
feats.access: You're from the Shackles

feats.name: Bullet Dancer Burn
feats.notes: The fiery blaze of your weapons combined with your unorthodox technique leaves your opponents with little opportunity to capitalize on any gaps in your defenses, or properly defend themselves against your onslaught.

feats.name: Bullet Dancer Dedication
feats.notes: You've learned how to synchronize traditional martial arts and guns.
feats.prerequisite: expert in unarmored defense and trained in unarmed attack

feats.name: Bullet Dancer Reload
feats.notes: You've learned to reload your simple firearms with uncanny grace, the ammunition simply falling into place as though part of a well-practiced kata.

feats.name: Bullet Split
feats.notes: You carefully align your weapon with the edge of your blade, splitting the projectile in two as you fire to attack two different targets.

feats.name: Bullseye
feats.notes: You carefully take aim to avoid your foe’s concealment and cover.

feats.name: Bullying Staff
feats.notes: You can Shove and Trip larger creatures.
feats.source: Pathfinder #151: The Show Must Go On

feats.name: Burn Identity
feats.notes: You transport yourself up to 1 mile, as a 5th-rank translocate spell.

feats.name: Burn It!
feats.notes: Fire fascinates you.

feats.name: Burning Cascade
feats.notes: Energy flares out around you when you drop into your signature stance.

feats.name: Burning Demand
feats.notes: You create a faintly glowing sigil (shedding normal light in a 5-foot radius) on the target’s body, after which you command the target to approach you, run away (as if it had the fleeing condition), release what it’s holding, drop prone , or stand in place.

feats.name: Burning Jet
feats.notes: A condensed burst of flame shoots behind you, propelling you forward with its sheer force.

feats.name: Burning Spell
feats.notes: You enhance your spell with elemental fire, causing it to set the target on fire.
feats.prerequisite: Elementalist Dedication; fire is in your elemental philosophy

feats.name: Burning Surge
feats.notes: You cause a surge of magical energy to flare up, harming that creature and those near it.
feats.trigger: A creature Casts a Spell within your spellsurge aura.

feats.name: Burrowing Form
feats.notes: Your eidolon can burrow through loose dirt.

feats.name: Burrowing Shot
feats.notes: You tune light mortar to maximize penetration into hard surfaces.

feats.name: Burrowing Tripkee
feats.notes: You’ve gotten the knack of using your oversized, webbed hands to rapidly shovel earth.

feats.name: Butterfly Blade Dedication
feats.notes: You've trained in one of Goka's oldest traditions of espionage, intimidation, and combat mastery.
feats.access: Defeat a member of the Butterfly Blades in a sanctioned bout.

feats.name: Butterfly's Kiss
feats.notes: You can make nonlethal Strikes with a butterfly sword without taking a penalty.

feats.name: Butterfly's Sting
feats.notes: You gain the sneak attack class feature.

feats.name: Buzzing Death Cicadas
feats.notes: Your swarm takes on characteristics of the death cicadas of the Mana Wastes, whose distinctive buzz is said to be a herald of imminent demise.

feats.name: By Your Name
feats.notes: In a moment of inspiration, you understand the target perfectly, allowing you to craft a rune that draws effects to the target by their very name.

feats.name: Cackle
feats.notes: Your patron’s power fills you with confidence, letting you sustain a magical working even as a quick burst of laughter leaves your lips.

feats.name: Cadence Call
feats.notes: You call out a quick cadence, guiding your allies into a more efficient rhythm.

feats.name: Cadre
feats.notes: Between your daring adventures, people seek you out.
feats.prerequisite: Captain Dedication; expert in Diplomacy or Intimidation

feats.name: Calaca's Showstopper
feats.notes: You've spent many an evening learning songs and tales featuring calacas, death's wandering minstrels.

feats.name: Calcification
feats.notes: You attempt to turn a creature into pure bone.

feats.name: Calcifying Sand
feats.notes: Your flesh gives way as you're struck, becoming coarse sand that can magically turn your enemy to stone.
feats.trigger: A creature damages you with an attack using an unarmed attack or a non-reach melee weapon.

feats.name: Calculated Splash
feats.notes: You have calculated all the angles to maximize a bomb’s splash.

feats.name: Call and Response
feats.notes: Your composition takes the form of a call-and-response chant that lets your allies continue the effect without you.

feats.name: Call Draconic Ally
feats.notes: Either by beseeching a dragon or bending it to your will, you conjure a mighty creature to assist you.

feats.name: Call from Death's Door
feats.notes: Even death halts in the face of your power.
feats.trigger: The dying condition of an ally you’re observing would increase.

feats.name: Call Gun
feats.notes: You build a powerful magical connection with a chosen gun or crossbow, gaining the ability to conjure it directly to your hand from any distant location.

feats.name: Call Implement
feats.notes: You can tug on the bonds of ownership between yourself and your implement, causing it to find its way back to you.

feats.name: Call of Elysium
feats.notes: The wild wonder of Elysium harmonizes within you, and in dire straits, you can share its benefits with your allies.

feats.name: Call of the Green Man
feats.notes: You can call forth nearby nature spirits to augment your body.

feats.name: Call of the Wild
feats.notes: You call upon the creatures of nature to come to your aid.

feats.name: Call the First Tools
feats.notes: You can call upon the ancient powers bestowed on you by the gods to create any tools you might need at a moment’s notice.

feats.name: Call The Hunt
feats.notes: You instruct your allies on how best to defeat your prey.

feats.name: Call the Hurricane
feats.notes: Massive waves spiral around you, with you as the eye of the hurricane.

feats.name: Call the Swarm
feats.notes: You give a shrill whistle and point, and a massive swarm of rats pours forth from the surrounding terrain to fill a 30-foot burst within 120 feet.

feats.name: Call the Worm
feats.notes: You gain summon animal , heightened to 9th level, as an innate primal spell that you can cast once per day, but can only summon a purple worm .
feats.source: Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm

feats.name: Call to Battle
feats.notes: You channel the undying spirit of the einherjar to join to fight.
feats.trigger: You lose the unconscious condition.

feats.name: Call Ursine Ally
feats.notes: You can cast a 3rd-rank summon animal as an innate spell, but only to summon a black bear .

feats.name: Call Wizardly Tools
feats.notes: You’re mystically connected to your wizardly tools, ensuring you can always find them when you’ve misplaced them.

feats.name: Call Worm Spirit
feats.notes: You call forth a ghostly manifestation of the worm spirit.
feats.source: Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm

feats.name: Call Your Shot
feats.notes: When you successfully Play to the Crowd, add the following to the list of benefits you can choose from: A creature you can see within 30 feet becomes frightened 2 .

feats.name: Called
feats.notes: You’ve heard the Call, and by resisting it, you’ve developed a bulwark against effects that target your mind.

feats.name: Called Shot
feats.notes: You target a specific area of your foe's anatomy to debilitating effect.

feats.name: Callow May
feats.notes: You are among the most common of changelings—those born to sweet hags—and a vibrant green eye signifies that parentage.

feats.name: Calm and Centered
feats.notes: Your occult connection to the world helps you deal with being frightened or stupefied .
feats.access: Character follows the ways of Sangpotshi or studies texts and lore containing Sangpotshi secrets

feats.name: Camoflage Coat
feats.notes: You've learned to use your natural camouflage to your advantage, enhancing your ability to blend with your surroundings through careful movements and additional markings or attire.

feats.name: Camouflage
feats.notes: You alter your appearance to blend in to the wilderness.

feats.name: Campfire Chronicler Dedication
feats.notes: You’ve gained Isthralei’s attention and can now offer stories up to him

feats.name: Can't Fall Here
feats.notes: You physically help an ally remain standing and encourage them to push through their pain against dire odds.
feats.trigger: An adjacent and willing ally would be reduced to 0 HP but not killed.

feats.name: Can't You See?
feats.notes: The eye rebels, the mind recoils—no matter how much those who can see you try to explain what's there, their friends' gazes just skitter over you, like a bird afraid to land.
feats.prerequisite: Trained in Occultism; Expert in Stealth

feats.name: Cannibalize Magic
feats.notes: The fey magic inside of you is a vital part of your body, and you can steal other sources of magic to replenish yours.

feats.name: Cannon Corner Shot
feats.notes: By loading special ammunition in a particular way, you can make your siege weapons do all manner of tricks that other siege engineers can barely even imagine.

feats.name: Cannonball Fall
feats.notes: You’ve learned how to make a quick descent with a sudden stop—directly on an enemy.
feats.prerequisite: Trained in Acrobatics or Trained in Athletics
feats.access: You're from the Shackles

feats.name: Canny Acumen
feats.notes: Become an expert in a saving throw or Perception

feats.name: Canopy Predator
feats.notes: You are as at home in the treetops as you are beneath their branches.
feats.prerequisite: Verduran Shadow Dedication; Trained in Athletics

feats.name: Canopy Sight
feats.notes: You can see equally well even in dense jungles where only a small amount of light shines through.

feats.name: Cantorian Reinforcement
feats.notes: The life energy that helped create the first hobgoblins is particularly potent in you, protecting you from ongoing maladies.

feats.name: Cantorian Rejuvenation
feats.notes: The life-giving energy that flows in your blood revitalizes you.

feats.name: Cantorian Restoration
feats.notes: The energy that flows in your blood can save a life in the direst of times.
feats.trigger: A living creature within 60 feet would die.

feats.name: Cantrip Casting
feats.notes: You increase your ability to cast simple spells.

feats.name: Cantrip Expansion
feats.notes: Study broadens your range of simple spells.
feats.source: Player Core, Player Core 2, Impossible Magic

feats.name: Cantrip Supremacy
feats.notes: You know more than most how useful even the simplest of spells can be during the course of a day.

feats.name: Captain Dedication
feats.notes: You become trained in your choice of Diplomacy or Intimidation ; if you are already trained in both of these skills, you become trained in a skill of your choice.
feats.prerequisite: Charisma +2; you don't have an animal companion, construct companion, or other companion that functions similarly

feats.name: Captivating Curiosity
feats.notes: You can snare the attentions of onlookers with your unique appearance.

feats.name: Captivating Intensity
feats.notes: Your ability to captivate others has grown, and you can use your captivator abilities more often.

feats.name: Captivator Dedication
feats.notes: Your ability to captivate others borders on the preternatural.
feats.prerequisite: Charisma +2; Trained in Deception or Trained in Diplomacy

feats.name: Capture Magic
feats.notes: When you resist a spell, you capture some of its magic for your own use.
feats.trigger: You succeed at your save against an enemy’s harmful spell, or an enemy fails a spell attack roll against you from a harmful spell.

feats.name: Caravan Leader
feats.notes: You know how to get the most effort out of your allies on the road.

feats.name: Cardinal Guardians
feats.notes: You focus your divine magic to allow your apparitions to work in concert using the magic from one to weaken an enemy against the power of the next.

feats.name: Careful Explorer
feats.notes: You gain a sixth sense for traps, noticing them even when you're not trying to.

feats.name: Caretaker's Intuition
feats.notes: Your forebears had a deep understanding of the natural world around them, and you’ve learned some of their knowledge and techniques.

feats.name: Caretaker's Restoration
feats.notes: The stewarding abilities of your forebears allows you to repair objects important to you.
feats.trigger: An item you’re holding, wearing, or wielding becomes broken but not destroyed .

feats.name: Carried with the Swarm
feats.notes: When your swarm is sharing your space and Strides, you can choose to have your swarm carry you with it.

feats.name: Cartwheel Dodge
feats.notes: You can dodge away from damaging effects.
feats.trigger: You succeed or critically succeed at a Reflex saving throw.

feats.name: Cascade Bearer's Flexibility
feats.notes: You call upon your Cascade Bearer training to help you adjust a spell for the current situation.
feats.prerequisite: Magaambyan Attendant Dedication; Cascade Bearers affiliation

feats.name: Cascade Bearer's Spellcasting
feats.notes: Your Cascade Bearer training allows you to broaden the horizons of your halcyon spells further than most Magaambyans, weaving in spiritual magic.
feats.prerequisite: Magaambyan Attendant Dedication; Cascade Bearers affiliation

feats.name: Cascade Countermeasure
feats.notes: When in Arcane Cascade, you can make yourself resistant to magic.

feats.name: Cascading Ray
feats.notes: Magical energy spills out to extend beyond the creature you struck.

feats.name: Cast Down
feats.notes: The sheer force of your faith can bring a foe crashing down.

feats.name: Cast Out
feats.notes: You attempt to cast a malevolent entity out of the creature or object it's possessing.

feats.name: Castigating Weapon
feats.notes: The force of your deity’s castigation strengthens your body so you can strike down the enemy and its allies.

feats.name: Cat Fall
feats.notes: Treat falls as shorter than they are

feats.name: Cat Nap
feats.notes: You can regain your energy quickly with a brief nap.

feats.name: Cat's Luck
feats.notes: You instinctively twist away from danger.
feats.trigger: You fail a Reflex saving throw

feats.name: Catch the Details
feats.notes: You are quick at recognizing broad details about people and things around you.

feats.name: Catchy Tune
feats.notes: You create a tune so catchy, your foes can't help but dance along.

feats.name: Caterwaul
feats.notes: You give a daring yowl, calling your companion back from the brink of unconsciousness.
feats.trigger: An ally within 30 feet would be reduced to 0 HP but not immediately killed.

feats.name: Catfolk Dance
feats.notes: You have a habit of always being in the way when other creatures attempt to move.

feats.name: Catfolk Lore
feats.notes: Growing up among catfolk has taught you the traditional values of freedom, stewardship, and quick reactions to trouble.

feats.name: Catfolk Weapon Familiarity
feats.notes: You gain access to all uncommon weapons with the catfolk trait.

feats.name: Cathartic Focus Spell
feats.notes: You learn the focus spell listed under your emotion's entry.

feats.name: Cathartic Mage Dedication
feats.notes: You've learned to harness a particular emotion and mix it into your magic.
feats.prerequisite: Charisma 14 or ability to cast spells from spell slots

feats.name: Catrina's Presence
feats.notes: You've adopted the calming presence of catrinas, the festive dead..

feats.name: Cattle Speech
feats.notes: You can understand the lowing of cattle and similar animals as its own language.

feats.name: Cauldron
feats.notes: You can brew magic in your cauldron, creating useful magical concoctions.

feats.name: Caustic Nectar
feats.notes: You have specialized glands inside your throat, which produce acidic nectar that you can spit long distances.

feats.name: Cauterize
feats.notes: You use the smoking barrel of your firearm to sear shut a bleeding wound.
feats.trigger: You're wielding a loaded firearm and you or an adjacent ally are taking persistent bleed damage .

feats.name: Cautious Curiosity
feats.notes: You've learned a few magical techniques for getting yourself both into and out of trouble unnoticed.
feats.prerequisite: at least one arcane or occult innate spell gained from a gnome heritage or gnome ancestry feat

feats.name: Cautious Delver
feats.notes: You've studied the many ways that ancient architects and spellcasters protected their possessions, such as by implementing deadly traps and curses, and learned some magic to counteract them.

feats.name: Cautious Word
feats.notes: You let your words defend you, just as your allies in the Vellumis Scholars defend through knowledge.
feats.trigger: An enemy hits you with a Strike .

feats.name: Cavalier Dedication
feats.notes: You gain a young animal companion that serves as your mount.
feats.prerequisite: Trained in Nature or Trained in Society

feats.name: Cavalier's Banner
feats.notes: You fly the banner of your pledge from your mount, raising your allies’ spirits.

feats.name: Cavalier's Charge
feats.notes: You Command an Animal to order your mount to Stride twice.

feats.name: Cave Climber
feats.notes: After years of clambering through caverns, you can climb easily anywhere you go.

feats.name: Cayden's Freedom
feats.notes: Even if you've never downed a tankard of ale nor indulged in a night of rowdy revelry, you appreciate the dedication to freedom from Cayden Cailean and his worshippers.

feats.name: Ceaseless Shadows
feats.notes: You excel at going unnoticed, especially among a crowd.

feats.name: Cel Rau
feats.notes: You are a cel rau, child of a strigoi, one of the first vampires to walk Golarion.

feats.name: Celebrity Dedication
feats.notes: The more people you have looking at you, the more content you are, and you take every opportunity to show up others when their performances are less than perfect.

feats.name: Celestial Armaments
feats.notes: You imbue a fragment of your divine spark into a weapon, blessing your blade and transforming it into a weapon worthy of the celestial realms.

feats.name: Celestial Cacophony
feats.notes: Your weapon contains a detonation chamber that launches fireworks, sparklers, and black powder pellets that sizzle, twist, and scatter on the ground in a cacophonous manner liable to annoy the entire Celestial Court.
feats.access: Tian Xia origin

feats.name: Celestial Form
feats.notes: You take on a celestial countenance, gaining the features of a type of celestial who serves your deity; for example, as an angel, you gain a halo and feathery wings.

feats.name: Celestial Magic
feats.notes: You possess celestial magic.
feats.prerequisite: Angelkin, Lawbringer, Musetouched, or or another lineage feat associated with celestials

feats.name: Celestial Mercy
feats.notes: Your celestial powers allow you to remove lesser afflictions with ease.
feats.prerequisite: Angelkin, Lawbringer, Musetouched, or another lineage feat associated with celestials

feats.name: Celestial Mount
feats.notes: Your steed gains incredible celestial powers granted by your deity.

feats.name: Celestial Rebirth
feats.notes: Through your diligence and commitment to heroics, you finally complete your apotheosis into a true celestial .

feats.name: Celestial Strikes
feats.notes: Your connection to good arms all your attacks against forces of evil.

feats.name: Cellular Reconstruction
feats.notes: Your ostilli takes control of your nervous system and kicks your cellular functions into overdrive when you're about to die.
feats.trigger: You fail a recovery check while dying .

feats.name: Cenotaph Stance
feats.notes: You take on a stance that marks your location as a place where none will fall.

feats.name: Centaur Lore
feats.notes: You've learned how to nurture your environment and to care for your people.

feats.name: Centaur Weapon Familiarity
feats.notes: You've trained in the weapons favored by your people, becoming a skilled archer and jouster.

feats.name: Ceremonial Knife
feats.notes: You have prepared a special knife to direct energies when spellcasting.

feats.name: Ceremony of Aeon's Guidance
feats.notes: Your patron aeon has allowed you to call upon their gifts to serve their ends.

feats.name: Ceremony of Aeon's Shield
feats.notes: Your patron aeon graced you with powers of protection.

feats.name: Ceremony of Fortification
feats.notes: Your exoskeleton arranges itself into an optimal defensive shape.

feats.name: Ceremony of Growth
feats.notes: You can alter your exoskeleton's size.

feats.name: Ceremony of Knowledge
feats.notes: You tap into aeon knowledge.

feats.name: Ceremony of Protection
feats.notes: You manipulate your exoskeleton to overlap itself.

feats.name: Ceremony of Sun's Gift
feats.notes: Your connection to the sun has become an unbreakable bond.

feats.name: Ceremony of Sunlight
feats.notes: You have learned how to master the power contained within sunlight, just like the trees that form your body.

feats.name: Ceremony of the Evened Hand
feats.notes: You have cultivated your exoskeleton's form for close combat, using knots, whorls, and reinforced branches.

feats.name: Ceremony of the Strengthened Hand
feats.notes: Your exoskeleton's weapons are even more potent.

feats.name: Certain Strategem
feats.notes: You know exactly where to strike a foe to target their weak spots.

feats.name: Certain Strike
feats.notes: Even when you don’t hit squarely, you can still score a glancing blow.

feats.name: Chain Infusion
feats.notes: The elemental matter in your blast keeps reconstituting itself to travel onward, no matter how many bodies it collides with.

feats.name: Chain of Words
feats.notes: You see the thin lines of magic between your creations, and you can exploit that connection with a small shift of power from one rune to another.

feats.name: Chain Reaction
feats.notes: You fire your gun once, creating a devastating and unpredictable chain of events; perhaps your bullet strikes exactly the right spot on a water tower, causing it to flood and incite a stampede of horses which knock over a lantern that sets a city on fire.

feats.name: Chaining Mutation
feats.notes: The dart fired by your ostilli can ricochet to strike another creature.

feats.name: Challenge Insight
feats.notes: Your deep grasp of the mystical lets you know exactly what to say to make others doubt how well they understand the source of their own power.
feats.trigger: A creature you can see Casts a Spell that is from the divine or occult tradition.

feats.name: Champion Dedication
feats.notes: Choose a deity.

feats.name: Champion Resiliency
feats.notes: You gain 3 additional Hit Points for each champion archetype class feat you have.
feats.prerequisite: Champion Dedication; class granting no more Hit Points per level than 8 + your Constitution modifier

feats.name: Champion's Reaction
feats.notes: You can gain and use the champion’s reaction associated with your cause

feats.name: Champion's Sacrifice
feats.notes: You can suffer so that others might live.

feats.name: Chance Death
feats.notes: Your previous life ended due to sheer poor luck, struck by lightning or choking on a fish bone.
feats.trigger: You would die as a result of a failed recovery check or saving throw.

feats.name: Change of Face
feats.notes: You know that for the best disguise to work, one requires not only the right skills but also the right look—luckily you can copy both using special magical techniques.

feats.name: Changeling Lore
feats.notes: All too aware of your true nature, you’ve studied hags and their powers.

feats.name: Channel Divine Spark
feats.notes: You embrace your divine spark, unleashing your full potential.

feats.name: Channel Rot
feats.notes: You've learned to channel your curse through weapons you wield instead of solely through your flesh.

feats.name: Channel Smite
feats.notes: You siphon the energies of life and death through a melee attack and into your foe.

feats.name: Channel the Godmind
feats.notes: You tap into the collective consciousness of the Godmind, the governing entity of axiomite society, to rapidly parse near-infinite variables to read your surroundings.

feats.name: Channeled Protection
feats.notes: Your apparition uses excess energy to protect you.

feats.name: Channeler's Stance
feats.notes: You enter a stance that allows power to flow through you.

feats.name: Channeling Block
feats.notes: You pour divine energy into a desperate block.

feats.name: Chaotic Spell
feats.notes: Your foe can hardly predict and counter your moves if you yourself have no idea what will happen.

feats.name: Charged Creation
feats.notes: Your magic is drawn to your persistent creations.

feats.name: Charlatan
feats.notes: You’ve learned to mimic the abilities of spellcasters by studying their flourishes and words

feats.name: Charmed Life
feats.notes: When danger calls, you have a strange knack for coming out on top.
feats.trigger: You attempt a saving throw, but you haven’t rolled yet.

feats.name: Charmed Sleep
feats.notes: When you sleep, you turn into an inanimate object a little smaller than a human’s thumb—easily overlooked and carried.

feats.name: Charming Liar
feats.notes: Improve a target’s attitude with your lies

feats.name: Charred Remains
feats.notes: Your next fire spell leaves embers in its wake.

feats.name: Chastise
feats.notes: With but a mere word from your deity, you exploit a foe’s fear to see their inner being brought low.

feats.name: Cheat Death
feats.notes: Somehow you always escape the reaper by a hair's breadth.
feats.trigger: You take damage that would reduce you to 0 Hit Points.

feats.name: Cheaters Always Prosper
feats.notes: You’re no champion of justice and are perfectly willing to fight dirty if it helps you survive.
feats.access: You're from the Shackles

feats.name: Cheek Pouches
feats.notes: Your cheeks are stretchy, and you can store up to four items of light Bulk or less in these cheek pouches.

feats.name: Chelaxian Scion Dedication
feats.notes: A noble house has invested in your training, imparting special techniques the family has honed over generations.
feats.access: You’re an aristocrat or honored retainer from a Chelaxian noble house.

feats.name: Chemical Contagion
feats.notes: Your injury poisons can spray onto creatures.

feats.name: Chemical Purification
feats.notes: You developed a method to chemically purify and consecrate your bombs on the fly.
feats.trigger: You use Quick Alchemy to craft an alchemist's fire or ghost charge , and that bomb's level is at least 2 levels lower than your advanced alchemy level.
feats.access: Knights of Lastwall have access to this feat.

feats.name: Chemical Trail
feats.notes: You can leave a faint chemical trail as you move and can use the chemical trails of other surkis to navigate.

feats.name: Childlike Plant
feats.notes: You’re adept at hiding your plantlike features to pass as a human.
feats.prerequisite: Chrysanthemum Leshy heritage or Peachchild Leshy heritage

feats.name: Choking Smoke
feats.notes: When you cast fireball , you can modify it to create a cloud of smoking smoke.

feats.name: Chorus Companion
feats.notes: Animals can be musical partners as much as the subjects or audience.

feats.name: Chosen of Lamashtu
feats.notes: You bear the favor and blessings of Lamashtu, the Mother of Monsters.

feats.name: Chosen Ward
feats.notes: You have designated an ally to be you and your companion’s ward, making it your primary directive to shield them from harm.

feats.name: Chromotherapy
feats.notes: You firmly believe in the technique of strengthening one's life force, spiritual energies, and bodily fluids through the application of colored light.

feats.name: Chronocognizance
feats.notes: The flows and ebbs of time are obvious to you, as are the tangles that form when it's distorted.
feats.prerequisite: Time Mage Dedication; master in Perception

feats.name: Chronomancer's Secrets
feats.notes: The secrets of time peel back, revealing deeper truths.

feats.name: Chronoskimmer Dedication
feats.notes: You became partially unstuck from time and have learned how to manipulate your place in the flow of time.

feats.name: Cindersoul
feats.notes: The fire of your elemental ancestor manifests like dying embers of a blaze, and your inner charcoal helps staunch bleeding, purify simple poisons, and absorb acid.

feats.name: Circle of Spirits
feats.notes: With a thought, word, or gesture, you reach your mind out to another spirit.

feats.name: City Scavenger
feats.notes: You know that the greatest treasures often look like refuse.

feats.name: Civil Service
feats.notes: Citizens bolster vacant leadership roles

feats.name: Claim Cardinal Domains
feats.notes: Your dominion over the divine truths of the world increases.

feats.name: Claim the Field
feats.notes: You hurl your banner forward with precision, claiming the battlefield for yourself and your allies.

feats.name: Clan Lore
feats.notes: Your identity as a member of your clan is as central to your sense of self as your dwarven ancestry.

feats.name: Clan Pistol
feats.notes: Raised in the ancient halls of Dongun Hold or the surrounding region, you display your lineage with a clan pistol, rather than a clan dagger.
feats.access: You are from Dongun Hold or Alkenstar.

feats.name: Clan Protector
feats.notes: Your clan dagger can protect your allies as easily as yourself.

feats.name: Clan's Edge
feats.notes: By moving your clan dagger with rapid precision, you can protect yourself more effectively.

feats.name: Clang!
feats.notes: You make a foe pay for attacking you as its blow or spell glances off your armor.
feats.trigger: An enemy critically misses a Strike or spell attack roll against your AC.

feats.name: Clashing Compound Invocation
feats.notes: As you invoke runes from disparate traditions of magic, their diametrically opposed effects repel each other in a destructive backlash.

feats.name: Claw and Talon Flow
feats.notes: You fluidly shift between your two stances.

feats.name: Claw Snag
feats.notes: You hook into the target, pulling yourself forward and rending flesh.
feats.trigger: A creature attempts to Escape while you have them grappled or restrained .

feats.name: Clawdancer Dedication
feats.notes: You've practiced the art of fighting with your natural claws, hooking them into prey and thrashing at targets surrounding you.
feats.prerequisite: permanent unarmed claw or talon attack (such as one granted by your ancestry or a graft)

feats.name: Claws of the Dragon
feats.notes: Your fingernails grow into razor-sharp claws, and scales speckle your fingers, hands, and wrists.

feats.name: Clean Take
feats.notes: Thanks to many long hours of rehearsals, your acting skill is infinitely adaptable.
feats.trigger: You fail, but don’t critically fail, a Deception or Performance check to portray a famous figure.

feats.name: Cleansing Light
feats.notes: A burst of light from your horn cleanses your allies of ailments and sends your foes reeling.

feats.name: Cleansing Spell
feats.notes: Infused with celestial light, your magic can more effectively heal wounds and purge afflictions.

feats.name: Cleansing Subroutine
feats.notes: Your nanites help purge your body of harmful chemicals and toxins.

feats.name: Cleansing Transformation
feats.notes: You learn to cleanse bodily toxins alongside the transformations of your shape-changing magic.

feats.name: Clear as Air
feats.notes: Compact layers of air diffract and bend light around your body, making you appear as clear as the sky on a perfect day.

feats.name: Clear the Way
feats.notes: You put your body behind your massive weapon and swing, shoving enemies to clear a wide path.

feats.name: Cleave
feats.notes: You swing clear through one foe and into another.
feats.trigger: Your melee Strike reduces an enemy to 0 Hit Points, and another enemy is adjacent to that creature.

feats.name: Cleric Dedication
feats.notes: You cast spells like a cleric.

feats.name: Clever Counterspell
feats.notes: You creatively apply your prepared spells to Counterspell a much wider variety of your opponents’ magic.

feats.name: Clever Gambit
feats.notes: Your battle tactics are aided by assessing your foe’s capabilities and range.
feats.trigger: Your Strike critically hits and deals damage to a creature you’ve identified with Recall Knowledge

feats.name: Clever Improviser
feats.notes: You’ve learned how to handle situations when you’re out of your depth.

feats.name: Clever Shadow
feats.notes: You can perform simple Interact actions with your shadow, such as opening an unlocked door.

feats.name: Climate Adaptation
feats.notes: Like evergreen trees, which stay healthy and vibrant from winter through summer, you too can adapt to a variety of extreme climates.
feats.access: Pine leshies have access to this feat

feats.name: Climbing Claws
feats.notes: You can extend your claws to aid you in climbing.

feats.name: Climbing Tail
feats.notes: Your tail makes it much easier for you to climb.

feats.name: Clinch Strike
feats.notes: Your opponents can’t slip your grasp without punishment.
feats.trigger: A creature you had grabbed or restrained successfully Escapes .

feats.name: Cling
feats.notes: You hang onto a foe to harry them into submission.

feats.name: Clinging Climber
feats.notes: You climb like a spider.

feats.name: Clinging Shadows Initiate
feats.notes: You learn a mystical stance that transforms your qi into sticky smoke that shrouds your limbs.

feats.name: Clinging to Life
feats.notes: This life still holds much for you, and you aren’t ready to fall back into the River of Souls just yet.
feats.trigger: You are reduced to 0 HP and don’t immediately die.

feats.name: Cloak of Poison
feats.notes: You secrete a cloak of concentrated poison that harms any who dare attack you.

feats.name: Cloaking Pulse
feats.notes: Your ostilli can emit illusion magic to mask your position, granting you the Drape Ambient Magic action. Drape Ambient Magic ( illusion ) Frequency once per round; Effect Your ostilli turns clear as it converts its stored magic into a bubble of refracting light around you.

feats.name: Clobber
feats.notes: With a mighty blow, you send an enemy flying backward and onto the ground.

feats.name: Clockwork Celerity
feats.notes: You can use unstable clockwork devices in your innovation to push your invention to act more quickly.
feats.trigger: Your turn begins.

feats.name: Clockwork Reanimator Dedication
feats.notes: You can animate corpses through cunning engineering.

feats.name: Clone-Risen
feats.notes: You were formed from a clone ritual or alchemical experiment.

feats.name: Close Contract
feats.notes: You’re bolstered when a plan comes together.

feats.name: Close Formation
feats.notes: You practiced fan dance as a member of a large group, coordinating your moves together to create living art and heightening your sense of spatial awareness.
feats.prerequisite: Fan Dancer Dedication; Master in Performance

feats.name: Close Quarters
feats.notes: If you're Small or smaller, you can end your movement in the same square as a Small or smaller ally.

feats.name: Clotting Elixirs
feats.notes: Your restorative concoctions have a clotting effect on the drinker's blood.

feats.name: Cloud Gazer
feats.notes: Your connection to air allows you to see through obscuring mists.

feats.name: Cloud Jump
feats.notes: Jump impossible distances

feats.name: Cloud Step
feats.notes: Using fantastic acrobatic skill, you can walk for brief stretches across insubstantial surfaces.

feats.name: Cloud Walk
feats.notes: Your growing link to cloud dragons has granted you the ability to walk on clouds.

feats.name: Clue Them All In
feats.notes: You can clue in all your allies at once.

feats.name: Coating of Slime
feats.notes: An acidic ooze coats your limbs.

feats.name: Cobble Dancer
feats.notes: You know how to take advantage of foes thrown off-balance by unstable flooring, loose cobblestones, or similar impediments.

feats.name: Cobra Envenom
feats.notes: You slightly dislocate your joints to lash out with devious intent and the power to envenom your foe.
feats.prerequisite: Cobra Stance; expert in unarmed strikes

feats.name: Cobra Stance
feats.notes: You enter a tightly coiled stance, with your hands poised as venomous fangs.

feats.name: Coerce the Current
feats.notes: With a flick of your tail, you direct the water around you to move creatures.

feats.name: Coffin Bound
feats.notes: You bind your spirit to a coffin filled with soil of your homeland, making it a place of recovery.

feats.name: Cognitive Loophole
feats.notes: You can find a loophole in a mental effect to temporarily overcome it.
feats.trigger: Your turn ends

feats.name: Cold Iron Stomach
feats.notes: You have steeled yourself against potent odors.

feats.name: Cold Minded
feats.notes: The subtle strands of beguiling magic leave little impression on your mind.

feats.name: Collapse
feats.notes: You collapse into a pile of bones, mitigating the worst of the damage you would have taken, and the triggering attack deals only the amount it would deal on a hit (typically full damage instead of double damage).
feats.trigger: An enemy's Strike against you is a critical hit.

feats.name: Collapse Armor
feats.notes: You've modified your armor innovation to collapse into a more compact form so you can don or remove it in an instant.

feats.name: Collapse Construct
feats.notes: You've modified your construct companion and built it out of light materials, enabling you to collapse it into a carrying case or other compact and innocuous form.

feats.name: Collapse Wall
feats.notes: You detonate the required bombs in order to bring a wall down on a creature.
feats.trigger: A creature moves into the bombs' splash area.

feats.name: Collateral Reinforcement
feats.notes: With a combination of bony armor, extra flesh layers, and tactical incorporeal phasing, you protect your thralls from collateral damage.

feats.name: Collateral Thrash
feats.notes: You smack the foe you're thrashing into someone else.

feats.name: Colugo's Traversal
feats.notes: Forbidding valleys and sheer cliffs can’t curb your vows to reunite the lost.

feats.name: Combat Assessment
feats.notes: You make a telegraphed attack to learn about your foe.

feats.name: Combat Climber
feats.notes: Fight more effectively as you Climb

feats.name: Combat Grab
feats.notes: Using your prior attack to shift your opponent’s guard, you take another swing and grab them.

feats.name: Combat Premonition
feats.notes: By narrowing your sense of the future, you can improve that of your allies.

feats.name: Combat Reading
feats.notes: You use a performer’s cold reading techniques, aura reading, and other tricks to discover your foe’s strengths and weaknesses.

feats.name: Combination Finisher
feats.notes: You combine a series of attacks with a powerful finishing blow.

feats.name: Combine Elixirs
feats.notes: You can add the full ingredients of a second elixir to an elixir you make to create a hybrid concoction.

feats.name: Combined Form
feats.notes: Cooperation and coordination are the secrets to getting by in tanuki society.
feats.trigger: An ally within 30 feet uses a polymorph effect.

feats.name: Come and Get Me
feats.notes: You open yourself to attacks so you can respond in turn.

feats.name: Come at Me!
feats.notes: You're a legendary duelist, welcoming all challengers, enabling you to challenge many foes even while other challenges are active.

feats.name: Come in From the Wilderness
feats.notes: A willing ally on the ground in your waking world is swaddled in earth.

feats.name: Comforting Presence
feats.notes: Your occult connection to your allies lets you take on fear and confusion they feel.
feats.trigger: An adjacent ally becomes frightened or stupefied .
feats.access: Character follows the ways of Sangpotshi or studies texts and lore containing Sangpotshi secrets

feats.name: Command Attention
feats.notes: You command the attention of all around you with style, ensuring their gaze falls only upon you until the end of your next turn.

feats.name: Command Corpse
feats.notes: You gain the Command Undead feat, but you can use it only to transform the effects of harm spells you cast on mindless undead .
feats.prerequisite: Corpse Tender Dedication; ability to cast _harm_

feats.name: Command Elemental
feats.notes: You grasp the animating force within an elemental creature and bend it to your will.

feats.name: Command Undead
feats.notes: You grasp the animating force within an undead creature and bend it to your will.

feats.name: Commander Dedication
feats.notes: You gain the tactics class feature like a commander and gain your own folio; this folio contains two common mobility or offensive tactics of your choosing.

feats.name: Commander's Companion
feats.notes: You gain the service of a young animal companion. You can affix your banner to your companion.

feats.name: Commitment to Equality
feats.notes: You help an ally shake off any impediment that would give an enemy an unfair advantage.
feats.prerequisite: Eagle Knight Dedication; Expert in Diplomacy

feats.name: Commitment to Justice
feats.notes: When your allies are harmed, you deliver retribution.

feats.name: Commitment to Liberty
feats.notes: You can’t abide when a foe has one of your allies in its grip.

feats.name: Commitment to Protection
feats.notes: You attempt to guide an ally into a more defensive pose against a particular danger.
feats.prerequisite: Golden Legionnaire Dedication; Expert in Warfare Lore

feats.name: Commitment to Valor
feats.notes: While fear might distract you from your duty, it'll never cause you to abandon it.
feats.trigger: You would gain the fleeing condition.

feats.name: Commitment to Vigilance
feats.notes: Your foes find it difficult to maneuver around you without attracting your attention.

feats.name: Communal Crafting
feats.notes: Other PCs can help you Craft

feats.name: Communal Healing
feats.notes: You’re an exceptional conduit for vitality and, as you channel it through you, you can divert some to heal yourself or another creature.

feats.name: Communal Sustain
feats.notes: Choose one spell with a sustained duration that one of your allies has in effect.

feats.name: Communal Tale
feats.notes: Stories are an experience meant to be shared as a group.
feats.source: Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind

feats.name: Community Knowledge
feats.notes: You commune with the psychic echoes of your ancestors and community, channeling their experiences into yourself.
feats.trigger: You attempt a skill check requiring 3 actions or fewer.

feats.name: Community Needs
feats.notes: You have learned to take the time needed to be flexible and to contemplate the best use of your magic for those around you.

feats.name: Community-Minded
feats.notes: You are familiar with all the members of your community and their typical movements, and you have learned how to apply these patterns outside those circles.

feats.name: Companion's Cry
feats.notes: You can urge your companion to do its utmost.

feats.name: Competitive Eater
feats.notes: Gorging on flesh after your stomach is full fortifies you, making you hardy enough to withstand more punishment.

feats.name: Complete the Hero's Journey
feats.notes: As your divine spark travels through each of your ikons in turn, it gains power, culminating its journey when it enters your third ikon.

feats.name: Compliant Gold
feats.notes: You can command your weapon to shrink or grow, for convenience or power.

feats.name: Conceal Spell
feats.notes: Through sheer mental effort, you can simplify the incantations and gestures needed to spellcast, leaving them barely noticeable.

feats.name: Concealing Currents
feats.notes: You use currents of water to conceal a projectile, preventing your enemy from predicting its trajectory.

feats.name: Concealing Legerdemain
feats.notes: Rather than hide an object somewhere the inspectors won't search, you're skilled at keeping the object on the move so it's never where they look.

feats.name: Conceited Mindset
feats.notes: Because you know your mind is superior, you scoff at anyone who would alter your mental state—but this hubris gets the better of you when you're wrong.

feats.name: Concentrated Assault
feats.notes: You and your spotter combine your efforts to bring down your target.

feats.name: Conductive Sphere
feats.notes: A floating metal ball forms in a space within 30 feet, flashing with electricity.

feats.name: Conductor's Redirection
feats.notes: You conduct electrical damage through your body.
feats.trigger: You are hit by an attack, spell, or other effect that deals electricity damage.

feats.name: Conduit of Void and Vitality
feats.notes: You use the unstable energy of your curse to manipulate the most basic of divine magic.

feats.name: Confabulator
feats.notes: Reduce the bonuses against your repeated lies

feats.name: Conflux Focus
feats.notes: You imagine how you’ll weave magic and combat into future battles, improving your focus.

feats.name: Conflux Wellspring
feats.notes: You've achieved perfect magical and physical balance, allowing magic to flow into and through you more easily.

feats.name: Confounding Image
feats.notes: When you cast mirror image , you can modify it to create a duplicate of yourself.
feats.prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _mirror image_

feats.name: Confusing Commands
feats.notes: You shout out bewildering but authoritative commands while imitating the voices, linguistic quirks, and speech patterns of your opponents.

feats.name: Conglomerate of Limbs
feats.notes: You call forth a lumbering mass of fleshy limbs.

feats.name: Conjure Hell
feats.notes: Though you might not worship Asmodeus or other devils, you've studied enough of Hell to call forth a brief burst of its fire.

feats.name: Conjurer of Corpses
feats.notes: You can call forth many kinds of undead to do your bidding.

feats.name: Conjurer's Countermeasure
feats.notes: You can make yourself resistant to damaging spells.

feats.name: Connect the Dots
feats.notes: Ephemeral connections between people, places, and concepts are invisible to most, but seeing them is your stock and trade.

feats.name: Conrasu Lore
feats.notes: You have learned about your history and your people from shapers.

feats.name: Conrasu Weapon Expertise
feats.notes: Whenever you gain a class feature that grants you expert or greater proficiency in certain weapons, you also gain that proficiency for conrasu weapons.

feats.name: Conrasu Weapon Familiarity
feats.notes: You have taken it upon yourself to learn the ways of combat to aid with your tasks, perhaps in a role as a corrector.

feats.name: Conrasu Weapon Understanding
feats.notes: You have come to know conrasu weapons as you know yourself.

feats.name: Conscious Spell Specialization
feats.notes: You become more adept with the spells that are always in your mind.

feats.name: Consecrate Spell
feats.notes: You infuse a spell with the power of your faith, consecrating it.
feats.prerequisite: ability to cast focus spells, divine spells
feats.access: Knights of Lastwall have access to this feat.

feats.name: Consecrated Aura
feats.notes: Your body radiates positive energy, making your very presence disorienting to undead and encouraging them to move away from you.

feats.name: Consistent Surge
feats.notes: Your nanites are incredibly effective, capable of improving your body's efficiency regularly.

feats.name: Consolidated Overlay Panopticon
feats.notes: You volunteered for a controversial experimental procedure to install clockwork prosthetic eyes.

feats.name: Constant Gaze
feats.notes: Your eyes keep a continual watch for dangers from all sides.

feats.name: Constant Levitation
feats.notes: Your power has unbound you from the earth below.

feats.name: Constricting Hold
feats.notes: Your eidolon constricts the creature, dealing bludgeoning damage equal to your eidolon’s level plus their Strength modifier, with a basic Fortitude save against your spell DC.

feats.name: Construct Shell
feats.notes: You've adjusted your construct innovation so that when you ride it, special plates, hollows, or similar form partial barriers around you to add additional protection.

feats.name: Consult Celestial Advisor
feats.notes: For many, the Calling of an ascended celestial is a wondrous but challenging path, which they must walk alone.

feats.name: Consult the Spirits
feats.notes: You have learned rites or meditations that enable you to perceive minor, invisible spirits within a place.
feats.prerequisite: Master in Occultism, Master in Nature, or Master in Religion

feats.name: Consult the Spirits (Rivethun Emissary)
feats.notes: You spend 1 hour communing with powerful spirits of the world to gain insight, information, or advice.

feats.name: Consult the Stars
feats.notes: You find wisdom in the movements of the heavens.

feats.name: Consume Energy
feats.notes: Your connection to energy is so much stronger than the offending display in front of you, allowing you to claim it for yourself.
feats.trigger: An enemy within 60 feet uses an ability that has the trait corresponding to your deviation damage type.

feats.name: Consume Magic
feats.notes: You consume the magic of an incoming spell or effect to protect your allies, though you might give yourself indigestion.
feats.trigger: You attempt a saving throw against an area effect from the tradition matching your magiphage ability.

feats.name: Consume Power
feats.notes: You absorb energy and hold it in your kinetic gate.
feats.trigger: You would take acid, electricity, fire, or sonic damage.

feats.name: Contact with the Enemy
feats.notes: You know that even the best-laid plans rarely survive contact with the enemy, and you have prepared your allies to adapt with a wide array of contingencies.

feats.name: Contagious Rage
feats.notes: You can drive your allies into a frenzy, granting them incredible benefits.

feats.name: Contagious Spell
feats.notes: Your magic can bring devastation to more individuals.

feats.name: Contingency Gadgets
feats.notes: You are too brilliant to be caught off guard, and you always have just the right gadget for the situation.

feats.name: Contingency Leap
feats.notes: When imperiled by a fall, you swiftly transport yourself out of danger.
feats.trigger: You fall, and there is an edge or handhold within 30 feet.

feats.name: Continual Recovery
feats.notes: Treat Wounds on a patient more often

feats.name: Continuous Assault
feats.notes: You can use Elemental Assault once per hour instead of once per day.

feats.name: Contortionist
feats.notes: You can squeeze out of tight situations by twisting and bending your body into unnatural positions, gaining an advantage against foes that try to pin you down.

feats.name: Contract Negotiator
feats.notes: Your experience with bargaining and deciding terms as part of Highhelm's guilds helps you make deals in other situations.

feats.name: Control Tower
feats.notes: Your keen senses and ability to process battlefield information have dramatically improved, allowing you to drastically reduce the advantage of unseen foes.

feats.name: Controlled Blast
feats.notes: You maximize the effectiveness of your explosives by controlling every possible parameter of the blast meticulously.

feats.name: Controlled Bullet
feats.notes: You create a direct magical connection with your beast gun, allowing you to guide the beast gun's next shot by taking control of the projectile directly.

feats.name: Converge
feats.notes: Informing your ally of an opening created by your shot, you coordinate to set them up to hit the target at the same time.
feats.trigger: You make a successful ranged attack against an opponent who is within your overwatch field, and who is within reach of one or more of your allies who is also within your overwatch field.

feats.name: Convergent Tides
feats.notes: Your footwork is like the convergence of tides, granting your body supernatural power and fluidity.

feats.name: Convincing Illusion
feats.notes: You use your deceptive skills to make your illusions seem even more real.
feats.trigger: A creature succeeded, but didn’t critically succeed, at a Perception check or Will save to disbelieve an illusion from a spell that you cast

feats.name: Convocation of Earth and Moon
feats.notes: You call upon Mother Earth and Father Moon to fill you with light.

feats.name: Cooperative Crafting
feats.notes: You've learned to make the most of working with others on your crafting projects, a must when working with the various guilds of Highhelm.

feats.name: Cooperative Leadership
feats.notes: Leaders gain increased bonuses to aid each other

feats.name: Cooperative Nature
feats.notes: The short human life span lends perspective and has taught you from a young age to set aside differences and work with others to achieve greatness.

feats.name: Cooperative Soul
feats.notes: You have developed a soul-deep bond with your comrades and maintain an even greater degree of cooperation with them.

feats.name: Coordinated Charge
feats.notes: You heroically dash into the fray, inspiring your allies to follow.

feats.name: Coordinated Distraction
feats.notes: You distract an opponent from the fact that one of your allies is about to attack them.
feats.access: Help either the Washboard Dogs or the Diobel Sweepers destroy their rival.

feats.name: Coordinated Tactics
feats.notes: You and your follower fight in tandem.

feats.name: Coral Detoxification
feats.notes: The coral colony that you've tended has merged with your kidneys to add an additional layer of filtration.

feats.name: Coral Growth
feats.notes: The difference between yourself and your coral symbiotes is nearly impossible to tell apart as your bodies are so intertwined.

feats.name: Coral Lifeline
feats.notes: Your coral symbiotes have grown into your bloodstream and are now curled around your heart.

feats.name: Coral Reserve
feats.notes: Your coral symbiotes provide a store of energy that you can call upon when needed.

feats.name: Coral Symbiotes
feats.notes: You've tended to your coral jewelry so well that you have formed a symbiotic relationship with it.

feats.name: Core Attunement
feats.notes: Your core allows you to draw more power from it.

feats.name: Core Cannon
feats.notes: Your body transforms into a powerful magical cannon.

feats.name: Core Rejuvenation
feats.notes: Your soul taps into your core's power to push against the grasp of death and allow you to recover consciousness.
feats.trigger: You have the dying condition and are about to attempt a recovery check.

feats.name: Corgi Mount
feats.notes: The smallest of fey have ridden corgis as mounts since time immemorial, leading to a pattern on corgis' backs called a “faerie saddle.

feats.name: Cornered Animal
feats.notes: You become more dangerous when surrounded by enemies.

feats.name: Cornered Fury
feats.notes: If a foe of a larger size than you critically hits and damages you, that foe is off-guard to you for 1 round.

feats.name: Corpse Stench
feats.notes: Your body exudes an overwhelming scent of decay in a 10-foot emanation, so putrid that it nauseates creates within that range.

feats.name: Corpse Tender Dedication
feats.notes: You have a connection to mindless undead that allows you to communicate your intentions to them on a rudimentary level.

feats.name: Corpse Tender's Font
feats.notes: You easily tend to the wounds of the dead.

feats.name: Corpse-Killer's Defiance
feats.notes: You defy Tar-Baphon with every undead you destroy, using your victory to rally your allies.
feats.trigger: You destroy an undead foe.
feats.access: Knights of Lastwall have access to this feat.

feats.name: Correct The Story
feats.notes: You know the story of your journey well and can correct it when your enemy tells it incorrectly.
feats.trigger: An enemy critically succeeds at an attack roll or saving throw.

feats.name: Corrupted Ground
feats.notes: The ground on which you stride is mere fuel that you burn with unholy void energies, scarring the earth in your wake.

feats.name: Corrupted Shield
feats.notes: Your shield ally is more than just a spirit of protection— it's a conduit for deadly divine magic.

feats.name: Cosmic Cocktail
feats.notes: Using the liquors, vinegars, and fruits or herbs at your disposal, you spend 1 minute to create a cocktail with colors reminiscent of space and its stars.

feats.name: Costume Change
feats.notes: Enough of your life has been spent performing that you’ve mastered the art of the quick change—especially when it comes to armor or invested items.
feats.prerequisite: Acrobat Dedication or Celebrity Dedication; Quick Disguise; Master in Performance

feats.name: Coughing Dragon Display
feats.notes: This display emits a cascade of loud bangs or glittering trails.

feats.name: Counter Curse
feats.notes: You gather the energy of your maelstrom and fling its unleashed power into the enemy's curse, attempting to neutralize it.
feats.trigger: You or an ally within 30 feet is targeted by or in the emanation of a curse or misfortune effect from an opponent or object of which you're aware.

feats.name: Counter Element
feats.notes: Your absolute dedication to a single element lets you attempt to gain control over it, even when the element is in service to another entity.
feats.trigger: You're targeted by or in the area of an effect that has the trait matching your kinetic element and originates from an enemy or hazard.

feats.name: Counter Perform
feats.notes: You gain the counter performance composition spell.

feats.name: Counter Thought
feats.notes: When a foe Casts a Spell that has the mental trait and you can see its manifestations, you can use your own mental magic to disrupt it.
feats.trigger: A creature Casts a Spell with the mental trait.

feats.name: Countercharm
feats.notes: Your charms and illusions are so dominant that you can use them to counteract similar magic cast by others.
feats.trigger: A creature Casts a Spell with the illusion or mental trait.

feats.name: Counterclockwork Focus
feats.notes: You understand the need for law enforcement doctrine to adapt to the ever-changing innovations in technology and arcana.

feats.name: Counterspell
feats.notes: When a foe Casts a Spell and you can see its manifestations, you can use your magic to disrupt it.
feats.trigger: A creature Casts a Spell that you have prepared

feats.name: Courageous Advance
feats.notes: With a rousing call, you exhort an ally to advance.

feats.name: Courageous Assault
feats.notes: With a mighty shout, you can stir an ally to attack.

feats.name: Courageous Onslaught
feats.notes: You use your performance to orchestrate an onslaught against your enemies.

feats.name: Courteous Comeback
feats.notes: You grew up in the proud Padishah Empire, where even insults have a certain poetic wit.
feats.trigger: You critically fail a Diplomacy check.
feats.access: Keleshite nationality

feats.name: Courtly Graces
feats.notes: Get along in noble society

feats.name: Coven Spell
feats.notes: You rhyme with your ally’s incantations or echo their movements, linking your magic to empower their spell in one of two ways.
feats.trigger: An ally within 30 feet Casts a Spell

feats.name: Cover Fire
feats.notes: You lay down suppressive fire to protect allies by forcing foes to take cover from your wild attacks.

feats.name: Covering Stance
feats.notes: Your very presence on the field of battle protects nearby allies from harm.

feats.name: Covet Hoard
feats.notes: You have a dragon’s desire for treasure.

feats.name: Cozy Campfire
feats.notes: You spend 1 hour building a campfire in a single unoccupied square and whispering the stories of those you’ve met on your journeys.

feats.name: Crack Retort
feats.notes: You can use Reactive Strike with a loaded firearm you're wielding.
feats.prerequisite: Reactive Strike; trained in martial firearms

feats.name: Cracked Mountain
feats.notes: You fight on, staying on your feet and lashing out at a foe.
feats.trigger: You would be reduced to 0 Hit Points but not immediately killed.

feats.name: Craft Anything
feats.notes: Ignore most requirements for crafting items

feats.name: Craft Facsimile
feats.notes: You're renowned for your ability to recover important items and sometimes that requires creating a stand-in.
feats.prerequisite: Expert in Crafting; Pathfinder Agent Dedication

feats.name: Craft Philosopher's Stone
feats.notes: Your research has paid off, culminating in the legendary philosopher's stone.

feats.name: Craft Runewell
feats.notes: Even if the runelord whose soul influences you never did so themselves, you know how to create your own runewell—an artifact that grants you a measure of immortality.
feats.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star

feats.name: Crafter's Appraisal
feats.notes: Your knowledge of items' construction allows you to discern their magical effects as well.

feats.name: Crafter's Instinct
feats.notes: You sense a minor flaw in the weapon as you fire it, and quickly adjust your aim on the fly to avoid the flaw.
feats.trigger: You misfire with a firearm or you roll a failure on a Strike with a ranged weapon.
feats.access: You are from Dongun Hold or Alkenstar.

feats.name: Crane Flutter
feats.notes: You interpose your arm between yourself and your opponent.
feats.trigger: You are targeted with an attack by an observed attacker.

feats.name: Crane Stance
feats.notes: Your arms flutter like a crane's wings.

feats.name: Cranial Detonation
feats.notes: As your overwhelming psyche fells a creature, you use its flickering consciousness to detonate psychic energy from the creature's head.
feats.trigger: You successfully reduce one or more non-mindless enemies to 0 Hit Points with a spell.

feats.name: Crashing Slam
feats.notes: You can dash your foe to the ground with a single blow.

feats.name: Cratering Drop
feats.notes: You follow up your enemy's fall, driving you both to the earth in a meteoric descent.

feats.name: Crawling Fire
feats.notes: You mimic the motions of a beast of your devising, and it becomes real, with a flaming pelt and searing claws.

feats.name: Crawling Form
feats.notes: You can transform into a small animal or celestial creature to scurry and spy.
feats.prerequisite: Born of Animal heritage or Born of Celestial heritage

feats.name: Creative Prodigy
feats.notes: You have a powerful creative drive that is clear to any who interact with you.

feats.name: Creature Comforts
feats.notes: You've found comfort in the forms of other creatures, insulating yourself from feelings of fear.
feats.trigger: You become frightened .

feats.name: Creature of Myth
feats.notes: Your specialized united companion grows with unparalleled power and strength, becoming a creature of myth.
feats.prerequisite: Beast Lord Dedication; you have a united companion with a specialization.

feats.name: Creed Magic
feats.notes: You’ve expanded your divine capabilities, granting you magic that better supports your combat focus.

feats.name: Cremate Undead
feats.notes: Your overwhelming vitality sets undead alight.

feats.name: Crescent Cross Training
feats.notes: You have familiarity with the crescent cross , an ingenious weapon that combines an arm-mounted, multi-chamber crossbow with a crescent-shaped blade.

feats.name: Crimson Breath
feats.notes: You gain a fire breath weapon similar to that of a crimson worm .
feats.source: Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm

feats.name: Crimson Oath Devotion
feats.notes: You've made the Crimson Oath a part of yourself; you mumble it in your sleep and recite it under your breath as you march.
feats.prerequisite: Knight Reclaimant Dedication; ability to cast focus spells

feats.name: Crimson Shroud
feats.notes: You swathe yourself in a veil of red mist for 1 minute.

feats.name: Cringe
feats.notes: With pitiful posturing, you cause your foe to pull back a deadly attack.
feats.trigger: A creature you are aware of critically succeeds on a Strike against you and would deal damage to you.

feats.name: Critical Debilitation
feats.notes: Your debilitations are especially effective on your most powerful attacks.

feats.name: Critter Shape
feats.notes: Once per hour, you can use Change Shape to enter a critter shape.

feats.name: Croak Talker
feats.notes: You can communicate with the simplest of frogs and other similar creatures using longwinded croaks.

feats.name: Crocodile's Twin
feats.notes: Your egg contained your twin, a crocodile.
feats.prerequisite: Bakuwa Lizardfolk heritage or Makari Lizardfolk heritage

feats.name: Crone's Cruelty
feats.notes: Filled with rancor and hate, you rend the minds of those who displease you.

feats.name: Cross the Final Horizon
feats.notes: You Stride up to your Speed and your ki enshrouds your limbs in a terrifying stormy energy.

feats.name: Cross the Final Horizon
feats.notes: You Stride up to your Speed and your ki enshrouds your limbs in a terrifying stormy energy, increasing the reach of your Sky and Heaven Stance unarmed attacks by 5 feet.

feats.name: Cross the Threshold
feats.notes: You can cast ethereal jaunt as an occult innate spell once per day.

feats.name: Crossblooded Evolution
feats.notes: Odd interactions in your bloodline provide you with unexpected effects.

feats.name: Crossbow Ace
feats.notes: Your deep understanding of the crossbow allows you to reload efficiently while moving yourself out of the line of return fire.

feats.name: Crossbow Crack Shot
feats.notes: You have a deep understanding of the crossbow.

feats.name: Crossbow Infiltrator Dedication
feats.notes: You have mastered stealthy weapons that allow you to strike carefully from a distance far enough to avoid reprisal, yet close enough to confirm your kills.

feats.name: Crossbow Terror
feats.notes: Your skill with a crossbow strikes terror into your opponents when you threaten them with the next bolt.

feats.name: Crosscurrent Counter
feats.notes: You counter the creature with the power of elemental water, a tendril of it encasing your limb or weapon.
feats.trigger: You become grabbed or restrained by a creature.

feats.name: Crowd Mastery
feats.notes: You use the crowd to your advantage, diverting your foes’ attention to potential hidden dangers in the crowd.

feats.name: Crown of Bone
feats.notes: When you came of age, you were blessed by the Mother Earth with a thickened skull, which was celebrated as an auspicious sign among your community.

feats.name: Crown of Rule
feats.notes: This badge of office proclaims your sovereignty.

feats.name: Crown of the Saumen Kar
feats.notes: Your body begins to evolve and adapt, taking the first steps towards blending your very self with the ancient curse of the saumen kar.

feats.name: Crowned in Tempest's Fury
feats.notes: You become one with a devastating thunderstorm from the Plane of Air , placing a crown of lightning upon your brow.

feats.name: Crude Communication
feats.notes: Even if you don’t speak a creature’s language, you can rely on inflection, root words, and body language to infer rudimentary meaning.

feats.name: Cruel Piercing
feats.notes: You learn to impale your targets.

feats.name: Cruelty
feats.notes: The harm you deal with your corrupting touch saps the strength from your enemy's body.

feats.name: Crunch
feats.notes: Your jaws can crush bone and bite through armor.

feats.name: Crusader's Masquerade
feats.notes: Your mask can hide you from the undead .

feats.name: Crush Dissent
feats.notes: Quell Dissent more efficiently

feats.name: Crushing Grab
feats.notes: Like a powerful constrictor, you crush targets in your unyielding grasp.

feats.name: Crushing Step
feats.notes: The weight of your armored feet casts aside natural impediments.

feats.name: Cry of Rebellion
feats.notes: You let loose a yell of unbridled passion, which fuels your allies, and pounds against your foes.

feats.name: Cryptic Spell
feats.notes: You hide your magic in the croak of a frog, in the sway of the trees, in the howl of the wind, and the flicker of the will-o'- wisp.

feats.name: Crystal Healing
feats.notes: You know how to stimulate a body's natural healing abilities through the application of resonant crystals.

feats.name: Crystal Keeper Dedication
feats.notes: You can use Arcana, Occultism, Religion, or Society to Decipher Writing by meditating before a crystal, regardless of the type of writing.
feats.source: Pathfinder #148: Fires of the Haunted City
feats.prerequisite: Trained in Elven Lore or Trained in Society

feats.name: Crystal Luminescence
feats.notes: Your horn glows with bioluminescent color, casting bright light in a 20-foot emanation (and dim light for the next 20 feet).

feats.name: Crystal Ward Spells
feats.notes: Your study of crystals and the energies held within a gem’s facets grants you special arcane crystal ward spells.
feats.source: Pathfinder #148: Fires of the Haunted City

feats.name: Cultivator Dedication
feats.notes: Through an esoteric, often exacting, regimen of meditation, diet, and exercise, you’ve learned to transform your body’s inner workings into a crucible of planar and spiritual energies.

feats.name: Cultivator's Keen Eye
feats.notes: Attuned to all arrangements of qi, you gain lifesense as an imprecise sense with a range of 30 feet.

feats.name: Cultural Adaptability
feats.notes: During your adventures, you've honed your ability to adapt to the culture of the predominant ancestry around you.

feats.name: Culvert's Collapse
feats.notes: Under your foes’ onslaught, the water within your violent blood stirs.

feats.name: Cunning Climber
feats.notes: Whether you are climbing a ship’s rigging, a jungle tree, or a clock tower, you have an uncanny knack for finding footholds and handholds where larger creatures can’t.

feats.name: Cunning Hair
feats.notes: Your hair moves under your control.

feats.name: Cunning Tinker
feats.notes: Time spent tending to your own form has unlocked your ability to fix other things.

feats.name: Cunning Trickster Mask
feats.notes: Your mask carries the legacy of Verdant Spider, the Speaker of Needs, allowing you to deceive and outwit your foes.

feats.name: Current Spell
feats.notes: As you use your magic to manipulate air or water, you divert some of its currents to form a barrier around you.
feats.prerequisite: Elementalist Dedication; air or water is in your elemental philosophy

feats.name: Current Spell
feats.notes: As you use your magic to manipulate air or water, you spin off some of its currents to form a barrier around you.

feats.name: Curse Maelstrom Dedication
feats.notes: A horrible curse has left a lingering stain on your soul, and its effects continue to plague you even if the curse's other effects have ended.
feats.prerequisite: You are cursed or have previously been cursed.

feats.name: Curse of the Saumen Kar
feats.notes: You activate the runes on your body to create an icy prison around a Huge or smaller creature you can see within 60 feet.

feats.name: Cursebreaker
feats.notes: Using various implements and esoteric methods, you can attempt to remove a curse from an unfortunate victim.

feats.name: Cursed Effigy
feats.notes: After your attack, you grab a bit of blood, cut hair, or other piece of the creature's body.

feats.name: Cushion Landing
feats.notes: As you fall, your mount dashes to your rescue.
feats.trigger: You fall from a height of 15 feet or higher.

feats.name: Cut from the Air
feats.notes: You can knock aside ranged attacks.
feats.trigger: You are the target of a physical ranged Strike

feats.name: Cut the Bonds
feats.notes: You can counteract a magical effect that impedes movement.
feats.prerequisite: Bellflower Dedication; expert in a melee weapon

feats.name: Cut them Down, Burn them Out
feats.notes: Inspired by the sixth line of the Crimson Oath, when you oppose the enemies of Lastwall, you aim to excise the rot from the land itself.
feats.prerequisite: Knight Reclaimant Dedication; master proficiency in a weapon

feats.name: Cutthroat Grapple
feats.notes: You can punish a creature that tries to escape your blades.
feats.trigger: A creature attempts to Escape from your Sawtooth Grapple.
feats.access: member of the Red Mantis assassins

feats.name: Cutting Flattery
feats.notes: Repeated entries in Firebrand bragging and flyting contests have taught you how to twist pretty words into concealed insults.
feats.prerequisite: Dandy Dedication or Pirate Dedication; Trained in Intimidation
feats.access: Members of the Firebrands at the rank of second mark or higher have access to this feat.

feats.name: Cutting Heaven, Crushing Earth
feats.notes: Your skill in combining fist and blade has grown into a seamless art where each attack makes an opponent more vulnerable to the next.

feats.name: Cutting Rebuke
feats.notes: If words could kill, the poet might rule the world.

feats.name: Cutting Without Blade
feats.notes: While tales of your divine ikons have spread far and wide, you’ve realized that, as they are all manifestations of your soul, the object itself is unnecessary.

feats.name: Cycle of Souls
feats.notes: Your spiritual allies guide your movements, allowing you to prepare for the trials before you at a speed faster than thought.
feats.prerequisite: liturgist practice; at least one animist stance
feats.trigger: Your turn begins.

feats.name: Cycle Spell
feats.notes: Your devotion to the cycle of souls grants you an additional divine spell.

feats.name: Cyclonic Ascent
feats.notes: Whorls of wind surround your lower body, forming a cyclone that lifts you into the air.

feats.name: Cynical
feats.notes: You've been approached with suspicion and distrust throughout your life and return these sentiments back to the strangers you encounter.
feats.source: Absalom, City of Lost Omens, Azarketi Ancestry Web Supplement

feats.name: Dalang's Ally
feats.notes: You move your shadow as a master puppeteer, allowing it to dance around your enemies and serve you in combat.

feats.name: Dance of Bloody Ink
feats.notes: As you lash out, your weapon is your brush, wounds forming words of power in your target’s flesh.

feats.name: Dance of Intercession
feats.notes: You either performed in or stood witness to the dance used to invoke the Celestial Dragon and can harness a sliver of their power.

feats.name: Dance of the Jester
feats.notes: Through your incredible dance skill, you can embody the character of the Jester, able to take control of the shadows of other players on stage (much to your amusement).

feats.name: Dance of the Mousedeer
feats.notes: You move your body in a pattern that evokes the small and clever Sister Mousedeer, misdirecting enemies and filling their vision with shadows to hide behind.

feats.name: Dance of the Tiger
feats.notes: Tales tell of the Tiger stalking the Mousedeer for days, hidden and instilling dread upon its prey.

feats.name: Dance of Thunder
feats.notes: Your steps echo with the thunderous retort of exploding black powder as you dance a dance of death.

feats.name: Dance Underfoot
feats.notes: You dart under the legs of your enemies in combat.

feats.name: Dancing Leaf
feats.notes: You are as light as a leaf on the breeze.

feats.name: Dandy Dedication
feats.notes: You are a consummate student of dignity, etiquette, and fashion.

feats.name: Dangle
feats.notes: You can hang by your tail from any suitable anchor point, such as a tree branch, balcony, or rocky outcropping (subject to the GM's discretion), typically while climbing.

feats.name: Dangle (Vanara)
feats.notes: You can hang by your tail from any suitable anchor point, such as a tree branch, balcony, or rocky outcropping (subject to the GM's discretion), typically while climbing.

feats.name: Danse Macabre
feats.notes: Your horde can drag unwilling victims along with it as it shambles forward.

feats.name: Daredevil's Gambit
feats.notes: If you critically succeed at your Daring Act, you can enter the target’s space and remain there until the beginning of your next turn or until the target moves, whichever comes first.

feats.name: Daring Act
feats.notes: You attempt a death-defying maneuver to distract your enemies.
feats.prerequisite: Trained in Acrobatics or Trained in Athletics; Firebrand Braggart Dedication

feats.name: Daring Flourish
feats.notes: You make quick use of an opening from your daring stunts.

feats.name: Dark Persona's Presence
feats.notes: When you Unleash your Psyche, all your rage and pain—the portion of your psyche dedicated to cruel retribution—come along with it.
feats.trigger: You Unleash your Psyche.

feats.name: Darkseer
feats.notes: Zon-Kuthon smiles upon you—even if you curse his name—granting you pitch-black eyes that allow you to see in shadows and darkness.

feats.name: Dart Between
feats.notes: In the blink of an eye, you transport yourself and any items you’re wearing and holding from your current space to an unoccupied space within 60 feet that you can see.

feats.name: Darting Monkey
feats.notes: You have a heightened awareness in combat, and your darting strikes prevent your foes from distracting you or breaking your focus.

feats.name: Dash of Herbs
feats.notes: A small cloud of medicinal herbs heal a creature.

feats.name: Dashing Pickup
feats.notes: You Command an Animal to order your mount to Stride (or to Burrow, Climb, Fly, or Swim if it has the corresponding movement type).
feats.prerequisite: Cavalier Dedication; expert in Acrobatics or Athletics

feats.name: Dashing Pounce
feats.notes: With a burst of speed, you leap into the air, slashing with your hands.

feats.name: Dashing Strike
feats.notes: Springing away from one foe, you Strike at another.

feats.name: Dastardly Dash
feats.notes: You dash past an opponent, confounding them with underhanded tactics.

feats.name: Daunting Spell
feats.notes: Your enemies feel the inevitability of defeat once they feel the potency of your magic.
feats.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star

feats.name: Daywalker
feats.notes: Whether through painstaking exposure, devoted prayer, or simple luck, you've found a greater affinity for life through the sun's light.

feats.name: Daywalker
feats.notes: Through a profane pledge or a bloodline quirk, you can tolerate the sun's light.

feats.name: Dazing Blow
feats.notes: You pummel a held foe, hoping to stagger them.

feats.name: Dazzling Block
feats.notes: As your shield blocks an assault, you create a flash of brilliant, multicolored light in a 15-foot cone .
feats.trigger: You use Shield Block .

feats.name: Dazzling Bullet
feats.notes: Your tricks discombobulate your opponent, leaving spots in their vision from the bright flash of your gunshot reflected straight into their eyes.

feats.name: Dazzling Display
feats.notes: You perform a bewildering show of prowess, such as by whirling and flashing a weapon, that unnerves foes.

feats.name: Dazzling Dragonet Disappearance
feats.notes: A brilliant sheen on your scales flashes when you’re hit, then you’re nowhere to be found.
feats.trigger: An adjacent enemy hits you with an attack .

feats.name: Dead Reckoning
feats.notes: You've trained yourself to maintain a strong sense of direction at all times, even when you can't use a compass or see the sky above.
feats.prerequisite: Pathfinder Agent Dedication; Trained in Survival

feats.name: Deadeye
feats.notes: You relax your eyes, taking in the presence of hidden things, granting you the ability to locate invisible creatures.

feats.name: Deadly Aim
feats.notes: You aim for your prey’s weak spots, making your shot more challenging but dealing more damage if you hit.
