feats.name: Deadly Aspect
feats.notes: You have honed the unarmed attack your draconic heritage has granted you to a lethal degree.

feats.name: Deadly Butterfly
feats.notes: You gain access to the butterfly sword's critical specialization effect.

feats.name: Deadly Casework
feats.notes: You treat a well-planned assassination with the diligence that you would bring to any investigation.
feats.prerequisite: member of the Red Mantis assassins
feats.access: member of the Red Mantis assassins

feats.name: Deadly Grace
feats.notes: Your graceful attacks are especially powerful.

feats.name: Deadly Mutation
feats.notes: The dart fired by your ostilli is more dangerous.

feats.name: Deadly Poison Weapon
feats.notes: Your poisons are devastatingly potent.

feats.name: Deadly Simplicity
feats.notes: When you are wielding your deity’s favored weapon, increase the damage die size of that weapon by one step.
feats.prerequisite: deity with a simple or unarmed attack favored weapon, trained with your deity's favored weapon

feats.name: Deadly Strikes
feats.notes: You have honed your body to attack with lethal focus.

feats.name: Death Dive
feats.notes: You guide your mount into a plummet, diving headlong at a single foe.

feats.name: Death from Above
feats.notes: Seemingly to defy gravity, you use a nearby vertical surface to propel yourself upward and then strike downward like the driving rain.

feats.name: Death from Above
feats.notes: You leap down on your target, using their body to cushion your fall and your momentum to empower your attack.
feats.prerequisite: Canopy Predator; Verduran Shadow Dedication; Expert in Athletics

feats.name: Death Rattle
feats.notes: When the time comes for your horde to be returned to its temporary rest, its departure carries those nearby closer to death.

feats.name: Death Roll
feats.notes: You corkscrew your body, twisting your victim.

feats.name: Death Speaker
feats.notes: Your voice and magic speak to the core existence within undead creatures, circumventing the need for the creature to comprehend.

feats.name: Death Warden
feats.notes: With your intimate familiarity with the duality of positive and negative energy, you're able to stand as a bulwark against death and undeath alike.

feats.name: Death's Door
feats.notes: You continue to fight when others would fall.
feats.trigger: You take damage that would reduce you to 0 Hit Points.

feats.name: Death's Drums
feats.notes: Your life has been spent challenging death itself, and proximity to that implacable foe only makes your heart beat harder.

feats.name: Deathblow
feats.notes: Your carefully prepared and placed shot brings instant death to your target.
feats.prerequisite: Guerrilla Dedication; Poisoned Sticks and Stones

feats.name: Deathguard
feats.notes: The twisting rotted limbs, clattering bones, or swirling ectoplasm of your horde can hide you from others' vision.

feats.name: Deathless Servant
feats.notes: The servants of apocalypse know that it is impossible to cheat death, but your will is sufficient to help you outlive even your strongest enemies.

feats.name: Deathly Scream
feats.notes: A thrall’s scream mentally harms and frightens your foes.

feats.name: Deathly Secrets
feats.notes: No means of creating or ruling the undead is beyond your grasp, even those of magical traditions not your own.

feats.name: Debilitating Bomb
feats.notes: You can add a crystalline additive to an alchemical bomb to have it undermine your enemy.

feats.name: Debilitating Breath
feats.notes: Your breath causes lasting hindrance to those it harms.

feats.name: Debilitating Dichotomy
feats.notes: You reveal a glimpse of the impossible conflicts between the divine anathema behind your curse , forcing you to reckon with another's conflicts as well.

feats.name: Debilitating Shot
feats.notes: Aiming for a weak point, you impede your foe with a precise shot.

feats.name: Debilitating Venom
feats.notes: Your venom is particularly potent, affecting targets in different ways.

feats.name: Deceptive Deduction
feats.notes: You've had to take on many roles while working undercover, so you're practiced at following the example of those around you to pretend expertise in a variety of fields.
feats.trigger: A creature you can see uses Recall Knowledge .

feats.name: Deceptive Tactics
feats.notes: Your training has taught you that the art of war is the art of deception.

feats.name: Deceptive Worship
feats.notes: Members of your cult frequently pass themselves off as worshippers of other religions.

feats.name: Decisive Swimmer
feats.notes: You are a talented athlete trained to compete in swimming competitions, and would sometimes be asked to help your community settle disputes with others by participating in swimming races.

feats.name: Declare Anathema
feats.notes: You declare a creature you are aware of within 30 feet anathema, causing their friends and strangers to shy away from them.

feats.name: Decree of Banisment
feats.notes: You assume a demeanor of authority and decree banishment upon a foe who has defied your authority.

feats.name: Decree of Execution
feats.notes: You proclaim that a foe has violated the sanctity of your realm and must die.

feats.name: Decree of Prosperity
feats.notes: You speak with a gentle encouragement that inspires confidence and competence in your followers.

feats.name: Decree of War
feats.notes: You declare your current foes as irredeemable enemies, calling your allies down upon them.

feats.name: Decry Thief
feats.notes: When you attempt to Demoralize, you can make it harder for the target to flee, in place of the action’s normal effects.
feats.prerequisite: Zephyr Guard Dedication; Trained in Intimidation

feats.name: Deduce Habits
feats.notes: When you use Plot the Future , you can instead contemplate a person that you’ve gotten to observe within 30 feet for at least 1 minute.
feats.access: member of the Red Mantis assassins

feats.name: Deep Freeze
feats.notes: You vent a jet of supercooled fluid from your innovation, damaging a foe and slowing it down.

feats.name: Deep Lore
feats.notes: Your repertoire is vast, containing far more spells than usual.

feats.name: Deep Roots
feats.notes: Your mind-control spells send burrowing mental roots that tear at your target's mind when they're removed or run their course.

feats.name: Deepening Devotion
feats.notes: Your investment in your draconic gift has unlocked greater power.

feats.name: Deeper Dabbler
feats.notes: With some streamlining to your process and a deeper collection of talisman materials, you make a greater number of talismans every day.

feats.name: Deepvision
feats.notes: Your vision is suited for night or the underground.

feats.name: Defend Mount
feats.notes: You interpose yourself between an attacker and your mount, defending your mount from harm.
feats.trigger: An enemy makes a Strike or spell attack against your mount while you’re riding it.

feats.name: Defend Our Union
feats.notes: You can protect your companion from danger with a welltimed attack.
feats.trigger: You and your companion are within 15 feet of each other, and a foe successfully Strikes your united companion.

feats.name: Defend Summoner
feats.notes: Your eidolon blocks attacks against you.

feats.name: Defender's Grit
feats.notes: You can’t protect anyone if you’re dead.

feats.name: Defensive Advance
feats.notes: With the protection of your shield, you dive into battle! You Raise your Shield and Stride.

feats.name: Defensive Armaments
feats.notes: You use bulky firearms or crossbows to shield your body from your foes' attacks.

feats.name: Defensive Coordination
feats.notes: Like the storied heroes who persist in the face of overwhelming odds, you and your allies will hold the line.

feats.name: Defensive Dismissal
feats.notes: You change your form as a means of evading a potentially fatal blow.
feats.trigger: A creature you’re aware of critically succeeds on a Strike against you.

feats.name: Defensive Growth
feats.notes: You grow a shield of woven flowers and branches, then Raise that Shield to defend yourself from the triggering attack.
feats.trigger: You’re the target of a physical attack .

feats.name: Defensive Instincts
feats.notes: Your body tenses up when surrounded, putting you on edge just enough to anticipate an attack.

feats.name: Defensive Needles
feats.notes: Your body is covered in sharp needles or spines which you can use to defend yourself.
feats.prerequisite: Cactus Leshy heritage or Pine Leshy heritage
feats.access: Pine leshies have access to this feat

feats.name: Defensive Recovery
feats.notes: Your faith provides temporary protection in addition to healing.

feats.name: Defensive Roll
feats.notes: Dropping into a roll to disperse the force of the blow, you can partially evade a lethal attack and stay conscious.
feats.trigger: A physical attack would reduce you to 0 Hit Points

feats.name: Defensive Stratagem
feats.notes: By scrutinizing a foe, you learn how to better avoid its attacks.

feats.name: Defensive Swap
feats.notes: You and your allies work together selflessly to protect each other from harm.
feats.trigger: You or an adjacent willing ally are the target of an attack.

feats.name: Defiance Unto Death
feats.notes: You loathe the alghollthus and their mind magic, and you’ve been trained to be willing to die rather than give into mental manipulation.
feats.access: Spiresworn elf

feats.name: Defiant Banner
feats.notes: You vigorously wave your banner to remind yourself and your allies that you can and must endure.

feats.name: Define the Canvas
feats.notes: You produce rune-inscribed stones, which whirl in the air before darting away to form a perimeter for a runic canvas.

feats.name: Deflect Projectile
feats.notes: You gain a +4 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.
feats.trigger: You are the target of a physical ranged attack.

feats.name: Deflecting Cloud
feats.notes: You've mastered a defensive technique unique to the ancient dragons of Bloodsalt: beating your wings to create a billowing cloud of mist.
feats.prerequisite: Dragon Disciple Dedication; _dragon wings_ sorcerer bloodline spell
feats.trigger: You are the target of a ranged attack.

feats.name: Deflecting Jewel
feats.notes: You walk the line between two sides of something, such as belonging to two clans, having a mixed allegiance or faith, or being caught between two possible fates.
feats.trigger: You're the target of a ranged attack while you possess your head gem.

feats.name: Deflecting Pulse
feats.notes: Your ostilli can use its stored magic to protect you from other magic, granting you the Turn Aside Ambient Magic action. Turn Aside Ambient Magic ( concentrate ) Your ostilli glows a faint yellow as it establishes a barrier.

feats.name: Deflecting Shot
feats.notes: You're always ready to take a quick shot to deflect a weapon or distract a foe enough to render them off target.
feats.trigger: An ally within the first range increment of your firearm or crossbow is hit by an attack, and you can see the attacker.

feats.name: Deflecting Wave
feats.notes: A cascade of water blunts or disperses the incoming attack.
feats.trigger: You would take acid, bludgeoning, fire, or slashing damage from an enemy's attack, spell, or other hostile effect.

feats.name: Deft Cooperation
feats.notes: You gain a bonus to your own checks when Aiding an ally.

feats.name: Defy Chains
feats.notes: You turn to face a fiend that attacked you, looking them squarely in the eyes (if it has them) and showing no fear.
feats.trigger: A fiend within 15 feet of you damages you with a Strike.

feats.name: Defy Death
feats.notes: You’re exceptionally difficult to kill.

feats.name: Defy Fey
feats.notes: You are keen to the wiles of the fey and can usually shake off their magic.

feats.name: Defy Hell
feats.notes: Your devotion to your cause gives you endless strength and courage to withstand the enemy's attacks.

feats.name: Defy Sorrow
feats.notes: You draw on this spiritual pain to push your body to greater heights.
feats.trigger: You’re dealt mental damage or spirit damage or you fail or critically fail a saving throw against a mental effect.

feats.name: Defy the Darkness
feats.notes: Using ancient dwarven methods developed to fight enemies wielding magical darkness, you've honed your darkvision and sworn not to use such magic yourself.

feats.name: Deific Font
feats.notes: Your life force can fuel the stuff of miracles.

feats.name: Deimatic Display
feats.notes: Imitating animal threat displays, you make yourself appear larger and more imposing.

feats.name: Deity's Domain
feats.notes: You embody an aspect of your deity.

feats.name: Deity's Protection
feats.notes: When you call upon your deity’s power to fulfill the promise of their domain, you gain divine protection.

feats.name: Delay Trap
feats.notes: You try to jam the workings of a trap to delay its effects.
feats.trigger: A trap within your reach is triggered

feats.name: Deliberate Death
feats.notes: Once, you died because someone—murderer, monster, or soldier— chose to strike you down.
feats.trigger: You are about to gain the dying condition as a result of another creature's attack or ability, and that creature is within your melee reach.

feats.name: Delver
feats.notes: Subterranean life taught you to swim through the ground like water.

feats.name: Demand Surrender
feats.notes: Confident in your victory, you command your opponent's surrender.

feats.name: Demanding Challenge
feats.notes: If your skill check to challenge a foe is a success, the target of your challenge takes a –1 circumstance penalty to attack rolls (or –2 if you critically succeed) until the end of your next turn.

feats.name: Demolish Defenses
feats.notes: With a powerful blow, you crack a foe's armor or tough hide, opening it up for further attacks.

feats.name: Demolishing Knockback
feats.notes: You make a forceful attack that has the power to push your foe through walls.

feats.name: Demolition Charge
feats.notes: You can rig your bombs to inanimate objects in order to cause destruction to the surrounding area.

feats.name: Demolitionist
feats.notes: You know how to destroy objects with a well-placed explosion.
feats.access: You are from Dongun Hold or Alkenstar.

feats.name: Demolitionist Dedication
feats.notes: You know how to set explosives to cause the maximum possible damage to buildings and other structures.

feats.name: Demon Hunter
feats.notes: The demons of Tanglebriar have long haunted your dreams, just as they have long threatened Kyonin.
feats.prerequisite: Expert in Religion or Expert in Demon Lore

feats.name: Demon Slayer
feats.notes: You can deliver a melee blow to a demon that creates an explosion of holy light to try to finish the demon off.

feats.name: Demon's Hair
feats.notes: Your hair constantly wriggles and writhes.

feats.name: Demon-Hunting Companion
feats.notes: You gain a young animal companion that has been specially trained to help you fight demons .

feats.name: Demonbane Warrior
feats.notes: You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to damage with weapons and unarmed attacks against demons.

feats.name: Demonblood Frenzy
feats.notes: Just the taste of fiendish blood is enough to send blood rushing through your veins in a supernatural fury.
feats.trigger: You successfully Strike a living creature that has the fiend trait with your tusks unarmed attack
feats.access: Matanji ethnicity

feats.name: Denier of Destruction
feats.notes: You can manipulate the same energies that the aeon orbs use to sustain life.
feats.trigger: Any ally within 30 feet that you can heal with your heal spell would take damage from an attack or effect from a source you can observe.

feats.name: Denounce Tyranny
feats.notes: You call out a creature's despicable or cowardly actions, disrupting its alliances or even making its allies ashamed to be seen with it.

feats.name: Deny Support
feats.notes: Keep opponents from flanking when you Feint them.
feats.access: Help either the Washboard Dogs or the Diobel Sweepers destroy their rival.

feats.name: Deny the Songs of War
feats.notes: To keep the peace, you disrupt those who seek to break it.
feats.source: Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind

feats.name: Derring-do
feats.notes: When you compound panache with even more derring-do, it somehow tends to work out.

feats.name: Desert Wind
feats.notes: A vortex of sand and dust surrounds you.

feats.name: Desiccating Inhalation
feats.notes: You draw in the moisture from nearby creatures, draining them dry to heal your wounds.

feats.name: Desperate Finisher
feats.notes: You throw everything you have into one last, reckless press.
feats.trigger: You complete the last action on your turn, and your turn has not ended yet

feats.name: Desperate Prayer
feats.notes: You call out to your deity in a plea for their aid.
feats.trigger: You begin your turn and have no Focus Points.

feats.name: Desperate Resuscitation
feats.notes: You can use your training in combat medicine to revive the recently deceased.
feats.prerequisite: Officer's Medical Training; Master in Medicine

feats.name: Desperate Revival
feats.notes: On the verge of death, you drain the life of all around you in a desperate attempt to remain alive.
feats.trigger: You would be reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed.

feats.name: Desperate Surge
feats.notes: You can conjure up at will the kind of strength that most beings only attain in life-or-death situations.

feats.name: Desperate Wish
feats.notes: You call out a desperate wish to the stars to save a friend.

feats.name: Desperate Wrath
feats.notes: Your blood boils when you take a beating, and you throw caution to the wind to finish the fight.
feats.trigger: Your turn begins, and your current Hit Points are at half your maximum or less.

feats.name: Destined Victory
feats.notes: You demand a battle against your chosen enemy.

feats.name: Destructive Block
feats.notes: You can protect yourself more effectively, at the expense of your shield.

feats.name: Detective's Readiness
feats.notes: When you're on a case, you stay watchful and resolute to avoid tricks your suspect might pull.

feats.name: Determination
feats.notes: Your training allows you to shrug off your foes’ spells and conditions when the need is dire.

feats.name: Determined Dash
feats.notes: Nothing can keep you from your enemy.

feats.name: Determined Lore Seeker
feats.notes: You've mastered useful spells that let you find hidden truths others might miss.

feats.name: Detonating Spell
feats.notes: Your spell becomes volatile and explosive.
feats.access: Knights of Lastwall have access to this feat.

feats.name: Devastating Duelist
feats.notes: You pointedly note your enemy's deficiencies, filling them with fear and dismay.

feats.name: Devastating Manifestation
feats.notes: Your armaments are especially powerful the moment after you manifest them.

feats.name: Devastating Shield Wallop
feats.notes: The impact of your shield sends foes tumbling to the ground.

feats.name: Devastating Spellstrike
feats.notes: Your Spellstrike sweeps are so wide and devastating, they smash into nearby foes.

feats.name: Devastating Weaponry
feats.notes: You release a volley of projectiles from your weapon, or power it to fly in every direction across the battlefield and Strike multiple creatures.

feats.name: Devil in Plain Sight
feats.notes: You've learned to draw your fiendish nature into a small ball of corruption and hide it in your soul.

feats.name: Devil you Know
feats.notes: Your knowledge of your enemies gives you an advantage against them, granting you a swift reaction to their devilry.
feats.prerequisite: Hellbreaker Dedication; Expert in Devil Lore or Expert in Hellknight Lore

feats.name: Devil's Advocate
feats.notes: You know more about the habits of devils than is entirely safe.
feats.access: Chelaxian nationality

feats.name: Devil's Eye
feats.notes: Your experience in the finer points of bargaining with a devil has awakened a sinister power that now inhabits your left eye.
feats.prerequisite: You made a bargain with a devil or won a legal case or other similar duel of wits against a devil.

feats.name: Devilish Wiles
feats.notes: Traditionally, fiends are exceptionally good at persuading people to do things, even when their targets know it's a bad idea.

feats.name: Devoted Focus
feats.notes: Your devotion is strong enough to increase your focus to incredible heights.

feats.name: Devoted Guardian
feats.notes: You adopt a wide stance, ready to defend both yourself and your chosen ward.
feats.access: Knights of Lastwall have access to this feat.

feats.name: Devout Blessing
feats.notes: You gain the blessing of the devoted class feature

feats.name: Devout Magic
feats.notes: You gain a devotion spell of your choice listed in the devotion spells class feature

feats.name: Devrin's Cunning Stance
feats.notes: You've learned Devrin Arlos's guileful ways, and his sly teachings help you remind your allies to keep their wits about them.
feats.access: Members of the Firebrands at the rank of second mark or higher have access to this feat.

feats.name: Devrin's Dazzling Diversion
feats.notes: Devrin Arlos has a habit of using whatever is at hand to temporarily blind others in combat.
feats.access: Members of the Firebrands at the rank of second mark or higher have access to this feat.

feats.name: Diabolic Certitude
feats.notes: Your Hellknight training drilled details of Hell's denizens deep into your mind.
feats.trigger: Your turn begins, and you can observe a devil .

feats.name: Diacritic Fluency
feats.notes: When you intensify your attention, you can modify a rune with great speed.

feats.name: Diamond Fists
feats.notes: Your body hardens as you combine your attacks, making your finishing blows more damaging.

feats.name: Diamond Soul
feats.notes: You have fortified your body and mind against eldritch effects.

feats.name: Didactic Strike
feats.notes: When you find a glaring weakness, you can set your allies up to annihilate your foe.

feats.name: Diehard
feats.notes: Die at dying 5, rather than dying 4

feats.name: Different Worlds
feats.notes: Create a second identity for yourself with a different name, history, and background.
feats.prerequisite: ability to select ancestry feats from multiple ancestries

feats.name: Dig Quickly
feats.notes: Your hands work as effectively as shovels when you need to dig a quick hole.

feats.name: Dig Up Secrets
feats.notes: You are an endless well of knowledge and can remember several vital pieces of information at once.

feats.name: Digger
feats.notes: You are used to building homes and defenses underground.
feats.prerequisite: Climbing Animal heritage or Running Animal heritage

feats.name: Dimensional Disappearance
feats.notes: You take advantage of certain idiosyncrasies of teleportation magic to better hide your position.
feats.prerequisite: _dimensional assault_ focus spell,; laughing shadow hybrid study

feats.name: Dimensional Pilfer
feats.notes: You have a preternatural ability to whisk items out from under their owners’ noses.
feats.prerequisite: Veil Dancer Dedication; Expert in Stealth

feats.name: Dire Form
feats.notes: Your hybrid shape is a hulking beast.

feats.name: Dire Growth
feats.notes: You transform into a primal reflection of your animal shape.
feats.prerequisite: Werecreature Dedication; your animal shape is not Small

feats.name: Directed Audience
feats.notes: You can shape the area of your composition spells.

feats.name: Directed Channel
feats.notes: You can shape the energy you channel in a single direction.

feats.name: Directed Poison
feats.notes: When you cast cloudkill , you can modify it to be under your control.
feats.prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _cloudkill_

feats.name: Directional Bombs
feats.notes: You can lob bombs with great force and a precise trajectory to angle the splash in a cone that sprays in a single direction, potentially allowing you to avoid allies and splash deeper into enemy lines.

feats.name: Dirge of Doom
feats.notes: You learn the dirge of doom composition cantrip (page 370), which frightens your enemies and keeps them from fully recovering from their fear.

feats.name: Dirty Trick
feats.notes: You hook a foe's bootlaces together, pull their hat over their eyes, loosen their belt, or otherwise confound their mobility through an underhanded tactic.

feats.name: Disarming Assault
feats.notes: You attack with enough force to knock the weapon out of your foe's hands.

feats.name: Disarming Block
feats.notes: With deft and practiced movement, you block at an angle to potentially dislodge the weapon.
feats.trigger: You Shield Block a melee Strike made with a held weapon.

feats.name: Disarming Flair
feats.notes: You knock weapons from the hands of your foes with style.

feats.name: Disarming Intercept
feats.notes: When you catch a weapon in your armor, you can move your body to wrench it from your foe's grasp.
feats.trigger: You Intercept an Attack that was made with a melee weapon by a creature you’re adjacent to.

feats.name: Disarming Smile
feats.notes: With a wide and sincere smile, you give your attacker pause.
feats.trigger: You are the target of a melee attack and the attacker has not rolled yet.

feats.name: Disarming Stance
feats.notes: You adopt a fencing stance that improves your control over your weapon.

feats.name: Disarming Twist
feats.notes: After your initial attack redirects your foe’s defenses, your follow-up wrests their weapon from their grasp.

feats.name: Discerning Gaze
feats.notes: You have a sense for when people are lying.
feats.prerequisite: Vigilante Dedication; member of the Gray Gardeners

feats.name: Discerning Strike
feats.notes: Identifying a creature is the first step in finding its weaknesses.

feats.name: Disciple of Shade
feats.notes: You've delved deeper into the mysteries of shadow and become blessed with magical power that increases your skills in the arts of deception and persuasion.

feats.name: Disciple's Breath
feats.notes: You unleash your breath weapon without spending focus.
feats.prerequisite: Dragon Disciple Dedication; _dragon breath_ sorcerer bloodline spell

feats.name: Discordant Voice
feats.notes: Your courageous anthem lets loose a discordant shriek that imbues your allies’ attacks with powerful sonic reverberations.

feats.name: Discreet Inquiry
feats.notes: You are subtle in your efforts to learn the things you need to know.
feats.prerequisite: Expert in Deception or Expert in Diplomacy

feats.name: Disengaging Twist
feats.notes: Your ability to twist your opponents’ bodies into painful locks and holds makes you particularly adept at escaping such predicaments.
feats.trigger: A creature gives you the grabbed or restrained condition.

feats.name: Disk Rider
feats.notes: When you cast floating disk , you can modify it to ride atop.
feats.prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _floating disk_

feats.name: Dismal Harvest
feats.notes: The expiring breaths of your enemies fuel your power.
feats.trigger: Your last action was a Mobbing Assault made by your horde that reduced at least one living creature to 0 Hit Points.

feats.name: Dismantle Spell
feats.notes: Your innate power can shut down other magic.

feats.name: Dismounting Strike
feats.notes: You leap from your horse, using the momentum of its movement to deal a devastating blow with your melee weapon.

feats.name: Disorienting Opening
feats.notes: You use your foes’ openings to expose even greater weaknesses.

feats.name: Disorienting Venom
feats.notes: The venom injected by your fangs disorients your foes.

feats.name: Dispelling Slice
feats.notes: Your sneak attack slices through the threads binding magic to a target.

feats.name: Dispelling Spellstrike
feats.notes: The spell you deliver tries to force out magic affecting your enemy.

feats.name: Disperse into Petals
feats.notes: You merge with the blossoms sprouting from you and disperse, becoming a visible cloud of blossoms and petals.

feats.name: Disrupt Prey
feats.notes: Make a melee Strike against your prey.
feats.trigger: Your hunted prey is within your reach, and it uses a manipulate action, uses a move action, or leaves a square during a move action it’s using

feats.name: Disrupt Qi
feats.notes: You carefully target a creature's pressure points to block its inner life force.

feats.name: Disrupting Strikes
feats.notes: You call forth positive energy from within to help you destroy undead.

feats.name: Disruptive Blur
feats.notes: You use cacophonous blasts from your gun or distracting shots from your crossbow to cause momentary diversions, letting you move about the battlefield with impunity.

feats.name: Disruptive Stance
feats.notes: The slightest distraction can provoke your wrath, and you’re prepared to foil enemies’ actions.

feats.name: Disruptive Stare
feats.notes: Your frigid gaze can turn a foe's blood to ice.
feats.trigger: A creature within 30 feet attempts to Cast a Spell with the concentrate trait.

feats.name: Dissolution's Clarity
feats.notes: The Dissolution teaches that darkness can bring clarity and focus, serenity and strength—and so you draw on nearby shadows to replenish your magic.

feats.name: Dissolution's Sight
feats.notes: Accepting your inner darkness means that no outer darkness can obscure your sight.

feats.name: Dissolution's Sovereignty
feats.notes: With discipline born from a lifetime in darkness, you convince the shadow of an enemy to fight by your side.

feats.name: Distant Archer
feats.notes: You've trained to harry your foes from great distances, using your swiftness to maintain distance and keen eyesight to stay on target.

feats.name: Distant Cackle
feats.notes: It takes a very brave person to enter the laughter-haunted forest where you dwell.

feats.name: Distant Invocation
feats.notes: Your connection to your runes stretches over even greater distances.

feats.name: Distant Wandering
feats.notes: Your body falls unconscious and your spirit projects out of it.

feats.name: Distant Waterbird's Poise
feats.notes: You flow around your foe, using the magic of your attack to carry you away.
feats.trigger: You hit a target with a Spellstrike.

feats.name: Distracting Bites
feats.notes: You know how to take advantage of those your swarm has attacked.

feats.name: Distracting Explosion
feats.notes: Your enemies think they can concentrate on something else while you're nearby? Oh, you'll give them a distraction, all right!
feats.trigger: A creature within your reach uses a concentrate action.

feats.name: Distracting Feint
feats.notes: Your Feints are far more distracting than normal.

feats.name: Distracting Flattery
feats.notes: You know how to maintain a good impression and manage your image, even while keeping uncouth company.
feats.trigger: You observe a target’s attitude toward yourself or your allies decrease as a result of an ally’s behavior.

feats.name: Distracting Performance
feats.notes: Your performances are especially distracting, allowing your allies to Sneak away with ease.

feats.name: Distracting Shadows
feats.notes: You have learned to remain hidden by using larger folk as a distraction to avoid drawing attention to yourself.

feats.name: Distracting Shot
feats.notes: The sheer power of your attacks, or the overwhelming number of them, leaves an enemy flustered.

feats.name: Distracting Spellstrike
feats.notes: You weave distracting magic with one hand to enhance the efficacy of your Spellstrike .

feats.name: Distracting Toss
feats.notes: You toss one weapon into the air as a distraction as you throw another.

feats.name: Disturbing Defense
feats.notes: Your internal organs and blood vessels have shifted and changed, and even you don't know precisely where in your body they are.

feats.name: Disturbing Knowledge
feats.notes: You utter a litany of dreadful names, prophecies, and descriptions of realms beyond mortal comprehension, drawn from your study of forbidden tomes and scrolls.

feats.name: Dive of the Divine
feats.notes: You dive from the sky, bringing down the might of the divine with you.
feats.prerequisite: Mortal Herald Dedication; fly Speed of at least 20 feet
feats.access: You are at least 20 feet above the ground.

feats.name: Diverse Lore
feats.notes: Your wandering studies mean you've heard rumors or theories about almost every topic.

feats.name: Diverse Mystery
feats.notes: You have broadened your understanding of the divine and can tap into the wonders of a different mystery.

feats.name: Diverse Recognition
feats.notes: Your Pathfinder training allows you to quickly size up numerous threats.
feats.prerequisite: Pathfinder Agent Dedication; master in a skill used to Recall Knowledge
feats.trigger: You successfully Recall Knowledge about a creature you can see, using a skill in which you are a master.

feats.name: Diverse Weapon Expert
feats.notes: Your proficiency ranks for simple weapons and martial weapons increase to expert, and your proficiency rank for advanced weapons increases to trained.
feats.prerequisite: Fighter Dedication; expert in any kind of weapon or unarmed attack

feats.name: Divert Destiny
feats.notes: You defy the fate before you, calling on wells of mythic vitality to sustain your life and allow you to persevere.
feats.trigger: An attack or effect would reduce you to 0 Hit Points or kill you outright.

feats.name: Divert Streamflow
feats.notes: With a brief gesture, you adapt swiftly to an attack like a flowing stream.
feats.trigger: You’re damaged by a melee Strike by a creature in your reach.

feats.name: Diverting Vortex
feats.notes: You use vestiges of magic to create a protective vortex.

feats.name: Divide and Conquer
feats.notes: When you face multiple foes, you wield your warshard weapon with vigor.
feats.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star

feats.name: Divine Aegis
feats.notes: A barrier offers protection against other magic but leaves you exposed to divine energy.
feats.trigger: You attempt a saving throw against a magical effect, but you haven’t rolled yet.

feats.name: Divine Apex
feats.notes: You can pour divine power into an item, letting the wearer exceed their limits.

feats.name: Divine Breadth
feats.notes: As your understanding increases, your god grants you more divine spells each day.

feats.name: Divine Castigation
feats.notes: Your deity’s grace doesn’t extend to your sworn enemies.

feats.name: Divine Countermeasures
feats.notes: You’ve studied your extraplanar heritage with the intent of better defending yourself, whether against creatures aligned with or opposed to your extraplanar lineage, and you’ve found that your techniques are equally powerful against celestials , fiends , and other divine entities.

feats.name: Divine Declaration
feats.notes: You can call forth a holy or unholy word from the realms beyond to punish your foes.

feats.name: Divine Disharmony
feats.notes: From your collection of religious trinkets, you pull out opposing divine objects.

feats.name: Divine Dragonblood
feats.notes: You can trace your lineage to a dragon with almost deific powers, such as a diabolic dragon or empyreal dragon .

feats.name: Divine Effusion
feats.notes: The power of your mystery surges through you like a font of divine energy, even when your own magic dwindles.

feats.name: Divine Emissary
feats.notes: Your familiar is a divine emissary, sent to you by your deity or patron and infused with celestial powers.
feats.prerequisite: a familiar, you follow a good-aligned deity or patron
feats.access: Knights of Lastwall have access to this feat.

feats.name: Divine Evolution
feats.notes: The divine might provided by your bloodline flows through you.

feats.name: Divine Grace
feats.notes: You call upon your deity's grace
feats.trigger: You attempt a save against a spell, but you haven’t rolled yet.

feats.name: Divine Guidance
feats.notes: Find guidance in the writings of your faith

feats.name: Divine Healing
feats.notes: Although you aren't a proper champion of your faith, your deity still recognizes your efforts and provides you with a small divine ability to help others.
feats.prerequisite: Knight Vigilant; Expert in Religion; worship a deity with a divine font that grants _heal_

feats.name: Divine Health
feats.notes: Your faith makes you resistant to disease, protecting you as you offer succor to the ill.

feats.name: Divine Infusion
feats.notes: You pour energy into the subject of your healing to empower its attacks.

feats.name: Divine Invulnerability
feats.notes: Though you are not yet a god, you can invoke a measure of omnipotence that makes you high invulnerable.

feats.name: Divine Presence
feats.notes: Your spirit becomes one with your deity, granting you the bearing of a god.

feats.name: Divine Rebuttal
feats.notes: You strive against magical threats physically and spiritually.
feats.trigger: Your ally is about to roll a saving throw against a magical ability of a creature you’re adjacent to

feats.name: Divine Reflexes
feats.notes: You gain an additional reaction that you can use only for your champion's reaction.

feats.name: Divine Wall
feats.notes: You use your shield to harry your enemies, preventing them from stepping away from or around you.

feats.name: Divine Weapon
feats.notes: You siphon residual spell energy into a weapon you’re wielding.
feats.trigger: You finish Casting a Spell using one of your divine spell slots on your turn

feats.name: Divine Wings
feats.notes: With effort, you can call forth magical wings from your back, similar in appearance to those of your extraplanar forebear, whether they be elegantly feathered wings or ominous bat wings.

feats.name: Diving Armor
feats.notes: You've modified your armor with fins, rotors, and other devices to make it easy for you to move through the water, plus mechanical gills that can help you extract breathable air from water.

feats.name: Dizzying Spell
feats.notes: Your spell leaves a foe’s head spinning and unable to concentrate.

feats.name: Dizzying Spin Dance
feats.notes: You’re practiced in using your fans to spin with dizzying speed.

feats.name: Djinni Magic
feats.notes: The magic of djinn runs through your blood.

feats.name: Do You Know Who I Am?
feats.notes: Your reputation casts a long shadow, allowing you to throw your cultural weight around, especially in larger settlements.

feats.name: Doctor's Visitation
feats.notes: You move to provide immediate care to those who need it.

feats.name: Dodge Away
feats.notes: You use your acrobatic prowess to evade an attack, using momentum to keep yourself moving if you choose.
feats.trigger: You are the target of a melee attack.

feats.name: Dodging Roll
feats.notes: You dodge a blow at the last possible moment.
feats.trigger: You take damage from an area effect that allows a Reflex save.

feats.name: Dogfang Bite
feats.notes: You can swing your beak to slash your foes when piercing attacks won't do.

feats.name: Dokkaebi Fire
feats.notes: You can create illusory wisps of ghostly blue flame.
feats.access: dokkaebi goblin heritage

feats.name: Domain Acumen
feats.notes: Every oracle's mystery touches on a divine domain of the deities that fuel it; you can access that power.

feats.name: Domain Embodiment
feats.notes: Your deity contains multitudes, and you can express any aspect of them you desire.

feats.name: Domain Fluency
feats.notes: You command a deep understanding of the domains related to your mystery.

feats.name: Domain Focus
feats.notes: Your devotion to your deity’s domains grows greater, and so does the power granted to you.

feats.name: Domain Initiate
feats.notes: Your deity bestows a special spell related to their powers.

feats.name: Domain Spirit
feats.notes: You forge an intense spiritual bond of mutual trust and appreciation with a single spirit that you have already bonded with using Bond with Spirit.

feats.name: Dominating Gaze
feats.notes: You stare into your target's eyes and enthrall them, shattering their free will.

feats.name: Dominion Aura
feats.notes: For a short time, you fully manifest the expectations of the god destroyer within you.

feats.name: Domino Effect
feats.notes: You've learned to pull the invisible strings of magic to affect targets that wouldn't normally be.
feats.trigger: A creature triggers a magical snare you crafted.

feats.name: Don thy Fervor
feats.notes: With a thought, the passion of your fiendish desires becomes evident in your eyes and posture.

feats.name: Dongun Education
feats.notes: You're knowledgeable in trades that are important to your people's survival and commercial interests.
feats.access: You are from Dongun Hold or Alkenstar.

feats.name: Doom of Sailors
feats.notes: Sailors know that the sight of an angry merfolk might well mean that they never see the shore again.

feats.name: Dormant Eruption
feats.notes: A sweltering heat and sparks of flame that take the form of tiny copies of you surround your body.
feats.prerequisite: You've been brought to 0 Hit Points by an enemy that has the fire trait or an enemy's ability that has the fire trait.

feats.name: Double Poison
feats.notes: You can apply two different infused injury poisons to the same weapon, though not to a piece of ammunition.

feats.name: Double Prey
feats.notes: You can focus on two foes at once, hunting both of them down.

feats.name: Double Shot
feats.notes: You shoot twice in blindingly fast succession.

feats.name: Double Slice
feats.notes: You lash out at your foe with both weapons.

feats.name: Double, Double
feats.notes: For each temporary oil or potion you brew during your daily preparations, you brew two copies of it.

feats.name: Doublespeak
feats.notes: You're skilled at saying one thing and meaning something different.

feats.name: Dousing Spell
feats.notes: You enhance your spell with elemental water, soaking the target.
feats.prerequisite: Elementalist Dedication; water is in your elemental philosophy

feats.name: Dracomancer
feats.notes: The power infused into you by your draconic benefactor’s presence allows you to manifest their most iconic spells.

feats.name: Draconic Acolyte Dedication
feats.notes: As an acolyte of dragonkind, you have an item known as a draconic gift that you can use to summon a portion of the magical essence of the dragon you received it from.

feats.name: Draconic Arrogance
feats.notes: Few can sway you from your goals while the fury of combat fills you.

feats.name: Draconic Aspect
feats.notes: You have an obvious draconic feature, such as sharp claws, a snout full of sharp teeth, or strong reptilian tail, that you can use offensively.

feats.name: Draconic Familiar
feats.notes: Your devotion to dragons has attracted a loyal servant.

feats.name: Draconic Fury
feats.notes: You briefly summon spectral claws that lash out in a flurry.

feats.name: Draconic Paragon
feats.notes: Your connection to your draconic benefactor becomes especially pronounced.

feats.name: Draconic Resilience
feats.notes: Energy reminiscent of dragon scales shimmers over you, making it more difficult for attacks to penetrate your defenses.

feats.name: Draconic Resistance
feats.notes: Draconic magic safeguards you against harm.

feats.name: Draconic Scent
feats.notes: Your sense of smell is uncanny, much like a dragon's.

feats.name: Draconic Scent
feats.notes: Your sense of smell has heightened to be as keen as that of a dragon.

feats.name: Draconic Sight
feats.notes: You have a fraction of the senses of your draconic forebear.

feats.name: Draconic Sycophant
feats.notes: You possess features that dragons find particularly cute or charming, making it easier to endear yourself to them, or at least cause them to momentarily forgive your insolence.

feats.name: Draconic Veil
feats.notes: Like some dragons, your forebear had the supernatural ability to change their shape to walk among humanoids.

feats.name: Drag Down
feats.notes: While swimming in water at least 10 feet deep, you grab an adjacent creature (on nearby land or in the water) and pull it below the surface.
feats.source: Absalom, City of Lost Omens, Azarketi Ancestry Web Supplement

feats.name: Dragging Strike
feats.notes: You aim your weapon to snag a foe's armor, clothing, or flesh to pull them closer.

feats.name: Dragon Arcana
feats.notes: You've discovered how to add the magic of dragons to your tradition.
feats.prerequisite: ability to cast spells from spell slots; Dragon Disciple Dedication

feats.name: Dragon Disciple Dedication
feats.notes: You choose to study or worship one type of dragon, and your focus grants you a measure of its power.
feats.access: You are a kobold with the dragonscaled or spellscaled heritage, a dragon instinct barbarian, or a draconic bloodline sorcerer.

feats.name: Dragon Grip
feats.notes: Your hold has a unique draconic connection.

feats.name: Dragon Lore
feats.notes: You've set your mind on learning more about your ancestor and their kin, and perhaps you were even raised by a dragon parent.

feats.name: Dragon Prince
feats.notes: The blood of the Dragon Kings runs strong in your veins.

feats.name: Dragon Roar
feats.notes: You bellow, instilling fear in your enemies.

feats.name: Dragon Shape
feats.notes: You can take on the shape of some of the world’s most fearsome creatures.

feats.name: Dragon Spit
feats.notes: Many Tian-Dan claim to have dragon blood in their veins, and in your case, this is true—you can spit energy, and you might have an especially visible sign of your draconic heritage.

feats.name: Dragon Stance
feats.notes: You enter the stance of a dragon and make powerful leg strikes like a lashing dragon's tail.

feats.name: Dragon Transformation
feats.notes: You transform into a ferocious Large dragon, gaining the effects of 6th-rank dragon form except that you use your own AC and attack modifier, you apply your extra damage from Rage , and the Dragon Breath action uses your class DC.

feats.name: Dragon's Flight
feats.notes: You have grown a small pair of draconic wings or have honed your use of the wings you've had since birth.

feats.name: Dragon's Journey
feats.notes: Your movements are like that of a dragon weaving a serpentine path between your enemies and allies.

feats.name: Dragon's Presence
feats.notes: As kin to dragonkind, you project unflappable confidence (that collapses catastrophically against the deadliest foes).

feats.name: Dragon's Rage Breath
feats.notes: You breathe deeply and exhale powerful energy in a 30-foot cone, dealing 1d6 damage per level to each creature in the area with a basic Reflex save against your class DC.

feats.name: Dragon's Rage Wings
feats.notes: You sprout dragon wings from your back of the same color as your chosen dragon.

feats.name: Dragonet Breath
feats.notes: You have developed your magical breath.

feats.name: Dragonet Immunities
feats.notes: You will not fall asleep unless you choose to allow it, nor will you sit still.

feats.name: Dragonet Resistances
feats.notes: You might be a little dragon, but you are still a dragon, which means it’s difficult to constrain you.

feats.name: Dragonscaled Lore
feats.notes: The study of dragons is not merely academic to you but part of your family tree.

feats.name: Drain Emotion
feats.notes: You touch an adjacent creature and attempt to draw out its excess emotion.

feats.name: Drain Soul Cage
feats.notes: You make your soul cage into your bonded item, allowing you to harness its abundant magical energy.
feats.prerequisite: Lich Dedication; Drain Bonded Item, spellbook

feats.name: Drain Vitality
feats.notes: You draw out the bestial magic energy within your bonded beast gun to fortify yourself, purge ongoing harm, and bolster your life force with a sheath of swirling life essence.

feats.name: Draining Strike
feats.notes: You draw the life out of your target using both your weapon and your thralls as a conduit.

feats.name: Draining Touch
feats.notes: You reach out your arm, grasping hungrily for a source of energy.

feats.name: Drake Rider Dedication
feats.notes: You gain the service of a young riding drake , riding dragonet , or another animal companion with the dragon trait you have access to.

feats.name: Draw from the Land
feats.notes: You pull strength from the surrounding terrain.

feats.name: Drawn in Vital Ink
feats.notes: After striking the target, you run a brush or finger along your weapon to collect a bit of its blood.

feats.name: Dread Blade
feats.notes: Your strikes with your conjured dagger impart the chill of the grave.

feats.name: Dread Marshal Stance
feats.notes: Putting on a grim face for the battle ahead, you encourage your allies to strike fear into their foes with vicious attacks.

feats.name: Dread Mosquito Storm
feats.notes: You release a massive swarm of deadly bloodsuckers.

feats.name: Dread Striker
feats.notes: You capitalize on your enemies’ fear to slip past their defenses.

feats.name: Dream Guise
feats.notes: You Stride into a willing ally's space, at which point both of your appearances shift into a shared third appearance, usually one that looks like a mix of the two of you.

feats.name: Dream Logic
feats.notes: You can transmit a sense of dreamy nonchalance.

feats.name: Dream Magic
feats.notes: You learn dream-related magic to aid your studies.

feats.name: Dream May
feats.notes: You are the child of a cuckoo hag, making one of your eyes violet or even black.

feats.name: Drenching Mist
feats.notes: When you cast obscuring mist , you can modify it to extinguish flames.
feats.prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _obscuring mist_

feats.name: Drifter's Juke
feats.notes: You move in and out of range to complement your attacks.

feats.name: Drifting Pollen
feats.notes: A haze of pollen floats around you.

feats.name: Drilled Reflexes
feats.notes: You leave a lasting impression on your squadmates that makes them particularly adept at following your commands.

feats.name: Drive Back
feats.notes: You push the enemy back and attempt to intercede between the foe and your ally.
feats.trigger: An enemy within your reach Strikes an ally adjacent to you.
feats.access: Knights of Lastwall have access to this feat.

feats.name: Drive-By Attack
feats.notes: You can smoothly line up an attack without disrupting your control.

feats.name: Driving Rain
feats.notes: Heavy drops of rain batter down, hitting like sling stones and impeding vision.

feats.name: Drowning Mist
feats.notes: Though not unique to Chelaxian kineticists, this sarglagon -inspired technique floods enemies’ lungs.

feats.name: Druid Dedication
feats.notes: You cast spells like a druid.

feats.name: Dual Energy Heart
feats.notes: A second energy dwells in your eidolon.

feats.name: Dual Finisher
feats.notes: You split your attacks.

feats.name: Dual Onslaught
feats.notes: When you lash out with both weapons, you leave no room for the target to escape your attack.

feats.name: Dual Studies
feats.notes: You and your eidolon learn different skills.

feats.name: Dual Thrower
feats.notes: You know how to throw two weapons as easily as strike with them.

feats.name: Dual-Form Weapon
feats.notes: You've built your innovation with replaceable interlocking pieces that you can use to transform it into another type of weapon entirely.

feats.name: Dual-Handed Assault
feats.notes: You snap your free hand over to grip your weapon just long enough to add momentum and deliver a more powerful blow to your opponent.

feats.name: Dual-Weapon Blitz
feats.notes: You attack as you weave your way around the battlefield.

feats.name: Dual-Weapon Reload
feats.notes: You carry your ammunition in a way that allows you to reload while holding two weapons.

feats.name: Dual-Weapon Reload (Gunslinger)
feats.notes: You carry your ammunition in a way that allows you to reload while holding two weapons.

feats.name: Dual-Weapon Warrior Dedication
feats.notes: You're exceptional in your use of two weapons.

feats.name: Dualborn
feats.notes: Your suli heritage can be traced back to two geniekin ancestors of opposing elements, or to an elemental ancestor that embodied two combined elements.

feats.name: Dualistic Synergy
feats.notes: If your next action is to Cast a Spell from your spell slots, you gain a benefit.

feats.name: Dubious Knowledge
feats.notes: Learn true and erroneous knowledge on failed check
feats.prerequisite: trained in a skill with the Recall Knowledge action

feats.name: Duck!
feats.notes: Your long experience with your erratic patrons and their peers has given you a lot of practice in hitting the deck when you hear the rumbling of a powerful entity.

feats.name: Duel Spell Advantage
feats.notes: When you start a psychic duel, you gain a third natural psychic spell.

feats.name: Dueling Acumen
feats.notes: You're always ready for a new duel, and you've been trained to start and end fights quickly.

feats.name: Dueling Dance (Fighter)
feats.notes: Using a free hand as pivot and balance, you both attack and defend with your weapon.

feats.name: Dueling Parry (Fighter)
feats.notes: You can parry attacks against you with your one-handed weapon.

feats.name: Dueling Riposte
feats.notes: You elegantly counterattack against your flailing enemy.
feats.trigger: A creature within your reach critically fails a Strike against you

feats.name: Duelist Dedication
feats.notes: You are always ready to draw your weapon and begin a duel, no matter the circumstances.
feats.prerequisite: trained in light armor and simple weapons

feats.name: Duelist's Challenge
feats.notes: Select one enemy you can see and proclaim a challenge against it.

feats.name: Duelist's Edge
feats.notes: You hone your reaction time through duels and learn to draw your weapon seamlessly as you begin a fight.
feats.trigger: You roll initiative, and you are observing at least one opponent.

feats.name: Duelist's Form
feats.notes: Many assume that a duelist's habit of fighting with one hand behind their back or on their hip is an insult or self-restriction.

feats.name: Duo Dragon Kick
feats.notes: You’ve practiced an impressive spin technique with your construct, automatically attacking in tandem as you launch each other through the air.

feats.name: Duo's Aim
feats.notes: With assistance from your spotter, you aim for an especially accurate attack.

feats.name: Duskwalker Lore
feats.notes: You either found another duskwalker who taught you the secrets of your kind, or you managed to research your unusual heritage.

feats.name: Duskwalker Magic
feats.notes: Your connection to psychopomps gives you the power to glimpse the near future and protect corpses from the ravages of undeath.

feats.name: Duskwalker Weapon Familiarity
feats.notes: You have familiarity with the bo staff , longbow , composite longbow , scythe , and staff

feats.name: Dust Cloud
feats.notes: Dust and pollen fill your waking world, obscuring creatures from sight.

feats.name: Dustsoul
feats.notes: Your earth elemental ancestor's influence manifests in you as dust and dirt, like the soil of a field or the hot desert sands.

feats.name: Dwarven Doughtiness
feats.notes: You are naturally calm and collected in the face of imminent danger.

feats.name: Dwarven Lore
feats.notes: You eagerly absorbed the old stories and traditions of your ancestors, your gods, and your people.

feats.name: Dwarven Reinforcement
feats.notes: You can use your knowledge of engineering and metalwork to temporarily strengthen thick objects and structures.

feats.name: Dwarven Weapon Familiarity
feats.notes: Your kin have instilled in you an affinity for hard-hitting weapons, and you prefer these to more elegant arms.

feats.name: Eagle Eye
feats.notes: Your practice with crossbows and firearms has sharpened your attention to detail.

feats.name: Eagle Eyes
feats.notes: You and your spotter are adept at watching out for one another.

feats.name: Eagle Knight Dedication
feats.notes: Eagle Knights are the marshals and envoys of Andoran and are committed to keeping the peace.
feats.prerequisite: Trained in Diplomacy; Trained in Society
feats.access: You’re invited by a current member of the Eagle Knights or the People’s Council.

feats.name: Earned Glory
feats.notes: Elves often struggle with underestimating aiuvarins, and you are experienced at telling stories of your accomplishments to gain their respect.

feats.name: Ears of the Forest
feats.notes: Beyond relying on your own senses, you keep an ear open for nearby creatures for help in exploring your surroundings.

feats.name: Ears that Hear the Truth
feats.notes: You have an acute understanding of the rhythms of living things, and you never miss the quaver that betrays a spoken lie.

feats.name: Earth to Heavens Strike
feats.notes: Your blows hamper both a foe’s mobility and cognitive functions by focusing first on their lower extremities and then their head.

feats.name: Earthbond
feats.notes: Your bond to the terra firma under your feet increases as your connection to your draconic aspect grows.

feats.name: Earthsense
feats.notes: Your connection to earth and stone allows you to feel the slightest displacement that disturbs them, down to the shift of a pebble.

feats.name: Earworm
feats.notes: By endlessly repeating a motif, you implant a memorable song that repeats over and over again in your allies’ heads, preparing them to respond to it later.

feats.name: Ease the Burden
feats.notes: You wash away a creature’s pain with a touch.

feats.name: Easily Dismissed
feats.notes: You are practiced at blending into the background of the streets and halls of larger folk to ensure that you are overlooked.
feats.access: Chelaxian nationality

feats.name: Eat Fortune
feats.notes: As someone tries to twist fate, you consume the interference.
feats.trigger: A creature within 60 feet uses a fortune or misfortune effect.

feats.name: Ebb and Flow
feats.notes: You can pull forth both vitality and the void simultaneously to harm your enemies and heal your allies.

feats.name: Echo of the Fallen
feats.notes: With the utmost gratitude for your help in releasing them from their unearthly coil, a tiny sliver of a ghostly entity has remained attached to you.
feats.prerequisite: You helped to lay a haunt, ghost, or spirit to rest.

feats.name: Echoes in Stone
feats.notes: You pause a moment to attune your senses to the stone around you.

feats.name: Echoing Channel
feats.notes: When you pull forth vitality or void energy, you also create a smaller pocket of that energy.

feats.name: Echoing Fury
feats.notes: You cheat the rules of time to co-locate during your attack.
feats.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star

feats.name: Echoing Spell
feats.notes: You time the components of your spell with exacting precision, setting up a resonance that duplicates the spell's effects.

feats.name: Echoing Violence
feats.notes: Your powerful attack causes damage that reverberates through your opponent’s body, shaking muscle from bone.
feats.trigger: You critically succeed with an unarmed Strike against an opponent.

feats.name: Echolocation
feats.notes: When you take the Seek action, you can use hearing as a precise sense with a range of 40 feet until the start of your next turn.

feats.name: Eclectic Obsession
feats.notes: Your desire for stimulation has led you from one pursuit to another and granted you a smattering of expertise with myriad crafts and professions.

feats.name: Eclectic Polymath
feats.notes: Your flexible mind can quickly shift from one spell to another.

feats.name: Eclectic Skill
feats.notes: Your broad experiences translate to a range of skills.

feats.name: Eclectic Sword Mastery
feats.notes: You instinctively learn how to use a sword with just a few practice swings.

feats.name: Eclipsed Vitality
feats.notes: You shroud yourself in ashes that hide the vital essence sought by life-sensing undead.
feats.prerequisite: Assassin Dedication or Scout Dedication; Master in Stealth
feats.access: Knights of Lastwall have access to this feat.

feats.name: Ectoplasmic Aura
feats.notes: For the next 10 minutes, you and all allies in a 30-foot emanation from you gain a +1 circumstance bonus to AC as the air between you and your enemies thickens with ectoplasm.

feats.name: Edgewatch Detective Dedication
feats.notes: You're a specially trained detective for the Edgewatch guard precinct in Absalom.
feats.source: Pathfinder #157: Devil at the Dreaming Palace

feats.name: Edict of Mortality
feats.notes: You recite an excerpt of the Laws of Mortality, often the first law: “Let no mortal be beholden to a god.” Attempt an Intimidation check against all enemies within 60 feet that worship a deity, comparing your result against each target's Will DC.

feats.name: Edifying Trace
feats.notes: When you apply a rune to a foe, it reveals something about them to you.

feats.name: Educate Allies
feats.notes: You tweak the properties of your composition spell to convey a bit of your defensive knowledge.
feats.trigger: An ally benefiting from one of your composition spells is subject to an effect with the auditory, illusion, linguistic, sonic, or visual trait

feats.name: Educated Assessment
feats.notes: You attempt to Recall Knowledge about a creature, and the GM uses the same secret roll result against the creature’s Deception or Stealth DC, giving you the information from a Battle Assessment.
feats.access: A character who is a member of the Pathfinder Society has access to this option.

feats.name: Eerie Compression
feats.notes: Your limbs and even your torso can collapse in on themselves, allowing you to fit through tight spaces as though you were a Small creature.

feats.name: Eerie Environs
feats.notes: The natural world can be scary to those not used to it—and you make it scarier still.
feats.prerequisite: Trained in Intimidation; Trained in Stealth

feats.name: Eerie Flicker
feats.notes: Your body flickers momentarily into the Ethereal Plane .
feats.trigger: An enemy’s Strike would hit you and you weren’t already concealed , hidden , or undetected by that enemy.

feats.name: Eerie Proclamation
feats.notes: You know there are places in the world that are just wrong— places where the birds don't sing and where you always feel like you're being watched.
feats.prerequisite: Expert in Occultism; Expert in Survival

feats.name: Eerie Traces
feats.notes: The tracks you leave behind are strange, somehow disconcerting and unnerving—they might travel backward, or through places no one would think to pass through.
feats.prerequisite: Trained in Intimidation; Trained in Survival

feats.name: Efficient Alchemy
feats.notes: Thanks to the time you've spent studying and experimenting, you know how to scale your formulas into larger batches that don't require any additional attention.

feats.name: Efficient Alchemy (Paragon)
feats.notes: Prepare more alchemical items from your infused reagents.

feats.name: Efficient Controls
feats.notes: By reducing redundant systems and streamlining essential functions, you have made it easier for the vehicle to operate with fewer crew.
feats.prerequisite: Vehicle Mechanic Dedication; Master in Crafting

feats.name: Efficient Explorer
feats.notes: You are more efficient at exploring uncharted territories.
feats.prerequisite: trained in Lore about a specific terrain

feats.name: Efficient Preparation
feats.notes: You’ve developed techniques for drilling your allies on multiple tactics in a succinct and efficient manner.

feats.name: Efficient Rituals
feats.notes: You can perform particularly extensive rituals in less time.

feats.name: Effortless Captivation
feats.notes: You maintain your innate charms and illusions with hardly a thought.
feats.trigger: Your turn begins.

feats.name: Effortless Concentration
feats.notes: You can maintain a spell with hardly a thought.
feats.source: Player Core, Player Core 2, Impossible Magic
feats.trigger: Your turn begins

feats.name: Effortless Impulse
feats.notes: A steady ripple from your kinetic gate maintains one of your impulses.
feats.trigger: Your turn begins.

feats.name: Effortless Reach
feats.notes: Focusing the powers of your ki to augment your blows, you stretch and lengthen your body in ways that defy logic.

feats.name: Efreeti Magic
feats.notes: The magic of your efreeti ancestors flows through you.

feats.name: Eidetic Ear
feats.notes: You have an amazing memory for sound.

feats.name: Eidetic Memorization
feats.notes: Pathfinders are often asked to study the intricacies of ancient history under less than ideal conditions, and you've trained your brain to make the most of your limited time.

feats.name: Eidolon's Retort
feats.notes: Your eidolon makes a melee Strike against the triggering creature.
feats.trigger: A creature within your eidolon’s reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it’s using.

feats.name: Eidolon's Trample
feats.notes: Your eidolon Strides up to double their Speed and can move through the spaces of creatures at least one size smaller, Trampling each creature whose space they enter.

feats.name: Eidolon's Wrath
feats.notes: Your eidolon gains the eidolon’s wrath link spell, which they cast, instead of you.

feats.name: Elaborate Flourish
feats.notes: You embellish your spellcasting with entrancing flourishes and grand pronouncements, making it harder to identify or counter.

feats.name: Elaborate Scroll Esoterica
feats.notes: You've picked up more scraps of magic texts, improving your makeshift scrolls.

feats.name: Elaborate Talisman Esoterica
feats.notes: As you continue to collect talismanic esoterica, you improve your ability to create temporary talismans.

feats.name: Elbow Breaker
feats.notes: You bend your opponent’s body or limbs into agonizing positions that make it difficult for them to maintain their grip.

feats.name: Eldritch Archer Dedication
feats.notes: You channel powerful magic with your archery, allowing you to deliver potent spells through the tip of an arrow rather than the more mundane flick of the wrist or whatever other gestures are usually used.
feats.prerequisite: expert in at least one weapon from the or bow or crossbow weapon group

feats.name: Eldritch Calm
feats.notes: Your fey heritage has altered your mindset to more resemble the uncanny perspective of the fey.

feats.name: Eldritch Debilitations
feats.notes: You know how to apply debilitations that are particularly troublesome for spellcasters.

feats.name: Eldritch Reload
feats.notes: You integrate your talent for magic into your use of reloading weapons.

feats.name: Eldritch Researcher Dedication
feats.notes: An eager student of occult lore, you enjoy reading rare or forgotten tomes with ancient rituals and hidden secrets.
feats.prerequisite: Trained in Arcana; Trained in Occultism

feats.name: Electric Counter
feats.notes: You can charge yourself with lighting, gain resistance to electricity or shocking an attacker.
feats.trigger: You would take damage.

feats.name: Electrify Armor
feats.notes: You electrify your armor to punish foes who dare to attack you.

feats.name: Electrogenesis
feats.notes: Some animals and beasts have electric organs in their body that they can use to jolt their prey.
feats.prerequisite: Wild Mimic Dedication; you have seen a creature deal electricity damage with an unarmed Strike or have identified a creature capable of dealing electricity damage with an unarmed Strike in combat

feats.name: Elegant Buckler
feats.notes: You've learned a flexible way to position your buckler to provide more protection.

feats.name: Elemental Apotheosis
feats.notes: You take on an elemental countenance, appearing like a type of elemental of your element.
feats.prerequisite: Nourishing Gate; exactly one kinetic element

feats.name: Elemental Artillery
feats.notes: Spinning wood and metal together, you create a rugged wooden ballista.

feats.name: Elemental Assault
feats.notes: You shroud your arms and held weapons in elemental magic.

feats.name: Elemental Bulwark
feats.notes: You call upon the corresponding elements of your suli heritage to resist the effect.
feats.trigger: An enemy is about to damage you with cold, electricity, or fire, or with a spell that has the air , earth , fire , or water trait.

feats.name: Elemental Defense
feats.notes: You attune yourself to elemental power so that you gain a burst of protection when you call upon it.

feats.name: Elemental Embellish
feats.notes: You can summon a harmless but impressive elemental display.

feats.name: Elemental Evolution
feats.notes: The elemental power within you is more mutable and versatile than most.

feats.name: Elemental Existence
feats.notes: Your body becomes infused with elemental earth.

feats.name: Elemental Explosion
feats.notes: You unleash the energy roiling within you.

feats.name: Elemental Eyes
feats.notes: You can see in the darkness as easily as an elemental.

feats.name: Elemental Familiar
feats.notes: Your familiar becomes an elemental spirit capable of taking on aspects of the elements.

feats.name: Elemental Familiar (Kineticist)
feats.notes: A small creature made of elemental matter springs forth from your kinetic gate.

feats.name: Elemental Fist
feats.notes: You can color your qi in bright elemental energy.

feats.name: Elemental Lore
feats.notes: You've devoted yourself to researching the secrets of the Inner Sphere.

feats.name: Elemental Overlap
feats.notes: Though you've dedicated yourself to one element, you learn to mix that element with another.

feats.name: Elemental Revision
feats.notes: You can scratch out and rewrite part of an elemental rune to temporarily change the type of power it channels.

feats.name: Elemental Shape
feats.notes: You understand the fundamental elements of nature such that you can imbue them into your body and manifest as a living embodiment of those elements.

feats.name: Elemental Spark
feats.notes: You’ve learned to alter the magic of your sprite’s spark, imparting them with elemental energies.
feats.access: Tian Xia origin (but see special)

feats.name: Elemental Subsitution
feats.notes: You can tamper with the elemental energy of a spell.

feats.name: Elemental Summons
feats.notes: You can call the elements to you.

feats.name: Elemental Trade
feats.notes: You have a strong connection with stone and metal.

feats.name: Elemental Transformation
feats.notes: You open your kinetic gate, but rather than activating your kinetic aura, you instead become overwhelmed with transformative elemental energy.

feats.name: Elemental Wrath
feats.notes: You are so attuned to the land that you can call forth a bolt of energy from your surroundings.

feats.name: Elementalist Dedication
feats.notes: Each day when you make your daily preparations, you can attune yourself to one element of your choice from your elemental philosophy.

feats.name: Elf Atavism
feats.notes: Your elven blood runs particularly strong, granting you features far more elven than those of a typical aiuvarin.

feats.name: Elf Step
feats.notes: You move in a graceful dance, and even your steps are broad.

feats.name: Eliminate Red Herrings
feats.notes: You have a keen sense for avoiding spurious lines of inquiry.

feats.name: Elite Dracomancer
feats.notes: Your draconic power equals that of a lesser dragon.

feats.name: Elucidating Vision
feats.notes: Your eyes have seen many things in your past lives, and your sight seems to have grown more powerful over your lifetimes.

feats.name: Elucidation
feats.notes: You can cut through illusions with such precision that all those around you find their senses sharpened as well.
feats.trigger: You succeed at a saving throw to disbelieve an illusion.

feats.name: Elude the Divine
feats.notes: You are able to escape inquisitions involving divine magic, allowing you to blend in well in Mzali but also to avoid unwanted attention in other oppressive theocracies.

feats.name: Elude Trouble
feats.notes: Stride up to your Speed.
feats.trigger: A creature missed you with a melee attack.

feats.name: Elven Aloofness
feats.notes: As much as you might care for them, you've come to terms with the ephemeral nature of non-elves, and it makes their threats feel less troublesome.

feats.name: Elven Instincts
feats.notes: Your senses let you react rapidly.

feats.name: Elven Lore
feats.notes: You've studied traditional elven arts, learning about arcane magic and the world around you.

feats.name: Elven Persistence
feats.notes: Elves don’t give up easily on their pursuits.
feats.trigger: You fail a skill check you’re at least trained in.

feats.name: Elven Verve
feats.notes: While all elves are immune to the paralyzing touch of ghouls, you can shake off flesh-numbing magic of all kinds.

feats.name: Elven Weapon Familiarity
feats.notes: You favor bows and other elegant weapons.

feats.name: Elver Pet
feats.notes: Athamarus have bonded with eels more closely than any other fish.

feats.name: Elysium's Cadence
feats.notes: You've been ensnared by an azata's infectious enthusiasm for life, love, and freedom.
feats.prerequisite: You've partied extensively with an azata or entered a romantic relationship with an azata.

feats.name: Emancipator's Mask
feats.notes: Your mask grants you the abilities of Whistling Kite, the Vigilant Seer, who emancipated thousands.

feats.name: Embed Aeon Stone
feats.notes: You discover the secrets to embedding aeon stones into your flesh.

feats.name: Ember's Eyes
feats.notes: Your eyes blaze with inner flame.

feats.name: Emberkin
feats.notes: A peri's roaring spirit burns in your soul.

feats.name: Emblazon Antimagic
feats.notes: Your deity’s symbol protects against offensive magic.

feats.name: Emblazon Armament
feats.notes: Carefully etching a sacred image into a physical object, you steel yourself for battle.

feats.name: Emblazon Divinity
feats.notes: Emblazon more equipment at the same time.

feats.name: Emblazon Energy
feats.notes: With elemental forces, you make your emblazoned symbols more potent.

feats.name: Embodied Dragoon Subjectivity
feats.notes: When your allies call for swift reinforcements or lightning raids, you're ready to answer.

feats.name: Embodied Dreadnought Subjectivity
feats.notes: Your colossal might marks you as a behemoth, the pride of Nex's Fleshforges, and the heaviest ordnance is a child's toy in your monumental grasp.
feats.access: You're from Nex

feats.name: Embodied Legionary Subjectivity
feats.notes: Nex's Fleshforges shaped you not to achieve individual greatness at arms, but rather to become a part of a legion, a modular piece integral to the combined arms stratagems of Nexian battlemages.
feats.access: You're from Nex

feats.name: Embodiment Of The Balance
feats.notes: Your place in the balance between the forces of life and entropy expands the spells you can pull from the spirit realms.

feats.name: Embolded With Glorious Purpose
feats.notes: Communing with powerful spirits of the world and other powers far greater than yourself fills your heart with purpose and inspires you to strive for greater accomplishments.

feats.name: Embrace the Pain
feats.notes: Ignoring your pain, you reach out and grab the creature or weapon that caused you harm.
feats.trigger: A creature within your reach damages you with a melee attack.

feats.name: Emerald Boughs Accustomation
feats.notes: You are comfortable and socially capable in almost any cultural context.
feats.prerequisite: Magaambyan Attendant Dedication; Expert in Society; Emerald Boughs affiliation

feats.name: Emerald Boughs Hideaway
feats.notes: You use Emerald Bough techniques to create a small extradimensional space called a hideaway that lasts as long as you are conscious.
feats.prerequisite: Magaambyan Attendant Dedication; Emerald Boughs affiliation

feats.name: Emergency Medical Assistance
feats.notes: You've learned a variety of methods for helping allies who are bleeding, burning, or otherwise suffering persistent damage, from brushing off acid to patting down fires.

feats.name: Emergency Regeneration
feats.notes: You have battled against foes whose bodies naturally regenerate, and while yours doesn't do so all the time, it can happen in a pinch.
feats.prerequisite: Wild Mimic Dedication; you have deactivated a creature’s regeneration for at least 1 round or have identified a creature with regeneration in combat
feats.trigger: You’re reduced to 0 hit points from damage that’s neither acid nor fire .

feats.name: Emergency Targe
feats.notes: You immediately Raise a Shield or cast shield .
feats.trigger: An enemy you’re aware of hits you with a Strike or a spell attack, or you fail a save against an enemy’s spell.

feats.name: Emissary Assistance
feats.notes: As an emissary, you have assisted land-bound creatures in journeying underwater to visit your settlements.

feats.name: Emissary Familiar
feats.notes: You forge a mystical bond with a spirit or create a spirit from a fragment of your own soul.

feats.name: Emissary of Peace
feats.notes: Even when bloodshed is inevitable, you would rather see your foes surrender.

feats.name: Emit Defensive Odor
feats.notes: While athamarus' natural pheromones are typically used for communication, you have developed yours into a defense mechanism to ward off foes.

feats.name: Emotional Partitions
feats.notes: You have created strong mental partitions in your mind to filter out negative emotional influences.

feats.name: Emotional Push
feats.notes: You prepare to take advantage of your enemy’s sudden change in emotions.
feats.trigger: An enemy you’re aware of fails its save against an emotion spell

feats.name: Emotional Surge
feats.notes: Your heart soars, increasing your power for a moment.

feats.name: Emotionless
feats.notes: Your malfunctioning emotional processors make it difficult for you to feel strong emotions.

feats.name: Empathetic Envoy
feats.notes: You believe that treating others with respect is the fastest way into their hearts, and in turn others are more likely to believe in your good intentions and write off bad first impressions as flukes.

feats.name: Empathetic Plea
feats.notes: The way you cringe or use those puppydog eyes you've been practicing elicits an empathetic response in the attacker.
feats.trigger: You are attacked by a creature that you haven't yet acted hostile toward. You must use this reaction before the creature rolls its attack.

feats.name: Empathic Calm
feats.notes: Once per day, you can cast either calm emotions or sanctuary as an innate occult spell, heightened to half your level rounded up.

feats.name: Empathy Incarnate
feats.notes: Reincarnation has given you a compassionate perspective and enabled you to relate to almost everyone you speak with, putting them at ease and quickly generating trust.

feats.name: Emphatic Emissary
feats.notes: You can tell when diplomacy has failed and a meeting is close to unraveling or falling to blows.
feats.trigger: You roll initiative.

feats.name: Empiricist's Eye
feats.notes: Sharp and piercing, your eyes see all and convey more.

feats.name: Empowered Onslaught
feats.notes: When your body and mind are perfectly in sync and pushed to the limit, it can produce even greater results.
feats.trigger: You critically hit and Sustain a battle aura.

feats.name: Empty Body
feats.notes: You transmute your body into an ethereal form.

feats.name: Empyreal Aura
feats.notes: As an ultimate foe of evil and protector of the innocent, your very presence is a ward against evil.

feats.name: Enchanting Shot
feats.notes: With a single whisper carried on the wind, you enchant your ammunition to make a foe more vulnerable to your attacks.

feats.name: Encouraging Words
feats.notes: You give an ally a quick pep talk, helping them recover.

feats.name: Endemic Herbs
feats.notes: The herbal items you create use medicinal plants endemic to your location.

feats.name: Endless Memories
feats.notes: You've lived a thousand lives and done a hundred-thousand things.

feats.name: Endless Return
