feats.notes: You can return your enemies as thralls without a second thought.

feats.name: Endurance of the Rooted Tree
feats.notes: Just as the Vale of Aroden retains light and life despite inhospitable surroundings, you can sustain yourself regardless of your environment.

feats.name: Endure Anarchy
feats.notes: Recover from Unrest more quickly and lessen its effects

feats.name: Endure Death's Touch
feats.notes: Your conviction redirects the undead’s attack through your armor and then harmlessly away.
feats.prerequisite: Knight Vigilant; expert in medium or heavy armor
feats.trigger: An undead hits you with an unarmed attack.

feats.name: Enduring Alchemy
feats.notes: You've learned how to make your personal energy last just a little bit longer when quickly brewing ad hoc concoctions.

feats.name: Enduring Debilitation
feats.notes: Your debilitations last for 1 minute.
feats.trigger: You apply a debilitation to a creature.

feats.name: Enduring Quickness
feats.notes: You move as fast and freely as the wind.

feats.name: Energetic Resonance
feats.notes: Your blood resonates with magical energy, mitigating the effects of harmful spells.
feats.trigger: You would take acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage from a spell.

feats.name: Energize Bite
feats.notes: The deadly energy of your breath remains in your jaws to empower your attacks.
feats.prerequisite: Breath of the Dragon; jaws unarmed attack

feats.name: Energize Wings
feats.notes: You stoke your magic to energize your wings, temporarily transforming them into glowing, majestic forms.

feats.name: Energized Font
feats.notes: You can focus your mind more quickly thanks to the magic that flows within you.
feats.prerequisite: focus pool, at least one innate spell from a gnome heritage or ancestry feat that shares a tradition with at least one of your focus spells

feats.name: Energized Spark
feats.notes: The energy of your spirit manifests as crackling lightning, the chill of winter, or the power of an element.

feats.name: Energy Ablation
feats.notes: As you direct destructive energy at a foe, you can divert some of its power into a protective barrier that shields you from harm.

feats.name: Energy Beam
feats.notes: You can channel your core's power through the magical gem that serves as your eye.

feats.name: Energy Blessed
feats.notes: Energy runs through your blood more powerfully.

feats.name: Energy Fortification

feats.prerequisite: Prepare Elemental Medicine; Expert in Occultism
feats.access: Minkai or Forest of Spirits origin

feats.name: Energy Fusion
feats.notes: You fuse two spells together, combining their energy types.

feats.name: Energy Heart
feats.notes: Your eidolon’s heart beats with energy.

feats.name: Energy Interceptor

feats.name: Energy Resistance
feats.notes: Your eidolon has stronger resistance.

feats.name: Energy Ward
feats.notes: You convert energy from the last spell you cast into a protective ward.

feats.name: Enervating Wail
feats.notes: You release a terrible wail that tears at the spirits of all nearby.

feats.name: Enforce Oath
feats.notes: You call on your oath to embolden you in combat.
feats.prerequisite: Any feat with the oath trait

feats.name: Enforced Order
feats.notes: You never fail to strike down the ever-expanding reaches of chaos.

feats.name: Engine Bay
feats.notes: You are practiced at working in vast garages of vehicles and can work on many machines at a time.
feats.prerequisite: Vehicle Mechanic Dedication; Expert in Crafting

feats.name: Enhanced Familiar
feats.notes: You infuse your familiar with additional primal energy, increasing its abilities.

feats.name: Enhanced Glyph Familiar
feats.notes: Your living rune is imbued with more magical power.

feats.name: Enhanced Psychopomp Familiar
feats.notes: Your psychopomp's continued service in Pharasma's name brings it favor from the goddess.

feats.name: Enhanced Undead Familiar
feats.notes: You infuse your undead familiar with void energy.

feats.name: Enigma's Knowledge
feats.notes: Your muse whispers knowledge to you at all the right times.

feats.name: Enjoy the Show
feats.notes: You address an ally or any onlookers to your combat, flaunting to your foes how little attention they require.

feats.name: Enlarged Chassis
feats.notes: You've empowered your core to support a larger body, granting you size and additional reach.

feats.name: Enlightened Presence
feats.notes: You exude an aura of resolve.

feats.name: Enshroud Soul Cage
feats.notes: You wreathe your soul cage in an ever-growing collection of obfuscating illusions and protective abjurations to hide it from your enemies.

feats.name: Ensnaring Disarm

feats.trigger: Your last action was a critical success to Disarm .

feats.name: Ensnaring Wrappings

feats.trigger: Your Strike deals physical damage to a creature that is within reach of your arms and isn't more than one size larger than you.

feats.name: Enter Divine Realm
feats.notes: You are granted access to your deity’s realm and can travel there quickly.

feats.name: Enterprising Ritualist
feats.notes: Elegant and expensive components are no replacement for your skill and practice at ritual casting.

feats.name: Enthralling Allure
feats.notes: The powers of domination employed by your progenitors have manifested in you as well.

feats.name: Enticing Dwelling
feats.notes: Your spirit dwelling is particularly inviting to spirit wisps.

feats.name: Entities from Afar
feats.notes: You can call in aberrations to fight for you or to answer questions.

feats.name: Entity's Strike
feats.notes: The more you try to force your body to stay yours, the more it warps to channel the energy flowing through you.

feats.name: Entourage
feats.notes: You have a small group of admirers who tend to follow you around while you’re in civilized settlements.

feats.name: Entreat with Forebears
feats.notes: Something about your presence causes creatures of your bloodline to, consciously or not, recognize you as one of their own, and you become inured to their tricks.
feats.prerequisite: a bloodline that corresponds with a creature trait

feats.name: Entwined Energy Ki
feats.notes: You can transform your inner power into a type of energy to empower your ki abilities.

feats.name: Envenom Fangs
feats.notes: You envenom your fangs.

feats.prerequisite: you possess a Strike from a nagaji heritage or ancestry feat that deals poison damage

feats.name: Envenomed Edge
feats.notes: With a combination of your poison glands and herbal concoctions, you can consistently deliver venomous attacks when you hit an enemy's weak points.

feats.name: Environmental Adaptability
feats.notes: Having experienced the harshest environs that nature has to offer, your body is able to adapt to intense heat and cold.

feats.name: Environmental Explorer
feats.notes: You've traversed enough untamed wilderness to gain an intuitive understanding of the dangers that exist in such places.

feats.notes: You rapidly adapt to environments through a combination of skill, meditation, and divine grace

feats.name: Environmental Guide
feats.notes: You can rapidly adapt to climates and help others do the same.

feats.name: Equitable Defense

feats.trigger: You take damage from a critical hit.

feats.name: Escape Timeline
feats.notes: You step outside of the flow of time momentarily, allowing you to avoid dangers.
feats.trigger: Your turn begins.

feats.name: Esoteric Polymath
feats.notes: You keep a book of occult spells, similar to a wizard’s spellbook, and can use its spells to supplement your spell repertoire.

feats.name: Esoteric Reflexes
feats.notes: Reacting with an implement becomes instinct.
feats.prerequisite: an implement that grants a reaction

feats.name: Esoteric Spellcasting
feats.notes: Your study of a variety of esoteric texts and supernatural matters has broadened your mind and improved your spellcasting.

feats.name: Esoteric Warden
feats.notes: When you apply antithetical material against a creature successfully, you also ward yourself against its next attacks.

feats.name: Esteemed Visitor
feats.notes: Your polite manners and natural ability to comfort others make it easy for you to break down cultural barriers and earn strangers’ trust.

feats.name: Eternal Bane
feats.notes: Your life has made you a nexus for your deity’s vile power.

feats.name: Eternal Blessing
feats.notes: Your deeds have brought your deity’s grace to you for all of eternity.

feats.name: Eternal Boost
feats.notes: Your link with your eidolon is so intense that you continuously reinforce their abilities.

feats.name: Eternal Composition
feats.notes: The world is a stage upon which you are always playing.

feats.name: Eternal Elixir
feats.notes: Your body readily accepts and retains minor changes.

feats.name: Eternal Guide
feats.notes: Your attuned apparitions recognize that you still have essential work to do and refuse to allow you to pass on, gathering up your essence to carry your soul back to the community you call home.

feats.name: Eternal Hero
feats.notes: Whatever the explanation, you’re almost impossible to kill.
feats.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star

feats.name: Eternal Legend Dedication
feats.notes: As your renown as a fighter grows, your Calling comes to fruition.

feats.name: Eternal Memories
feats.notes: You have lived longer than most realize, and due to your many lifetimes of practice you remember almost everything from your previous incarnations now.

feats.name: Eternal Torch
feats.notes: You open a connection to your kinetic gate, large enough for a torch flame to flow.

feats.name: Eternal Wings
feats.notes: Your wings are now a permanent part of your body.

feats.name: Eternal Wings (Sylph)
feats.notes: Your wings are now a permanent part of your body.

feats.name: Eternity-Incinerating Blaze
feats.notes: The blaze of your divine spark is hot enough that it burns in not just the present, but the past and future as well.

feats.name: Evade Doom
feats.notes: You can elude supernatural disaster.

feats.name: Evanescent Wings
feats.notes: You've manifested wings that can flutter for brief spurts.

feats.name: Evangelize
feats.notes: You point out a detail that incontrovertibly supports your faith, causing a listener's mind to whirl.

feats.name: Evasiveness (Rogue)
feats.notes: Your proficiency rank for Reflex saves increases to master.
feats.prerequisite: Rogue Dedication; expert in Reflex saves

feats.name: Even the Odds

feats.notes: Even when overpowered, Eagle Knights hold out hope.

feats.name: Ever Dreaming
feats.notes: You draw no distinction between the sleeping and waking worlds.

feats.name: Ever-Vigilant Senses
feats.notes: Your eidolon has enhanced senses.

feats.name: Everdistant Defense
feats.notes: You have learned that distance can foil enemies better than any armor.

feats.name: Everstand Stance
feats.notes: You brace your shield with both hands, enhancing its potential for both offense and defense.

feats.access: A character who is a member of the Knights of Lastwall has access to this option.

feats.name: Everyone Duck!
feats.notes: You intentionally set off the trap, but you take special precautions to protect yourself and your allies from the trap’s effects.

feats.notes: Raising your weapon or fist aloft, you begin to gleam with dazzling radiance.

feats.name: Exceptional Follower
feats.notes: Your followers' abilities have soared to new heights.

feats.name: Executioner Weapon Training

feats.name: Exemplar Dedication

feats.name: Exemplar Expertise

feats.name: Expand Aura

feats.name: Expanded Elemental Magic

feats.name: Expanded Repertoire

feats.notes: You gain the expert spellcasting benefits .
feats.prerequisite: Basic Summoner Spellcasting; master in the skill associated with your eidolon’s tradition

feats.name: Expert Witch Spellcasting
feats.notes: You gain the expert spellcasting benefits.
feats.prerequisite: Basic Witch Spellcasting; master in the skill associated with your patron's tradition

feats.name: Expert Wizard Spellcasting
feats.notes: You gain the expert spellcasting benefits.
feats.prerequisite: Basic Wizard Spellcasting; Master in Arcana

feats.name: Exploding Bullet
feats.notes: You load your gun with a bullet forged of magic instead of matter, barely contained in an arcane shell.

feats.name: Exploit Blunder
feats.notes: By watching your foes closely, you can make the most out of their mistakes.
feats.trigger: A creature you Devised a Stratagem against on your most recent turn fails or critically fails a Strike against you.

feats.name: Exploit Opening
feats.notes: You take advantage of your spotter’s devastating attack to unleash your own follow-up attack.
feats.trigger: Your spotter critically succeeds at a Strike against a creature, and that creature is within your crossbow or firearm’s first range increment.

feats.name: Exploitive Bomb
feats.notes: You can mix a refractile substance into an alchemical bomb to foil resistances.

feats.name: Explosion
feats.notes: Your innovation can explode on command.

feats.name: Explosion of Power
feats.notes: Your magic explodes.

feats.name: Explosive Arrival
feats.notes: Your summoned creature appears in a detonation of arcane runes.

feats.name: Explosive Death Drop
feats.notes: You lift your enemy into the air before bringing them crashing down with a fiery detonation.

feats.name: Explosive Entry
feats.notes: You know exactly how to make a memorable entrance.
feats.prerequisite: Demolitionist Dedication; Master in Engineering Lore

feats.name: Explosive Expert
feats.notes: You have continued training in volatile weapons and gained a deeper understanding.
feats.access: You are from Dongun Hold or Alkenstar.

feats.name: Explosive Leap
feats.notes: You aim an explosion from your innovation downward to launch yourself into the air.

feats.name: Explosive Maneuver
feats.notes: Thanks to a hidden experimental feature you built into your weapon, your weapon explosively deploys levers, tangling hooks, or similar mechanisms to provide significant assistance when you perform a combat maneuver.

feats.name: Explosive Metamorphosis
feats.notes: You use additional primal energy to transform, creating a burst of elemental energy to complement your transformation.

feats.name: Explosive Savant
feats.notes: A lifetime wielding firearms and explosive ordinance amid the chaos of battle has granted you great skill with volatile weapons.
feats.access: You are from Dongun Hold or Alkenstar.

feats.name: Express Driver
feats.notes: You can optimize your vehicle's performance, coaxing extra speed and choosing paths to avoid slowdowns.

feats.name: Express Rider
feats.notes: You can encourage your mount to cover ground quickly.

feats.name: Expressive Face
feats.notes: Your face is constructed to move organically and show your emotions, making you more relatable to organic creatures.

feats.name: Exsanguinate
feats.notes: After one of your attacks, you direct your foe’s blood to spray upon you, infusing you with life energy.

feats.name: Extend Boost
feats.notes: You can increase the duration of your eidolon’s boosts.

feats.name: Extend Elixir
feats.notes: Integrating your own personal energy into the elixirs you create causes them to affect you for longer.

feats.name: Extend Surge
feats.notes: You tap deeper into the vortex of magical energy within you.

feats.name: Extended Kinesis
feats.notes: You've refined the control you can exert over your elements.

feats.name: Extinguish Light
feats.notes: You wrap shadow around a single unattended light source within 120 feet that's no larger than a torch.

feats.name: Extra Squishy
feats.notes: Your rubbery physique makes it easier for you to wedge yourself into tight spaces and more difficult for your enemies to dislodge you.

feats.name: Extract Vow of Nonviolence
feats.notes: You entice or threaten a weapon, making it swear not to harm you.

feats.name: Extradimensional Stash
feats.notes: When you perform sleight of hand, you fold space so that objects really do disappear.

feats.name: Extraplanar Cloud
feats.notes: When you use Extraplanar Haze , you can spend 1 additional action to disperse the particles as a 10-foot-radius cloud centered on you instead of as a haze; the activity gains the concentrate trait.

feats.name: Extraplanar Haze
feats.notes: Your body emits tiny particles of extraplanar matter, such as crystalline motes or smoky vapor, that surround you in a haze.

feats.name: Extraplanar Supplication
feats.notes: You call upon divine power to place a benediction upon your allies or a malediction upon your foes.

feats.name: Extravagant Parry
feats.notes: You use one-handed weapons to parry with style.

feats.name: Exude Demonic Corruption
feats.notes: Most of the changes from the demon within you have harmed you so far, but you've found a way to expel some of the corruption within you to poison others.
feats.prerequisite: Living Vessel Dedication; your entity is a demon

feats.name: Exult in Violence
feats.notes: You let out a war cry as your blow lands true, and judgment descends on an enemy.

feats.name: Exultant Blood Magic
feats.notes: The magic in your blood sings an exultant song of battle.
feats.prerequisite: Surging Blood Magic; legendary in Arcana or Religion, depending on your chosen tradition

feats.name: Eye for Masonry
feats.notes: Your familiarity with architecture allows you to easily spot subtle stonework.

feats.name: Eye for Numbers
feats.notes: You've learned to quickly estimate the number of items in a group with relative accuracy at only a glance.

feats.name: Eye for Smugglers
feats.notes: Your time checking seemingly innocent cargo ships for illicit goods has made you as canny as you are suspicious.

feats.name: Eye for Treasure
feats.notes: You know good artisanship when you see it and can wax poetic about crafting techniques and forms.

feats.name: Eye for Weakness
feats.notes: When you successfully Recall Knowledge about a creature you can see, you automatically learn if it has a weakness to holy or unholy in addition to any other results.
feats.prerequisite: Sister of the Golden Erinys Dedication

feats.name: Eye of Ozem
feats.notes: Learn how to better spot danger at a distance.
feats.prerequisite: Lastwall Sentry Dedication; expert in Perception

feats.name: Eye of the Arclords
feats.notes: The Arclords of Nex have achieved a unique mastery of magic.
feats.access: You are a member of the Arclords of Nex.

feats.name: Eyes of God
feats.notes: You can see things as they truly are.

feats.name: Eyes of Night
feats.notes: You can see in the darkness as easily as a true vampire.

feats.name: Eyes of the City
feats.notes: You can track down targets with the help of locals.
feats.prerequisite: Trained in Diplomacy or Trained in Society

feats.name: Eyes of the Sea
feats.notes: Your eyes have adapted to the rigors of the sea.

feats.name: Eyes that See Eternity
feats.notes: Mythic power opens your eyes to the secrets of reality and eternity.

feats.name: Eyes Unclouded
feats.notes: Your senses are enhanced by your divine spark, enabling you see things as they truly are, piercing through illusions, transformations, and lies.

feats.name: Fabricate Truth
feats.notes: You invent a false truth by fast talking, switching arguments, shifting the standard of evidence, and generally confounding others.

feats.name: Fabricated Connections
feats.notes: You can lie about having taken an action so convincingly that you acquire all the tangible benefits of having successfully completed it.

feats.name: Fabricated Credentials
feats.notes: You're so familiar with the paperwork necessary to maintain your cover that you can easily whip up documents that support your fabrications.
feats.prerequisite: Twilight Talon Dedication; Master in Deception

feats.name: Face Your Fears
feats.notes: A lifetime of facing Nidal's terrors has taught you to fight through fear.

feats.name: Fade Away
feats.notes: Your ability to blend into the background allows you to fade away entirely or appear innocuous even to magical effects.

feats.name: Fade Presence
feats.notes: You weave magic around you to mask your presence from observers.

feats.name: Fading
feats.notes: You partially fade from reality.
feats.trigger: You are targeted with a Strike by someone you can detect.

feats.name: Faith in the Fallen
feats.notes: The Gravelands are full of fallen spirits seeking to move on, and you consider it your obligation to assist in that regard.
feats.access: You’re a member of the Vellumis Scholars.

feats.name: Faithful Steed
feats.notes: You gain the service of a young animal companion as a mount.

feats.name: Faithful Stride
feats.notes: Confident in your faith, you Command an Animal to order your mount to Stride up to twice its Speed (or up to three times its Speed if you used 3 actions for Faithful Stride).

feats.name: Fake It Till You Make it
feats.notes: When you take on a role, you become more capable with all sorts of tasks involving that role.

feats.name: Fake Out
feats.notes: With a skilled flourish of your weapon, you force an enemy to acknowledge you as a threat.
feats.trigger: An ally is about to use an action that requires an attack roll, targeting a creature within your weapon's first range increment.

feats.name: Falcon Swoop
feats.notes: Like the fastest of predatory birds, you soar toward your prey at great speeds.

feats.name: False Faith
feats.notes: Droskar knows you may need to disguise yourself in societies that oppose your faith.
feats.source: Pathfinder #148: Fires of the Haunted City

feats.name: False Priest Form
feats.notes: Nobody respects tanuki, but most everyone respects an esteemed priest, so what better form to take if you want to get by a little easier? When you Change Shape, you can assume the shape of a priest or other religious official from a religion of your choosing.

feats.name: Fame and Fortune
feats.notes: Gain RP when you critically succeed at Kingdom skills

feats.name: Familiar
feats.notes: You make a pact with a creature that serves you and assists your spellcasting.
feats.source: Player Core, Player Core 2, Impossible Magic

feats.name: Familiar Conduit
feats.notes: Under your tutelage, your familiar has grown attuned to the hidden currents of the world and can serve as a conduit for your magic.
feats.prerequisite: Familiar Master Dedication; able to cast spells

feats.name: Familiar Foe
feats.notes: You regularly face off against undead and can identify many with a glance.
feats.prerequisite: Lastwall Sentry Dedication; Expert in Religion or Expert in Undead Lore

feats.name: Familiar Form
feats.notes: You can use your magic to transform into a small creature of a type that commonly serves as a spellcaster's familiar, potentially allowing you to safely scout for your party while retaining a degree of spellcasting ability.

feats.name: Familiar Mascot
feats.notes: When selecting master abilities, you can choose an ally to benefit from any specific master ability.

feats.name: Familiar Master Dedication
feats.notes: You have forged a mystical bond with a creature.

feats.name: Familiar Oddities
feats.notes: Perhaps due to the curse within you, curses occasionally perceive you as an extension of themselves and readily reveal themselves to you
feats.prerequisite: Curse Maelstrom Dedication; Trained in Occultism or Trained in Curse Lore

feats.name: Familiar Ritualist
feats.notes: Your familiar’s magical presence can serve as an aspect of a ritual.
feats.prerequisite: Familiar Sage Dedication; ability to cast a ritual

feats.name: Familiar Sage Dedication
feats.notes: You’ve forged an empowered mystical bond with your familiar.
feats.prerequisite: You have a familiar, and you're able to cast spells.

feats.name: Familiar's Eyes
feats.notes: You use your familiar's senses as easily as your own.

feats.name: Familiar's Language
feats.notes: You’ve learned to speak with your familiar and other creatures like it.

feats.name: Familiar's Resolve
feats.notes: When you weave magic, your familiar traces symbols that throw off fear and doubt.

feats.name: Fan Dancer Dedication
feats.notes: You sweep across the battlefield, manifesting both the gentle spring breeze and the crisp autumn gusts.
feats.access: Tian Xia origin

feats.name: Fancy Moves
feats.notes: You show off your fighting style to discourage your foes.

feats.name: Fane's Escape
feats.notes: A good getaway requires a good distraction.
feats.access: Member of the Pathfinder Society.

feats.name: Fane's Fourberie
feats.notes: Stella Fane has perfected a technique for using playing cards as weapons that's one part sleight of hand and one part magic.
feats.access: Member of the Pathfinder Society.

feats.name: Fang Sharpener
feats.notes: You have filed your teeth into jagged points and have an unusually powerful jaw, making your mouth a dangerous weapon.
feats.prerequisite: Irongut Goblin heritage or Razortooth Goblin heritage

feats.name: Fangs
feats.notes: Your incisors have grown into true fangs: long, sharp, and well-suited to drawing blood.

feats.name: Fantastic Leap
feats.notes: You launch yourself through the air at a foe.

feats.name: Fantastic Leaps
feats.notes: Your leaps seem to defy gravity as you soar through the air in a single bound.

feats.name: Far Lobber
feats.notes: You've learned how to throw a longer distance.

feats.name: Far Shot
feats.notes: Your experience in the field has taught you how to focus your aim at a distance, increasing your accuracy.

feats.name: Far Throw
feats.notes: When you Strike with a thrown weapon, you take only a –1 penalty for each additional range increment between you and the target, rather than a –2 penalty.

feats.name: Farabellus Flip
feats.notes: Surprisingly agile even in a breastplate and carrying a full rucksack, Marcos Farabellus developed this evasive maneuver during one of his many adventures.
feats.prerequisite: Trained in Acrobatics; trained in medium armor
feats.trigger: An enemy targets you with a melee Strike.
feats.access: Member of the Pathfinder Society.

feats.name: Fascinated by Society
feats.notes: Just as some humanoids find themselves driven to study nature, you are obsessed with the artificial constructs of society and can't get enough.

feats.name: Fascinating Performance
feats.notes: Perform to fascinate observers

feats.name: Fast Channel
feats.notes: Divine power is always at your fingertips, swiftly responding to your call.

feats.name: Fast Recovery
feats.notes: Regain more HP from rest, recover faster from disease

feats.name: Fast Swimmer
feats.notes: You move more quickly underwater.
feats.prerequisite: Undersea Privateer Dedication; you have a Swim speed

feats.name: Fatal Aria
feats.notes: Your songs overwhelm the target with unbearable emotion, potentially striking them dead on the spot.

feats.name: Fatal Bullet
feats.notes: You're especially talented at striking your enemies in their most vulnerable areas.

feats.name: Fatal Shot
feats.notes: You modify an arrow or bolt to bring death to your target in a single potent hit.

feats.name: Fated Duel
feats.notes: You and your knights are an unbeatable force together, but sometimes it’s a monarch’s duty to resolve the fate of their kingdom with nothing more than their own trusted weapon.

feats.name: Faultspawn
feats.notes: You bear a grudge, inherited from a blasphemous asura forebear in your bloodline, against a particular deity and their works.

feats.name: Fautless Defense
feats.notes: As you are struck, your steely determination reminds those who fight you that they are destined to be no more than footnotes in your tale.
feats.trigger: You would take damage from a Strike made by a creature.

feats.name: Favor of Heaven
feats.notes: You're one of Hei Feng's chosen people and have the authority of the Celestial Court on your side.

feats.name: Favorable Winds
feats.notes: You wrap a shell of favorable wind around a weapon you wield.

feats.name: Favored Prey
feats.notes: You have studied a specific type of wild creature and can hunt it more easily.

feats.name: Favored Terrain
feats.notes: You have studied a specific terrain to overcome its challenges.

feats.name: Fear No Pain!
feats.notes: You have learned to endure pain without complaint and are capable of steeling your allies with similar resolve.
feats.trigger: An ally within 30 feet fails a save against a mental effect.

feats.name: Fear of God
feats.notes: You embed a divine fear into the triggering foe that lasts for 10 minutes.
feats.prerequisite: Mortal Herald Dedication; Expert in Intimidation
feats.trigger: You successfully Demoralize an enemy.

feats.name: Fearful Symmetry
feats.notes: You attack with a feline grace as captivatingly beautiful as it is deadly.

feats.name: Fearsome Brute
feats.notes: Fear makes your foes weak and more vulnerable to your attacks.

feats.name: Fearsome Familiar
feats.notes: Your elemental familiar trades places with an elemental from its elemental plane.

feats.name: Fearsome Fangs
feats.notes: Your claws and jaws are brutally powerful and efficient, even by ursine standards.

feats.name: Fearsome Form
feats.notes: A fearsome illusion covers you, evoking the terror of the most dangerous animals.

feats.name: Feast
feats.notes: You feast upon an adjacent restrained or unconscious creature, or a deceased creature that died in the past hour.

feats.name: Feast Planner
feats.notes: You learn the fortifying brew ritual, but you instead prepare dishes for a lavish meal that have the same effect as the drinks from the normal version of the ritual.

feats.name: Feather Step
feats.notes: Step into difficult terrain

feats.name: Feathered Cloak
feats.notes: To blend in with the grounded and wingless, you fold your wings just so on your back, creating the illusion of a feathered cloak.

feats.name: Feathered Flechettes
feats.notes: Unfurling your wings in a quick snap, you send feathers scattering in all directions.

feats.name: Feed on Pain
feats.notes: The psychic feedback of another creature's pain fills you with false life.
feats.trigger: you deal mental damage

feats.name: Feed the Void
feats.notes: The void within you manages to manifest itself temporarily, a black hole opening over your heart and threatening to draw everything in.

feats.name: Feeding Frenzy
feats.notes: Your serrated teeth rip and tear at your prey.

feats.name: Feeling Your Oats
feats.notes: You are incredible, impeccable, an icon of style and grace—and everyone knows it.
feats.prerequisite: Celebrity Dedication or Dandy Dedication; Trained in Deception
feats.access: Members of the Firebrands at the rank of second mark or higher have access to this feat.

feats.name: Feet that Stride the Sky
feats.notes: You feel the call of the sky, or perhaps a desperate urge to test the limits of the earth’s hold on you.

feats.name: Feign Innocence
feats.notes: You convince a creature that, despite appearances, you're on its side.

feats.name: Felicitous Riposte
feats.notes: You take advantage of your foe's openings with uncanny odds.

feats.name: Feline Dance
feats.notes: You fluidly move between stances in the process of dodging.
feats.trigger: You attempt a basic Reflex save.
feats.access: catfolk ancestry

feats.name: Fell Rider
feats.notes: You have trained with your animal companion to become a terrifying juggernaut on the battlefield.

feats.name: Felling Shot
feats.notes: Your ranged attacks can shoot an unprepared foe right out of the air.

feats.name: Felling Strike
feats.notes: Your attack can ground an airborne foe.

feats.name: Feral Lunge
feats.notes: You spring on an unsuspecting opponent, tearing at them with your teeth.
feats.prerequisite: Werecreature Dedication; your animal shape grants a fangs or jaws unarmed attack

feats.name: Feral Mending
feats.notes: You can heal your wounds while reshaping your flesh.
feats.prerequisite: Werecreature Dedication; you were not afflicted with the curse of the werecreature

feats.name: Feral Scramble
feats.notes: Sinking your claws in, you propel yourself at shocking speed.
feats.prerequisite: Werecreature Dedication; your animal shape grants a claw unarmed attack

feats.name: Feral Senses
feats.notes: The eyes and noses of animals are naturally sharper than most humanoids.

feats.name: Feral Toss
feats.notes: You hurl foes away with a shake of your head.
feats.prerequisite: Werecreature Dedication; your animal shape grants an antler, horn, or tusk unarmed attack

feats.name: Fermenting Liquors
feats.notes: You always have a special batch of preserved liquor ready for each day.

feats.name: Ferocious Beasts
feats.notes: Since ancient times, the mightiest orc beast tamers would draw out the true fighting spirit of their companion beasts by feeding the creatures a draft incorporating the orc’s own blood.
feats.prerequisite: Bonded Animal, animal companion, or Pet; Orc Ferocity

feats.name: Ferocious Charge
feats.notes: You've taught your companions to charge directly at an enemy.
feats.prerequisite: Beastmaster Dedication; animal companion with an antlers, head, or horn unarmed attack

feats.name: Ferocious Gust
feats.notes: With heavy wing beats, you whip up a furious gust and direct it at your opponents.

feats.name: Ferocious Shape
feats.notes: You’ve mastered the shape of dinosaurs.

feats.name: Ferocious Will
feats.notes: You send a blast of magical feedback at the effect's source, dealing 5d6 mental damage with a basic Will save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.
feats.trigger: You succeed at a saving throw against a magical mental effect.

feats.name: Ferocity Mimicry
feats.notes: You have trained yourself to continue fighting even when your body is screaming for you to stop.
feats.prerequisite: Wild Mimic Dedication; you have encountered a creature who has kept fighting or dealt damage after being reduced to 0 Hit Points (such as via death throes or Ferocity) or have identified a creature with such an ability in combat
feats.trigger: You would be reduced to 0 Hit Points but not immediately killed.

feats.name: Ferrousoul
feats.notes: The elemental metal in your soul resonates strongly with iron, bronze, and other sturdy, practical metals suitable for weaponry.

feats.name: Ferry Through Waves
feats.notes: The waters around you permit you passage, a privilege you can share with a willing ally.

feats.name: Festering Wound
feats.notes: Wounds you inflict with your unarmed attacks fester and rot, becoming infected and difficult to heal.

feats.name: Fetchling Lore
feats.notes: You've learned obscure lessons about your fellow fetchlings.

feats.name: Feverish Enzymes
feats.notes: Your claws and fangs exude an infectious enzyme, related to the necrotic effects of ghoul fever, that causes a creature's wounds to heal slowly.

feats.name: Fey Ascension
feats.notes: The fey influence on your form and features grows even more powerful and notable.

feats.name: Fey Caller
feats.notes: You have learned some of the tricks the fey use to bend primal magic toward illusions and trickery.

feats.name: Fey Cantrips
feats.notes: You've learned the cantrips sprites have used since time immemorial.

feats.name: Fey Disguise
feats.notes: You can disguise yourself with magical illusions.

feats.name: Fey Fellowship
feats.notes: Your enhanced fey connection (either through your blood or via prolonged contact with their kind) affords you a warmer reception from creatures of the First World as well as tools to foil their tricks or withstand their magic.

feats.name: Fey Influence
feats.notes: Your exposure to fey influence has given you some primal magic
feats.source: Impossible Lands, PFS Scenario #1-17: The Perennial Crown Part 2, The Thorned Monarch

feats.name: Fey Life
feats.notes: There are some fates worse than death–and you worked to save a fey from one such fate.
feats.prerequisite: You helped to save a fey from a terrible fate, and you're not a fey.

feats.name: Fey Magic
feats.notes: You can use faerie magic to hide yourself and expose hidden foes.

feats.name: Fey Skin
feats.notes: While you are more susceptible to cold iron than most of the Wingless, you also have an incredible resilience and a deeper connection to the healing energies of the First World .

feats.name: Fey Tracker
feats.notes: You are exceptionally skilled at noticing the subtle techniques fey use to avoid notice.

feats.name: Fey Transcendence
feats.notes: You become a powerful fey creature, gaining strengths tied to the First World but also some of the weakness against which all fey must contend.

feats.name: Fey's Trickery
feats.notes: You connect with the fey trickster within yourself to momentarily vanish from sight.
feats.prerequisite: Living Vessel Dedication; your entity is a fey

feats.name: Field Artillery
feats.notes: While castles are generally obliging enough to stay in one place, out in the field positioning is of paramount importance—a gun in the wrong place is worse than useless.

feats.name: Field Propagandist Dedication
feats.notes: Having devoted your life to crafting propaganda, you know that winning the hearts and minds of soldiers can be a deciding factor in securing the successful outcome of a war.
feats.prerequisite: Charisma +2; Trained in Deception; Trained in Diplomacy

feats.name: Fiend Eternal
feats.notes: Through all your machinations and accumulation of power, you have completed your apotheosis and become a true archfiend.

feats.name: Fiend Slayer
feats.notes: Your attack tears through a fiend, possibly sending it back to where it came from.

feats.name: Fiend-trampling Stature
feats.notes: Fiends unfortunate enough to be trampled beneath your feet or rent within your grasp are swiftly granulated into bone kindling and blood powder, and the pain of your strikes prevents them from action.

feats.name: Fiendish Brand
feats.notes: Make a Strike with a weapon or unarmed attack that deals piercing or slashing damage.
feats.prerequisite: Sister of the Golden Erinys Dedication

feats.name: Fiendish Form
feats.notes: Your features reshape into those of a type of fiend who serves your deity; for example, as a demon you might have putrid scales, twisted horns, and red eyes.

feats.name: Fiendish Magic
feats.notes: You possess fiendish magic.
feats.prerequisite: Grimspawn, Pitborn, or Hellspawn, or another lineage feat associated with fiends

feats.name: Fiendish Mount
feats.notes: Your steed ally manifests a suite of powerful and sinister gifts granted to it by your deity.

feats.name: Fiendish Strikes
feats.notes: Your festering connection to the forces of evil infuses your weapons with debilitating malevolence, tearing down creatures of good with every attack.

feats.name: Fierce Competitor
feats.notes: You challenge a single ally to a physical competition.

feats.name: Fierce Grasp
feats.notes: Once you get your hands on someone, it's hard for them to get away.

feats.name: Fiery Rebirth
feats.notes: When you escape death, you return to life with retributive fire that burns those who harmed you.
feats.trigger: You regain Hit Points while you are unconscious .

feats.name: Fiery Retort
feats.notes: Ignoring your pain, you sear your attacker with a wave of flame.
feats.trigger: An opponent adjacent to you hits you with a melee weapon or a melee unarmed attack.

feats.name: Fight Choreography
feats.notes: You’ve spent enough time training in stage fighting and teaching a wide range of stunts that you can prepare your companions with directions on how to avoid peril in battle.
feats.prerequisite: Acrobat Dedication or Gladiator Dedication; master in Theater Lore

feats.name: Fight or Flight
feats.notes: You’ve learned to make use of the surge of adrenaline that comes with fear.
feats.trigger: You gain the frightened condition.
feats.access: You're from the Shackles

feats.name: Fight Through Oblivion
feats.notes: Mortal wounds that would kill other warriors are no more than the flutter of butterfly wings to you.

feats.name: Fighter Dedication
feats.notes: You become trained in martial weapons.

feats.name: Fighter Resiliency
feats.notes: You gain 3 additional Hit Points for each fighter archetype class feat you have.
feats.prerequisite: Fighter Dedication; class granting no more Hit Points per level than 8 + your Constitution modifier

feats.name: Fighting Horn
feats.notes: You can modify the size and shape of your horn over time using your mental powers.

feats.name: Final Form
feats.notes: You embrace your monstrous blood and make it your own, screaming out to the heavens and hells alike in rage, pain, and defiance.

feats.name: Final Rest
feats.notes: As stubborn in death as you are in life, you vow you'll never aid your hated enemies.

feats.name: Final Shot
feats.notes: You jam a triple charge of black powder into your weapon to unleash a devastating but risky and inaccurate attack.

feats.name: Final Shot Knows the Way
feats.notes: You judge a foe’s defenses after attacking them and channel that knowledge into your warshard weapon and its ammunition.
feats.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star

feats.name: Final Spite
feats.notes: You can channel the power of death into a poisonous spite.
feats.trigger: A creature reduces you or a living ally within 30 feet to 0 Hit Points. You can trigger this action even while dying .

feats.name: Final Union
feats.notes: You and the heroic spirit have formed an eternal pact and now share your body.

feats.name: Finessed Features
feats.notes: You've learned how to build snares that trigger based on visual stimuli.

feats.name: Finest Trick
feats.notes: Many fiends—rakshasa rajas and demonic succubi most famously—can take on the forms of others.

feats.name: Finish Their Story!
feats.notes: Though your tale is immortal, your foes aren’t afforded such an advantage and mainly serve only to further your legend.

feats.name: Finishing Follow-through
feats.notes: Finishing a foe maintains your swagger.

feats.name: Finishing Precision
feats.notes: You’ve learned how to land daring blows when you have panache.

feats.name: Finned Ridges
feats.notes: The ridges and flaps of your skin steer you through the water.

feats.name: Fire Lung
feats.notes: A lifetime of proximity to flames has inured your lungs and eyes to smoke.

feats.name: Fire Resistance
feats.notes: Your connection to heat and flame means that fire is reluctant to bring its full force to bear against you.

feats.name: Fire Savvy
feats.notes: You've grown up around a forge and are well-suited to dealing with smoke and flame.
feats.access: You are from Dongun Hold or Alkenstar.

feats.name: Firebrand Braggart Dedication
feats.notes: Your Firebrand training has taught you that achieving something is more satisfying if you boast about it first.
feats.prerequisite: Charisma 14; second mark member of the Firebrands

feats.name: Firesight
feats.notes: You can see through the haze of flame.

feats.name: Firework Technician Dedication
feats.notes: You’ve learned the secrets of making fire and sound bloom using black powder, metals, and paper.

feats.name: First Frost
feats.notes: The gelid shard within your heart may sap your ability to feel and experience emotion, but it also lets you create and manipulate cold.

feats.name: First Revelation
feats.notes: You gain your mystery’s initial revelation spell.

feats.name: First to Strike, First to Fall
feats.notes: Whenever you successfully Strike a creature that has not acted in the first round of combat, that creature is off-guard until the end of your next turn.

feats.name: First World Adept
feats.notes: Over time your fey magic has grown stronger.
feats.prerequisite: at least one primal innate spell

feats.name: First World Magic
feats.notes: Your connection to the First World grants you a primal innate spell, much like those of the fey.

feats.name: Fish from the Falls' Edge
feats.notes: Seeing your ally fall, you let out a cry, sending your divine spark to them temporarily to keep them from tumbling down the River of Souls.
feats.trigger: A living creature within 30 feet would die.

feats.name: Fishblooded
feats.notes: There's nothing beneath the waves that can slow you down.

feats.name: Fisheye
feats.notes: You can gain the magic of the seas by eating your favorite seafood.

feats.name: Fit for the Role
feats.notes: Not only are you a flamboyant performer, but you’ve mastered an occult secret that allows you to outfit yourself and your companions with magical visages.

feats.name: Five Breaths, One Death
feats.notes: You cycle through the elements in a devastating combination attack.

feats.name: Five-breath Vanguard Dedication
feats.notes: You flow like the elemental cycle, adapting your stance and techniques constantly in response to whatever circumstances you face.
feats.prerequisite: Two of the five elemental stances (Ironblood Stance, Mountain Stance, Reflective Ripple Stance, Stoked Flame Stance, and Tangled Forest Stance)
feats.access: Tian Xia origin or exposure to Tian elementalism

feats.name: Five-gods Ram
feats.notes: You attack in an unceasing flurry of charging headbutts.

feats.name: Flailtongue
feats.notes: Your tongue has mutated into a lashing weapon reminiscent of Kabriri's bone-laden flail .

feats.name: Flair Rider Stance
feats.notes: You spend little time in your saddle as you flip unpredictably around your dragon mount, dodging attacks.
feats.prerequisite: Drake Rider Dedication; Trained in Acrobatics

feats.name: Flamboyant Athlete
feats.notes: Your panache allows you to perform incredible feats: climbing, swimming, and leaping far beyond your normal capacity.

feats.name: Flamboyant Cruelty
feats.notes: You love to kick your enemies when they're down, and you look fabulous when you do.

feats.name: Flamboyant Leap
feats.notes: You stylishly leap and deliver a powerful finisher.

feats.name: Flame Jump
feats.notes: Your peri lineage has opened your mind to fire's raw, purging essence.

feats.name: Flames of Vision
feats.notes: Dokkaebi were among the first goblins to pioneer gazing through flames, spectral or physical, to cast their senses far and wide.
feats.access: dokkaebi goblin heritage or Tian Xia origin

feats.name: Flash Forge
feats.notes: An artificial metal object forms in the hands of you or a willing ally within 30 feet.

feats.name: Flash of Omipotence
feats.notes: For but a moment you hold the power of a god.
feats.trigger: Your turn begins.

feats.name: Flash of Omnipresence
feats.notes: Empowered with divine energy, you can be at an ally’s side in the blink of an eye.

feats.name: Flash of Omniscience
feats.notes: You briefly see the world as your deity does, recognizing the truth of those around you for a moment.
feats.trigger: Your turn begins.

feats.name: Flash your Badge
feats.notes: You make a fearsome show of your authority.
feats.prerequisite: Alkenstar Agent Dedication; Master in Intimidation

feats.name: Flashing Shield
feats.notes: Your shield flares with holy light as you block the attack, searing the undead with the power of your faith.
feats.prerequisite: Lastwall Sentry Dedication; you worship a good-aligned deity
feats.trigger: You use the Shield Block reaction, and the opponent that triggered the Shield Block is undead and adjacent to you.

feats.name: Flashy Dodge
feats.notes: You deftly dodge out of the way, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.
feats.trigger: A creature you can see targets you with an attack.

feats.name: Flashy Roll
feats.notes: You can use Flashy Dodge before attempting a Reflex save, in addition to its original trigger.

feats.name: Fledgling Flight
feats.notes: You can fly through the air in short bursts at half your land Speed.

feats.name: Fleeing Diversion
feats.notes: You are quick to capitalize on your distractions.

feats.name: Fleeing Shriek
feats.notes: You let out an ear-piercing screech.

feats.name: Fleet
feats.notes: Increase your Speed by 5 feet

feats.name: Fleet Tempo
feats.notes: To rush after a criminal or reach someone in need, you ring a sprightly tone.
feats.source: Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind

feats.name: Fleeting Shadow
feats.notes: You're able to quickly disappear and then move about without drawing the attention of your enemies.

feats.name: Flensing Slice
feats.notes: When you hit with both attacks with Double Slice, you flense the target, making it bleed and creating a weak spot.

feats.name: Flesh Tsunami
feats.notes: You unleash a wave of melted flesh.

feats.name: Flesh Wound
feats.notes: You fire to ensure that even if your shot doesn't land cleanly, it still lands close enough to deal some damage.

feats.name: Flexible Form
feats.notes: Your body is as supple as a sapling, capable of bending without breaking.

feats.name: Flexible Halcyon Spellcasting
feats.notes: You broaden your ability to channel your power into halcyon magic.

feats.name: Flexible Nexus
feats.notes: In bending the basic essences of magic around yourself, you have seen the ways they connect and flow into each other, changing from one to the next.

feats.name: Flexible Ritualist
feats.notes: You can perform two aspects of a ritual yourself.

feats.name: Flexible Spellcaster Dedication
feats.notes: You now have four cantrips per day instead of three.

feats.name: Flexible Studies
feats.notes: You've collected a cross-section of information on various disciplines you can refer to when preparing for various tasks.

feats.name: Flexible Tail
feats.notes: You can perform simple Interact actions with your tail, such as opening an unlocked door.

feats.name: Flexible Transmogrification
feats.notes: You’ve learned how to transmogrify your eidolon to suit the circumstances of the day.

feats.name: Flickering Stories
feats.notes: Stories, like fires, can create shadows as much as they illuminate.

feats.name: Flickering Twirl
feats.notes: You use your movements and disguises to make yourself a flickering blur.

feats.name: Fling Head
feats.notes: You Interact to remove your head, if it isn’t already detached, and fling it at an enemy within 30 feet, where it emits a bone-chilling wail before dematerializing and returning to your body.

feats.name: Fling Into action
feats.notes: You release mythic power to turn disaster into opportunity and hurl yourself into an advantageous position.

feats.name: Flinging Blow
feats.notes: You take a moment to center yourself, then unleash a powerful blow that sends your target tumbling away.

feats.name: Flinging Charge
feats.notes: You throw a weapon to distract your opponent as you close the gap to begin your assault.

feats.name: Flinging Shove
feats.notes: Whether you’re shoving opponents with a shield or a large weapon, you’ve learned to push them even further.

feats.name: Flinging Updraft
feats.notes: A speeding wind heeds your call, picking someone up and depositing them nearby.

feats.name: Float Free
feats.notes: You move 5 feet or up to half your swim Speed vertically through the water.

feats.name: Flood Stance
feats.notes: The lessons of the flood teach a stance that distributes and circulates a single breath through the body and allows your punches to contain the focused power of a torrent of water.

feats.name: Floral Restoration
feats.notes: You request that nearby plants share their vitality with you to replenish your body and magic.

feats.name: Flourish and Ruin
feats.notes: You can call upon the vital essence of your spirit to restore life to your allies and call forth vines to ensnare and bludgeon your foes.

feats.name: Flourishing Finish
feats.notes: Your martial prowess demoralizes all who can see you.

feats.name: Flow of War
feats.notes: Divine battle instincts take over your body, letting you move and lash out with instinctive speed.
feats.trigger: Your turn begins.

feats.name: Flower Chimera
feats.notes: You call on a guardian of the wild to burst forth from the land to aid you.
feats.access: Tian Xia origin

feats.name: Flower Magic
feats.notes: Certain magics in the world flow easily through your sap.

feats.name: Flower Street Infamy
feats.notes: Your history of coquetries, flirtations, dalliances, and liaisons is so lengthy that, even in a city as large as Absalom, you're bound to run into your past at inopportune moments.

feats.name: Flowering Path
feats.notes: Vitality and elemental wood flows out from your body and into the earth, infusing it with a stream of new life.

feats.name: Flowing Palm Deflection
feats.notes: The simple and precise movements of your hands allow you to deflect blows with the same efficacy as a raised shield .

feats.name: Fluid Contortionist
feats.notes: You can ignore difficult terrain caused by moving through tight spaces that aren't tight enough to force you to Squeeze.

feats.name: Flurry of Maneuvers
feats.notes: Your flurry is a combination of maneuvers.

feats.name: Fluttering Distraction
feats.notes: You’re trained in snapping and fluttering your fans to draw the eyes of observers around you.
feats.trigger: An enemy attempts a ranged or melee Strike against an ally within 30 feet.

feats.name: Fluttering Misdirection
feats.notes: You’ve trained in drawing the eyes of your audience to specific aspects of your performance through the careful manipulation of your fans and body.

feats.name: Fly on Shadowed Wings
feats.notes: Your apparition embraces you, feeding on your magic to become a pair of protective wings.

feats.name: Fly Swat
feats.notes: You've learned the secret of swatting away annoying pests and occasionally getting an easy meal out of it.

feats.name: Flying Blade
feats.notes: You apply your flashy techniques to thrown weapons as easily as melee attacks.

feats.name: Flying Flame
feats.notes: A Tiny shape of flame appears, taking a form of your choice— such as a bird, an arrow, or a simple sphere.

feats.name: Flying Kick
feats.notes: You launch yourself at a foe.

feats.name: Flying Tackle
feats.notes: You barrel forward, gathering enough momentum to take down a threatening foe.

feats.name: Focus Ally
feats.notes: You're so focused on your allies that you can help them to recenter when something would take them out of the fight.
feats.trigger: An adjacent ally fails, but doesn't critically fail, a saving throw against an effect with the incapacitation trait.

feats.name: Focused Cat Nap
feats.notes: When you Cat Nap, you can also Refocus as you dream of a relevant activity.

feats.name: Focused Fascination
feats.notes: When you use Fascinating Performance in a combat encounter, you need only a success, rather than a critical success, to fascinate your target.

feats.name: Focused Fire
feats.notes: You limit the blast of your shot for accuracy.

feats.name: Focused Juggler
feats.notes: You continue Juggling until the end of your next turn.
feats.source: Pathfinder #151: The Show Must Go On
feats.trigger: Your turn begins.

feats.name: Focused Shot
feats.notes: You achieve a state of perfect calm before unleashing your attack, opening your mind to the minute movements of the world around you to increase your accuracy.

feats.name: Fog Cloak
feats.notes: When you are concealed by mist or fog , you’re hidden until a creature successfully Seeks to find you.
feats.access: member of the Red Mantis assassins

feats.name: Foil Senses
feats.notes: Take precautions against special senses

feats.name: Folk Dowsing
feats.notes: You can find what you're looking for using a dowsing rod or pendulum.

feats.name: Folk Healer
feats.notes: Your community recognizes you as a shaman or other animist, a status you obtained through lineage, apprenticeship, or a supernatural event.

feats.name: Folklorist Dedication
feats.notes: You are a master archivist and entertainer, capable of pulling wisdom from the tales you tell and weaving your allies and enemies into a powerful narrative.
feats.source: Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind

feats.name: Folksy Patter
feats.notes: You are adept at disguising coded messages as folksy idioms.

feats.name: Folktales Lore
feats.notes: You can pull bits of wisdom from any tale.
feats.source: Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind

feats.name: Follow the Threads of Fate
feats.notes: A norn’s thread—spun from fate itself—runs through or wraps around your ikon.
feats.source: Pathfinder #217: Death Sails a Wine-Dark Sea

feats.name: Follow-up Assault
feats.notes: Even in the face of failure you press the attack, determined to succeed.

feats.name: Follow-up Strike
feats.notes: You have trained rigorously to use all parts of your body as a weapon, and when you miss with an attack, you can usually continue the attack with a different body part and still deal damage.

feats.name: Following Smite
feats.notes: You call upon your deity’s power and channel it through your weapon.

feats.name: Font of Knowledge
feats.notes: Experience or focused study have granted you mastery of a number of topics.

feats.name: Font of Life or Death
feats.notes: As you reach ever higher in your quest to achieve true divinity, the powers of life and death flow evermore easily from you.

feats.name: Food Preservation
feats.notes: Your techniques extend the storage life for certain ingredients and food through pickling, alcohol, or fermentation.

feats.name: Fool's Fleeting Plan
feats.notes: When Aercelys, hero-god of fools and fire, dove into the funeral pyre of his beloved daughter, he seemed a fool without thought for his safety.

feats.name: Foolproof Instructions
feats.notes: You feel confident that you can explain your scrolls so well that even your allies can use them.

feats.name: For Love, For Lightning
feats.notes: Rumors suggest this technique was pioneered by knights who undertook missions for Clarethe Iomedar at the half-moon, but many Crimson Reclaimers have since mastered it.
feats.access: A character who performs a specialized mission for Clarethe Iomedar has access to this option.

feats.name: For the Fallen!
feats.notes: So many other hopefuls have attempted the Test of the Starstone before you and failed.

feats.name: Forager
feats.notes: Forage for supplies to provide for multiple creatures

feats.name: Force Fang
feats.notes: You can turn your attack into an unerring blur of force.

feats.name: Force of Nature
feats.notes: You're a nigh-unstoppable killing machine, with only silver able to quell your rampage.

feats.name: Forced Entry
feats.notes: You are trained to preserve the archaeological value of your location when entering.
feats.prerequisite: Expert in Athletics; Pathfinder Agent Dedication
feats.access: A character who is a member of the Pathfinder Society has access to this option.

feats.name: Forceful Push
feats.notes: When you cast mage hand , you can modify it to shove a creature.
feats.prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _mage hand_

feats.name: Forceful Shot
feats.notes: Your ranged attacks push your foes away from your allies.

feats.name: Forcible Energy
feats.notes: You perform complex manipulations to make the energy from your spells so powerful that your enemies remain vulnerable to it afterward.

feats.name: Forensic Acumen
feats.notes: You understand principles of forensic medicine, making you better at examining a body to determine the cause of death or injury.

feats.name: Forensic Countermeasures
feats.notes: Your knowledge of deductive reasoning allows you to derail fellow investigators .
feats.access: member of the Red Mantis assassins

feats.name: Foresee Danger
feats.notes: You perceive every possible way your foe's attack could land and attempt to avoid them all.
feats.trigger: A creature targets you with an attack, and you can see the attacker.

feats.name: Foreseen Failure
feats.notes: You see your spell fail to take hold to disastrous end, then snap back to reality—it was all a precognition, and you know to try a different spell.
feats.trigger: A spell you cast has no effect because you critically failed all your spell attack rolls or because all targets critically succeeded at their saving throws.

feats.name: Forest Passage
feats.notes: You can always find a path, almost as if foliage parted before you.

feats.name: Forest Stealth
feats.notes: You are skilled at quickly hiding behind bits of underbrush or foliage.

feats.name: Forest's Heart
feats.notes: You adopt a stance that allows your apparitions to channel spiritual energy down through you to inhabit roots, control vines, and command plant-life from the ground you stand on to fight on your behalf.

feats.name: Forestall Curse
feats.notes: You've learned to hold back your curse .

feats.name: Foretell Harm
feats.notes: Your magic echoes ominously as you glimpse injury in the target's future.

feats.name: Forever Among Humanity
feats.notes: Passing unseen within society is second nature to you now.

feats.name: Forewarn
feats.notes: Your foresight and planning are more valuable than armor as you direct your ally away from danger, but there's a limit to how often you can guide your allies away from a foe's relentless assaults.
feats.trigger: An enemy within your overwatch field attempts an attack against an ally who is also within your overwatch field.

feats.name: Forge New Word
feats.notes: At the pinnacle of your art, you have forged a new great rune of power, a new ideal expression or utterance to be added to the craft.

feats.name: Forge-Blessed Shot
feats.notes: You intone a prayer to the dwarven deities Torag or Angradd, willing a higher power to guide your aim in the heat of battle.
feats.trigger: You attempt a ranged Strike.
feats.access: You are from Dongun Hold or Alkenstar.

feats.name: Forge-Day's Rest
feats.notes: Your unusual rest cycle allows you to recover faster.
feats.access: underground dwarf ethnicity

feats.name: Forgotten Presence
feats.notes: The world conspires to keep you forgotten and unnoticed— memories cloud, ink stains out your name in ledgers, and portraits of you crack and warp over your face.

feats.name: Forlorn
feats.notes: Watching your friends age and die fills you with moroseness that protects you against harmful emotions.

feats.name: Form a Flock
feats.notes: You call nearby wild dragonets to swarm to your side.

feats.name: Form Control
feats.notes: With additional care and effort, you can take on an alternate shape for a longer period of time.

feats.name: Form Lock
feats.notes: Your ability to control your own qi empowers you to pressure other creatures into resuming their true forms.

feats.name: Form of the Bat
feats.notes: You can transform into a harmless bat.

feats.name: Form of the Beloved Mother
feats.notes: You channel the blessings of Nalinivati to transform into a manifestation of her will.
feats.access: Tian Xia origin or follower of Nalinivati

feats.name: Form of the Dragon
feats.notes: You can briefly transform into a paragon of your draconic ancestry.

feats.name: Form of the Sea
feats.notes: You can call upon sea waters to empower you.

feats.name: Form Retention
feats.notes: You have trained your mind and body to tolerate polymorph magic for longer periods of time, so long as you prepare for the change appropriately.

feats.name: Form Up!
feats.notes: You’ve trained in battle formations for a plethora of situations.

feats.name: Formation Master
feats.notes: You can assemble a formation even with members of ancestries that lack the hobgoblins’ military discipline, and you can extend these benefits to your hobgoblin allies.

feats.name: Formation Training
feats.notes: You know how to fight in formation with your brethren.

feats.name: Formidable Breath
feats.notes: Thanks to rigorous breathing exercises and a diet similar to that of your lineage, your magical breath is more powerful.

feats.name: Fortified Elixirs
feats.notes: Your treatments for diseases and poisons can be very efficacious, though they tend not to last as long.

feats.name: Fortified Fiefs
feats.notes: Gain bonuses to Fortify, and Construct or Rebuild certain buildings easier

feats.name: Fortified Flesh
feats.notes: Your flesh is resistent to physical damage.

feats.name: Fortified Mind
feats.notes: Your mind is unusually resilient and resistant to influence.

feats.name: Fortify Shield
feats.notes: You reinforce your shield with a rocky outgrowth of metal and stone.

feats.name: Fortifying Knock
feats.notes: Your shield is a natural canvas for your art.

feats.name: Fortissimo Composition
feats.notes: Your anthems grow louder and more potent, bolstered by your muse’s power.

feats.name: Fortuitous Shift
feats.notes: You have grown more comfortable with your penchant for supernatural disappearance.

feats.name: Fortunate Blow
feats.notes: You set an enemy up for a devastating follow-through from your allies.

feats.name: Fortunate Relief
feats.notes: Your god favors your attempts to remove afflictions and conditions.

feats.name: Fortune's Favor
feats.notes: You understand when an investment in you has the chance to pay off.
feats.trigger: You’re about to reroll a failed skill check or saving throw due to a fortune effect.

feats.name: Forward Gaze into Life
feats.notes: Despite the constant cold of death at your back, you keep your gaze forward into the realm of life.
feats.source: Pathfinder #217: Death Sails a Wine-Dark Sea

feats.name: Fossil Rider
feats.notes: Using your ancestors' bones, you manifest their spirits around you in a fossilized form.

feats.name: Fountain of Secrets
feats.notes: You constantly remember details about the world.

feats.name: Four Winds
feats.notes: Mimicking the anemoi—monarchs of the four winds—you propel four creatures.

feats.name: Four-armed Aspect
feats.notes: You intone vows to shoulder others’ pains; in response, your torso sprouts an additional pair of arms to help you bear those burdens.

feats.name: Fox Arson
feats.notes: When you critically hit with a foxfire Strike, the target takes an additional 1d4 persistent damage of the same type as the foxfire.

feats.name: Fox Possession
feats.notes: You can project a spiritual form to possess another.

feats.name: Fox Trick
feats.notes: You always have time for a joke or prank.

feats.name: Foxfire
feats.notes: A crack of your tail sparks wisps of blue energy.

feats.name: Fracture Time Flow
feats.notes: Your ability to interact with and even observe the flow of time allows you to fracture it slightly in a localized place whenever you land a particularly solid blow on a foe.
feats.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star

feats.name: Free and Fair
feats.notes: Use New Leadership and other activities more efficiently

feats.name: Free from Bonds
feats.notes: As a mortal herald, you cannot easily be captured, nor can your allies.

feats.name: Free Heart
feats.notes: You follow all your passions, unlimited in creativity and zeal.

feats.name: Freeze It!
feats.notes: You are no rime hag or Jadwiga, but the magic of the north has still left a mark on you.

feats.name: Fresh Ingredients
feats.notes: It is amazing the difference fresh herbs can make.

feats.name: Fresh Produce
feats.notes: You grow a nourishing nut, vegetable, seed, or fruit.

feats.name: Friend of the Family
feats.notes: You come from a long line of imperial kobolds—if you meet a stranger who has some political standing in Tian Xia, they might know someone from your family line.

feats.name: Friend of the Sea
feats.notes: You have established a companionship with a sea creature, often carrying them in a small, waterfilled globe when you are on land.

feats.name: Friendform
feats.notes: The shared bond between you and your allies allows you to act on their behalf.

feats.name: Friendly Fling
feats.notes: You can scoop up your friends with your horns to hurl them across the battlefield.

feats.name: Friendly Nudge
feats.notes: You don't always have time to wait for your allies to make room, so it's best to politely move them yourself.

feats.name: Friendly Toss
feats.notes: You toss your friends around the battlefield.

feats.name: Frighten Undead
feats.notes: Your very presence chills creatures of the night down to their core and you can use the spiritual power and faithful life force of religious verses to frighten even mindless undead .
feats.prerequisite: Undead Slayer Dedication; Trained in Intimidation

feats.name: Frightening Appearance
feats.notes: Your dramatic appearances can frighten bystanders.

feats.name: Frightening Indignation
feats.notes: Your anger at the world's many injustices boil out from you in a wave of palpable energy.

feats.name: Frightening Power
feats.notes: Draconic essence coruscates around you, sapping the resilience of your foes.

feats.name: Frightful Attrition
feats.notes: Your diminishment of your foes' ranks damages their morale.

feats.name: Frightful Aura
feats.notes: You're surrounded by a palpable sense of menace and power that's terrifying to behold.

feats.name: Frightful Condemnation
feats.notes: Your willingness to follow through on your pitiless judgment is frightful to the person you have condemned.
feats.prerequisite: Harsh Judgment; Vigilante Dedication; member of the Gray Gardeners
feats.trigger: You hit your condemned foe with a melee Strike in the same turn during which you condemned it with Harsh Judgment.

feats.name: Frightful Moan
feats.notes: You lament your fate, realeasing a ghastly moan that frightens the living.

feats.name: Frog Geyser
feats.notes: You can spray a powerful steam of water from your mouth to push your foes around.

feats.name: Frog Tide
feats.notes: You have a connection to water and are able to call upon it to batter your foes and carry them away.

feats.name: Frostbite Runes
feats.notes: Thick tattoos, each one a rune fragment from the saumen kar's long-lost language spelling out their pact with their equally lost deity, cover your body and stretch across your limbs, torso, and face.

feats.name: Frozen Breadth
feats.notes: Your attunement to arcane cold enhances the depths of your growing power.

feats.name: Full Automation
feats.notes: You become so entwined with your innovations that you can use them without a second thought.

feats.name: Full Flight
feats.notes: Your flight is unbound, as natural as it was before you were awakened.

feats.name: Fully Flighted
feats.notes: You gain the effects of Juvenile Flight at all times, rather than just once per day for 10 minutes.

feats.name: Fulminating Shot
feats.notes: You channel potent magic into your next shot, empowering it with a blast of crackling energy.

feats.name: Fulminating Synergy
feats.notes: When you draw upon your spells’ synergy, you create a physical manifestation of their magical resonance and invoke it to harm a foe.

feats.name: Fulu Familiar
feats.notes: You can imprint your familiar’s spiritual essence into a fulu , a small paper charm that can be affixed to objects, creatures, or structures.
feats.prerequisite: Familiar Sage Dedication; Expert in Occultism or Expert in Religion

feats.name: Fumesoul
feats.notes: The air inside you asserts itself as a toxic miasma, inuring you to most poisons.

feats.name: Fungal Exhalation
feats.notes: You can conjure toxic spores to infect enemies.

feats.name: Furious Bully
feats.notes: You bully foes across the battlefield.

feats.name: Furious Finish
feats.notes: Desperate to finish the fight, you pour all your rage into one final blow.

feats.name: Furious Focus
feats.notes: You’ve learned to maintain your balance even when swinging furiously.

feats.name: Furious Grab
feats.notes: You grab your foe while it's distracted by your attack.

feats.name: Furious Sprint
feats.notes: You rush forward.

feats.name: Furious Vengeance
feats.notes: Your enemy's blow fuels your rage and provokes your immediate retaliation.
feats.trigger: An enemy within your melee reach critically hits you with a melee Strike .

feats.name: Furnace Form
feats.notes: Opening your kinetic gate, you allow flames to consume your form and leave you a living flame.

feats.name: Fuse Stance
feats.notes: You have combined two stances into a single stance all your own.

feats.name: Fused Polearm
feats.notes: During your daily preparations, you can magically fuse your arcane bonded weapon and a magical staff together into one item, with the staff making up the haft of the weapon.

feats.name: Fused Staff
feats.notes: You can use your arcane prowess to fuse a magical staff into a weapon during your daily preparations or as a 10-minute activity with the manipulate trait.

feats.name: Future Spell Learning
feats.notes: More future memories of time magic percolate back to the present, teaching you spells you've yet to learn.

feats.name: Gadget Specialist
feats.notes: Rather than just using your gadgets for various boosts and tweaks, you also craft a few specific temporary consumable gadgets each day.

feats.name: Gallop Across Shadow
feats.notes: Though your enemy wields shadow and darkness as weapons, they are no impediment to you when you ride your trusted horse.

feats.name: Galvanize Spell
feats.notes: You reabsorb the magic of your spellsurge aura to power a piece of powerful magic.

feats.name: Game Hunter Dedication
feats.notes: You are skilled at tracking big game animals and similar creatures.

feats.name: Gang Up
feats.notes: You and your allies harry an opponent in concert.

feats.name: Gaping Flesh
feats.notes: Your wound yawns open, appalling your attacker.
feats.trigger: A creature you are aware of damages you with a melee Strike.

feats.name: Garden Path
feats.notes: You can guide your crop to move without notice.

feats.name: Gardener's Resolve
feats.notes: The Gray Gardeners are known for having nerves of steel and an unbreakable resolve.
feats.prerequisite: Vigilante Dedication; member of the Gray Gardeners
feats.trigger: You roll a failure (but not a critical failure) on a Will save against a fear effect

feats.name: Garland Spell
feats.notes: If your next action is to Cast a Spell with the fungus or plant trait, a garland of plants grows in a 10-foot burst in the spell’s range.

feats.name: Garuda Magic
feats.notes: You are descended from the wondrous garudas, and their keen senses manifest in your magical prowess.

feats.name: Garuda's Squall
feats.notes: Garudas' marksmanship and magic are second nature to you.

feats.name: Gather Disciples
feats.notes: Gods need followers, and you know that its best to gather a flock in the present to support you in your endeavor.
feats.prerequisite: Starstone Aspirant Dedication; Master in Religion

feats.name: Gathering Moss
feats.notes: By rooting yourself in place, you are able to focus your body's natural healing to work faster.

feats.name: Gaze of Veracity
feats.notes: You can channel your mask's power to pierce through lies and see the truth in any situation.

feats.name: Gear Gnash
feats.notes: Snares you create have complicated inner workings that are quite difficult to disable.

feats.name: Gear Up
feats.notes: Whether it's wooden stakes, holy water, or more unusual tools, you always have just the right thing to handle an undead's unusual weaknesses and vulnerabilities.

feats.name: Gecko's Grip
feats.notes: You cling to walls with a preternatural grip.

feats.name: Gemsoul
feats.notes: The earth inside you asserts itself as crystallized gemstones or metals, like a cluster of quartz or veins of iron and gold.

feats.name: General Training
feats.notes: Your adaptability manifests in your mastery of a range of useful abilities.

feats.name: General's Gambit
feats.notes: You move strategically forward to draw the enemy’s attention away from your allies.

feats.name: Generation Digger
feats.notes: You're so adept at burrowing through the earth that you don't even need tools; in fact, you just might be trusted to lead the latest generation dig.

feats.name: Generational Rune-Singer
feats.notes: You are a once-in-a-generation genius.

feats.name: Genie Weapon Expertise
feats.notes: Whenever you gain a class feature that grants you expert or greater proficiency in certain weapons, you also gain that proficiency in falchions, ranseurs, scimitars, tridents, and all geniekin weapons in which you are trained.

feats.name: Genie Weapon Familiarity
feats.notes: You've trained with weapons used by your genie ancestors.

feats.name: Genie Weapon Flourish
feats.notes: Whenever you critically hit using a falchion, ranseur, scimitar, trident, or a geniekin weapon, you apply the weapon's critical specialization effect.

feats.name: Gentle Death and Rebirth
feats.notes: You were once born from the energies of the land and nature, and by their power, you can return to life again.

feats.name: Geobukseon Retaliation
feats.notes: Your armor has a retractable spike-covered shell reminiscent of Hwanggot’s heavily armored geobukseon, or “turtle ships.” The shell unfolds across your body, giving you a +4 circumstance bonus to AC and resistance 2 to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage until the end of your next turn.
feats.trigger: You would take damage.
feats.access: Tian Xia origin

feats.name: Geologic Attunement
feats.notes: You tune to the earth and stone around you, extending your senses through it in rippling waves.

feats.name: Geomancer Dedication
feats.notes: You feel a deep connection to the world no matter where you are, a phenomenon known as “terrain attunement.” When you expend a spell slot to cast a spell with a trait that corresponds to the type of terrain you are currently in (as listed below), you gain the terrain attunement effect for that type of terrain.
feats.prerequisite: Trained in Nature; ability to cast spells from spell slots; at least one spell with the air, cold, earth, fire, plant, or water trait

feats.name: Germination of Resolve
feats.notes: Vitality floods your trammeled soul, offering you rejuvenation, if not quite rest.

feats.name: Get Behind Me!
feats.notes: When saving your allies from harm, you push them behind you to better protect them.

feats.name: Get Used to Disappointment
feats.notes: You capitalize on an opponent's failure with smug attitude and swagger, reminding them of the gap in skill between you and your opponent.

feats.name: Ghoran Lore
feats.notes: The very first memories ghorans have are those of their creation, and even after thousands of years, those memories have never faded for you.

feats.name: Ghoran Weapon Expertise
feats.notes: It's as if you've been training for a thousand years.

feats.name: Ghoran Weapon Familiarity
feats.notes: Over the course of your long, long existence, you've had a chance to practice with traditional ghoran weapons.

feats.name: Ghoran Weapon Practice
feats.notes: With plenty of practice, the memories of previous fights from previous lives come flooding back.

feats.name: Ghoran's Wrath
feats.notes: You have such a strong connection to the natural world that you can inspire it to attack at those who threaten you.

feats.name: Ghost Blade
feats.notes: You alter your weapon's phase so it can more easily strike incorporeal creatures.

feats.name: Ghost Dedication
feats.notes: You have risen as a shell of your former self, a spirit of mist and anguish.
feats.prerequisite: You died and returned as a ghost.

feats.name: Ghost Eater Dedication
feats.notes: You have trained as a ghost eater, a hunter specialized in the destruction of spirits.
feats.prerequisite: Trained in Occultism or Trained in Religion

feats.name: Ghost Flight
feats.notes: You can suppress your tether to the ground, overcoming your resistance to fly free.

feats.name: Ghost Hunter
feats.notes: Your connection to the Boneyard ensures that your blows strike true against spectral beings.

feats.name: Ghost Hunter Dedication
feats.notes: You have focused your training on hunting and defeating ghosts, spirits, and all manner of haunts.
feats.prerequisite: Trained in Occultism or Trained in Religion

feats.name: Ghost Strike
feats.notes: You can infuse a weapon you are carrying with magical energies that allow it to strike true against incorporeal undead.

feats.name: Ghost Wrangler
