feats.notes: Spirits around you coalesce upon your fists, enabling you to seize and harm other ghosts and spirits.
feats.access: Knights of Lastwall have access to this feat.

feats.name: Ghost-path Epiphany
feats.notes: Deviating from the orthodox path, you tread an inauspicious descent littered with flowers of death; this heretical choice will, in time, earn you the enmity and fear of more traditional cultivators.

feats.name: Ghostly Condemnation
feats.notes: You shriek a death sentence upon a single target within 120 feet, forcing it to experience the final moments of your mortal life as you were dragged through a howling mob and forced to kneel before the final blade that took your life and head.

feats.name: Ghostly Grasp (Deviant)
feats.notes: An invisible arm extends from you to grab and manipulate objects.

feats.name: Ghostly Grasp (Ghost)
feats.notes: Your control over your ghostly form grows.

feats.name: Ghostly Resistance
feats.notes: Your ghostly form becomes innately weaker but also gains resistance to many forms of damage.

feats.name: Ghostly Resonance
feats.notes: Your runes don’t just draw power from the world of the spirits— they can let even the most mundane objects harm spirits as well.

feats.name: Ghostly Stride
feats.notes: You fade into a slightly incorporeal form as you move.

feats.name: Ghosts in the Storm
feats.notes: Clouds, like eager pets, are drawn to you and to those in your good graces.

feats.name: Ghostsong
feats.notes: You have come to understand the pain and fury of spirits and can raise them to do your ghastly work.

feats.name: Ghoul Dedication
feats.notes: You have succumbed to ghoul fever, dying and returning as a ghoul , an undead cursed with a never-ending hunger for dead flesh that slowly overrides your reason and willpower until you would do anything for the meal you crave.
feats.prerequisite: You were killed by ghoul fever.

feats.name: Giant Hunter
feats.notes: You have studied giants and hunt them with efficiency.

feats.name: Giant Slayer
feats.notes: Your well-placed blows can fell mighty giants.

feats.name: Giant Snare
feats.notes: You can create bigger snares for quick deployment, making it more likely for a creature to walk into your snares.

feats.name: Giant's Lunge
feats.notes: You extend your body and prepare to attack foes outside your normal reach.

feats.name: Giant's Stature
feats.notes: You grow to incredible size.

feats.name: Gift of the Hoard
feats.notes: In pleasing the cravings of a mighty dragon, they have deigned to impart some of their magical essence into your body.
feats.prerequisite: You have succeeded at an important task given by a dragon, such as procuring a special treasure for their hoard.

feats.name: Gift of the Immortal Herb
feats.notes: Your blood turns a divine gold, shining in moments its spilled and begetting new life.

feats.name: Gift of the Moon
feats.notes: You can share your power with others, but they can't escape the werecreature's curse as easily as you can.

feats.name: Gifted Power
feats.notes: Your mystery grants you additional magic.

feats.name: Gigantic Megafauna Companion
feats.notes: The mammoths and other megafauna ridden by your people are larger than any ordinary beast.

feats.name: Gigaton Strike
feats.notes: When you use a full-power Megaton Strike, you can knock your foe back.

feats.name: Gigavolt
feats.notes: When you unleash electricity from your innovation, you can bounce it off obstacles, creating a field of electric death.

feats.name: Gildedsoul
feats.notes: Your elemental lineage manifests in the polished gleam of precious metals.

feats.name: Gird Champion
feats.notes: Your will manifests into divine weapons to protect and arm your followers.

feats.name: Glacial Prison
feats.notes: Intense cold swirls around your foe, covering it in frost that slows it down and turns its body to ice.

feats.name: Glad-Hand
feats.notes: Make an Impression on a target you’ve just met

feats.name: Gladiator Dedication
feats.notes: You know how to turn combat into a form of entertainment.

feats.name: Gladiator's Roar
feats.notes: You can project your voice into a high-pitched screech that damages your foes.

feats.name: Glamour
feats.notes: You unlock a new level of fey power and can manipulate the perceptions of others using a font of First World magic.

feats.name: Glass Skin
feats.notes: Even if vitrumancy is a mystery to you, your blood and flesh know the secrets of the art of arcane glass.
feats.prerequisite: You were present at the death of the medusa Alethsia, whose vitrumantic powers were passed on to you in the wake of her destruction.

feats.name: Glean Contents
feats.notes: You are adept at quickly scanning loose papers and carefully discerning the contents of sealed letters without damaging the seal.

feats.name: Glean Lore
feats.notes: You tap into the collected lore of the divine, accessing a variety of potentially useful information.

feats.name: Glider Form
feats.notes: Your eidolon evolves wings, a buoyant body, or some other means to control descent.

feats.name: Glitter Crystals
feats.notes: You can mix a blend of crushed flowers and alchemical salt into an alchemical elixir with the healing trait or alchemical food .

feats.name: Gloomseer
feats.notes: Gloom holds few terrors for you, and the pall of darkness over Nidal has made you comfortable in dim light.

feats.name: Glorious Banner
feats.notes: Your banner is an awesome sight to behold.

feats.name: Glorious Gamtu
feats.notes: You can access the mystical power that dokkaebi refer to as a hat.
feats.access: dokkaebi goblin heritage

feats.name: Glory and Valor!
feats.notes: You call upon your ascendant blood with a mighty cry that fills you with a revitalizing energy for 1 minute or until you critically fail a Strike, whichever comes first.

feats.name: Glory on High
feats.notes: You take to the skies to unveil the full magnificence of your deity’s power.
feats.prerequisite: Mortal Herald Dedication; fly Speed of at least 20 feet

feats.name: Glutton for Flesh
feats.notes: You have developed a capacity to store more flesh within your gaunt body to leave yourself satiated longer.

feats.name: Glyph Expert
feats.notes: You've learned to recognize the telltale writings and other signs that indicate the presence of magical traps.

feats.name: Glyph Familiar
feats.notes: You have taken a living rune as a familiar to aid you in your adventures.

feats.name: Gnaw
feats.notes: With enough time and determination, you can chew through nearly anything.

feats.name: Gnome Obsession
feats.notes: You might have a flighty nature, but when a topic captures your attention, you dive into it headfirst.

feats.name: Gnome Polyglot
feats.notes: Your extensive travels, curiosity, and love of learning help you to learn languages quickly.

feats.name: Gnome Weapon Familiarity
feats.notes: You favor unusual weapons tied to your people, such as blades with curved and peculiar shapes.

feats.name: Go With the Flow
feats.notes: You have an occult connection to the world that helps you blend in with the cacophony of life around you.
feats.trigger: A creature detects your attempt to Impersonate , and you’re within 30 feet of at least one other creature.
feats.access: Character follows the ways of Sangpotshi or studies texts and lore containing Sangpotshi secrets

feats.name: Goading Feint
feats.notes: Your tricks make foes overextend their attacks.

feats.name: Goblin Club
feats.notes: You can summon a mass of magic energy in your hand that, naturally, you use to smack those who offend you.
feats.access: dokkaebi goblin heritage

feats.name: Goblin Jubilee Display
feats.notes: Flames and explosions sear the air in a riot of color and devastation that rivals that wrought by even the wildest goblin party.

feats.name: Goblin Lore
feats.notes: You've picked up skills and tales from your goblin community.

feats.name: Goblin Scuttle
feats.notes: You take advantage of your ally's movement to adjust your position.
feats.trigger: An ally ends a move action adjacent to you

feats.name: Goblin Song
feats.notes: You sing annoying goblin songs, distracting your foes with silly and repetitive lyrics.

feats.name: Goblin Weapon Familiarity
feats.notes: Others might look upon them with disdain, but you know that the weapons of your people are as effective as they are sharp.

feats.name: Godbreaker
feats.notes: You have mastered an ultimate grappling technique capable of breaking even the mightiest of foes.

feats.name: Godless Healing
feats.notes: You recover an additional 5 Hit Points from a successful attempt to Treat your Wounds or use Battle Medicine on you.
feats.prerequisite: Battle Medicine; can’t have a patron deity

feats.name: Godling Dedication
feats.notes: Your Calling allows you to begin walking the path to true deific ascension, inspiring followers as your divine seed grows.

feats.name: Gods' Palm
feats.notes: You control your spirit energy when you attack, using it to reinforce yourself or to thrust past your enemy’s physical defenses.

feats.name: Godspeed
feats.notes: Mythic power grants you speed to rival beasts and demigods .

feats.name: Golden Body
feats.notes: Strike harder and heal more rapidly.

feats.name: Golden Dragon's Bounty
feats.notes: Your familiar alters the material of a spell into that of a precious metal.

feats.name: Golden Erinys Stance
feats.notes: Whether you're a keen student of vengeance or you picked up techniques after being a common target for the sisters' punishment, you've learned to dig painfully into your opponent's flesh.
feats.prerequisite: Sister of the Golden Erinys Dedication

feats.name: Golden League Xun Dedication
feats.notes: You are a xun for the Golden League, aiding the organization.

feats.name: Golden Legionnaire Dedication
feats.notes: You're a wall of metal standing against the tide of Andoran's enemies.
feats.access: You're invited by a current member of the Eagle Knights or the People's Council.

feats.name: Golem Dynamo
feats.notes: You've learned the secrets of Jistkan golem prostheses, allowing you to incorporate golem components into your dynamo and gain a portion of their magic.
feats.access: You are an automaton or are otherwise from the ancient Jistka Imperium.

feats.name: Golem Grafter Dedication
feats.notes: Your flesh has been specially treated with the same arcane and alchemical processes used to toughen the skin of flesh golems.
feats.prerequisite: expert in Arcana and Crafting, or an ally with expert proficiency in those skills willing to augment you

feats.name: Goloma Courage
feats.notes: The most important thing you've learned living with fear is how to overcome it.

feats.name: Goloma Lore
feats.notes: You lived an insulated life focused on avoiding danger.

feats.name: Gorilla Pound
feats.notes: You pound your chest before slamming into your foes.

feats.name: Gorilla Stance
feats.notes: You lower yourself to the ground and take an imposing, knuckle-walking stance.

feats.name: Goring Charge
feats.notes: Driven by the momentum of your thundering steps and powerful mass, your horns can pierce your foes.

feats.name: Gossamer Blade
feats.notes: Drawing upon your command of intangible spaces, you create an echo of your weapon to resonate through its victim.

feats.name: Gossip Lore
feats.notes: Your time gossiping in fashionable salons keeps you informed on every topic.

feats.name: Graceful Guidance
feats.notes: You can demonstrate how to quickly twist out of the way of dangerous effects.

feats.name: Graceful Leaper
feats.notes: Mass and muscle are meaningless when you propel yourself through the air; only grace and balance matter.

feats.name: Graceful Poise
feats.notes: With the right positioning, your off-hand weapon can strike like a scorpion’s stinger.

feats.name: Graft Technician
feats.notes: You can create and implant grafts.

feats.name: Grand Dance
feats.notes: You can summon the full magic of Bhopan's grand dance.

feats.name: Grand Medic's Mask
feats.notes: Your mask is infused with restorative magic associated with Ibex, the Flourishing Field, so it constantly repairs itself.

feats.name: Grand Metamorphosis
feats.notes: One of your nodes has adapted into a new magic-emitting organ.

feats.name: Grand Scroll Esoterica
feats.notes: You've completed the third and final step in your assimilation of scroll esoterica, granting you daily scrolls of incredible power.

feats.name: Grand Talisman Esoterica
feats.notes: You've gained the ability to place multiple talismans on an item.

feats.name: Grandmaster Qi Spells
feats.notes: You have unlocked a qi technique achievable only by those who attain complete mastery of both their body and their spirit.

feats.name: Grandmother's Wisdom
feats.notes: You carry the bones of your ancestors with you, and you can ask them for counsel.

feats.name: Grasping Corpses
feats.notes: Your foes are left reeling from the attacks made by the zombies or skeletons of your horde.

feats.name: Grasping Limbs
feats.notes: Your eidolon grabs enemies.

feats.name: Grasping Reach
feats.notes: You can extend a tangle of vines or tendrils to support your arms and extend your reach.

feats.name: Grasping Spirits Spell
feats.notes: Gaining substance from your magic, your apparitions increase the range of your spells, which then pull your enemy closer.

feats.name: Grave Focus
feats.notes: Studying necromancy in great depth has perfected your ability to find the links between life and death where you least expected.

feats.name: Grave Mummification
feats.notes: Exposure to the elements, magic, alchemy, and other phenomena intensified the changes from your mummification.

feats.name: Grave Sense
feats.notes: Learn how to sense undead in the area.

feats.name: Grave Sight
feats.notes: Your ability to sense undead has improved.

feats.name: Grave Strength
feats.notes: The flesh you've consumed over the course of your existence as a ghoul has made you stronger, gifting you with strange insights from the minds of the sapient creatures you've devoured and bringing you closer to a state of undead perfection.

feats.name: Grave Threat
feats.notes: You use your imposing demeanor to set up the undead for defeat.

feats.name: Grave's Voice
feats.notes: You can influence spirits and haunts

feats.name: Gravel Guts
feats.notes: Stone never becomes queasy, so why should you? You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against the sickened condition.

feats.name: Gravelands Herbalist
feats.notes: Your time with the Knights of Lastwall has taught you the secrets of creating and improving upon Lastwall soup.
feats.access: Knights of Lastwall have access to this feat.

feats.name: Graveshift
feats.notes: The maggots inhabiting your body impart you with the knowledge to travel from grave to grave, drawing upon the mystical power of the labyrinthine network of magical warrens and tunnels that connect Everglut to the Material Plane .

feats.name: Gravesight
feats.notes: You can see in the darkness as easily as a psychopomp.

feats.name: Gray Corsair Training
feats.notes: You strike for Andoran on the waters of the Inner Sea and beyond.
feats.prerequisite: Steel Falcon Dedication; Trained in Intimidation

feats.name: Great Bear
feats.notes: When you transform, you can take on a bear's bulk and size.

feats.name: Great Boaster
feats.notes: Your bragging is particularly effective.

feats.name: Great Cleave
feats.notes: Your fury carries your weapon through multiple foes.

feats.name: Great Shield Mastery
feats.notes: You've learned how to maximize the defensive abilities of the largest shields.

feats.name: Great Tengu Form
feats.notes: You take on the imposing form of a large, winged spirit.

feats.name: Greater Animal Senses
feats.notes: Your senses advance to match those of your animal aspect.

feats.name: Greater Armament
feats.notes: Your weapons have greater power available to them.

feats.name: Greater Augmentation
feats.notes: You've greatly improved your abilities and your core can support further augmentations.

feats.name: Greater Awakened Power
feats.notes: Your power undergoes yet another awakening

feats.name: Greater Bloodline
feats.notes: You uncover the greater secrets of your bloodline.

feats.name: Greater Crossblooded Evolution
feats.notes: Your bloodline is extraordinarily complex.

feats.name: Greater Cruelty
feats.notes: The extent of your corruption devastates your foes' minds and reflexes.

feats.name: Greater Deathly Secrets
feats.notes: Your undead secrets grow stronger still.

feats.name: Greater Debilitating Bomb
feats.notes: You have learned enhanced techniques and alchemical secrets that allow you to expand the range of effects you can impose with your bombs.

feats.name: Greater Deific Power
feats.notes: Divine power continues to fill you.

feats.name: Greater Despair
feats.notes: You increase the frequency of Mummy's Despair to once per 10 minutes instead of once per hour.

feats.name: Greater Distracting Shot
feats.notes: Even a single missile can throw off your enemy’s balance, and more powerful attacks leave it flustered for longer.

feats.name: Greater Enhance Venom
feats.notes: You upgrade the vishkanyan venom you can apply with Envenom to greater vishkanyan venom.

feats.name: Greater Esoteric Spellcasting
feats.notes: Your understanding of magic has evolved, and so has your spellcasting.

feats.name: Greater Expanded Repertoire
feats.notes: You have gained extensive knowledge in the art of creating runes.

feats.name: Greater Interpose
feats.notes: Your divine grace empowers you to avoid hits when you otherwise could not.

feats.name: Greater Lesson
feats.notes: Your patron grants you greater knowledge.

feats.name: Greater Magical Edification
feats.notes: You've continued to expand your compendium of tools to compile knowledge.

feats.name: Greater Magical Scholastics
feats.notes: You broaden the scope of your magical understanding, allowing you to find the right path, detect hidden objects, and conceal those objects from unscrupulous rivals.

feats.name: Greater Mental Evolution
feats.notes: Your bloodline's deep connection to mental essence greatly enhances your spell repertoire.

feats.name: Greater Merciful Elixir
feats.notes: Your additives contain panaceas that can remedy a plethora of maladies.

feats.name: Greater Mercy
feats.notes: Your faith enhances your ability to remove conditions.

feats.name: Greater Physical Evolution
feats.notes: You change form readily.

feats.name: Greater Revelation
feats.notes: You unlock deeper revelations hidden within your mystery.

feats.name: Greater Security
feats.notes: Shield in hand, you offer your ally its full protection you do yourself.

feats.name: Greater Snow Step
feats.notes: You can't be impeded by environmental effects that rely on cold or its byproducts.

feats.name: Greater Spell Runes
feats.notes: You gain more powerful spell runes.

feats.name: Greater Spiritual Evolution
feats.notes: Your magical blood allows your spells to be fully effective against incorporeal creatures.

feats.name: Greater Sun Blessing
feats.notes: Your connection to the Old Sun Gods grows stronger.
feats.source: Pathfinder #172: Secrets of the Temple City

feats.name: Greater than the Sum
feats.notes: You call upon the familial bonds you share with your allies and other ratfolk to become an overwhelming force in battle.

feats.name: Greater Transformation
feats.notes: You can assume your oni form more easily, and with greater benefits.

feats.name: Greater Vital Evolution
feats.notes: Vital power surges through you like a font of energy.

feats.name: Green Dash
feats.notes: The spirits of vegetation send you on your way, letting you move in a burst of speed.

feats.name: Green Tongue
feats.notes: You share a special kinship with all things green and living.

feats.name: Greenwatch Initiate
feats.notes: You've received the basic training developed for all Greenwatch recruits.

feats.name: Greenwatch Veteran
feats.notes: Your time spent tracking your target allows you to quickly identify its weaknesses and relay them to your allies.
feats.trigger: Your turn starts, and you're in combat against a creature you spent at least 10 minutes Tracking .

feats.name: Greenwatcher
feats.notes: Your experience fighting against and alongside fey creatures is nearly unrivaled.

feats.name: Grief's Fury
feats.notes: A lost love. A broken spear . Rage burning through a hero-god.
feats.trigger: Your bonded partner gains the dying condition or their dying value would increase.

feats.name: Grievous Blow
feats.notes: You know how to deliver focused, powerful blows that bypass your enemies’ resistances.

feats.name: Grim Insight
feats.notes: Others’ attempts to scare you often grant you insights about your would-be bullies that you can then exploit.

feats.name: Grimspawn
feats.notes: Your lineage traces back to a daemon, one of the manifestations of horrific forms of death that devour souls within their foul home of Abaddon .

feats.name: Gripping Limbs
feats.notes: Nodules, hooks, or claws on your limbs allow you to cling to surfaces with ease.

feats.name: Grippli Glide
feats.notes: You can use your webbed feet to guide your fall.

feats.name: Grippli Lore
feats.notes: You are well versed in grippli culture and tactics.

feats.name: Grit and Tenacity
feats.notes: You call upon deep reserves of toughness and mental fortitude to power through an otherwise debilitating effect.
feats.trigger: You fail a Fortitude or Will save.

feats.name: Group Aid
feats.notes: Your upbringing emphasized teamwork, and helping your allies comes naturally to you.

feats.name: Group Coercion
feats.notes: Coerce multiple targets simultaneously

feats.name: Group Impression
feats.notes: Make an Impression on multiple targets more easily

feats.name: Group Taunt
feats.notes: Your taunts draw the attention of multiple enemies at once.

feats.name: Grove-Harbored
feats.notes: You are accustomed to exploring thick woodlands and defending yourself against the attacks of magical plants.

feats.name: Grovel
feats.notes: You convince your foe you're less of a threat.

feats.name: Grow Tool
feats.notes: You grow a simple tool from your own body, coaxing flowers, vines, roots, and wood to grow and sprout from your flesh into the desired shape.

feats.name: Growing Eel Friend
feats.notes: Your eel pet grows larger and stronger.

feats.name: Grown of Oak
feats.notes: You can make your skin take on the woody endurance of an ancient tree and have your familiar follow suit.

feats.name: Growth Spell
feats.notes: You enhance your spell with elemental wood, causing your magic to expand and grow beyond its original limitations.
feats.prerequisite: Elementalist Dedication; wood is in your elemental philosophy

feats.name: Grudge Strike
feats.notes: You channel the spiritual power of spiteful grudges.

feats.name: Grudging Compliment
feats.notes: Every Firebrand can recognize the skill of others, but you've turned it into an art you can wield in combat.
feats.trigger: An enemy within 30 feet damages you or succeeds at a skill check.
feats.access: Members of the Firebrands at the rank of second mark or higher have access to this feat.

feats.name: Gruesome Strike
feats.notes: Make a Strike against the creature that triggered your champion's reaction.
feats.prerequisite: champion’s reaction that grants extra damage with your Strikes (including the desecration, iniquity, and obedience causes)

feats.name: Guard's Fury
feats.notes: Some Ulfen Guards tap into a well of fury to protect their charges.
feats.prerequisite: Ulfen Guard Dedication; you can’t already use the Rage action

feats.name: Guarded Advance (Guardian)
feats.notes: You slowly advance on the battlefield, taking utmost caution.

feats.name: Guarded Advance (Knight Vigilant)
feats.notes: You slowly advance on the battlefield, taking utmost caution.

feats.name: Guarded Domain
feats.notes: You and your united companion have elected to become guardians of a particular location or domain.

feats.name: Guarded Mind
feats.notes: When your enemies try to turn your mind against you, thoughts of your anathema bolster you.
feats.trigger: You fail a saving throw against an effect that has the mental trait.

feats.name: Guarded Movement
feats.notes: Your guard is up, even while moving.

feats.name: Guarded Thoughts
feats.notes: Your mind, like a dark naga's , foils attempts to read your thoughts.

feats.name: Guardian Dedication
feats.notes: You become trained in Athletics ; if you were already trained in Athletics, you instead become trained in a skill of your choice.

feats.name: Guardian Ghosts
feats.notes: You magically divert some of the harm from an incoming attack away from yourself, forcing your undead companion to take it in your stead.
feats.trigger: You would take damage from a Strike while one of your undead companions is adjacent to you.

feats.name: Guardian Lion Roar
feats.notes: Your innovation is augmented with plates shaped to resemble the gaping maws of guardian lions, which you can energize to expel a stream of sonic energy reminiscent of a lion’s powerful roar.
feats.prerequisite: armor innovation, construct innovation, or weapon innovation

feats.name: Guardian Resiliency
feats.notes: You gain 3 additional Hit Points for each guardian archetype class feat you have.
feats.prerequisite: Guardian Dedication; class granting no more Hit Points than 10 + your Constitution modifier

feats.name: Guardian's Deflection
feats.notes: You use your weapon to deflect the attack against your ally, granting a +2 circumstance bonus to their AC against the triggering attack.
feats.trigger: An ally within your melee reach is hit by an attack, you can see the attacker, and a +2 circumstance bonus to AC would turn the critical hit into a hit or the hit into a miss.

feats.name: Guardian's Deflection (Fighter)
feats.notes: You use your weapon to deflect the attack against your ally, granting a +2 circumstance bonus to their Armor Class against the triggering attack.
feats.trigger: An ally within your melee reach is hit by an attack, you can see the attacker, and the ally gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to AC would turn the critical hit into a hit or the hit into a miss

feats.name: Guardian's Embrace
feats.notes: Your spirit guide discorporates to surround you in an invisible protective shroud.

feats.name: Guardian's Intercept
feats.notes: You can use the Intercept Attack reaction once per 10 minutes.

feats.name: Guding Retort
feats.notes: With a cunning twist of their unarmed attack, your eidolon shifts the position of a foe.

feats.name: Guerrilla Dedication
feats.notes: You're skilled in subtle tactics and using the environment against your enemies.
feats.prerequisite: Trained in Stealth; Trained in Survival

feats.name: Guerrilla Weaponry
feats.notes: You are especially skilled in transforming simple weapons that can be easily assembled from readily available materials into deadly weapons.

feats.name: Guide the Timeline
feats.notes: You know the result you want and subtly nudge the timeline to your intended destination.

feats.name: Guided by the Stars
feats.notes: The stars grant you insights that guide your actions.
feats.trigger: You are about to attempt a skill check or saving throw.

feats.name: Guided Hover
feats.notes: You guide your draconic companion, whose outstretched wings fill with unseen thermals.
feats.trigger: Your turn ends.

feats.name: Guided Skill
feats.notes: You ask your spirit guide for aid.

feats.name: Guiding Finish
feats.notes: Using your weapon as a lever, you force your opponent to end up right where you want them.

feats.name: Guiding Luck
feats.notes: Your luck guides you to look the right way and aim your blows unerringly.

feats.name: Guiding Riposte
feats.notes: By shifting your weight and angling your weapon, you guide your opponent to a more favorable position.

feats.name: Guiding Shot
feats.notes: Your ranged attack helps guide your allies into striking your enemy's weak point.

feats.name: Guiding Words
feats.notes: Your words speak divine truth, guiding blades and arrows to their mark.
feats.prerequisite: Mortal Herald Dedication; Master in Diplomacy

feats.name: Guillotine Blade
feats.notes: The echoes of the splinter of finality's original purpose resonate through the artifact.

feats.name: Gunpowder Gauntlet
feats.notes: Your flair keeps foes' attention, as your motions with your gun draw your foes into a deadly game.

feats.name: Gunslinger Dedication
feats.notes: You become trained in simple and martial crossbows and simple and martial firearms.

feats.name: Gusting Spell
feats.notes: You manipulate the currents of your spell's energy, allowing you to gracefully glide with your wings.

feats.name: Haft Beatdown
feats.notes: The momentum of each of your attacks feeds into the next blow in the routine, creating a brutal rhythm that enables you to give your target one continuous beatdown.

feats.name: Haft Striker Stance
feats.notes: You enter a stance that allows you to leverage the haft of your weapon to brutal effect as an effective and frighteningly efficient weapon in its own right.

feats.name: Hag Claws
feats.notes: When you came of age, your fingernails grew long and sharp.

feats.name: Hag Magic
feats.notes: Through your heritage, you can replicate a hag’s magic.

feats.name: Hag's Sight
feats.notes: You’ve nurtured the supernatural abilities gifted by your hag mother, particularly your sight.

feats.name: Hail of Splinters
feats.notes: A fusillade of jagged splinters flies from you.

feats.name: Hair Trigger
feats.notes: No one can react faster than you can pull your trigger.
feats.prerequisite: initial deed that allows you to Interact to draw a weapon

feats.name: Halcyon Speaker Dedication
feats.notes: You devote much of your study to halcyon magic.
feats.prerequisite: Magaambyan Attendant Dedication; member of the Magaambya of conversant rank
feats.access: A character who is Magaambyan of at least attendant rank has access to this option.

feats.name: Halcyon Spellcasting Adept
feats.notes: You refine your halcyon magic.
feats.prerequisite: Halcyon Spellcasting Initiate; master in either Arcana or Nature, expert in the other

feats.name: Halcyon Spellcasting Initiate
feats.notes: Your knowledge of halcyon magic increases.

feats.name: Halcyon Spellcasting Sage
feats.notes: Your command over halcyon magic is nearly unmatched.
feats.prerequisite: Halcyon Spellcasting Adept; legendary in either Arcana or Nature, master in the other

feats.name: Half-Truths
feats.notes: You are able to weave your words in such a way that you never use actual lies, but still mislead people to certain conclusions.
feats.prerequisite: Expert in Deception; Expert in Diplomacy

feats.name: Halfling Ingenuity
feats.notes: While your willingness to dig into a task you know little about might get you into trouble, your incredible luck often saves you from danger.

feats.name: Halfling Lore
feats.notes: You've dutifully learned how to keep your balance and how to stick to the shadows where it's safe, important skills passed down through generations of halfling tradition.

feats.name: Halfling Luck
feats.notes: Your happy-go-lucky nature makes it seem like misfortune avoids you, and to an extent, that might even be true.
feats.trigger: You fail a skill check or saving throw

feats.name: Halfling Weapon Familiarity
feats.notes: You favor traditional halfling weapons, so you've learned how to use them more effectively.

feats.name: Hallowed Earth
feats.notes: The earth is both where the dead rise from and where they are put to rest.

feats.name: Hallowed Initiate
feats.notes: You've expanded your focus spellcasting to techniques used by clerics and wizards.

feats.name: Hallowed Necromancer Dedication
feats.notes: You've studied techniques allowing you to blend so-called hallowed necromancy into your own spellcasting to bolster the living and destroy the undead .
feats.prerequisite: Expert in Religion; good alignment, able to cast spells using spell slots, able to cast at least one necromancy spell

feats.name: Hallucinogenic Ink
feats.notes: Your defensive ink spray has developed the capacity to cause haunting hallucinations.

feats.name: Halo
feats.notes: You have a halo of light and goodness that sheds light with the effects of a divine light cantrip.

feats.name: Halyard Strike
feats.notes: You’ve learned to fight confidently while swinging from a line.
feats.access: You're from the Shackles

feats.name: Hammer Quake
feats.notes: You smash the ground with your weapon, knocking nearby creatures to the ground.

feats.name: Hampering Stance
feats.notes: You make it difficult for enemies to move past you.

feats.name: Hamstringing Strike
feats.notes: You slow your foes with a well-aimed attack.

feats.name: Hand of the Lich
feats.notes: Negative energy intensifies your undead form and makes your very touch the antithesis of life.

feats.name: Hands that Unweave Disaster
feats.notes: Your hands move with uncanny sureness, dismantling danger.

feats.name: Handy with Your Paws
feats.notes: You can easily craft objects.

feats.name: Haphazard Repair
feats.notes: You quickly fix your innovation, at the cost of its stability.

feats.name: Harbinger's Armament
feats.notes: Your deity grants you extra power that you have learned to channel into your weapons.

feats.name: Harbinger's Claw
feats.notes: You caw ominously, cursing the creature with misfortune.
feats.trigger: A creature within 60 feet is about to attempt an attack roll or skill check.

feats.name: Harbinger's Protection
feats.notes: You often work on missions alone, making sure to cover up your weaknesses more effectively than other members of your faith.

feats.name: Hard Tail
feats.notes: Your tail is much stronger than most, and you can lash out with it with the strength of a whip.

feats.name: Hard to Fool
feats.notes: You're accustomed to seeing through shifting darkness and bewildering magic.

feats.name: Harden Flesh
feats.notes: You fortify your skin with minerals drawn from earth and stone.

feats.name: Hardened Chassis
feats.notes: Your exterior is so tough that only the strongest of weapons can fully damage it.

feats.name: Hardwood Armor
feats.notes: Wood and bark grow over your body like armor.

feats.name: Hardy Traveler
feats.notes: There’s no journey too far or burden too heavy when you have friends at your side or hope within your heart.

feats.name: Harming Hands
feats.notes: The mordant power of your void energy grows.

feats.name: Harmless Doll
feats.notes: You look like nothing more than an ordinary toy, doll, or statuette, and you can fool others with your innocuous appearance.

feats.name: Harmlessly Cute
feats.notes: Your size and demeanor make it easy for you to convince others that you mean no harm.

feats.name: Harmonize
feats.notes: You can perform multiple compositions simultaneously,

feats.name: Harmonize Self
feats.notes: You can restore your health by tapping into your qi.

feats.name: Harness Natural Magic
feats.notes: Although it’s often faint, you can sense the presence of magic all around you.
feats.trigger: Your turn begins.

feats.name: Harrow Casting
feats.notes: You draw a card from your harrow deck just before you cast a spell to infuse your magic with its destined potential.
feats.access: This feat is available to all players in a Stolen Fate campaign

feats.name: Harrow Ritualist
feats.notes: You immediately learn two of the following rituals: astral projection , call spirit , commune , commune with nature , legend lore , or planar binding .
feats.access: This feat is available to all players in a Stolen Fate campaign

feats.name: Harrower Dedication
feats.notes: You become trained in Occultism; if you are already trained in this skill, you become trained in a different skill of your choice instead.
feats.access: This feat is available to all players in a Stolen Fate campaign

feats.name: Harrying Strike
feats.notes: Your attack prevents a foe from pursuing your allies.

feats.name: Harsh Judgment
feats.notes: You loudly declare the creature's life forfeit by your judgment
feats.prerequisite: Vigilante Dedication; member of the Gray Gardeners

feats.name: Hasted Assault
feats.notes: You can speed yourself up to move and attack more swiftly.

feats.name: Hasty Celebration
feats.notes: After even the briefest success, you get caught up in the moment and begin to party, cheering your allies on.
feats.trigger: You critically succeed at an attack roll against an enemy, or an enemy critically fails their saving throw against one of your effects.

feats.name: Haughty Obstinacy
feats.notes: Your powerful ego makes it harder for others to order you around.

feats.name: Haunt Ingenuity
feats.notes: Your cunning knowledge grants you the ability to notice the emotional echo of a soul that passed on, leaving a haunt in its wake.

feats.name: Haunting Memories
feats.notes: Your soul bears metaphysical impressions of the innumerable other spirits imprisoned with you in the final blade from which you escaped, allowing you to draw upon their memories.

feats.name: Hazard Finder
feats.notes: You have an intuitive ability to sense hazards.

feats.name: Head of the Night Parade
feats.notes: You remember the revelry of the Night Parade and call them to your aid in a riotous display.

feats.name: Head Stomp
feats.notes: Make an unarmed melee Strike against a prone target.

feats.name: Headless Haunt
feats.notes: You were condemned to death and executed with one of Galt’s infamous final blades , where your soul was trapped for years or even decades.
feats.access: You were executed with a final blade

feats.name: Headshot
feats.notes: You attempt to finish your target with a final, well-placed shot.

feats.name: Heal Animal
feats.notes: You can heal your animal companion's wounds.

feats.name: Heal Mount
feats.notes: Your devotion to your mount manifests as a surge of vital energy.

feats.name: Healer's Halo
feats.notes: Your halo can enhance positive energy.
feats.trigger: You or allies within 30 feet recover Hit Points while your halo is active.

feats.name: Healing Bomb
feats.notes: You can add a foamy catalyst to an elixir of life to turn it into a topical projectile.

feats.name: Healing Flesh
feats.notes: Some legends claim that the flesh of a merfolk, if consumed, can grant health, longevity, and even immortality.

feats.name: Healing Hands
feats.notes: Your vitality is even more vibrant and restorative.

feats.name: Healing Nexus
feats.notes: You metabolize some of the magic you absorb into your internal nexus to stitch together any wounds on the rest of your body.

feats.name: Healing Sanctuary
feats.notes: When you call upon your deity’s power, you also radiate a sense of safety that fortifies your allies.

feats.name: Healing Transformation
feats.notes: You can take advantage of shapechanging magic to close wounds and patch injuries.

feats.name: Heart of Earth
feats.notes: The earth parts to allow you passage.

feats.name: Heart of the Kaiju
feats.notes: Witnessing the might of a kaiju up close awoke a new ferocity within you.

feats.name: Heartless Debilitations
feats.notes: You debilitate your enemies with ruthless and terrifying efficiency.
feats.access: member of the Red Mantis assassins

feats.name: Heatwave
feats.notes: You harness the oncoming flames and twist them into a screen of heat and smoke, granting you concealment until the beginning of your next turn.
feats.trigger: An effect would deal fire damage to you, even if you resist all the damage.

feats.name: Heaven's Step Offense
feats.notes: Your lessons from the stage find life in the storied mercy and fearlessness of Grand Prince Gennaris III.
feats.trigger: Your melee Strike reduces a creature to 0 Hit Points

feats.name: Heaven's Thunder
feats.notes: With a loud shout, you unleash your ki in a crackling shroud of thunder and lightning that engulfs your body.

feats.name: Heaven's Thunder
feats.notes: With a loud shout, you unleash your ki in a crackling shroud of thunder and lightning that engulfs your body.

feats.name: Heaven-Earth Encompassing Sleeves
feats.notes: Your magic extends to your garments.

feats.name: Hedge Mage Dedication
feats.notes: The Universe is your laboratory and altar, and the world your workshop and study.

feats.name: Hedge Maze
feats.notes: You sculpt a manicured maze of hedges.

feats.name: Hedge Prison
feats.notes: You cultivate plants to entrap your foes.

feats.name: Hefting Shadow
feats.notes: Your shadow can contain objects.

feats.name: Hefty Hauler
feats.notes: Increase your Bulk limits by 2

feats.name: Heightened Captivation
feats.notes: You can infuse your charms and illusions with more power.

feats.name: Heightened Instincts
feats.notes: You've worked to sharpen your companions' instincts to supernatural levels.

feats.name: Heir of the Saoc
feats.notes: In the past, you would have been a proud initiate of the Saoc Brethren.

feats.name: Hell of 1,000,000 Needles
feats.notes: The landscape fills with monumental filaments of metal.

feats.name: Hell's Armaments
feats.notes: You've trained relentlessly with your order's weapon to maximize their deadliness.
feats.prerequisite: Hellknight Preferment; expert in at least one of your order's favored weapons

feats.name: Hell's Bane
feats.notes: Your in-depth knowledge of your foes grants you insight into their weaknesses, granting you an advantage when fighting against them.

feats.name: Hell-Lancer Shot
feats.notes: Make a ranged Strike with a firearm against a fiend , ignoring the fiend's concealed condition and any lesser cover .
feats.prerequisite: Golden Legionnaire Dedication; trained in martial firearms

feats.name: Hellbreaker Dedication
feats.notes: By joining the League, you’ve taken on the responsibilities of a Hellbreaker.
feats.access: You’re a member of the Hellbreakers league.

feats.name: Hellbreaker's Resolve
feats.notes: You gird yourself in both mind and body for danger, steeling your resolve.

feats.name: Hellknight Dedication
feats.notes: You've started walking the path toward becoming a true Hellknight, though you're currently considered only an armiger.
feats.access: You're from Old Cheliax.

feats.name: Hellknight Mobility
feats.notes: You've learned how best to move in your heavy armor.
feats.prerequisite: Hellknight Dedication; expert in Hellknight half plate or Hellknight plate

feats.name: Hellknight Preferment
feats.notes: You've forged your body to be able to stand toe-to-toe with a devil, and your mind has been shaped by the strictures of the Measure and the Chain.
feats.prerequisite: Hellknight Dedication; passed the Hellknight Test; trained in Hellknight plate

feats.name: Hellknight Signifer Preferment
feats.notes: You've bolstered your force of will with the power of the Measure and the Chain.
feats.prerequisite: Hellknight Dedication; passed the Hellknight Test; trained in Hellknight breastplate; you have a spellcasting class feature.

feats.name: Hellknight-Errant
feats.notes: Either through unfortunate circumstances or your own choice, you remain a Hellknight armiger instead of entering the true ranks of your order, though you still believe in the tenets of law and order.
feats.prerequisite: Hellknight Dedication; you've refused to take or have failed the Hellknight Test.

feats.name: Hellspawn
feats.notes: Your lineage descends from devils, conniving schemers of Hell .

feats.name: Helpful Halfling
feats.notes: When you aid a friend with a task, you find many ways to help and avoid interfering.

feats.name: Helpful Poppet
feats.notes: You're particularly skilled at helping others with a task.

feats.name: Helpful Tinkering
feats.notes: You don't just tinker with your own innovation, you fiddle with your allies' weapons as well (for their benefit, of course).

feats.name: Helt's Spelldance
feats.notes: Ranik Helt knows a special technique to hide his spells as part of a performance, and you've learned this technique.
feats.access: Members of the Firebrands at the rank of second mark or higher have access to this feat.

feats.name: Hematocritical
feats.notes: You bathe in the arterial fluids of your enemy, drinking deep of their freed essence to empower your magic and increase your spellcasting efficacy.

feats.name: Henge Gate
feats.notes: You hold a rune in your heart and strike the earth, causing two standing stones to rise nearby, your chosen rune carved upon their surfaces and blazing in the air above them.

feats.name: Herald's Strike
feats.notes: The power of your blows can send your victim hurling through your deity’s realm for a fragment of a second.

feats.name: Herald's Weapon
feats.notes: Your weapon becomes a wrathful instrument of your deity’s power.

feats.name: Heraldic Proclamation
feats.notes: You proclaim your spell with the might of your god behind you.

feats.name: Herbal Forager
feats.notes: Your skill with herbs has improved.

feats.name: Herbalist Dedication
feats.notes: You can create natural remedies.

feats.name: Hero's Wings
feats.notes: You have begun the final steps to reaching your full potential.

feats.name: Hero-God's Bond
feats.notes: At times, the myth of a hero-god includes a favored partner or a bonded ally, such as the hero-gods of promises and shield-bearers, Upion and Warrick.

feats.name: Heroes' Call
feats.notes: The songs of ancient heroes echo through your mind and quicken your pulse, especially in dire straits.

feats.name: Heroic Defiance
feats.notes: Even as shadows of your doom haunt the corners of your vision, your implacable spirit surges and cries out that your time has not yet come.
feats.trigger: You gain the doomed condition.

feats.name: Heroic Presence
feats.notes: The blood of heroes courses through your veins, and you inspire your allies to dig deep and find a new level of resolve.

feats.name: Heroic Recovery
feats.notes: The restorative power of your healing invigorates the recipient.

feats.name: Heroic Scion Dedication
feats.notes: Destiny calls, and the soul of a dead hero reincarnates to take up the fight! Either an old enemy resumes their efforts to affect chaos and violence, or a new threat arises and you feel compelled to stand against it.
feats.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star

feats.name: Heroic Weakness
feats.notes: As word of your faith spreads, so too does word of your foibles and weaknesses.

feats.name: Hex Focus
feats.notes: Your patron’s teachings have allowed you to achieve a deeper focus.

feats.name: Hex Master
feats.notes: You embody the link to your patron so completely that you can cast your hexes in rapid succession.

feats.name: Hidden Hoard
feats.notes: Your draconic gift is the key to a repository of treasure that only you can access.

feats.name: Hidden Intentions
feats.notes: You layer meanings in your words, and only those you've taken into your confidence can divine your true plans.
feats.prerequisite: Twilight Talon Dedication; Master in Deception

feats.name: Hidden Magic
feats.notes: You've learned to hide the magical auras of your gear.
feats.prerequisite: Vigilante Dedication; Expert in Arcana, Expert in Nature, Expert in Occultism, or Expert in Religion

feats.name: Hidden Paragon
feats.notes: When you slip out of sight, you disappear.
feats.trigger: You successfully use Stealth to Hide and become hidden from all of your current foes, or use Stealth to Sneak and become undetected to all your current foes

feats.name: Hidden Thorn
feats.notes: Some flowers can hide their thorns, and yours happen to be hidden along your arms.

feats.name: Hideous Ululation
feats.notes: Your throat has multiple separate chambers that can give your voice an eerie echo.

feats.name: Hierophant's Power
feats.notes: You have entwined yourself with the natural world, and its full power flows through you.

feats.name: High Alert
feats.notes: You're constantly on guard, keeping watch over your allies against fiendish forces—no one can get the jump on your group while you're around.

feats.name: High-Speed Regeneration
feats.notes: Your wounds knit together with barely a thought.
feats.trigger: Your turn begins

feats.name: Hijack Undead
feats.notes: Your clockwork devices can commandeer the bodies of undead , bending them to your will.

feats.name: Hilt Hammer
feats.notes: You know how to turn any weapon into a bone-crushing implement of skeletal destruction.

feats.name: Hindquarter Kick
feats.notes: You hold your prey's defensive limbs in place with your claws while delivering a swift kick to their unprotected sides.

feats.name: Hireling Manager
feats.notes: Hirelings gain +2 to skill checks.

feats.name: History of Violence
feats.notes: Your attacks bring with them echoes of previous battles, calling the unquiet victims of your most brutal acts to savage your opponents.

feats.name: Histrionic Injury
feats.notes: You respond with a startled look, dramatic pratfall, or theatrical arm-flailing that stymies your attacker.
feats.trigger: A creature you can see damages you with a melee Strike.

feats.name: Hit and Run
feats.notes: Leaping from a hiding place, you quickly attack your foe before retreating.

feats.name: Hit the Dirt!
feats.notes: You fling yourself out of harm's way.
feats.trigger: A creature you can see attempts a ranged Strike against you.

feats.name: Hoarder's Craw
feats.notes: Your draconic features include a pouch inside your body that you use to store food prior to digestion.

feats.name: Hobbling Criticals
feats.notes: Your eidolon’s unarmed attacks batter your foes into submission, hampering their movement.

feats.name: Hobgoblin Lore
feats.notes: You've studied traditional hobgoblin exercises and fieldcraft, all of which have a militaristic bent.

feats.name: Hobgoblin Weapon Familiarity
feats.notes: You gain access to all uncommon weapons with the hobgoblin trait.

feats.name: Hobnobber
feats.notes: Gather Information rapidly

feats.name: Hold Mark
feats.notes: You bear scars or tattoos enhanced by the mark of your community’s prowess.

feats.name: Holistic Care
feats.notes: You provide emotional and spiritual care.

feats.name: Holy Bloom
feats.notes: Though you might not be a priest of Milani, her divine spirit flows through you.

feats.name: Holy Flower
feats.notes: Milani's grace empowers you further.

feats.name: Holy Light
feats.notes: You raise your arms to the sky and pray fervently, surrounding yourself in a beacon of holy light.
feats.access: Knights of Lastwall have access to this feat.

feats.name: Home in the Deep
feats.notes: You cut through the water, and dwell beneath the surface with ease.

feats.name: Homeward Bound
feats.notes: The connection between you and the First World resonates within your body stronger than it does for most gnomes, allowing you to cross the threshold between the Universe and the First World.

feats.name: Homing Beacon
feats.notes: As your spell strikes a target, you plant a beacon in the target's mind that announces its presence to those nearby.

feats.name: Homing Shot
feats.notes: Your shots zip around corners and fly at impossible angles to reach your target.

feats.name: Hone Claws
feats.notes: You grind or gnaw a particularly wicked edge onto your claws.

feats.name: Hook 'Em
feats.notes: The Salt Breakers learned to use whatever they could during the Vidric Revolution, and they quickly mastered the art of making a rope into a useful tool in combat.
feats.access: Members of the Firebrands at the rank of second mark or higher have access to this feat.

feats.name: Hop Up
feats.notes: Your frog-like agility awakens as soon as you do.
feats.trigger: You lose the unconscious condition.

feats.name: Hopping Stride
feats.notes: You've internalized the hopping gait of your vampiric forebear.

feats.name: Horizon Walker Dedication
feats.notes: You've mastered travel within a specific type of terrain.

feats.name: Horn and Bone Incantation
feats.notes: You invoke mantras of tellurian rebirth.

feats.name: Horselord's Bond
feats.notes: Your bond with your horse becomes supernaturally strong as the two of you continue your crusade against Zon-Kuthon's dominion.

feats.name: Hot Foot
feats.notes: Using a carefully aimed shot, you make a creature “dance.”

feats.name: House of Imaginary Walls
feats.notes: You erect an imaginary barrier others believe to be real.

feats.name: Howling Aspect
feats.notes: Pulling your hair loose into flames and gnashing your teeth into ragged fangs, you howl a vow of ire, and your form surges to meet the demands of your deadly promise.

feats.name: Hulking Size
feats.notes: Your eidolon grows substantially.

feats.name: Humble Spell
feats.notes: For basic spells, basic movements; you can do without flamboyant gestures or showy signs of power.

feats.name: Hungry Blade
feats.notes: Once your spectral dagger has tasted an enemy’s soul, your splinter of finality becomes increasingly relentless in its attempts to claim the soul.

feats.name: Hungry Eyes
feats.notes: Your eyes can see through darkness with an oni’s visual acuity.

feats.name: Hungry Goblin
feats.notes: You’ll eat anything and anyone.

feats.name: Hunted Shot
feats.notes: You take two quick shots against the one you hunt.

feats.name: Hunter's Aim
feats.notes: When you focus on aiming, your attack becomes particularly accurate.

feats.name: Hunter's Defense
feats.notes: Your canny understanding of natural and primal creatures helps you predict and dodge their attacks.
feats.trigger: A creature with the animal , beast , elemental , fey , fungus , or plant trait attacks you, and you can see the attacker.

feats.name: Hunter's Fangs
feats.notes: Your fangs are exceptionally painful.

feats.name: Hunter's Sanctum
feats.notes: You establish a safe house where you can prepare for your hunt.

feats.name: Hunting Snag
feats.notes: Learning from nature's predators has taught you how to keep your prey close.
feats.trigger: A creature within your reach uses a move action or leaves a square during a move action it’s using.

feats.name: Hurl at the Horizon
feats.notes: Your weapon flies from your hand as if propelled under its own power.

feats.name: Hurling Charge
feats.notes: You make a ranged Strike with your thrown weapon, Stride , and then Interact to draw another weapon.

feats.name: Hurricane Swing
feats.notes: Choose either lightning bolt or gust of wind .
feats.trigger: You critically hit a foe with a Strike with a slashing weapon.

feats.name: Hush
feats.notes: You strike a target and hinder their attempts to call for help.

feats.name: Hybrid Form
feats.notes: When you Change Shape, you retain elements of your kitsune form, allowing you to speak in a fox form, use kitsune unarmed attacks in a tailless form, or gain a tail in your tailless form to use abilities that require one.

feats.name: Hybrid Shape
feats.notes: Mastery of your shapeshifting lets you combine the best features of your humanoid and spider forms.

feats.name: Hybrid Study Spell
feats.notes: You gain the conflux spell from a hybrid study of your choice.

feats.name: Hydra's Bond
feats.notes: When the hero-gods built Pol-Sylirica and its seven armies, they feared betrayal from within.

feats.name: Hydraulic Deflection
feats.notes: Drawing moisture from the atmosphere, you create a disc of hovering water that deflects attacks.

feats.name: Hydraulic Maneuvers
feats.notes: You batter your foes with a torrent of water siphoned from your surroundings.

feats.name: Hyena Familiar
feats.notes: Hyenas serve kholo as pets and trackers.

feats.name: Hymn of Healing
feats.notes: You learn the hymn of healing composition spell, which imbues your music with rich melodies that help your allies recover from harm.

feats.name: Hypnotic Gaze
feats.notes: You can widen your field of vision, allowing you to affect more creatures with your Hypnotic Lure .

feats.name: Hypnotic Lure
feats.notes: Your unblinking gaze is so intense it can befuddle the mind of others, drawing your victims toward you even against their better judgment.

feats.name: I Am the Weapon
feats.notes: Your supernatural bond with your weapon infuses it with a powerful echo of your sentience, your memory, and even fragments of your very soul.
feats.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star

feats.name: I Knew the Heroes
feats.notes: Your stories aren’t mere tales passed down from elder to youth or teacher to student.
feats.prerequisite: Uzunjati Recollection; legendary in a Recall Knowledge Skill

feats.name: I Meant to Do That
feats.notes: Somehow your stray bullet causes an unintended reaction that creates a problem for your enemy: perhaps a ricochet knocks your foe's weapon away or they stumble over stray debris in an attempt to dodge your bullets.
feats.prerequisite: Unexpected Sharpshooter Dedication; Trained in Deception

feats.name: I Sense Malevolence
feats.notes: Your time in the River of Souls has given you deep insight into the machinations of those who refuse to move on.

feats.name: I Will Return
feats.notes: Your special connection to death and rebirth allows you to sense when it’s your time to enter the Great Beyond, and now isn’t the time.

feats.name: I've Been Here Before
feats.notes: You adapt quickly to new settings and terrains.
feats.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star

feats.name: I've Had Many Jobs
feats.notes: Finding and excelling at odd jobs is child’s play to one who has worked many occupations during many lives.

feats.name: Ice Crafter
feats.notes: The ancient ice-crafting techniques of the saumen kar awaken within you.

feats.name: Icy Apotheosis
feats.notes: You are as much a creature of cold as whatever ancestry you were born to.

feats.name: Idol Threat
feats.notes: You brandish the precious object you're holding menacingly, at once mocking it and threatening its safety.

feats.name: Idyllkin
feats.notes: Your wild, unique features betray your agathion birthright.

feats.name: Igneogenesis
feats.notes: You can create a permanent stone object, either sculpting stone pulled directly from your kinetic gate or manipulating earth and stone around you.

feats.name: Ignite the Sun
feats.notes: The fires of creation become yours to control.

feats.name: Iivlar's Boundary Break
feats.notes: You can bend the boundary between planes with the natural skill of an iivlar.

feats.name: Iivlar's Deflection
feats.notes: You’re able to use the silk woven into your skin to deflect attacks, reducing the deadliness of grievous blows.
feats.trigger: You are struck by a critical hit that deals physical damage.

feats.name: Ill Tide
feats.notes: Some land dwellers say that merfolk are bad luck.
feats.trigger: A creature within 30 feet of you critically fails an attack roll, skill check, or saving throw

feats.name: Illimitable Finisher
feats.notes: Your strikes flow endlessly.

feats.name: Illuminating Stories
feats.notes: Stories serve as beacons in the night, illuminating valuable knowledge even if the tale itself misses the mark.

feats.name: Illusion Sense
feats.notes: Your ancestors spent their days cloaked and cradled in illusions, and as a result, sensing illusion magic is second nature to you.

feats.name: Illusory Identity
feats.notes: There are times when skills or looks are not enough to convince someone of your identity, and you instead require adequate documentation.
feats.access: Members of the Firebrands at the rank of second mark or higher have access to this feat.

feats.name: Ilverani Purist
feats.notes: All twilight speakers are trained to resist the alluring customs of younger peoples, but you have made it your mandate to keep the Ilverani way unchanged.

feats.name: Imbue Mindlessness
feats.notes: You grasp the mind of an undead creature and temporarily wipe it as empty as a zombie's brain.

feats.name: Imbue Spell
feats.notes: You pass the energy of your magic onto an ally, allowing another to release the spell.
feats.trigger: Your previous action was to Cast a Spell .

feats.name: Immediate Rebuke
feats.notes: You can use Reactive Strike when a creature within your reach Strikes one of your allies.

feats.name: Immobile Form
feats.notes: You take on the shape you had before you awoke to hide in plain sight.
feats.prerequisite: Born of Item heritage, Born of Elements heritage, or Born of Vegetation heritage

feats.name: Immortal Bear
feats.notes: Your body thrums with the primal vitality of the greatest of the ursine beasts.

feats.name: Immortal Lightness
feats.notes: You breathe, allowing your golden core to release qi into the meridians governing your lower body, and break into a burst of speed that could shame arrows in flight.

feats.name: Immortal Ruin
feats.notes: Your commitment to ending all life earns you a measure of immortality, setting the stage for you to become a true Rider of the Apocalypse, possibly supplanting one of the Four.

feats.name: Immortal Techniques
feats.notes: You flow from technique to technique, renewing yourself as you embrace each style you have mastered.

feats.name: Immovable Object
feats.notes: You plant your feet in a wide stance, resisting all movement not of your own volition.
feats.prerequisite: Eternal Legend Dedication; master in Fortitude or Reflex Saves

feats.name: Impaling Bone
feats.notes: Once per day, you can cast impaling spike as a 7th-rank innate occult spell, except the spike is made of bone instead of cold iron.

feats.name: Impaling Briars
feats.notes: You can fill an area with devastating briars.

feats.name: Impaling Finisher
feats.notes: You stab two foes with a single thrust or bash them together with one punch.

feats.name: Impaling Thrust
feats.notes: You impale your enemy and hold it in place with your weapon, and leave it bleeding when it gets free.

feats.name: Impassable Wall Stance
feats.notes: You refuse to let foes past your guard.
feats.access: A character who is a member of the Knights of Lastwall has access to this option.

feats.name: Impeccable Crafting
feats.notes: Craft items more efficiently

feats.name: Impenetrable Fog
feats.notes: Fog condenses in a chaotic, swirling pattern, thick enough that it seems to push back against you.

feats.name: Imperial Dragon Potion
feats.notes: During your daily preparations , you can spend 10 minutes to create a variant energy breath potion, which has the kobold trait in addition to its normal traits.
feats.prerequisite: Expert in Crafting; Heavenscribe Kobold heritage

feats.name: Imperious Aura
feats.notes: Your glowing and majestic kinetic aura marks you as a true child of the elements.
feats.prerequisite: one or more stance impulses that affect your kinetic aura
feats.trigger: Your turn begins.

feats.name: Impervious Vehicle
feats.notes: From armor plating and flexible components, to reinforced materials and backup redundant functionality, you have built safeguards to protect your vehicle from the rigors of combat.

feats.name: Implausible Infiltration
feats.notes: You find tiny imperfections and somehow fit yourself through them, possibly moving directly through the wall or floor.

feats.name: Implausible Purchase
feats.notes: It seems impossible, but you've analyzed every angle and are able to just keep pulling out exactly the item you need, even in far-flung locations.

feats.name: Implausible Purchase (Rogue)
feats.notes: You can use Prescient Planner even if you have already used it after purchasing goods, and you can Interact to draw the item as a single action instead of a 2-action activity.

feats.name: Implement Initiate
feats.notes: Mastery of an implement is the sign of a studied thaumaturge.

feats.name: Implement's Assault
feats.notes: Your implement supercharges your weapon to shoot an impossible volley or carve through your foes.

feats.name: Implement's Flight
feats.notes: By weakening your relation to the ground and strengthening your relation to the sky, you've learned to soar through the air, your implement carrying you as surely as any broomstick or pestle.

feats.name: Impose Order
feats.notes: You shift the underlying fabric of reality to impose a baseline of order.
feats.trigger: You would critically fail a skill check or suffer an effect with the misfortune trait.

feats.name: Impose Order (Psychic)
feats.notes: You bring discipline to your mind and magic, ensuring that you don't under-perform.

feats.name: Imposing Destrier
feats.notes: Under your care, your mount has realized its innate potential.

feats.name: Impossible Flurry
feats.notes: You forgo precision to attack at an impossible speed.

feats.name: Impossible Gossip
feats.notes: You can speak to inanimate objects, finding a magical spark within them similar to the one that animated you.

feats.name: Impossible Polymath
feats.notes: Your esoteric formulas are so unusual that they allow you to dabble in magic from diverse traditions that other bards don’t understand.
feats.prerequisite: Trained in Arcana, Trained in Nature, or Trained in Religion; Esoteric Polymath

feats.name: Impossible Riposte
feats.notes: Your ripostes can deflect attacks back at their source.

feats.name: Impossible Snares
feats.notes: You can create endless shorter-lived snares, protecting your lair or using them against foes.

feats.name: Impossible Striker
feats.notes: Nothing can prevent you from making a sneak attack, even if your opponent can see every blow coming.

feats.name: Impossible Technique
feats.notes: You execute a maneuver that defies possibility.
feats.trigger: An enemy’s attack hits you or you fail a saving throw against an enemy’s ability.

feats.name: Impossible Volley
feats.notes: You fire a volley at all foes in an area.

feats.name: Impressive Landing
feats.notes: You slam into the ground, shattering it around you.
feats.trigger: You fall at least 10 feet and land on a solid surface.

feats.name: Impressive Mount
feats.notes: You’ve trained your mount to become a powerful force on the battlefield.

feats.name: Impressive Performance
feats.notes: Make an Impression with Performance

feats.name: Imprison Foe
feats.notes: Rather than grant your foes the mercy of a swift death, you can consign them to suffer in an extradimensional prison with an appearance of your choosing.

feats.name: Improbable Elixirs
feats.notes: Your mastery of alchemical secrets enables you to replicate effects most believe can be achieved only via magic.

feats.name: Improved Command Corpse
feats.notes: When you use Command Undead on a mindless undead , if the undead succeeds at its save but doesn't critically succeed, it becomes your minion for 1 round.

feats.name: Improved Command Undead
feats.notes: Undead creatures find it all but impossible to resist your commands.
feats.prerequisite: harmful font; Command Undead; evil alignment

feats.name: Improved Dueling Riposte
feats.notes: Your weapon whirls and darts, striking foes whenever the slightest opening or moment of weakness presents itself.

feats.name: Improved Elemental Blast
feats.notes: The power of your elemental blast improves.

feats.name: Improved Elemental Bulwark
feats.notes: You gain resistance 10 from Elemental Bulwark instead of 5.

feats.name: Improved Familiar
feats.notes: You find it easy to attract a powerful and unusual familiar to your side.

feats.name: Improved Familiar (Witch)
feats.notes: You find it easy to attract a powerful and unusual familiar to your side.

feats.name: Improved Hijack Undead
feats.notes: Undead creatures find it all but impossible to resist your commands.

feats.name: Improved Invigorating Elixir
feats.notes: Choose physical invigoration or mental invigoration, and add the listed conditions to those you can choose for an invigorating elixir.

feats.name: Improved Knockback
feats.notes: When you successfully Shove a creature, increase both the distance you can push the creature and the distance you can move to follow along with the target by 5 feet on a success or 10 feet on a critical success.

feats.name: Improved Poison Weapon
feats.notes: You deliver poisons in ways that maximize their harmful effects.

feats.name: Improved Reflexive Shield
feats.notes: Your shield can help save nearby allies.

feats.name: Improved Signature Weapon
feats.notes: Your signature weapon takes on the properties of mystical materials renowned for defeating undead, spirits, and other such creatures.

feats.name: Improved Swift Banishment
feats.notes: You easily banish creatures with your weapon.

feats.name: Improved Twin Riposte (Fighter)
feats.notes: Your weapons are a blur, blocking and biting at your foes.

feats.name: Improved Twin Riposte (Ranger)
feats.notes: At the start of each of your turns, you gain an additional reaction that you can use only to perform a Twin Riposte.

feats.name: Improvisational Defender
feats.notes: You are always prepared for fights that frequently disrupt seemingly peaceful times.

feats.name: Improvisational Warrior
feats.notes: You have increased skill with improvised weapons.

feats.name: Improvise Admixture
feats.notes: You scrounge together enough ingredients from what's left in your alchemist's toolkit to produce a few more versatile vials on the fly.

feats.name: Improvise Strategy
feats.notes: You’re a wild card on the battlefield, inventing unpredictable tactics and surprising foes.

feats.name: Improvise Tool
feats.notes: You can jury-rig solutions when you don't have the proper tools on hand.

feats.name: Improvised Crafting
feats.notes: You've learned to repair your equipment even in challenging circumstances, making use of what you have available.

feats.name: Improvised Critical
feats.notes: You can apply critical specialization effects to improvised weapons you wield.

feats.name: Improvised Pummel
feats.notes: When you make a Strike with an improvised weapon you're wielding, you gain a +1 item bonus to the attack roll, and you can have the Strike deal two weapon damage dice instead of the improvised weapon's normal number.

feats.name: Improvised Repair
feats.notes: You can hastily patch damaged equipment together, but the temporary fix lacks the full care required for lasting repairs.

feats.name: In Lightning, Life
feats.notes: “In lightning, there is life.” This lesson is whispered throughout Lepidstadt, and you can put it to practical use.

feats.name: In Plain Sight
feats.notes: People often only see what they want to see, a weakness you know how to take full advantage of.

feats.name: In the Horde's Grip
feats.notes: When your skeletons and zombies attack, their skeletal claws and rotting hands clutch and tear flesh.

feats.name: In Tune
feats.notes: You attune your great skill in performing to another, granting them a small measure of your skill as though anyone could do it.

feats.name: Incorporeal Shot
feats.notes: You can concentrate an immense amount of magic to create a piece of ammunition that phases through everything but your target.

feats.name: Incredible Aim
feats.notes: By spending a moment to focus, you can ensure your attack strikes true.

feats.name: Incredible Beastmaster Companion
feats.notes: Your mature animal companions continue to grow and develop.

feats.name: Incredible Companion (Druid)
feats.notes: Your animal companion continues to grow and develop.

feats.name: Incredible Companion (Ranger)
feats.notes: Your animal companion continues to grow and develop.

feats.name: Incredible Construct Companion
feats.notes: Thanks to your continual tinkering, your construct companion has advanced to an astounding new stage of engineering, enhancing all its attributes.

feats.name: Incredible Dragon Companion
feats.notes: Your mature dragon companion develops further, becoming more robust and formidable.

feats.name: Incredible Familiar
feats.notes: Your familiar is imbued with even more magic than other familiars.

feats.name: Incredible Familiar (Familiar Master)
feats.notes: Your familiar is infused with even more magic than other familiars.

feats.name: Incredible Ferocity
feats.notes: Given time to collect yourself after a near-death scrape, you can rebuild your ferocity and withstand additional finishing blows.

feats.name: Incredible Improvisation
feats.notes: A stroke of brilliance gives you a major advantage with a skill despite your inexperience.
feats.trigger: You attempt a check using a skill you’re untrained in

feats.name: Incredible Initiative
feats.notes: +2 to initiative rolls

feats.name: Incredible Investiture
feats.notes: Invest up to 12 magic items

feats.name: Incredible Luck
feats.notes: You always seem to bounce back from the worst.

feats.name: Incredible Luck (Halfling)
feats.notes: Even other halflings consider you to be particularly lucky.

feats.name: Incredible Megafauna Companion
feats.notes: Under your care and training, your megafauna companion has realized its innate potential.

feats.name: Incredible Mount
feats.notes: Under your care and training, your mount has realized its innate potential.

feats.name: Incredible Reanimated Companion
feats.notes: You imbue the necrotized flesh of your reanimated construct companion with strange chemicals and fine-tune the clockwork within, enhancing all its capabilities.

feats.name: Incredible Recollection
feats.notes: You can sift through knowledge locked within your mind at an incredible pace.

feats.name: Incredible Ricochet
feats.notes: After your first shot singles out your opponent’s position, you direct another that ricochets around obstacles and strikes unerringly.

feats.name: Incredible Scout
feats.notes: When you scout, you are particularly alert for danger, granting your allies precious moments to prepare to fight.

feats.name: Incredible Sprint
feats.notes: You push yourself, unleashing a burst of sudden speed.

feats.name: Incriminating Spell
feats.notes: You can attempt to blame someone else for your attempt to modify a target’s mind.

feats.name: Indomitable Shot
feats.notes: You can fire a single shot that penetrates multiple foes.
feats.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star

feats.name: Indomitable Spirit
feats.notes: Your soul has accumulated countless particles of quintessence over myriad deaths and rebirths, and for one moment, this raw material from the Great Beyond envelops you and your comrades.

feats.name: Induce Imbalance
feats.notes: Your blows can disrupt the delicate balance of elemental energies that keep a body in good health.

feats.name: Inertial Barrier
feats.notes: Your spell leaves behind barriers that reduce shock and motion.

feats.name: Inescapable Grasp
feats.notes: Your grasp has a supernatural quality to it, preventing your foes from easily escaping—with or without magical assistance.

feats.name: Inevitable Thralls
feats.notes: You gain the necromancer's Inevitable Return reaction, allowing you to create thralls from the corpses of your enemies.

feats.name: Inexhaustible Countermoves
feats.notes: At the start of each enemy's turn, you gain an extra reaction

feats.name: Inexorable
feats.notes: You imbue yourself with the resilience of the cave worm .
feats.source: Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm

feats.name: Infectious Emotions
feats.notes: When you use Catharsis, one ally within 30 feet gains the catharsis activation benefits in addition to you.

feats.name: Infernal Interference
feats.notes: Your attacks force a foe to glimpse the iron, soul-wrenching landscapes of Hell .

feats.name: Infiltrate Dream
feats.notes: Entering a dream is as natural to you as stepping through a doorway.

feats.name: Infiltration Assassination
feats.notes: With a high-priority target in reach, you quickly move to eliminate them.

feats.name: Infiltration Automation
feats.notes: You have quiet, well-oiled joints, and you move around as silently as a shadow, though you sometimes use a magical boost.

feats.name: Infiltrator's Blitz
feats.notes: Though your training is meant to ensure you don't get caught by your enemies, your missions are often high risk, and sometimes the only option you have left when things go wrong is to unleash a blistering torrent of violence while running away as fast as possible.

feats.name: Infiltrator's Reload
feats.notes: You specialize in reloading while preparing for the next step in your infiltration.
feats.prerequisite: Crossbow Infiltrator Dedication; Expert in Stealth

feats.name: Infinite Blades Celestial Arrow
feats.notes: Each shot you launch multiplies itself with spiritual blades, rings, and other missiles that shower upon your foes.

feats.name: Infinite Expanse of Bluest Heaven
feats.notes: An illusion of a limitless expanse with an impossibly blue sky makes all within feel the sensation of falling...

feats.name: Infinite Possibilities
feats.notes: You can prepare a spell slot that exists in your mind as many different possibilities at once.

feats.name: Inflame Crowd
feats.notes: Your performances are a call to action for the crowds who listen to you.

feats.name: Influence Nature
feats.notes: With patience and time, you can make bird calls, leave game trails, and ultimately influence the behavior of a certain type of animals in the region to favor and even aid you in the days to come.

feats.name: Infused Void
feats.notes: If the next action you use is to cast a grave spell that deals damage, creatures damaged by the spell take additional void damage equal to the rank of the spell.

feats.name: Infused with Belkzen's Might
feats.notes: Your tattoos immortalize the conquests of orc war leaders, such as Belkzen besieging the dwarven Sky Citadel of Koldukar.

feats.name: Inhale, Exhale!
feats.notes: You take an especially deep breath as a prelude to unleashing your dragonet breath on your foes.

feats.name: Inherit the Dreaming Heirloom
feats.notes: Whether you always carried it or perhaps only recently inherited, you have a pusaka— an heirloom containing a spirit who you communicate with in your dreams.

feats.name: Initial Eidolon Ability
feats.notes: Your link to your eidolon strengthens, granting them a new ability.

feats.name: Initiate Warden
feats.notes: You’ve trained with one of the ranger sects known as wardens, who practice a specialized type of primal magic.

feats.name: Inked Cache

feats.name: Kinetic Dampening

feats.name: Kinetic Pinnacle

feats.name: Kitsune Lore

feats.name: Kitsune Spell Expertise

feats.name: Kitsune Spell Familiarity

feats.name: Kizidhar Magic

feats.name: Klingegeist

feats.name: Kneecap

feats.name: Kneel Before the Rightful Heir

feats.name: Kneel for No God

feats.name: Knight in Shining Armor
feats.notes: As a knight in shining armor, you train daily in the heaviest armor, expanding your expertise to heavy armor.
feats.prerequisite: Knight Vigilant; expert in light armor, medium armor, or unarmored defense; trained in heavy armor

feats.name: Knight Reclaimant Dedication

feats.access: A character who is a member of the Knights of Lastwall has access to this option.

feats.name: Knight Vigilant
feats.notes: You are dedicated to the cause of the Shining Sentinels.

feats.name: Knight's Retaliation

feats.name: Knockback Spell

feats.name: Knockback Strike
feats.notes: You focus your strength into a blow powerful enough to push an enemy away from you.

feats.name: Know it All
feats.notes: Your knowledge of abstruse topics is unparalleled.

feats.name: Know the Beat
feats.notes: You have been trained to investigate crimes.

feats.name: Know thy Doom
feats.notes: As your legend grows, details of your demise become clearer.

feats.name: Know Your Enemy
feats.notes: You aim to turn knowledge into power against your foes.

feats.name: Know Your Own
feats.notes: You've spent countless hours studying the history of elves on your world and beyond and are a studied expert in your people's ways.

feats.name: Know-It-All

feats.name: Knowledge is Power (Magus)

feats.name: Knowledge is Power (Wizard)

feats.name: Knowledge of Shapes

feats.name: Kobold Breath
