feats.name: Kobold Lore
feats.notes: You attentively learned key kobold survival strategies from your elders.

feats.name: Kobold Momentum
feats.notes: You possess the confidence of a dragon, and your success emboldens you to draw on power reserves you didn’t know you had.

feats.name: Kobold Weapon Familiarity

feats.name: Kodama Call
feats.notes: The small spirits known as kodama pride themselves in taking care of trees and other vegetation, and they’ll happily come to your aid as well.
feats.access: Tian Xia origin

feats.name: Koi Secrets

feats.access: Tian Xia origin

feats.name: Kraken's Call
feats.notes: You call forth the sleeping krakens of the deep to crush your enemies.

feats.name: Kreighton's Cognitive Crossover

feats.access: Member of the Pathfinder Society.

feats.name: Lab Rat

feats.name: Labyrinthine Echoes
feats.notes: You can make your voice reverberate off any surface.

feats.name: Land Legs

feats.name: Landscape Form
feats.notes: While walking down the road on a moonlit night, one might be puzzled to find a shop or hill that wasn’t there before.

feats.name: Larcenous Hand

feats.name: Larcenous Tail
feats.notes: You can perform minor mischief with your tail.

feats.name: Larger than Life (Guardian)

feats.name: Larger than Life (Kitsune)

feats.name: Lassoing Lash

feats.name: Lasting Armament

feats.name: Lasting Coercion

feats.name: Lasting Doubt

feats.name: Lastwall Warden

feats.name: Late Awakener

feats.name: Laughing Kholo

feats.name: Lava Leap

feats.name: Lavasoul

feats.name: Lawbringer

feats.name: Lead by Example

feats.name: Lead Climber

feats.name: Lead Investigator
feats.notes: You spend 1 minute briefing up to four allies about one of your open investigations.

feats.name: Lead the Pack
feats.notes: You can have up to two animal companions active at once.
feats.prerequisite: Mature Beastmaster Companion; you have multiple animal companions

feats.name: Lead the Way
feats.notes: You move forward, creating an opening for others to follow.

feats.name: Leader of All
feats.notes: You accept anyone who would follow you on your adventures.

feats.name: Leading Dance
feats.notes: You sweep your foe into your dance.

feats.name: Leaf Transformation
feats.notes: You know how to run an enterprise that others would never be able to get off the ground—some say it’s your savvy acumen or jovial manner, but you know it’s because you can cut costs by transforming leaves into money.

feats.notes: You're quick enough to line up a shot even while diving to the ground.

feats.name: Leap the Falls

feats.name: Learn by Watching
feats.notes: Before your awakening, you watched humanoids performing some skill near you frequently.

feats.name: Leave An Opening

feats.name: Leech-Clip

feats.name: Left-hand Blood

feats.name: Legacy of Monarchs
feats.notes: No matter what might happen to you, your legacy shall never die.

feats.name: Legend of Combat

feats.name: Legendary Codebreaker
feats.notes: Quickly Decipher Writing using Society

feats.name: Legendary Guide

feats.name: Legendary Laugh
feats.notes: Your laugher echoes in the minds of your enemies.

feats.name: Legendary Leader

feats.name: Legendary Linguist
feats.notes: Create pidgin languages to communicate with anyone

feats.name: Legendary Medic
feats.notes: Remove disease, blinded, deafened, doomed, or drained

feats.name: Legendary Monster

feats.name: Legendary Monster Hunter

feats.prerequisite: Legendary in Nature; Master Monster Hunter

feats.name: Legendary Negotiation
feats.notes: Quickly parley with foes

feats.name: Legendary Performer
feats.notes: Gain renown for your Performance

feats.name: Legendary Professional
feats.notes: Gain renown for your Lore

feats.name: Legendary Rider

feats.name: Legendary Shot

feats.name: Legendary Size

feats.name: Legendary Sneak
feats.notes: Hide and Sneak without cover or being concealed

feats.name: Legendary Summoner
feats.notes: Your ability to summon extends past your other spellcasting.

feats.name: Legendary Survivalist
feats.notes: Survive extreme conditions

feats.name: Legendary Tattoo Artist

feats.name: Legendary Thief
feats.notes: Steal what would normally be impossible to steal

feats.name: Legs of Stone

feats.name: Lengthy Diversion

feats.name: Leshy Lore
feats.notes: You deeply understand your people’s cultural traditions and innate strengths.

feats.name: Leshy Superstition

feats.name: Lesson of Unified Elusion
feats.notes: You and your student react as one to common threats.

feats.name: Life-Giving Magic

feats.name: Lifelink Surge

feats.name: Lifesense
feats.notes: You have a limited ability to sense life force, like your psychopomp forebears.

feats.name: Light of Revelation

feats.name: Light Paws

feats.name: Light Step
feats.notes: You aren’t bothered by tricky footing.

feats.name: Light-bending Jewel
feats.notes: Your ability to walk unseen through the world has given you the new moon’s blessing.

feats.name: Lighter than Air
feats.notes: Your mysterious steps become even lighter, transcending the mortal world altogether.

feats.name: Lightless Litheness

feats.name: Lightless Sight

feats.name: Lightning Qi

feats.name: Lightspeed Assault
feats.notes: You zoom from enemy to enemy, striking each in an instant.

feats.name: Like a Fish in Water

feats.name: Like a Roach

feats.name: Lingering Breath

feats.name: Lingering Chill

feats.name: Linguist Dedication
feats.notes: You have studied languages and their development.

feats.name: Linguistic Revival
feats.notes: You achieved fluency in different languages with each reincarnation, and your brain remembers much of the grammar, idioms, and obscenities that you spouted in old lives.

feats.name: Link Focus

feats.name: Link Wellspring
feats.notes: Your bond replenishes your focus.

feats.name: Linked Focus

feats.name: Lion Blade Dedication

feats.access: You’re from Taldor.

feats.name: Lion's Fury

feats.name: Lion's Magic

feats.name: Lion's Might

feats.name: Litany of Self-Interest

feats.name: Live the Creed

feats.notes: You bleed off some electric power from your innovation in the shape of a damaging bolt.

feats.name: Meld Into Eidolon
feats.notes: Your physical form can combine with that of your eidolon.

feats.name: Melodious Spell
feats.notes: You subtly weave your spellcasting into a performance.

feats.name: Memory of Mastery
feats.notes: Flashes of past selves surface in an instant, especially when you’re under duress.

feats.name: Memory of Nothing
feats.notes: With a look and a gesture, you turn a thinking creature’s mind against itself, causing the creature to struggle to remember how to perform more complex actions.

feats.name: Memory of Skill
feats.notes: Your years of training in a previous life didn’t go to waste with your death, and you can call upon this training when you most need it.

feats.name: Menacing Prowess
feats.notes: Scaring off multiple people at once is your specialty.
feats.prerequisite: Golden League Xun Dedication; Expert in Intimidation

feats.name: Mental Balm
feats.notes: Your spells release soothing mental waves.

feats.name: Mental Buffer
feats.notes: Your mind deflects some amount of harm from attacks that induce pain or manipulate your mind directly.

feats.name: Mental Forge
feats.notes: Your experiences in combat shape your mind's capability to strengthen and shape your weapon to match the way you move in combat.

feats.name: Mental Static
feats.notes: Your thoughts sting back when a lesser mind tries to invade your own.
feats.trigger: You roll a critical success on a Will save against a mental effect from a creature.

feats.name: Mental Sustenance
feats.notes: You can sustain yourself with the power of your mind.

feats.name: Mentor of Legends
feats.notes: You're an extraordinary teacher, capable of inspiring your students to amazing feats of athletics and ingenuity.

feats.name: Mercenary Motivation
feats.notes: A large part of being in the Mercenary League entails doing mercenary work.

feats.name: Mercenary Reversal
feats.notes: Even though the fight seems to be surging against you and your compatriots, you know that a key ally can always turn the tide.

feats.name: Merciful Elixir
feats.notes: You mix a special additive into your elixir that calms the drinker’s body and mind.
feats.trigger: You craft an elixir of life using Quick Alchemy, and that elixir is at least 2 levels lower than your advanced alchemy level.

feats.name: Merciless Rend
feats.notes: Your eidolon rends their foes.

feats.name: Mercy
feats.notes: Your touch soothes the body or mind.

feats.name: Merfolk Lore
feats.notes: You paid close attention to your lessons in school.

feats.name: Merfolk Weapon Familiarity
feats.notes: You were taught the most effective weapons of the sea.

feats.name: Merge with the Source
feats.notes: You're among the most powerful of Speakers and can adopt the form of the spirits you entreat with.
feats.prerequisite: Speaker in Training or Budding Speaker Centaur heritage

feats.name: Mesmerizing Gaze
feats.notes: When you meet someone’s gaze, they’re unable to look away from you.

feats.name: Messenger
feats.notes: You were built with a special ability to relay private messages to your fellow automatons, but you can luckily use it with anyone you would like.

feats.name: Metabolic Control
feats.notes: You're able to better control your body's metabolism to preserve energy.

feats.name: Metabolize Element
feats.notes: Your rapidly metabolize the elemental particles in your opponent's spell to gain a boost of energy.
feats.trigger: You take damage from a foe's spell or magical ability with a trait of one of the elements in your elemental philosophy.

feats.name: Metal Carapace
feats.notes: Sheets of bent and rusted metal cover you in an armored shell.

feats.name: Metal-Veined Strikes
feats.notes: Metallic veins grow throughout your body, giving your unarmed attacks a metallic sheen.

feats.name: Metallic Envisionment
feats.notes: You always account for every weakness, allowing your mind to imagine just the right physical form to take advantage of your opponents.

feats.name: Metallic Skin
feats.notes: You fortify your natural resistances with elemental metal, covering your skin with thick metal.

feats.name: Meteoric Spellstrike
feats.notes: A trail of energy flows from your target back to you.

feats.name: Methodical Debilitations
feats.notes: You strategically craft your debilitations to lessen or negate an enemy’s tactical advantages.

feats.name: Methodical Magic
feats.notes: You can reorder the world with your magic.

feats.name: Meticulous Restorer
feats.notes: Waste not, want not; your steady eye allows you to restore craftwork quickly while conserving valuable material.

feats.name: Might of the Realm
feats.notes: Bolstered by the presence of your knights, you strike a mighty blow in the name of your rule.

feats.name: Mighty Bear
feats.notes: The power of the bear within you can expand your physical presence even further.

feats.name: Mighty Bulwark
feats.notes: Thanks to the incredible connection you have forged with your armor, you can use it to shrug off an extensive array of dangers.

feats.name: Mighty Dragon Shape
feats.notes: You've practiced and increased your draconic might, allowing you to take your draconic form more often.

feats.name: Mighty Dragonet
feats.notes: You’ve grown especially large and now tower over your fellow dragonets.

feats.name: Mighty Wings
feats.notes: Your dragon wings are now a permanent part of your body, giving you a fly Speed equal to your Speed.
feats.prerequisite: Dragon Disciple Dedication; _dragon wings_ sorcerer bloodline spell

feats.name: Mimic Protections
feats.notes: By adopting resonant reflections, you have learned to copy the abilities of other creatures as well.

feats.name: Mind over Matter
feats.notes: Your mind’s limits are only what you imagine them to be.

feats.name: Mind Projectiles
feats.notes: You've learned to stretch your mind's influence further, releasing projectiles with a swing of your mind weapon.

feats.name: Mind Shards
feats.notes: With a swing and a thought, you detonate your mind weapon into a burst of psychic shards that shred the mind.

feats.name: Mind Smith Dedication
feats.notes: You've learned to imagine a shape in your mind, to envision it so strongly it takes form in the material world.

feats.name: Mineral Deposits
feats.notes: Precious metals from your bloodstream line your claws, jaws, or the tip of your tail, and you’re able call upon your blood to surge and empower your attacks.

feats.name: Miniaturize
feats.notes: Your eidolon can shrink even further.

feats.name: Minion Guise
feats.notes: When you are in your social identity, you can also grant a social identity to an animal companion, familiar, pet, or other minion you gained from a class feature or feat.
feats.prerequisite: Vigilante Dedication; Expert in Deception; animal companion or familiar

feats.name: Minor Deific Power
feats.notes: Your mental, physical, and spiritual training have granted you access to divine magic that doesn't rely on any other deity or patron.

feats.name: Minor Magic
feats.notes: You’ve dabbled in a variety of tricks, gaining minor magical abilities from a particular tradition.

feats.name: Minor Omen
feats.notes: The stars warn you of danger in the nick of time.
feats.trigger: You fail a Reflex save.

feats.name: Minotaur Lore
feats.notes: You were raised in a minotaur enclave or have spent a great deal of time studying your culture and ancestry.

feats.name: Minotaur Weapon Familiarity
feats.notes: Your elders taught you to wield weapons that can split skulls and smash through shields.

feats.name: Minuscule Mentee
feats.notes: You’ve found a fellow poppet on the cusp of awakening and decided to help.

feats.name: Miracle Worker
feats.notes: Your alchemical mastery can resuscitate the recently slain.

feats.name: Miraculous Flight
feats.notes: With superior engineering and magical application, you have freed your signature vehicle from the bonds of gravity, allowing it to soar through the sky like a dragon.

feats.name: Miraculous Intervention
feats.notes: Through divine intervention or whispered prayers, you foil an enemy's response.
feats.trigger: An adjacent fiend or undead begins to use a reaction.
feats.access: Knights of Lastwall have access to this feat.

feats.name: Miraculous Medic
feats.notes: Your ability to heal others is miraculous enough to bring people back from near-death.

feats.name: Miraculous Possibility
feats.notes: Your deity empowers you to perform minor miracles, allowing you to readily adapt to the fluctuating needs of your duties.

feats.name: Miraculous Repair
feats.notes: Geniekin can't grant magical wishes, but some echo of power lingers within you.

feats.name: Miresoul
feats.notes: You have a connection to the muddier denizens of the Plane of Earth from its border with the Plane of Water, and your elemental lineage manifests as clay or mud, reflecting that bond.

feats.name: Mirror Refuge
feats.notes: Your origin in the space behind mirrors enables you to use a mirror as a hideaway, like the spell one with stone.

feats.name: Mirror Shield
feats.notes: You reflect the spell back against its caster.
feats.trigger: An opponent casting a spell that targets you critically fails a spell attack roll against your AC

feats.name: Mirror-Risen
feats.notes: You were created from magic involving mirrors and still retain some ability to seek refuge in reflected illusions.

feats.name: Mischievous Tail
feats.notes: Your tail can bedevil your foes.

feats.name: Mist Child
feats.notes: You blend in with unnatural subtlety.

feats.name: Mist Escape
feats.notes: As you fall, your body reacts to defend itself.
feats.trigger: You are reduced to 0 HP.

feats.name: Mist Strider
feats.notes: You condense the moisture in the air, solidifying it so it can hold your weight.

feats.name: Mistaken Identity
feats.notes: You feel a strong connection with your progenitor and can convince yourself an effect targeting your mind was meant for theirs instead.
feats.trigger: You're about to attempt a saving throw against a mental effect.

feats.name: Mistsoul
feats.notes: You have a connection to vaporous forms of water, such as fog and mist.

feats.name: Misty Transformation
feats.notes: Wild mists cover your form.
feats.trigger: You transform due to a polymorph effect.

feats.name: Mixed Maneuver
feats.notes: You leverage your knowledge of martial arts to mix different maneuvers together into a single flowing combination.

feats.name: Mobile Finisher
feats.notes: You attack in motion.

feats.name: Mobile Magical Combat
feats.notes: You dart around the battlefield, casting spells while you carefully make melee attacks with your weapon.

feats.name: Mobile Shot Stance
feats.notes: Your shots become nimble and deadly.

feats.name: Mobile Swarm
feats.notes: The clicking of fast-moving legs accompanies your swarm in all kinds of environments.

feats.name: Mobile Thralls
feats.notes: Your thralls can now follow you wherever you go.

feats.name: Mobility
feats.notes: You move without leaving an opening.

feats.name: Mockingbird's Disarm
feats.notes: The Mockingbird is a master at running into foes and coming away with their weapons.
feats.trigger: You succeed at a check to Tumble Through or use Tumbling Strike , and you moved through an enemy's space.
feats.access: Members of the Firebrands at the rank of second mark or higher have access to this feat.

feats.name: Moderate Enhance Venom
feats.notes: You upgrade the vishkanyan venom you can apply with Envenom to moderate vishkanyan venom.

feats.name: Modular Dynamo
feats.notes: Your dynamo has modular configurations, allowing you to swap between various different possibilities with ease in order to adapt to various situations in combat.

feats.name: Moisture Bath
feats.notes: Your moist skin is especially resistant to damage from temperature-altering effects.

feats.name: Moldersoul
feats.notes: Your connection to elemental wood asserts itself in the form of decay, like forgotten logs left to rot and the char that remains after a forest fire, cycles of devastation clearing away what was to make room for the next generation of life.

feats.name: Molten Wire
feats.notes: Spinning molten iron through a vortex of fire, you trap your foe in searing wires.

feats.name: Molten Wit
feats.notes: Your elemental soul has sparked not just your body but also your mind.

feats.name: Moment of Apotheosis
feats.notes: For a small moment, you can assume the form of your god.

feats.name: Moment of Clarity
feats.notes: You push back your rage for a moment in order to think clearly.

feats.name: Momentary Respite
feats.notes: Your sense of destiny manifests as rapid physical healing.
feats.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star
feats.trigger: You lose Hit Points from persistent damage.

feats.name: Momentous Charge
feats.notes: You rush into your enemies with great and reckless force.

feats.name: Momentum Strike
feats.notes: Putting your weight behind your weapon's swing, you can push one enemy into another.

feats.name: Monastic Archer Stance
feats.notes: You enter a specialized stance for a unique martial art centered around the use of a bow.

feats.name: Monastic Weaponry
feats.notes: You have trained with the weaponry of your monastery or school.

feats.name: Monk Dedication
feats.notes: You become trained in unarmed attacks and gain the powerful fist class feature.

feats.name: Monk Moves
feats.notes: You gain a +10-foot status bonus to your Speed when you’re not wearing armor.

feats.name: Monk Resiliency
feats.notes: You gain 3 additional Hit Points for each monk archetype class feat you have.
feats.prerequisite: Monk Dedication; class granting no more Hit Points per level than 8 + your Constitution modifier

feats.name: Monk's Flurry
feats.notes: You gain the Flurry of Blows action.

feats.name: Monkey Spirits
feats.notes: Vanaras generally consider the spirits of departed monkeys to be less informative or interesting than their own ancestors traveling the cycles of existence, yet these monkey spirits can prove useful when the situation is dire.

feats.name: Monster Crafting
feats.notes: Craft items using monster parts

feats.name: Monster Hunter
feats.notes: You quickly assess your prey and apply what you know.

feats.name: Monster Warden
feats.notes: You understand how to defend yourself and others against your prey.

feats.name: Monstrosity Shape
feats.notes: You can transform into a powerful magical creature.

feats.name: Monstrous Inclinations
feats.notes: Your apparitions share with you the monstrous nature of those creatures who dwell in deep seas or ancient woods.

feats.name: Monstrous Peacemaker
feats.notes: Your dual human and orc nature has given you a unique perspective, allowing you to bridge the gap between humans and the many intelligent creatures in the world that humans consider monsters.

feats.name: Monumental Maestro
feats.notes: You’ve studied the moving compositions of Andreas Romung, a legendary maestro whose Shining Crusade anthems live on in the music for the play Echoes of Glory .

feats.name: Moon May
feats.notes: Your mother was a moon hag, a handmaiden of Groetus, and you have a single scarlet eye and a sliver of her supernal foresight.

feats.name: Mooneater
feats.notes: You call on the spirit of the dragon that devoured the moon to temporarily swallow a celestial body and blind onlookers with its visage.

feats.name: Moray Ambush
feats.notes: Like the moray eels athamaru communities raise and train, you know how to quickly strike from hiding.
feats.trigger: You are hidden and a creature who hasn’t detected you passes within 20 feet of you.

feats.name: Moray Eel Mount
feats.notes: You have either trained a giant moray eel since its hatching or have tamed one in the wild.

feats.name: More Real than Real
feats.notes: Your performances aren’t just well-known, they’re famous across the land and beyond.

feats.name: Morning Side Dishes
feats.notes: You know a proper breakfast should have a variety of sides.

feats.name: Morph-Risen
feats.notes: You were once a shapeshifter or spellcaster using polymorph magic, but something went wrong, and you became trapped in the form of the creature you were imitating.

feats.name: Morphic Manipulation
feats.notes: You've attuned your natural aura to that of plant life, coaxing it to grow faster than normal.

feats.name: Morphic Strike
feats.notes: You can lash out with a portion of your previous self.

feats.name: Morrigna's Spider Affinity
feats.notes: Much like morrignas, you feel an affinity for spiders.

feats.name: Mortal Ascension
feats.notes: Your power uplifts you, breaking the bonds between you and the ground.

feats.name: Mortal Healing
feats.notes: You grant greater healing when the gods don't interfere.
feats.prerequisite: Expert in Medicine; you follow the Laws of Mortality

feats.name: Mortal Herald Dedication
feats.notes: You become a mortal herald of your deity, gaining power in return for your service.
feats.prerequisite: Worshiper of a specific deity; Master in Religion or your deity’s divine skill

feats.name: Mortal Possibility
feats.notes: You made yourself into a paragon of mortality and prove that deities aren't needed to achieve greatness.

feats.name: Mortem Ultimatum
feats.notes: You have discovered the greatest secrets of life and death.

feats.name: Mortification
feats.notes: Your reckonings have prepared your body for physical punishment.

feats.name: Mother's Mindfulness
feats.notes: You have the protective instinct your own mother lacks and will gladly suffer in another's place.
feats.trigger: An adjacent ally is hit by an attack.

feats.name: Motionless Cutter
feats.notes: Your weapon is so sharp even an insect alighting upon its still blade would be severed.

feats.name: Mountain Quake
feats.notes: You stomp, shaking the earth beneath you.

feats.name: Mountain Skin
feats.notes: You become trained in medium and heavy armor.

feats.name: Mountain Stance
feats.notes: You enter the stance of an implacable mountain—a technique created by dwarven monks—allowing you to strike with the weight of an avalanche and block blows with your garments.

feats.name: Mountain Strategy
feats.notes: Dwarves have a long history fighting common foes, and you've mastered the ancient tactics to better face these enemies.

feats.name: Mountain Stronghold
feats.notes: You focus on your connection to the earth and call upon the mountain to block attacks against you.

feats.name: Mountain's Stoutness
feats.notes: Your hardiness lets you withstand more punishment than most.

feats.name: Mounted Shield
feats.notes: You’ve trained with your shield to defend both yourself and your mount.

feats.name: Mounting Leap
feats.notes: You jump atop your mount from afar, landing comfortably astride it.

feats.name: Mud Boat's Passage
feats.notes: You instinctively create magical boats that keep your feet dry (mostly).

feats.name: Muddle Through
feats.notes: Ruin accumulates more slowly

feats.name: Mug
feats.notes: You make a quick attack and rob your foe in the process.

feats.name: Multifaceted Will
feats.notes: Without the firm hand of a patron, your power begins to reflect deeper complexities, sometimes latching onto entirely unexpected sources of magical potency.

feats.name: Multifarious Muse
feats.notes: Your muse doesn’t fall into a single label.

feats.name: Multilingual
feats.notes: Learn two new languages

feats.name: Multilingual Cipher
feats.notes: You use multiple languages to create and break codes.

feats.name: Multishot Stance
feats.notes: You lock yourself in a stable position so you can fire swiftly and accurately.

feats.name: Multitalented
feats.notes: You’ve learned to split your focus between multiple classes with ease.

feats.name: Mummy Dedication
feats.notes: Whether through natural processes or foul rituals, your body was mummified, and you've risen as an undead mummy.
feats.prerequisite: you are dead and were mummified (by natural or ritualistic means)

feats.name: Mummy's Despair
feats.notes: You force your mental anguish outward, projecting it upon those around you.

feats.name: Munitions Crafter
feats.notes: Bullets and bombs can be scarce in some parts, so you've learned to make your own.

feats.name: Munitions Machinist
feats.notes: You're particularly adept at crafting ammunition and bombs.

feats.name: Munitions Master Dedication
feats.notes: You have drilled enough with your light mortar to operate it with unrivaled efficiency.

feats.name: Murderer's Circle
feats.notes: Circle your foe while you beat on them.

feats.name: Murderous Thorns
feats.notes: Your thorns are many, vicious, and sharp.
feats.prerequisite: Hidden Thorn or Thorned Rose heritage

feats.name: Murksight
feats.notes: Your vision pierces through non-magical fog, mist, rain, and snow.

feats.name: Muscle Barrier
feats.notes: You create an extra thick layer of muscle to protect your target.

feats.name: Muscle Mimicry
feats.notes: Your study of another allows you to mirror their movements subtly, even in the heat of combat.
feats.prerequisite: Alter Ego Dedication; Trained in Athletics; Master in Deception
feats.trigger: An enemy makes a successful Disarm , Escape , Grapple , Shove , or Trip attempt.

feats.name: Musetouched
feats.notes: Your blood sings with the liberating power of the azatas.

feats.name: Musical Summons
feats.notes: Your studies have given you a deeper understanding of animals and beasts, allowing you to call them to your side as you cast your spell.

feats.name: Mutable Familiar
feats.notes: Your familiar's supernatural spirit has outgrown its corporeal body.

feats.name: Mutant Innervation
feats.notes: Basic mutagens that affect your mind and thoughts can make you communicate telepathically, protect you from being detected, or let you communicate with anyone.

feats.name: Mutant Physique
feats.notes: Basic mutagens that affect your physical form can bring out the beast within you, turn you nigh invincible, or make your body more elastic.

feats.name: Mutate Weapon
feats.notes: deal more damage with your Living Weapon.

feats.name: My Claws are Daggers
feats.notes: Your claws are as sharp as your teeth.

feats.name: My Kingdom, My Blood
feats.notes: The health of the ruler is the health of the kingdom, and the health of the kingdom is that of its ruler, each bound to the other inextricably.

feats.name: My Reputation Precedes Me
feats.notes: Long years of brave exploits haven’t gone unnoticed.
feats.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star

feats.name: Myriad Forms
feats.notes: With a bit of self-discovery, you find a new form.

feats.name: Mysterious Breadth
feats.notes: Increase the spell slots you gain from oracle archetype feats

feats.name: Mysterious Repertoire
feats.notes: Your mystery holds unknowable depths of magic not always associated with the divine.

feats.name: Mystery Conduit
feats.notes: The power of your mystery enables you access to myriad magic.

feats.name: Mystic Life Force
feats.notes: Magic energy sustains you, supporting your form far beyond the capabilities of mere flesh.

feats.name: Mystical Flare
feats.notes: You release a torrent of magic to fill the air with tiny, distracting explosions of light.

feats.name: Myth Hunter
feats.notes: Your ancestors confronted and bested mythic beasts of Iblydan antiquity.
feats.prerequisite: Trained in Hero-God Lore or Trained in Legendary Beast Lore
feats.trigger: You successfully Recall Knowledge to identify a creature that has the mythic trait.

feats.name: Myth of Quick-Thinking
feats.notes: Your myth includes amusing parables of clever plans and sly maneuvers, often applied to small things in life such as disguising yourself as a sheep to ambush a wolf or tricking a snake into shedding its skin.

feats.name: Myth of Realm-Walking
feats.notes: Your myth speaks of distant travel to countless countries, planes, or dimensions.

feats.name: Mythic Allies
feats.notes: You channel mythic power through your body and into a summoned ally, temporarily reinforcing them with a shared fraction of your mythic potential.
feats.prerequisite: ability to cast spells from slots, at least one summon spell in your spellbook or repertoire

feats.name: Mythic Casting
feats.notes: You can infuse mythic power directly into your spells to make them exceptionally potent.

feats.name: Mythic Containment
feats.notes: You infuse a receptacle, such as a normal bag, sack, or box, with mythic power, transforming it into a prison into which you can command a creature.

feats.name: Mythic Counter
feats.notes: You can overwhelm the magical designs of others with sheer magic power.

feats.name: Mythic Counterspell
feats.notes: You quench and counter your enemy’s magic with potent spellcraft amplified and enhanced by carefully deployed mythic power.
feats.prerequisite: Quick Recognition; ability to cast spells from spell slots,; Sage's Calling
feats.trigger: A creature Casts a Spell, you’ve successfully Recognized the Spell, and you have either a prepared spell or an unexpended spell slot of equal or greater rank.

feats.name: Mythic Heightening
feats.notes: You overload your minor spells to give them greater effect.

feats.name: Mythic Magic
feats.notes: You convert your mythic power into a magical effect.

feats.name: Mythic Refocus
feats.notes: As your ability to control your mythic power grows, you learn to channel it to restore and reinforce other forms of power at your command.

feats.name: Mythic Strike
feats.notes: You infuse your weapon or unarmed attack with mythic power before lashing out at an enemy with devastating force.

feats.name: Mythic Weapon Specialization
feats.notes: When you fully embrace your Calling, your blows hit with incredible force that can fell even the mightiest of creatures.
feats.prerequisite: Eternal Legend Dedication; greater weapon specialization

feats.name: Nagaji Lore
feats.notes: You're the vassal or apprentice of a learned naga , and you've studied the secrets of naga magic and concocting intricate poisons.

feats.name: Nagaji Spell Expertise
feats.notes: Your magical skill rivals that of accomplished naga spellcasters.

feats.name: Nagaji Spell Familiarity
feats.notes: Either through study, exposure, or familial devotion, you have the magic of nagas bubbling in your blood.

feats.name: Nagaji Spell Mysteries
feats.notes: You've learned more naga magic.
feats.prerequisite: at least one innate spell from a nagaji heritage or ancestry feat

feats.name: Nalinivati's Light
feats.notes: Your slit eyes expand to absorb light and can see in the darkest of places.

feats.name: Named Artillery
feats.notes: It is a tradition among artillerists to name the siege weapon most important to them and closest to their heart—much as a sailor on a ship, the weapon is their livelihood.

feats.name: Nameless Anonymity
feats.notes: Your mask protects you further from divination.

feats.name: Nanite Shroud
feats.notes: Your nanites fly out of your body, swarming around you in a cloud.

feats.name: Nanite Surge
feats.notes: You stimulate your nanites, forcing your body to temporarily increase its efficiency.
feats.trigger: You attempt a skill check requiring three actions or fewer.

feats.name: Nantambu Chime-Ringer Dedication
feats.notes: You've studied the basics of harmony and resonance in magic, exemplified by the ringing of chimes.
feats.source: Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind
feats.prerequisite: Trained in Performance; Trained in Society

feats.name: Narrative Conduit
feats.notes: You act as a conduit for your companions just as your stories are a conduit between teller and listener.
feats.source: Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind

feats.name: Native Waters
feats.notes: You were born with or obtained a special connection to either fresh water or salt water.

feats.name: Natural Ambassador
feats.notes: You remember what it was like to speak easily with other animals, using old, familiar ways of communication to learn what they want and ask for favors in return.

feats.name: Natural Ambition
feats.notes: You were raised to be ambitious and always reach for the stars, leading you to progress quickly in your chosen field.

feats.name: Natural Conduit
feats.notes: You can use an animal as a conduit for your magic.

feats.name: Natural Illusionist
feats.notes: By drawing upon the First World’s magic, you can siphon a portion of that malleable world to create a convincing illusion.

feats.name: Natural Magnetism
feats.notes: Your connection with elemental iron grants you a natural field of weak magnetic attraction.

feats.name: Natural Medicine
feats.notes: Use Nature to Treat Wounds

feats.name: Natural Mutagen
feats.notes: You can distill your natural shapeshifting ability into an elixir that grants a lesser ability to morph.

feats.name: Natural Orienteering
feats.notes: There are few twisting paths that can disorient you.

feats.name: Natural Performer
feats.notes: Entertainment comes naturally to you.

feats.name: Natural Senses
feats.notes: You have retained your sharp animal senses even after awakening.

feats.name: Natural Skill
feats.notes: Your ingenuity allows you to learn a wide variety of skills.

feats.name: Natural Swimmer
feats.notes: Water flows around you, letting you cut through the waves as if born to it.

feats.name: Nature Prowler
feats.notes: When you begin your turn hidden or unnoticed by your hunted prey, that creature is off-guard to you until the end of your turn.

feats.name: Nature's Embrace
feats.notes: You call on the world to hamper your foes.

feats.name: Nature's Precision
feats.notes: Your companions pick at an enemy's weak points.
feats.prerequisite: Beastmaster Dedication; animal companion with an agile or finesse unarmed attack

feats.name: Necrologist Dedication
feats.notes: Your studies of the lists of the dead allow you to call forth a horde of undead with a brief incantation.
feats.prerequisite: ability to cast spells from spell slots, ability to cast _summon undead_

feats.name: Necromancer Dedication
feats.notes: You can cast spells like a necromancer, gaining a dirge with four common occult cantrips of your choice.

feats.name: Necromancer's Visage
feats.notes: Necromantic energy demonstrates your power over undead, creating a demeanor that commands their fear and respect.
feats.prerequisite: ability to create or control undead; cleric with a negative font, oracle of bones, or necromancer wizard

feats.name: Necromantic Bulwark
feats.notes: Regular exposure to necromantic effects left you better able to defend against them.

feats.name: Necromantic Deflection
feats.notes: You imbue your shield with life-giving energy to deflect harmful necromantic magic.
feats.access: Knights of Lastwall have access to this feat.

feats.name: Necromantic Heir
feats.notes: Your affinity for negative energy spills outward and grants you a refilling well of necromantic essence.

feats.name: Necromantic Lifesense
feats.notes: Your connection to life and death allows you to sense the life force of a creature with a glance.

feats.name: Necromantic Physiology
feats.notes: Your unusual physiology has developed in a way that makes it difficult for parasites and other infestations to prey upon you.

feats.name: Necromantic Resistance
feats.notes: Gain resistance to necromancy effects and damage.

feats.name: Necromantic Resistance
feats.notes: As part of your training, you've inured yourself against necromancy through grueling, repeated exposure.

feats.name: Necromantic Tenacity
feats.notes: Reduce the power that necromantic effects hold over you.

feats.name: Necrotic Bomber
feats.notes: You gain the necrotic bomb grave spell.

feats.name: Needle In The God's Eyes
feats.notes: With sinews of bronze and thews of iron, you leap to the heavens, piercing the arrogant eyes of the gods.

feats.name: Negate Damage
feats.notes: Your armor innovation activates various devices you prepared ahead of time, and you use one of them to reduce the damage you would take by 15.
feats.trigger: You would take damage

feats.name: Nephilim Eyes
feats.notes: Your eyes can see through darkness with visual acuity akin to that possessed by most extraplanar beings.

feats.name: Nephilim Lore
feats.notes: You know the secrets of the Multiverse .

feats.name: Nephilim Resistance
feats.notes: You resist energy like your extraplanar predecessors.

feats.name: Never Tire
feats.notes: As long as you have an audience, you can continue to perform even when you are on the brink of collapse.
feats.trigger: You would gain the fatigued condition.

feats.name: Never!
feats.notes: The idea that you would hurt your companions, even when you've lost your reason, is unthinkable.

feats.name: Nidalese Horselord Dedication
feats.notes: Thanks to the deep bond you share with your Nidalese horse, the two of you gain remarkable abilities.
feats.prerequisite: Trained in Nature; horse animal companion
feats.access: You’re from Nidal.

feats.name: Night Magic
feats.notes: You can tap into the magic that runs through your blood.

feats.name: Night Terror
feats.notes: Buoyed by your fearsome reputation, your steed can take flight.

feats.name: Night's Glow
feats.notes: The stars and moon lend you their light.

feats.name: Night's Shine
feats.notes: Your power from the moon and stars becomes strong enough to illuminate the night sky.

feats.name: Night's Warning
feats.notes: Portents written in the night sky show you how to avoid an attack.
feats.trigger: A creature targets you with an attack and you can see the attacker.

feats.name: Nightvision Adaptation
feats.notes: The nanites in your ocular processors have adapted to darkness, enhancing your ability to see in the dark.

feats.name: Nightwave Springing Reload
feats.notes: Training with the crew of the Nightwave has taught you their technique for reloading while leaping to board another ship.
feats.access: Members of the Firebrands at the rank of second mark or higher have access to this feat.

feats.name: Nimble Crawl
feats.notes: Crawl at a faster rate

feats.name: Nimble Dodge
feats.notes: You deftly dodge out of the way, gaining a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against the triggering attack.
feats.trigger: A creature targets you with an attack and you can see the attacker

feats.name: Nimble Elf
feats.notes: Your muscles are tightly honed.

feats.name: Nimble Form
feats.notes: Your eidolon evolves into a figure of pure grace.

feats.name: Nimble Hooves
feats.notes: You possess hooves, ankle wings, or some other feature that hastens your movement.

feats.name: Nimble Reprisal
feats.notes: You can use Retributive Strike at greater distance.

feats.name: Nimble Roll
feats.notes: You throw yourself into a roll to escape imminent danger.

feats.name: Nimble Shield Hand
feats.notes: You are so used to wielding a shield that you can do so even while using the hand that’s holding it for other tasks that require the dexterity of a hand.

feats.name: Nimble Strike
feats.notes: You’re cunning enough to find an opening in an opponent’s attack.

feats.name: No Cause for Alarm
feats.notes: Reduce creatures’ frightened condition values

feats.name: No Escape
feats.notes: You keep pace with a retreating foe.
feats.trigger: An enemy within reach attempts to move away from you.

feats.name: No Evidence
feats.notes: You leave little sign when attempting to remain unseen.

feats.name: No Gods, Only Mortals!
feats.notes: You order the caster to stop their spellcasting.
feats.trigger: You successfully Recognize a Spell with the divine trait

feats.name: No Hands, No Problems
feats.notes: After a lifetime of using temporary, ghostly limbs to manipulate objects, you hardly need real hands.

feats.name: No Hard Feelings
feats.notes: Despite the devastation your weapons tend to inflict upon their targets or the destruction you might unleash upon an area, your foes still manage to walk away at the end of a fight—at least sometimes.

feats.name: No Need to Fear
feats.notes: With a simple reminder of perseverance, you bolster the bravery of yourself and your allies.
feats.trigger: You or an ally within 60 feet attempts a saving throw against a fear effect.

feats.name: No Stranger to Death
feats.notes: Your regular exposure to the insidious putrescence of undeath inured you to its effects.

feats.name: No! No! I Created You!
feats.notes: You appeal to your construct companion's bond with its creator to have it break free of a controlling effect.
feats.trigger: Your construct companion would become confused or controlled .

feats.name: No!!!
feats.notes: The shock of seeing your ally near death breaks whatever limits exist in your mind, sending your power spilling forth.
feats.trigger: A non-minion ally within 60 feet is reduced to 0 Hit Points.

feats.name: Noble Bloom
feats.notes: Certain plants and flowers hold a reputation throughout Tian Xia for being strong and upstanding, able to weather adversity.
feats.trigger: An ally within 30 feet would be reduced to 0 Hit Points but not immediately killed.
feats.access: chrysanthemum leshy heritage

feats.name: Noble Resolve
feats.notes: Once, genies ruled vast kingdoms, and a remnant of that confidence and power is reflected in your strong will.

feats.name: Noble Sacrifice
feats.notes: As your knights devote their lives and swords to you, so too do you return their devotion with your own fierce protection.
feats.trigger: One of your designated knights is within 15 feet of you and would take damage from an enemy’s Strike .

feats.name: Nocturnal Charm
feats.notes: The supernatural charm of your vampiric progenitor hangs about you, and you've learned to use it on mortals.

feats.name: Nocturnal Grippli
feats.notes: You tend to do most of your hunting and work at night and have adapted to the requirements of nocturnal life.

feats.name: Nocturnal Kindred
feats.notes: You have an innate connection with other creatures of the night and understand some of them.

feats.name: Nocturnal Senses
feats.notes: Your senses gain even greater clarity.

feats.name: Nocturnal Tripkee
feats.notes: You tend to do most of your hunting and work at night and have adapted to the requirements of nocturnal life.

feats.name: Nodal Healing
feats.notes: You can induce wound repair by circulating magic throughout your body.

feats.name: Nodal Regeneration
feats.notes: Your body processes magic so effectively that you can induce true regeneration, replacing limbs and restoring organs.

feats.name: None Shall Know
feats.notes: Even magical means have a hard time prying information from you.

feats.name: Nonlethal Spell
feats.notes: You can alter offensive spells to be less deadly.

feats.name: Nonlethal Takedown
feats.notes: You prefer to use nonlethal means against living opponents, but the weapons you carry are lethal enough to destroy undead.

feats.name: Norgorber's Secret
feats.notes: Being the god of secrets, Norgorber has erased all traces of his life before his ascension so that his every mortal act and even his identity remain unknown and unknowable.

feats.name: Nosoi's Mask
feats.notes: Many psychopomps wear masks when dealing with the living, and many cultures believe that seeing an unmasked psychopomp's face invites death.

feats.name: Not so Fast!
feats.notes: You lash out when foes try to get past you, possibly stopping them in their tracks.
feats.trigger: A creature within your reach leaves a square during a move action it’s using.

feats.name: Not This Time
feats.notes: You reflexively attempt to cycle a creature’s timeline briefly to a reality where it’s less able to succeed.
feats.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star
feats.trigger: A creature targets you with a single-target spell or ability that you defend against with a saving throw or your AC.

feats.name: Nothing but Fluff
feats.notes: Your fluffy interior lacks specific organs and struts, with few weak spots to injure.

feats.name: Nothing Personal
feats.notes: When you’re on a job, you can’t allow anyone to stop you.

feats.name: Nourishing Gate
feats.notes: You can sustain yourself on a single drop of elemental dew or the slightest spark from the Plane of Fire .

feats.name: Nourishing Symbiosis
feats.notes: As you recuperate from your wounds, life energy flows from you to the land and back to you again.

feats.name: Now You See Me
feats.notes: You flash through several possible timelines as you move.
feats.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star

feats.name: Noxious Odor
feats.notes: You have developed your skill with your defensive pheromones and have concentrated them into a noxious form.

feats.name: Nudge the Scales
feats.notes: You lay a finger on the scales of life and death to heal a creature, regardless of whether it's living or undead .

feats.name: Null Field
feats.notes: You understand the frequency of energies that have damaged you and can extend the magical network of power in your internal nexus to diffuse incoming attacks.

feats.name: Numb
feats.notes: As your body continues to rot and putrefy, your senses deaden and your undead powers grow.

feats.name: Numb to Death
feats.notes: Your past has left you numb to death's call.
feats.prerequisite: Diehard; you have died at least once

feats.name: Numbing Spice Exhalation
feats.notes: You can mix alchemically preserved peppers into an alchemical food consumable to spice it up with alchemical fire.

feats.name: Oath of The Avenger
feats.notes: You’ve sworn an oath to punish wicked acts you witness.

feats.name: Oath of The Defender
feats.notes: During your daily preparations, you can swear an oath to defend against a certain kind of enemy during your deeds that day.

feats.name: Oath of The Slayer
feats.notes: During your daily preparations, you can swear an oath to defeat, topple, or destroy a certain kind of enemy during your deeds that day.

feats.name: Oatia Skysage Dedication
feats.notes: Your study of the stars unlocks supernatural insights and magic.

feats.name: Obscured Emergence
feats.notes: You are, by nature, a thing of gloomy woods and barren wilds, and when you choose show yourself, a bit of this gloom clings to you, obscuring your form with strange distortions or mist.

feats.name: Obscured Terrain
feats.notes: When you cast obscuring mist , you can modify the spell to blanket the area, making it difficult to see the ground.
feats.prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _obscuring mist_

feats.name: Observant Explorer
feats.notes: You've gained an intuitive sense about creatures.

feats.name: Observational Analysis
feats.notes: You are able to rapidly discern relevant details about your opponents in the heat of combat.

feats.name: Occult Breadth
feats.notes: Your repertoire expands, and you can cast more occult spells each day.

feats.name: Occult Dragonblood
feats.notes: Your blood contains a tiny fragment of unusual or inexplicable power from a mysterious dragon, such as a conspirator dragon or omen dragon .

feats.name: Occult Evolution
feats.notes: You draw power from the obscure secrets of the universe.

feats.name: Occult Resistance
feats.notes: Your study of occult practices has shown you how to best defend against them.

feats.name: Ocean Wariness
feats.notes: Stories about those who have mistreated your people in the past (particularly stories about alghollthu mind control) left you untrusting of those outside your community.

feats.name: Ocean's Balm
feats.notes: A blessing of the living sea salves wounds and douses flames.

feats.name: Ocean's Bite
feats.notes: Your jaws open wider than a humanoid mouth should, showing off multiple rows of serrated shark teeth or a viperfish-like nest of needles.
feats.prerequisite: Abyssal Merfolk heritage or Carcharodon Merfolk heritage

feats.name: Ocular Flesh
feats.notes: You create a fleshy eyeball that is the size of a marble.

feats.name: Oddity Identification
feats.notes: Recognize magic involving minds, fortune, or secrets

feats.name: Ode to Ouroboros
feats.notes: You learn the ode to ouroboros composition spell (page 371), which enables you to temporarily spare your allies from death.

feats.name: Of Lions and Wyrms
feats.notes: You starred in a war drama depicting First Emperor Taldaris’s battles against the Grogrisant, a massive six- eyed lion, and Verksaris the Kingeater, a mighty dragon.

feats.name: Offensive Analysis
feats.notes: You can enhance your senses and mental state to consider every aspect of an attack.

feats.name: Offensive Odor
feats.notes: You've mastered your defensive pheromones and have nearly complete control over them.

feats.name: Offensive Subroutine
feats.notes: Nanites augment your attacks.

feats.name: Officer's Education
feats.notes: You know that a broad knowledge base is critical for a competent commander.

feats.name: Officer's Expertise
feats.notes: Your proficiency in commander class DC increases to expert, and you become an expert in Warfare Lore .

feats.name: Officer's Mastery
feats.notes: Your proficiency in commander class DC increases to master, and you become a master in Warfare Lore.

feats.name: Officer's Medical Training
feats.notes: You received formal training in battlefield triage and wound treatment.

feats.name: Officer's Protection
feats.notes: When you use Commitment to Protection, you can target all allies within 30 feet.

feats.name: Oil Fire
feats.notes: Your armor includes flame-resistant gauntlets with oil-filled finger joints.

feats.name: Old Soul
feats.notes: Your immortal lineage has granted you a lifespan much longer than most mortals, and you've learned a lot along the way.

feats.name: Olethros's Decree
feats.notes: You have a connection to olethroses, the enigmatic psychopomps who successfully swayed the yamaraj to permit the creation of the first duskwalkers.

feats.name: Omnikinesis
feats.notes: You can realign your kinetic gate with a thought.

feats.name: On Borrowed Time
feats.notes: You accelerate a foe's personal timestream, which causes them to experience time at a faster rate, putting a terrible strain on their mind and body.

feats.name: On My Best Day
feats.notes: Be they in your current life or your previous one, you’ve had many heroic moments that continue to inspire you.
feats.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star

feats.name: Once and Future
feats.notes: Though foul treachery might lay you low or dark magic still your heart, when the people cry out for you in desperate need, you shall rise to protect them.

feats.name: One Among The Masses
feats.notes: It will take more than a gathered mass of foes to take you down.

feats.name: One For All
feats.notes: With precisely the right words of encouragement, you bolster an ally's efforts.

feats.name: One Life, Two Vessels
feats.notes: The minds of you and your companion are so intertwined that, so long as one of you lives, the other continues to exist in the living one’s mind.

feats.name: One More Activation
feats.notes: You've forged a deeper bond to your invested items, allowing you to activate them more than usual.

feats.name: One with Earth
feats.notes: You've learned to harness your connection to the earth to travel through it.

feats.name: One with the Land
feats.notes: Your connection to your bound terrain strengthens, making you unhindered by local weather.

feats.name: One with the Spirits
feats.notes: The spirits you’ve invoked throughout your life have left behind echoes and spiritual fragments, which you can manifest across your own flesh, temporarily transforming you into something more akin to spirit than mortal.

feats.name: One with the Wild
feats.notes: You naturally blend in with the wilderness, becoming camouflaged.

feats.name: One-inch Punch
feats.notes: You put all your force into a single mighty, carefully controlled blow.

feats.name: One-millimeter Punch
feats.notes: Your punches have incredible force and control.

feats.name: One-on-One
feats.notes: Your true skill can be seen in a one-on-one fight where you have room to dance around your opponent.
feats.prerequisite: Aldori Duelist Dedication; Trained in Deception

feats.name: One-Toed Hop
feats.notes: Assuming a peculiar stance, you make a short hop on each toe.

feats.name: Oneiric Influence
feats.notes: While Infiltrating a Dream, you can also implant a suggestion in the target's mind.

feats.name: Ongoing Investigation
feats.notes: You're always investigating what's around you, even as you perform other activities.

feats.name: Ongoing Selfishness
feats.notes: Your powerful personality and incredible ego demand that you protect yourself above all else.

feats.name: Ongoing Strategy
feats.notes: You're constantly studying small aspects of everyone's movements, even if you don't have a stratagem in place ahead of time.

feats.name: Oni Form
feats.notes: Your horns flash briefly as you grow in size and ferocity.

feats.name: Oni Rampage
feats.notes: Nothing invigorates you more than your own freshly spilled blood.
feats.trigger: You're reduced to less than half your maximum Hit Points by a creature within your reach.

feats.name: Oni Weapon Familiarity
feats.notes: Oni prefer large, cruel weapons for smashing their foes to pieces, and so do you.

feats.name: Oni's Mask
feats.notes: You aren’t as malleable as your oni ancestors but still can disguise yourself.

feats.name: Only My Doom May Claim Me
feats.notes: The power of your legend, fueled by your legendary deeds, resists any weapon that is not tied to your curse.

feats.name: Only the Worthy
feats.notes: You can designate your ikons as movable by only your own hand, leaving them fixed in place as surely as if they were lodged in stone.

feats.name: Ooze Empathy
feats.notes: You can connect with oozes (and other amorphous aberrations, at the GM's discretion) on a rudimentary level.
feats.prerequisite: Oozemorph Dedication; at least two other class feats from the oozemorph archetype

feats.name: Oozemorph Dedication
feats.notes: You are plagued by sporadic anatomical rearrangements, which grant you insights into other creatures with unusual anatomies.

feats.name: Open Mind
feats.notes: You have inherent psychic abilities that allow you to tap into the power of your mind.

feats.name: Open the Blazing Eye
feats.notes: Thanks to your diligence in the study of divine and occult mysteries, you can focus to temporarily attain a perception beyond the ordinary.

feats.name: Opening Stance
feats.notes: At the first sign of trouble, often before you consciously realize the danger, you drop into a stance with a mere thought.
feats.trigger: You roll initiative.

feats.name: Opening Stance (Fighter)
feats.notes: At the first sign of trouble, often before you consciously realize the danger, you drop into a stance with a mere thought.
feats.trigger: You roll initiative

feats.name: Operatic Adventurer
feats.notes: Your training has focused you for the opera, and it certainly shows.

feats.name: Opportune Backstab
feats.notes: When your enemy is hit by your ally, you capitalize upon the distraction.
feats.trigger: A creature within your melee reach is hit by a melee attack from one of your allies

feats.name: Opportune Opening
feats.notes: Your combat training taught you to capitalize on any moment of weakness from your foe.
feats.trigger: An ally lands a critical hit on a creature within your melee reach.

feats.name: Opportune Throw
feats.notes: Make a ranged attack with a Juggled item against a vulnerable creature.
feats.source: Pathfinder #151: The Show Must Go On
feats.trigger: A creature within 10 feet of you uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it’s using.

feats.name: Opportunistic Grapple
feats.notes: You use an opening to capture your prey.
feats.trigger: Your prey critically fails on an attack roll against you with a melee Strike .

feats.name: Oppurtune Trickster
feats.notes: You aren’t above using underhanded tactics to gain an advantage, easily routing your opponents when they attack.
feats.trigger: An adjacent ally makes a melee Strike against a creature.

feats.name: Oracle Dedication
feats.notes: Choose a mystery.

feats.name: Oracular Providence
feats.notes: Your mystery grants you access to deep reserves of truly miraculous divine power.

feats.name: Oracular Warning
feats.notes: You have a premonition about impending danger that you use to warn your allies.
feats.trigger: You are about to roll for initiative.

feats.name: Orator's Fillibuster
feats.notes: When you seek to convince others of the worth of your cause, you are capable of unleashing such an entrancing torrent of rhetoric and metaphor that it is all but impossible to look away from you.

feats.name: Orbiting Runestone
feats.notes: You create a runestone that floats around you, and you Trace a Rune with a damaging invocation on it even if the rune could not normally be applied to an object.

feats.name: Orc Ferocity
feats.notes: Fierceness in battle runs through your blood, and you refuse to fall from your injuries no matter how terrible they may be.
feats.trigger: You would be reduced to 0 Hit Points but not immediately killed

feats.name: Orc Lore
feats.notes: The hold elders taught you your people’s histories, told tales of great athletic feats, and shared with you the hardships your ancestors endured so that you can pass this wisdom down to future generations.

feats.name: Orc Sight
feats.notes: Your orc blood grants you the keen vision of your forebears.

feats.name: Orc Superstition
feats.notes: You defend yourself against magic by relying on techniques derived from orc cultural superstitions.
feats.trigger: You attempt a saving throw against a spell or magical effect, and have not yet rolled

feats.name: Orc Warmask
feats.notes: You paint your face to create a warmask .

feats.name: Orc Weapon Familiarity
feats.notes: In combat, you favor the brutal weapons that are traditional for your orc ancestors.

feats.name: Orchard's Endurance
feats.notes: Patches of bark appear on the skin of you and your nearby allies.

feats.name: Order Cross-Training
feats.notes: You gain the lesser order benefit of a Hellknight order other than the one to which you belong.

feats.name: Order Explorer
feats.notes: You have learned the secrets of another druidic order, passing whatever rites of initiation that order requires and gaining access to its secrets.

feats.name: Order Magic
feats.notes: You have delved deeper into the teaching of a new order, gaining access to a coveted order spell.

feats.name: Order Spell
feats.notes: You gain the initial order spell from your order.

feats.name: Order Training
feats.notes: You gain the lesser order benefit for the Hellknight order to which you belong.

feats.name: Ore Fists
feats.notes: When you enter the Stonestrike Stance, your fists appear to be covered with veins of unrefined ore.

feats.name: Orichalcum Bond
feats.notes: The ancient Thassilonians associated sins with different skymetals, and you’ve adapted that theory to empower your bonded weapon beyond its normal limits.

feats.name: Ornate Tattoo
feats.notes: You expand your tattoos to encompass greater magic.

feats.name: Orthographic Mastery
feats.notes: You understand the principles that underlie all written words, allowing you to read nearly any text.

feats.name: Ostentatious Arrival
feats.notes: If the next action you take is to Manifest your Eidolon as a three-action activity, or to Cast a 3-action summon or incarnate Spell, the creature appears in an explosion.

feats.name: Ostentatious Reload
feats.notes: Every good Firebrand knows that style can be as important as substance—so long as you don't screw up the delivery.
feats.access: Members of the Firebrands at the rank of second mark or higher have access to this feat.

feats.name: Osteo Armaments
feats.notes: If you have bones, you have a weapon.

feats.name: Ostilli Host Dedication
feats.notes: You've bonded with an attached symbiote known as an ostilli.
feats.prerequisite: Trained in Arcana or Trained in Nature
feats.access: surki ancestry

feats.name: Otherworldly Acumen
feats.notes: The arcane magic you possess grows in power and complexity.
feats.prerequisite: at least one innate spell gained from an elf ancestry feat

feats.name: Otherworldly Magic
feats.notes: Your elven magic manifests as a simple arcane spell, even if you aren't formally trained in magic.

feats.name: Ouroboric Pact
feats.notes: You’ve studied pacts at Cobyslarni, or learned under someone who has, and understand them to not only create a bargain between individuals, but a separate entity altogether: the pact itself.

feats.name: Out of Hand
feats.notes: Even when your limbs are severed, they remain a part of you.

feats.name: Overburdening Spell
feats.notes: You have learned how to weigh down your enemies’ life essence.

feats.name: Overburn
feats.notes: You engage your core, giving yourself more energy and speed for a fight.

feats.name: Overclock Senses
feats.notes: Your senses speed up to the point that time seems to stand still, allowing you to catch details and incoming attacks.

feats.name: Overcrowd
feats.notes: As long as you are Small, you can end your movement in the same square as a Small ally.

feats.name: Overdrive Ally
feats.notes: You quickly fling some of your powered-up mechanisms to an ally, sharing your benefits with them briefly.

feats.name: Overextending Feint
feats.notes: You goad a foe into overextending.

feats.name: Overloaded Ammunition
feats.notes: You can tenuously bind power into arrows or sling stones to transform them into explosive missiles.

feats.name: Overlooked Mastermind
feats.notes: Many consider half-orcs little more than dumb brutes.

feats.name: Overpowering Charge
feats.notes: You trample foes as you charge past.

feats.name: Oversized Throw
feats.notes: With a great heave, you seize a piece of your surroundings, such as a boulder, log, table, wagon, or chunk of earth, and hurl it at your foes.

feats.name: Overwatch Dedication
feats.notes: You have an innate knack for tactical observation, and you've innovated to apply that knack in a variety of ways that allow you to assist your allies.

feats.name: Overwhelming Blow
feats.notes: You throw your weight into a powerful attack that leaves you vulnerable.

feats.name: Overwhelming Breath
feats.notes: You control your breathing and align it with your qi, exhaling with controlled force in order to overcome your opponent's resistance.

feats.name: Overwhelming Energy
feats.notes: With a complex gesture, you call upon the primal power of your spell to overcome enemies’ resistances.

feats.name: Overwhelming Harm
feats.notes: Your ability to manipulate void energy has led you to the conclusion that more is always better.

feats.name: Overwhelming Spellstrike
feats.notes: You pierce through your foe’s resistance. Make a Spellstrike .

feats.name: Pack Attack
feats.notes: You have mastered techniques for hunting alongside your pack.

feats.name: Pack Hunter
feats.notes: You were taught how to hunt as part of a pack.

feats.name: Pack Movement
feats.notes: You and your companion move to take down a common enemy.

feats.name: Pack Of The Beast Lord
feats.notes: You and your united companion call upon the service of others of its kind, creating figment duplicates of your companion to form a massive swarm of formidable power.

feats.name: Pack Performance
feats.notes: When you and animals sing together, your words ring even brighter and bolder, cutting through disruptions.
feats.trigger: A creature counteracts or disrupts the spell you're casting.

feats.name: Pack Rat
feats.notes: You've learned how to cram vast quantities into small spaces.

feats.name: Pack Stalker
feats.notes: Ambushes are an honored kholo tradition.

feats.name: Pack Tactics
feats.notes: You have mastered how to hunt with your pack.

feats.name: Pack Takedown
feats.notes: The pack is strongest when it acts as one, and like a group of hungry wolves, you work together to bring down a single target.

feats.name: Packed with Flavor
feats.notes: Edible morsels you create are particularly potent and bursting with flavor.
feats.prerequisite: Wandering Chef Dedication; Expert in Crafting or Cooking Lore

feats.name: Pact of Draconic Fury
feats.notes: You've sworn a pact with a dragon, giving you the ability to tap into the dragon's immeasurable power in exchange for adding to their hoard.

feats.name: Pact of Eldritch Eyes
feats.notes: You've sworn a pact with an entity beyond mortal comprehension, granting you distant visions.

feats.name: Pact of Fey Glamour
feats.notes: You've sworn a pact with fey powers, granting you the otherworldly appearance of your dreams in exchange for oaths of hospitality.

feats.name: Pact of Huldra's Renewal
feats.notes: You’ve sworn a pact with Zemnaïdé, a huldra professor at Cobyslarni, to help renew his former homeland of the Sarkoris Scar.

feats.name: Pact of Infernal Prowess
feats.notes: You've sworn a pact with devils, granting you success in life in exchange for your soul in the afterlife.

feats.name: Pact of the Crossroads
feats.notes: You’ve sworn a pact with Ng the Hooded, the Eldest known as the Lord of the Crossroads, though your only sign of Ng’s acknowledgment is the benefits you receive.

feats.name: Pact of the Death Hunter
feats.notes: You’ve sworn a pact with a psychopomp bent on the destruction of all undeath.

feats.name: Pact of the Fey Paths
feats.notes: You’ve sworn a pact with a powerful fey creature that longs to see the wonders of the Universe.

feats.name: Pact of the Final Breath
feats.notes: You've sworn a pact with a powerful psychopomp—typically an olethros advocate or yamaraj judge—granting you a reprieve before your soul will be collected in exchange for respect for the dead and assistance against the undead.

feats.name: Pact of the Living Pact
feats.notes: You’ve sworn a pact with a pact that has somehow survived long after the death of the original pactbinder.

feats.name: Pact of the Nightblossom
feats.notes: You’ve sworn a pact with Jenway Nightblossom of the Synod of Truth in Dreams, a talented oneiromancer and pactbinder.

feats.name: Pact of the Rune Dragon
feats.notes: While the students of Cobyslarni are taught to make pacts with many kinds of dragons, a pact with a rune dragon is somewhat more frequent due to their interest in the accomplishments of various academies.

feats.name: Pactbinder Dedication
feats.notes: The first step toward forming a successful pact is an understanding of the magic behind it, along with skill at negotiation.
feats.prerequisite: Trained in Diplomacy; Trained in Arcana, Trained in Nature, Trained in Occultism, or Trained in Religion

feats.name: Pactbound Dedication
feats.notes: You befriended one of the last saumen kar and were infused with a fraction of their power, granting you the potential to become a guardian of their ancient pact.
feats.prerequisite: Trained in Nature; Erutaki or Giant language, must have earned the trust of a saumen kar who initiates you into the archetype

feats.name: Pain is Temporary
feats.notes: Sangpotshi practitioners know that suffering is a fleeting sensation that ultimately strengthens the soul and prepares it for a new reincarnation.

feats.name: Pain Tolerance
feats.notes: You gain resistance to mental damage equal to half your level and a +1 circumstance bonus to saving throws against effects that would make you clumsy , drained , or enfeebled .
feats.access: You're from Alkenstar or the Mana Wastes.

feats.name: Paired Link
feats.notes: You break a trinket, such as a lodestone or jade pendant, in two, creating a sympathetic link between the halves that bridges distance.

feats.name: Paired Shots
feats.notes: Your shots hit simultaneously.

feats.name: Palatine Detective Dedication
feats.notes: You have delved into the study of the occult and divine, becoming exceptionally skilled at identifying when such forces are at work.

feats.name: Palatine Enchantment
feats.notes: You have found yourself facing supernatural beings often and have learned how to combat them.

feats.name: Palatine Strike
feats.notes: Your strikes are particularly deadly against supernatural creatures.

feats.name: Pale Horse
feats.notes: Your mount becomes a grotesque creature of foreboding when you ride it.

feats.name: Palm-leaf Silhouette
feats.notes: You can make yourself as flat as a paper doll or shadow.

feats.name: Panache Paragon
feats.notes: You find opportunities to perform stylish feats in the moments between others' heartbeats and eye blinks.

feats.name: Pandemonium Eruption
feats.notes: You unleash the pent-up chaos within you, becoming a nexus of unbridled destruction that wreaks unfettered havoc on everyone in your vicinity.

feats.name: Panic the Dead
feats.notes: Vitality strikes terror in the undead.

feats.name: Pantheon Magic
feats.notes: The touch of divine meddling still runs through you, whether you want it or not.

feats.name: Paradoxical Mystery
feats.notes: The truest depths of your divine mystery are fathomless and contradictory, granting you changing powers that even you can barely begin to fathom.

feats.name: Paragon Battle Medicine
feats.notes: You've learned the modern uses of Battle Medicine originated by Kassi Aziril.
feats.access: You’re from Rahadoum.

feats.name: Paragon Companion
feats.notes: Your construct companion has reached the pinnacle of form and function.

feats.name: Paragon Reanimated Companion
feats.notes: You have reached the pinnacle of necromantic science, creating a mechanical zombie unlike any the world has seen before.

feats.name: Paragon's Guard
feats.notes: Once you’ve had a moment to set your stance, you always have your shield ready without a thought.

feats.name: Parallel Breakthrough
feats.notes: You expand your mind beyond your area of psychic specialty.

feats.name: Paralyzing Jewel
feats.notes: Your dedication to the ideals of art and beauty allows your head gem to access the power of the waning moon.

feats.name: Paralyzing Slash
feats.notes: Your enzymes can paralyze your foes rather than merely making it harder for them to heal their wounds.

feats.name: Parry and Riposte
feats.notes: Your parries and finishers allow you to riposte with the slightest provocation.

feats.name: Parthenogenic Hatchling
feats.notes: You were hatched from an unfertilized egg during hard times for your people, and are a biological copy of your mother.

feats.name: Parting Shot
feats.notes: You jump back and make a quick shot that catches your opponent by surprise.

feats.name: Party Crasher
feats.notes: You attend all the fashionable society parties, no matter how exclusive they might be.

feats.name: Pass Through
feats.notes: Filtering your form through the substance of an object, you can pass through walls, doors, and more.

feats.name: Pass Vengeful Judgement
feats.notes: To prevent yourself from frivolously calling down the terrible power of divine wrath, you have vowed to do so only with the assent of your mortal hierophant.

feats.name: Past Life
feats.notes: Flashes of your life become clearer and more frequent, allowing you to apply skills you developed while alive.

feats.name: Patch Job
feats.notes: You can patch up damage to an object with a quick fix.

feats.name: Path of Iron
feats.notes: With a burst of effort and speed, you weave a nimble path through your many enemies, striking each in turn as you move past them.

feats.name: Pathfinder Agent Dedication
feats.notes: You're a field agent of the globe-trotting Pathfinder Society.
feats.access: You are from Absalom.

feats.name: Patron Reborn
feats.notes: You have fully realized the ability to serve as a patron.

feats.name: Patron's Breadth
feats.notes: You can cast more spells each day.

feats.name: Patron's Glamour
feats.notes: Gathering up threads of your old connection, you can temporarily disguise yourself as your missing patron.

feats.name: Patron's Truth
feats.notes: You have mastered the greatest secrets of your patron’s magic and learned a fundamental truth about your patron, even if their identity still remains a mystery.

feats.name: Patron's Whisper
feats.notes: You gain the ability to speak to your charge over great distances.

feats.name: Patronize the Arts
feats.notes: A true aristocrat knows how to encourage their best hirelings, ensuring loyalty and future excellence.
feats.trigger: An ally within 30 feet of you critically succeeds at an attack roll or skill check.

feats.name: Patron’s Claim
feats.notes: Your patron partially manifests itself through your familiar to claim a foe’s power for its own.

feats.name: Patron’s Presence
feats.notes: Your patron can direct its attention through your familiar, and its mere presence becomes an ominous weight on the minds of other beings to distract them and blot out their magic.

feats.name: Pattern Flight
feats.notes: You place a bit of magic in a physical projectile, causing it to fly in a runic pattern through the air once you loose it.

feats.name: Peafowl Stance
feats.notes: You enter a tall and proud stance while remaining mobile, with all the grace and composure of a peafowl.

feats.name: Peafowl Strut
feats.notes: You slowly move across the battlefield with dangerous grace.

feats.name: Peculiar Anatomy
feats.notes: Your circulatory system contains viscous protoplasmic fluid instead of ordinary blood.

feats.name: Peer Beyond
feats.notes: You have uncanny insight into the way ghosts and haunts manifest, manipulate the mind, and rejuvenate.

feats.name: Peer Past the Hedge
feats.notes: You can pick up on subtle magic with ease.

feats.name: Peerless Captain
feats.notes: When you have an active follower in an encounter, you are quickened.

feats.name: Peerless Form
feats.notes: Your mastery over your body is perfect enough to hold back the ravages of time.

feats.name: Peerless Mascot Companion
feats.notes: As veterans of countless battles, you and your companion share an indomitable strength.

feats.name: Peerless Warden
feats.notes: Your mastery of primal magic has given you access to the greatest secrets of warden magic.

feats.name: Pei Zing Adept
feats.notes: You’re practiced at timing preparations to the point where you can treat multiple patients at once.
feats.prerequisite: Prepare Elemental Medicine; Expert in Crafting, Herbalism Lore, or Expert in Medicine
feats.access: Tian Xia origin

feats.name: Pelagic Aptitude
feats.notes: You've learned special tricks to survive underwater.

feats.name: Penetrating Fire
feats.notes: You blast a bullet through one foe and into another.

feats.name: Penetrating Projectile
feats.notes: Your projectiles are unhindered by flesh and bone.

feats.name: Penetrating Shot
feats.notes: You shoot clear through an intervening creature to hit your prey.

feats.name: Pennant of Victory
feats.notes: You wave your banner in victory, signaling to your allies that the fight is won.

feats.name: Peony's Flourish
feats.notes: As you spin around and create wide arching circles with your fans, you manifest a mosaic of peonies that confuses your enemies.

feats.name: Perfect Clarity
feats.notes: You burn out all your rage to ensure that your attack lands and your mind remains free.
feats.trigger: You fail or critically fail an attack roll or Will save.

feats.name: Perfect Debilitation
feats.notes: You have perfected the formulas for bombs that impede your enemies.

feats.name: Perfect Distraction
feats.notes: You use clever tactics to mislead your foes as you sneak away.

feats.name: Perfect Dive
feats.notes: You dive into the water with exceptional skill and connection to the waves, urging the water itself to cushion your fall.
feats.source: Absalom, City of Lost Omens, Azarketi Ancestry Web Supplement

feats.name: Perfect Encore
feats.notes: You develop another incredible creation.

feats.name: Perfect Finisher
feats.notes: You focus your panache into an impeccable assault.

feats.name: Perfect Form Control
feats.notes: Thanks to magic and muscle memory, you can stay in your alternate shapes indefinitely.

feats.name: Perfect Ki Adept
feats.notes: You gain the appropriate ki spell for your School of Perfection.

feats.name: Perfect Ki Exemplar
feats.notes: You gain an appropriate ki spell for your School of Perfection: unblinking flame emblem for Unblinking Flame, unbreaking wave barrier for Unbreaking Waves, unfolding wind blitz for Unfolding Wind, or untwisting iron augmentation for Untwisting Iron.

feats.name: Perfect Ki Expert
feats.notes: You gain an appropriate ki spell for your School of Perfection: unblinking flame aura for Unblinking Flame, unbreaking wave vapor for Unbreaking Waves, unfolding wind buffet for Unfolding Wind, or untwisting iron roots for Untwisting Iron.

feats.name: Perfect Ki Grandmaster
feats.notes: You gain an appropriate ki spell for your School of Perfection: unblinking flame ignition for Unblinking Flame, unbreaking wave containment for Unbreaking Waves, unfolding wind crash for Unfolding Wind, or untwisting iron pillar for Untwisting Iron.
feats.prerequisite: Perfect Ki Expert or Perfect Ki Exemplar

feats.name: Perfect Mutagen
feats.notes: You have enhanced the formulas for your mutagens, aligning them perfectly to your physiology.

feats.name: Perfect Pitch
feats.notes: Your ear for harmony has enhanced your ability with musical magic.

feats.name: Perfect Protection
feats.notes: Your armor protects you from the deadliest hits.

feats.name: Perfect Readiness
feats.notes: You prepare to fire with an instinctive speed and muscle memory that go beyond your conscious thoughts.

feats.name: Perfect Resistance
feats.notes: You gain resistance equal to half your level to all damage from effects with the appropriate trait for your School of Perfection: fire for Unblinking Flame, water for Unbreaking Waves, air for Unfolding Wind, and earth for Untwisting Iron.

feats.name: Perfect Shot
