feats.notes: After watching the motions of combat with incredible intensity and precision, you fire at your prey at the perfect moment to deliver maximum pain.

feats.name: Perfect Strike
feats.notes: You call upon insight from your training to recover accuracy.

feats.name: Perfect Truths
feats.notes: Your knowledge of Razmir’s faith and doctrines has grown.

feats.name: Perfect Weaponry
feats.notes: You gain the Monastic Weaponry monk class feat.

feats.name: Perfected Evaluations
feats.notes: You instantly assess the strengths and weaknesses of the enemy forces.

feats.name: Perfected Gamtu
feats.notes: Your hat embodies the illusory grandeur of a master dokkaebi.

feats.name: Perfected Thrall
feats.notes: Using your accumulated knowledge of all forms of necromancy, you create the perfect thrall.

feats.name: Perfection's Path
feats.notes: Choose one saving throw (Fortitude, Reflex, or Will) in which you’re an expert.
feats.prerequisite: Monk Dedication; expert in at least one saving throw

feats.name: Performance Weapon Expert
feats.notes: Your experience has made you better with a wide variety of weapons.
feats.prerequisite: Provocator Dedication; expert in any kind of weapon or unarmed attack

feats.name: Performative Weapons Training
feats.notes: You're skilled with flashy weapons and can use them to great effect.

feats.name: Performer's Treatment
feats.notes: With your experience as a performer, you can keep a set of medical tools handy at all times.
feats.prerequisite: Expert in Medicine; Expert in Performance

feats.name: Perfume Cloud
feats.notes: You issue a cloud of your fragrance like a full-body sneeze—but one that might save your life as the powerful perfume makes your attackers' eyes sting and water.

feats.name: Peri Magic
feats.notes: The shimmering embers of the righteous peris crackle at your fingertips.

feats.name: Pernicious Poison
feats.notes: You can add a toxic additive to an alchemical poison to make it splash poison on its target.

feats.name: Perpetual Breadth
feats.notes: You have expanded your supply of near-infinite items.

feats.name: Perpetual Scout
feats.notes: You spot anything out of place in the areas you know best.

feats.name: Perplex
feats.notes: You weave a confusing web of half-truths, conspiracy theories, and plausible motives to goad an enemy into lashing out wildly.

feats.name: Persistent Boost
feats.notes: Your innovation sets foes on fire, covers them in acid, leaves barbed thorns behind, or otherwise deals persistent damage to your foes that sticks around long after you deliver your boosted attack.

feats.name: Persistent Creation
feats.notes: You can cast creation as an innate spell at will, choosing whether it is arcane or primal each time.

feats.name: Persistent Mutagen
feats.notes: You've trained your physical form to remain stable.

feats.name: Persistent Odor
feats.notes: Your pheromones now linger on creatures.

feats.name: Person of Interest
feats.notes: Sometimes, you need to follow the leads as they come in the middle of an investigation.

feats.name: Personalized Poisoning
feats.notes: You developed techniques for discovering a target’s weaknesses to poisons using your forensic knowledge.
feats.access: member of the Red Mantis assassins

feats.name: Pervasive Superstition
feats.notes: You steep yourself in superstition and practice ancient orc mental exercises for shrugging off the effects of magic.

feats.name: Pesh Skin
feats.notes: Your plant form sprouts hundreds of spines, and your blood causes mild hallucinations in creatures exposed to it.

feats.name: Pet
feats.notes: You have a loyal pet

feats.name: Petal District Socialite
feats.notes: Through your experience with the many parties held nightly in clubs and estates within the Petal District, you understand the way rumors and gossip circulate during social events.

feats.name: Petal Step
feats.notes: You have a mastery over your own movement and can distribute your weight to dance lightly over the ground like petals drifting on the water.

feats.name: Petrified Skin
feats.notes: You were the target of some petrifying effect, and an element of that stony gaze has remained with you.
feats.prerequisite: You have been petrified by an enemy.

feats.name: Petrifying Gaze Mimicry
feats.notes: Either by witnessing or surviving the petrifying stare of a medusa or similar creature, you have learned to petrify those you lock eyes with.
feats.prerequisite: Wild Mimic Dedication; you have attempted a saving throw against a creature’s petrifying gaze or a similar ability or have identified a creature with such an ability in combat

feats.name: Phalanx Breaker
feats.notes: You know that to take out an enemy formation, you must punch a hole through its center.

feats.name: Phalanx Formation (Guardian)
feats.notes: You know how to clear a line of fire for your allies.

feats.name: Phalanx Formation (Knight Vigilant)
feats.notes: You know how to clear a line of fire for your allies.

feats.name: Phantom Charm
feats.notes: You can harness the spiritual connection in your blood, allowing you to shift the negative threads of fate.
feats.trigger: You attempt a check that would be subject to a misfortune effect.

feats.name: Phantom Orchestra
feats.notes: An easy way to trick others is to throw your voice into a nearby forest or thicket to make strange noises.

feats.name: Phantom Resemblance
feats.notes: Your can now draw from experience to wear any face you remember.

feats.name: Phantom Visage
feats.notes: You cloak yourself in illusions to mask your nature.
feats.access: dokkaebi goblin heritage

feats.name: Phase Bullet
feats.notes: You can aim your bullets not just in three normal dimensions, but in additional dimensions as well, removing all obstacles between you and your target.

feats.name: Phase Out
feats.notes: Your eidolon phases out of reality slightly, gaining resistance to all damage (except force , spirit , and vitality ) equal to half your level.

feats.name: Phenom's Verve
feats.notes: You're possessed with an incredibly vivacious spark that separates you not only from ordinary gun users and gunslingers, but even from other phenoms.

feats.name: Pheromonal Message
feats.notes: Your communicative pheromones are particularly well developed from years of living with other athamarus.

feats.name: Phoenix's Flight
feats.notes: You and your familiar learn the secrets of elemental fire, allowing you to merge together to become a legendary creature—a phoenix .

feats.name: Phonetic Training
feats.notes: You can pronounce and repeat words with near-perfect accuracy even if you don’t understand their meaning, and you can write them down in a phonetic script that allows you or another creature with Phonetic Training to read it later.

feats.name: Physical Training
feats.notes: You spend a lot of time focusing on your physical fitness.
feats.prerequisite: Swordmaster Dedication; Expert in Acrobatics; Expert in Athletics

feats.name: Pick Up the Pace
feats.notes: You lead by example and can help others push themselves beyond their normal limits.

feats.name: Pickpocket
feats.notes: Steal or Palm an Object more effectively

feats.name: Pied Piping
feats.notes: You learn the pied piping composition spell, which enables you to control the actions of weak-minded individuals.

feats.name: Pierce the Darkness
feats.notes: Your eyes have adapted to see in all circumstances, even without the assistance of light.

feats.name: Pierce The Eye
feats.notes: You aim a shot from your weapon directly at a foe’s eye, blinding them in the process.

feats.name: Pierce the Light
feats.notes: You tear the veil between the Material Plane and its shadow.

feats.name: Piercing Critical
feats.notes: Your attacks with your preferred weapons deal especially devastating wounds.

feats.name: Piercing Doom
feats.notes: You have grown accustomed to the curse that comes with your blessing, able to channel its effects through your attacks and forestall your own demise.

feats.name: Piercing Jab
feats.notes: Your eidolon runs an enemy through with a horn or similar attack.

feats.name: Piercing Quills
feats.notes: Your quills can dig particularly deep into the flesh of your opponents.

feats.name: Pilgrim's Token
feats.notes: You carry a small token of protection from a site holy to your faith.
feats.prerequisite: Trained in Religion; follower of a specific religion

feats.name: Pin to the Spot
feats.notes: Strike a foe and restrain them.

feats.name: Pinch Time
feats.notes: One of your parents has a human life span and another an elven life span, with your own somewhere between.

feats.name: Pinning Fire
feats.notes: You target your opponent's clothing, equipment, or loose flesh with a series of piercing projectiles to pin them to the ground or a nearby surface.
feats.trigger: You use Flurry of Blows to make two ranged piercing weapon Strikes against the same target.

feats.name: Pinpoint Poisoner
feats.notes: Unsuspecting targets are especially vulnerable to your poisons.

feats.name: Pirate Combat Training
feats.notes: You're particularly skilled at wielding the weapons used traditionally by pirates.

feats.name: Pirate Dedication
feats.notes: As a pirate, you sail the seas in search of enemy ships to plunder and great adventures to embark on.

feats.name: Pirate's Pet
feats.notes: An animal has become your loyal ally, perhaps after you liberated it from another ship or found it on a remote island.
feats.access: You're from the Shackles

feats.name: Pirouette
feats.notes: You twirl gracefully, spinning on one foot to evade your opponent's attack.
feats.trigger: An enemy targets you with a Strike.

feats.name: Pistol Phenom Dedication
feats.notes: You catch an opponent off-guard by spinning your weapon.
feats.prerequisite: trained in at least one type of one-handed firearm; Trained in Deception; Trained in Performance

feats.name: Pistol Twirl
feats.notes: Your quick gestures and flair for performance distract your opponent, leaving it vulnerable to your follow-up attacks.

feats.name: Pistolero's Challenge
feats.notes: With a stern call, carefully chosen barb, or some other challenging declaration, you demand your foe's attention in a duel.

feats.name: Piston Punch
feats.notes: You lash out with a powerful punch, extending your dynamo to a greater length in order to attack two creatures in a row.

feats.name: Pit of Snakes
feats.notes: Mundane serpents obey your summons.

feats.name: Pitborn
feats.notes: Your blood bears the mark of a demon.

feats.name: Pivot Strike
feats.notes: You Leap and then Strike using your staff.
feats.source: Pathfinder #151: The Show Must Go On

feats.name: Plague Rat
feats.notes: Your bites carry a cursed infection.

feats.name: Plague Sniffer
feats.notes: You can sniff out the pungent tang of disease.

feats.name: Planar Resilience
feats.notes: Your body has adapted to the variety of harsh climes that you encounter in your travels.

feats.name: Planar Sidestep
feats.notes: You shift your body briefly between planes, reducing the damage from your foe's attack.
feats.trigger: A creature hits you with a melee Strike.

feats.name: Planar Survival
feats.notes: Use Survival to Subsist on different planes

feats.name: Planar Traveler
feats.notes: You concentrate on the spaces between planes, allowing you to enhance your movement for a short period.
feats.trigger: Your turn begins.

feats.name: Plane Hop
feats.notes: The spaces between planes are obvious to you, and you can use them to move in unexpected ways.

feats.name: Plane Step
feats.notes: You temporarily move just beyond the threshold of the current plane, granting you concealment until the end of your next turn.

feats.name: Plane-Stepping Dash
feats.notes: You move with magical swiftness, treading between planar boundaries to shorten your journey.

feats.name: Plant Banner
feats.notes: You plant your banner to inspire your allies to hold the line.

feats.name: Plant Empathy
feats.notes: You have a connection to flora that allows you to communicate with them on a rudimentary level.

feats.name: Plant Evidence
feats.notes: You can put a single item you’re holding of light or negligible Bulk onto a person without them noticing by succeeding at a Thievery check against their Perception DC.

feats.name: Plant Shape
feats.notes: You can take the shape of a plant creature.

feats.name: Plant Soul Siblings
feats.notes: You’re now able to connect with the spirits present in the greenery of the natural world.

feats.name: Plate in Treasure
feats.notes: Precious metal flows from your fingers to plate an object.

feats.name: Play Dead
feats.notes: You lie prone and pretend to be an ordinary skeleton.

feats.name: Play to the Crowd
feats.notes: You show off for the crowd.
feats.trigger: You reduce an enemy to 0 Hit Points during a combat encounter with spectators.

feats.name: Play to the Crowd
feats.notes: You have a knack for knowing just how to manipulate groups by saying exactly what needs to be said.

feats.name: Plentiful Snares
feats.notes: You can prepare incredible numbers of snares each day out of simple ingredients.

feats.name: Plot the Future
feats.notes: You spend 10 minutes in contemplation to uncannily predict how events will play out.

feats.name: Pluck From the Sky
feats.notes: The skies are your rightful place, and you will not suffer another to occupy them.
feats.access: tengu , strix , or awakened animal ( flying animal ) ancestry

feats.name: Plum Deluge
feats.notes: You have learned to saturate an area with poison.

feats.name: Plumekith
feats.notes: Your blood soars with the power of the magnificent garuda, proud and stoic avian warriors.

feats.name: Plummeting Roll
feats.notes: Through nimble movements, a graceful landing, and a bit of luck, you can manage to fall from spectacular heights without a scratch.

feats.name: Point Blank Stance
feats.notes: You take aim to pick off nearby enemies quickly.

feats.name: Poison Coat
feats.notes: In nature, certain animals are covered in venomous spines, and just brushing against them can prove deadly.

feats.name: Poison Drinker
feats.notes: You temporarily transform your digestive system to instead gain a burst of sustenance from the poison you ingest.
feats.trigger: You critically succeed on a Fortitude save against a poison effect.

feats.name: Poison Resistance
feats.notes: Your affinity for the natural world grants you protection against some of its dangers.

feats.name: Poison Weapon
feats.notes: You apply a contact poison or injury poison to the required weapon; if you have a free hand, you can Interact to draw a poison as part of this action.

feats.name: Poisoned Sticks and Stones
feats.notes: You prepare your sling stones with small, edged grooves to enable them to deliver poison, and you have learned other techniques for poisoning your weapons.

feats.name: Poisoner Dedication
feats.notes: You make a point of always having a few toxins near at hand—you never know when some arsenic or the like might prove useful.

feats.name: Poisoner's Twist
feats.notes: Poisons attack specific parts of the body—one venom might target the lungs, another the circulatory system, while another deteriorates the nerves.

feats.name: Polearm Tricks
feats.notes: Your connection to rune magic has revealed tricks to make polearms deadlier in your hands.

feats.name: Polished Distraction
feats.notes: You take pride in the sheen of your armor, and how useful it is at distracting your enemies when you reflect light from it.

feats.name: Political Acumen
feats.notes: You have spent years following the political maneuvering and secret alliances of elves in Iadara.

feats.name: Political Virtuoso
feats.notes: Your mastery of the politics of your home nation is profound.

feats.name: Pollinate
feats.notes: As you’re hit, you emit a dense cloud of pollen, obscuring you from sight.
feats.trigger: You take bludgeoning damage.

feats.name: Polymorphic Escape
feats.notes: You polymorph into a tiny vermin, a cloud of leaves, or another shape that allows you to escape.
feats.trigger: You would become grabbed , immobilized , prone , or restrained .

feats.name: Ponpoko
feats.notes: No true tanuki would ever be caught without a musical instrument to play under the full moon.

feats.name: Ponpoko-pon!
feats.notes: Whether it’s because you play especially vigorously or are simply off-key, the music of your belly drum can physically wound your foes.

feats.name: Portentous Spell
feats.notes: Your spellcasting is rife with strange lights, mild fumes, and other captivating effects that befuddle your foes.

feats.name: Portents of the Haruspex
feats.notes: Although the divinations of a haruspex traditionally require organs and lengthy interpretation, you've learned how to glimpse the future in a more simple fashion by reading creatures' wounds.
feats.trigger: A creature within 30 feet is reduced to 0 Hit Points in a way that doesn't destroy their body.

feats.name: Positioning Assault
feats.notes: With punishing blows, you force your opponent into position.

feats.name: Positive Luminance
feats.notes: You learn how to create a luminous reservoir of positive energy that you can use to punish undead who dare attack you.

feats.name: Posse
feats.notes: By spending 1 minute giving guidance to help hunt down your prey, you instruct up to five willing creatures to assist you.

feats.name: Potent Nectar
feats.notes: Your nectar becomes particularly dangerous.

feats.name: Potent Poisoner
feats.notes: By concentrating your poisons’ toxic components, you make them harder for victims to resist.

feats.name: Poultice Preparation
feats.notes: When you create an elixir as an herbal item, you can prepare it as a poultice instead.

feats.name: Pounce Mimicry
feats.notes: You have mastered the art of stalking your prey and striking when they are most vulnerable.
feats.prerequisite: Wild Mimic Dedication; you have seen a creature use an ability that lets them Stride and Strike as a single action (such as Pounce) or have identified a creature with such an ability in combat

feats.name: Pouncing Transformation
feats.notes: By transforming as you move, you attack from odd angles.
feats.prerequisite: Werecreature Dedication; your animal shape has a land Speed only

feats.name: Pounding Leap
feats.notes: You use the momentum of your massive fists to launch yourself through the air.

feats.name: Powder Punch Stance
feats.notes: You infuse your handwraps with black powder .
feats.access: You're from Alkenstar or the Mana Wastes.

feats.name: Power Hungry
feats.notes: You focus your hunger, allowing you to consume even more power from your thralls.

feats.name: Power Slide
feats.notes: You throw the vehicle into a barely controlled skid, turning sharply to evade pursuit or bring your weapons to bear.

feats.name: Powerful Guts
feats.notes: Your stomach is particularly durable.

feats.name: Powerful Lash
feats.notes: You've learned to swing your lash ever faster and in wider arcs.

feats.name: Powerful Leap
feats.notes: Jump farther and higher

feats.name: Powerful Shove
feats.notes: You can push larger foes around with your attack.

feats.name: Powerful Snares
feats.notes: Your snares are particularly dif cult for enemies to avoid.

feats.name: Powerful Sneak
feats.notes: You’ve learned to exploit your enemies’ openings.

feats.name: Powerful Tail
feats.notes: You resemble an animal or a type of humanoid who has a tail.

feats.name: Practical Magic
feats.notes: +1 to Magic checks, use Magic instead of Engineering

feats.name: Practical Magic
feats.notes: Want not, waste not; through a mix of frugality, inspiration, and sheer resourcefulness, you maintain a catalog of materials with ambient, lingering magic, which you can transform into temporary spell catalysts .

feats.name: Practiced Brawn
feats.notes: You're accustomed to long days filled with hard physical labor.

feats.name: Practiced Defender
feats.notes: After extensive practice with the Swords, you're comfortable enough with your shield to move at a normal pace with it raised.

feats.name: Practiced Guidance
feats.notes: You can better Aid your crop.

feats.name: Practiced Opposition
feats.notes: You've battled more undead than you care to remember, often with little time to prepare between foes, forcing you to rely on experience and muscle memory to guide your blade.

feats.name: Practiced Paddler
feats.notes: You’re skilled at navigating bogs and marshes, even for a paddler shoony.

feats.name: Practiced Reflexes
feats.notes: You snap out a quick series of signals or commands that urge your allies to act with alacrity.

feats.name: Practiced Reloads
feats.notes: You've mastered the reloading techniques and methods usually practiced by only the most dedicated firearm professionals.

feats.name: Prairie Rider
feats.notes: You grew up riding your clan's shaggy ponies and riding dogs.

feats.name: Prayer Attack
feats.notes: You’ve mastered the signature assassination style of the Red Mantis.

feats.name: Prayer-Touched Weapon
feats.notes: You coat a weapon you're wielding in prayers and the divine power given to you by your deity.
feats.prerequisite: divine spells, you follow a good-aligned deity
feats.access: Knights of Lastwall have access to this feat.

feats.name: Precious Alloys
feats.notes: Your unarmed attacks gain the properties of special materials.

feats.name: Precious Ammunition
feats.notes: You have learned to mimic the power that lies between magic and material.

feats.name: Precious Munitions
feats.notes: You mix flecks of precious materials you've gathered on your journeys into your custom bullets to bring out those properties in your temporary ammunition.

feats.name: Precise Debilitations
feats.notes: You attack with great precision.

feats.name: Precise Finisher
feats.notes: Even when your foe avoids your Confident Finisher , you can still hit a vital spot.

feats.name: Precise Hooks
feats.notes: Your body is a varied and deadly weapon.

feats.name: Predator's Growl
feats.notes: You give a throaty growl to attempt to Demoralize a creature you just found.
feats.trigger: You successfully Seek a hidden or undetected creature.

feats.name: Predator's Pounce
feats.notes: You close the distance to your prey in a blur, pouncing on the creature before it can react.

feats.name: Predatory Claws
feats.notes: Your nails grow into sharp claws, perfect for seizing and tearing your prey.

feats.name: Predict Weather
feats.notes: By observing often subtle indicators in the environment, you may try to predict the day's weather.

feats.name: Predictable!
feats.notes: By observing an opponent, you can get a sense of their next move and prepare to counter or resist it.

feats.name: Predictive Purchase
feats.notes: You have just the thing for the situation.

feats.name: Predictive Purchase (Rogue)
feats.notes: You somehow manage to have just the thing for the situation.

feats.name: Predispose Settlement
feats.notes: You spend 7 days of downtime seeding propaganda through a settlement with a population of 2,500 or fewer.
feats.prerequisite: Field Propagandist Dedication; Expert in Deception

feats.name: Preemptive Reconfiguration
feats.notes: Your body anticipates the blow.
feats.trigger: You would take bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage.

feats.name: Premonition of Avoidance
feats.notes: Your deity grants you a moment’s foresight.
feats.trigger: You are about to roll a saving throw against a hazard

feats.name: Premonition of Clarity
feats.notes: Your deity sends you a vision of faith to steel you against mental attacks.
feats.trigger: You fail a saving throw against a mental effect

feats.name: Preparation
feats.notes: You survey the battlefield, calculating the possibilities.

feats.name: Prepare Elemental Medicine
feats.notes: You diagnose your patient, then prepare and administer a dose of elemental medicine to a creature.
feats.prerequisite: Trained in Crafting, Herbalism Lore, or Trained in Medicine
feats.access: Tian Xia origin

feats.name: Prepare Papers
feats.notes: You're practiced at creating forgeries that establish your outlaw credentials or augment your legal authority.
feats.prerequisite: Alkenstar Agent Dedication; Master in Society

feats.name: Prescience
feats.notes: Mythic power floods through your mind, filling you with visions of possible futures, events that might or might not happen, and warnings of things that might be.
feats.trigger: You’re about to roll initiative .

feats.name: Prescient Consumable
feats.notes: Procure consumable items with Prescient Planner

feats.name: Prescient Parry
feats.notes: Your warshard weapon intervenes at the last second, rising to deflect the incoming blow.
feats.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star
feats.trigger: You are targeted by a melee or ranged Strike with a weapon.

feats.name: Prescient Planner
feats.notes: Procure a piece of adventuring gear

feats.name: Preserve the Horde
feats.notes: The act of summoning additional undead minions doesn't make you lose the focus required to maintain the animation of your horde.
feats.trigger: You cast summon undead .

feats.name: Preserve the Moment
feats.notes: Sometimes, your actions are so successful and impressive that it’s worth going back to them.
feats.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star
feats.trigger: Your turn ends.

feats.name: Pressure Change
feats.notes: You sink or rise rapidly alongside your target, altering their internal pressure.

feats.name: Preternatural Parry
feats.notes: You snap your weapon or limb into place to ward off harm.
feats.trigger: You’re targeted by a Strike or a spell attack, or you’re about to roll a saving throw against a spell effect.

feats.name: Preternatural Polish
feats.notes: Armor you polish shines with righteous grace.

feats.name: Prevailing Position
feats.notes: Your flexibility with stances lets you sacrifice their benefits to better protect yourself.
feats.trigger: You are targeted by an attack or attempt a Reflex saving throw against a damaging effect, and you are in a stance .

feats.name: Preventative Treatment
feats.notes: You provide preventative remedies and care to help your patient fight off future maladies.
feats.access: Knights of Lastwall have access to this feat.

feats.name: Pride Hunter
feats.notes: You avoid the attention of creatures focused on your allies.

feats.name: Pride in Arms
feats.notes: With a shout of triumph, you grant inspiration to an ally fight on.
feats.trigger: An ally within 30 feet brings an enemy to 0 Hit Points.

feats.name: Primadonna
feats.notes: The spotlight should always be on you and you alone.

feats.name: Primal Aegis
feats.notes: You surround yourself with a thick field of protective primal energy.

feats.name: Primal Breadth
feats.notes: Increase the spell slots you gain from druid archetype feats by 1 for each spell rank other than your two highest druid spell slots.

feats.name: Primal Dragonblood
feats.notes: A dragon with a deep connection to the natural world, such as an adamantine dragon or a horned dragon , resides somewhere on your family tree.

feats.name: Primal Evolution
feats.notes: You can call upon the creatures of the wild for aid.

feats.name: Primal Focus
feats.notes: Your connection to nature is particularly strong, and the spirits of nature flock around you, helping you replenish your focus.

feats.name: Primal Guardian
feats.notes: You grow in power as a guardian of nature.

feats.name: Primal Howl
feats.notes: Your companion can let out a howl laced with your primal magic.

feats.name: Primal Proportions
feats.notes: You can mimic the sheer mass of the largest beasts.

feats.name: Primal Rampage
feats.notes: You gain unfettered movement and mountain resilience as 4th-rank primal innate spells that you can cast once per day.

feats.name: Primal Summons
feats.notes: Whenever you summon an ally, you can empower it with the elemental power of air, earth, fire, or water.

feats.name: Prismatic Scales
feats.notes: You can cause your scales to glow with scintillating, many-hued colors, protecting you from energy while dazzling foes.

feats.name: Pristine Weapon
feats.notes: Your verdant weapon can cut through the resistances of magical creatures.

feats.name: Prodigal Rune-Singer
feats.notes: You have mastered the art of singing your runes.

feats.name: Prodigious Climber
feats.notes: Your natural climbing ability and technique has made you a potent climber.

feats.name: Profane Bargain
feats.notes: You can strike a profane bargain with a willing, sapient creature.

feats.name: Progenitor Lore
feats.notes: You didn't just inherit your physical form from your progenitor; you also retained some of their knowledge.

feats.name: Project Persona
feats.notes: Where others etch their armor to serve as a conduit for their imaginations, your vivid mind and bold personality allow you to project a more fitting persona over your lackluster armor.

feats.name: Projectile Snatching
feats.notes: You pluck missiles from the air and hurl them back at their source.

feats.name: Prolific Prophet Spellcasting
feats.notes: Increase the number of spells in your repertoire and the number of spell slots you gain from prophet of Kalistrade archetype feats by 1 for each spell rank other than your two highest prophet of Kalistrade spell slots.

feats.name: Promise of Pain
feats.notes: You call out to an enemy in distress, promising them a future of unending pain.
feats.prerequisite: Sister of the Golden Erinys Dedication

feats.name: Propelled Leap
feats.notes: Like a flying fish, you can build up momentum and launch yourself into the air.

feats.name: Propeller Attachment
feats.notes: You've mastered attaching clockwork propellers to your daily quick-deploy snares that use gears.

feats.name: Propelling Sorcery
feats.notes: The force of your magic can be used to propel yourself or another.

feats.name: Prophesied Monarch Dedication
feats.notes: Your Calling has culminated in a destiny of rulership, and you’re able to forge a mythic bond with noble knights whose destinies become intertwined with your own.

feats.name: Prophet of Kalistrade Dedication
feats.notes: After induction into the ranks of the Kalistocrats, you learned the skills necessary to succeed in business and rise above others by following a set of detailed strictures.
feats.prerequisite: trained in Mercantile Lore; Trained in Society; Charisma +2
feats.access: You’re from Druma.

feats.name: Prophet's Lockbox
feats.notes: You’ve learned secret methods that allow you to store your valuables where no one else can reach them.

feats.name: Propulsive Leap
feats.notes: By expelling flames from your feet or levitating through electrical repulsion, you propel yourself through the air.

feats.name: Propulsive Mutation
feats.notes: Your ostilli can fire its dart farther.

feats.name: Proteankin
feats.notes: Your blood bubbles with the roiling quintessence of the Maelstrom, the infinite sea of primal chaos that long ago spawned the other Outer Planes.

feats.name: Protect Ally
feats.notes: You place your body between your friends and your enemies, protecting your allies against oncoming attacks.

feats.name: Protect the Royal Line
feats.notes: You must keep your royal person safe from harm, especially when surrounded by those who would dare approach you.

feats.name: Protective Bond
feats.notes: The power of your bond can protect you and your eidolon from harm.
feats.trigger: You and your eidolon are in a damaging effect’s area.

feats.name: Protective Claws
feats.notes: The chitin on your claws is so hard you can defend against attacks with them.

feats.name: Protective Cycle
feats.notes: You react to harm by flowing into an elemental stance with new advantages.
feats.trigger: You take damage from an attack.

feats.name: Protective Pose
feats.notes: Many physical poses can fortify one’s health, but some poses need more than one body to accomplish.
feats.access: Tian Xia origin

feats.name: Protective Sheath
feats.notes: When you lash out with your clan dagger, you keep its sheath close at hand.

feats.name: Protective Spirit Mask
feats.notes: Your mask carries the protective instincts of White Bull, the Horn Forger, and no one will hurt your allies while you have anything to say about it.

feats.name: Protective Strike
feats.notes: You keep harm at bay.
feats.trigger: A creature moves adjacent to or attempts a melee Strike against your designated ally.

feats.name: Protective Subroutine
feats.notes: Your nanites can augment your defenses.

feats.name: Prototype Companion
feats.notes: You have created a construct companion, and while it might not be an innovation, it serves as a trustworthy minion.

feats.name: Proud Mentor
feats.notes: You enjoy mentoring others and take pride in your students' accomplishments.

feats.name: Proud Nail
feats.notes: When a foe ignores your taunts, you make them pay.

feats.name: Provocator Dedication
feats.notes: For you, fighting is as much about style as skill.
feats.access: Successfully defeat the eberarks in the Irorium.

feats.name: Proximity Alert
feats.notes: You're unnaturally in tune with your surroundings and react instinctively to danger.

feats.name: Psi Burst
feats.notes: With a passing thought, you direct violent psychic energies at a nearby creature.

feats.name: Psi Catastrophe
feats.notes: You stop holding your power back, unleashing it all in a catastrophic blast.

feats.name: Psi Development
feats.notes: You’ve found a new mental form

feats.name: Psi Strikes
feats.notes: You siphon residual psychic energies from your spell into one weapon you're wielding or one of your unarmed attacks.

feats.name: Psychic Dedication
feats.notes: You feel something awaken within your mind

feats.name: Psychic Duelist Dedication
feats.notes: Through experience and in-depth visualizations of mental battles, you've grown adept at psychic duels.
feats.prerequisite: Trained in Occultism; you have been in a psychic duel

feats.name: Psychic Rapport
feats.notes: Your telepathic sensitivity intensifies when you're affected by mental magic, making it easier for you to link to other creatures.

feats.name: Psychopomp Familiar
feats.notes: Your familiar becomes a masked psychopomp —an extraplanar guardian of the cycle of souls.

feats.name: Public Execution
feats.notes: Some rebel Firebrand cells make a practice of publicly declaring the main target of a given operation.
feats.access: Members of the Firebrands at the rank of second mark or higher have access to this feat.

feats.name: Pull Together
feats.notes: Your citizens help mitigate failures

feats.name: Pummeling Whirlpool
feats.notes: You draw water from the environs, swirling it into a rough torrent around you to punish your foes.

feats.name: Puncturing Horn
feats.notes: While many kashrishi never use their horns for more than cracking open hard-shelled fruits or amplifying their psychic powers, you've practiced using yours offensively.

feats.name: Punishing Shove
feats.notes: When you push a foe away, you put the entire force of your armored form into it.

feats.name: Pupil's Guard
feats.notes: You're intimately familiar with your student's motions and are ready to step in at a moment's notice should anything threaten to disrupt them.
feats.trigger: Your student would be targeted with a reaction (such as Reactive Strike ) due to their Stride or manipulate action.

feats.name: Pure Legion Enforcer Dedication
feats.notes: You are sworn to uphold the Laws of Mortality within the borders of Rahadoum.

feats.name: Purge of Moments
feats.notes: All things eventually end, a truth that you can put into practice by accelerating your passage through time to shake off harmful effects.

feats.name: Purge Sins
feats.notes: You call on your celestial forebears to rid your body of all toxins and impurities.

feats.name: Purge System
feats.notes: You can sense the influence of harmful toxins in your body, and you heat and cool various parts of your body to expel them.

feats.name: Purify Element
feats.notes: You turn an element into its purest form.

feats.name: Purifying Breeze
feats.notes: You transfer the divine essence of your magic to the air around you, cleansing it of toxins.
feats.access: Knights of Lastwall have access to this feat.

feats.name: Purifying Spell
feats.notes: You purify the water within a creature's body to cleanse them of illness.

feats.name: Push Back the Dead!
feats.notes: You call to your ally and strengthen their resolve and abilities to defend against the horrific tricks undead bring to bear.
feats.access: Knights of Lastwall have access to this feat.

feats.name: Push it
feats.notes: You can push your vehicle's performance beyond the limits envisioned by its makers.
feats.prerequisite: Trick Driver Dedication; Master in Driving Lore

feats.name: Pushing Wind
feats.notes: As you spin and glide your fans alongside your allies, you kick up a mild wind that gently carries you all forward.

feats.name: Putrefaction
feats.notes: You spoil the food and water nearby, even within your foes’ bodies.

feats.name: Puzzle Solver
feats.notes: You have a natural affinity for problem-solving and the unknown.

feats.name: Pyre Ant Sting
feats.notes: Your swarm's stings burn with agonizing pain, much like that caused by the bright red pyre ants that make their tunnels within the parched sands of deserts like Qadira.

feats.name: Pyrophilic Recovery
feats.notes: You rely on fire and extreme heat to sprout and regrow.
feats.access: Pine leshies have access to this feat

feats.name: Qi Center
feats.notes: You center yourself with the universe and draw upon its vast power.
feats.prerequisite: Master of Many Styles; Qi Spells

feats.name: Qi Spells
feats.notes: You have cultivated your qi to produce magical effects.

feats.name: Qlippoth Magic
feats.notes: You've deeply studied the secrets of your blood and can force reality to act against its own wishes.

feats.name: Quadruped
feats.notes: You were crafted in a form with four legs rather than two.

feats.name: Quah Bond
feats.notes: You grew up among the Shoanti tribes, with the spirits watching over you, and they offer you guidance.
feats.access: Shoanti ethnicity

feats.name: Quaking Stomp
feats.notes: You stomp the ground with such force that it creates a minor earthquake, with the effects of the earthquake spell.

feats.name: Quality of Life
feats.notes: Cost of living expenses are reduced

feats.name: Quick Absorption
feats.notes: After so much exposure to the myriad forms of magical energy, you absorb magic almost instinctively.

feats.name: Quick Bomber
feats.notes: You keep your bombs and bomb-related reagents in easy-to-reach pouches from which you draw without thinking.

feats.name: Quick Change
feats.notes: You can shift between your identities with ease.

feats.name: Quick Climb
feats.notes: Climb swiftly

feats.name: Quick Coercion
feats.notes: Coerce a creature quickly

feats.name: Quick Disguise
feats.notes: Set up a disguise in less time

feats.name: Quick Draw
feats.notes: You draw your weapon and attack with the same motion.

feats.name: Quick Fix
feats.notes: You can attach a talisman using only a bit of glue and some string.

feats.name: Quick Identification
feats.notes: Identify Magic in 1 minute or less
feats.prerequisite: trained in Arcana, Nature, Occultism, or Religion

feats.name: Quick Juggler
feats.notes: When you start to Juggle or add another item to those you are Juggling, you add two items instead of one.
feats.source: Pathfinder #151: The Show Must Go On

feats.name: Quick Jump
feats.notes: High Jump or Long Jump as a single action

feats.name: Quick Mount
feats.notes: You and your mount can spring into action at a moment’s notice.

feats.name: Quick Positioning
feats.notes: You're always ready to get the jump on your target.

feats.name: Quick Recognition
feats.notes: Identify spells as a free action
feats.prerequisite: Master in Arcana, Master in Nature, Master in Occultism, or Master in Religion; Recognize Spell

feats.name: Quick Recovery (Kingdom)
feats.notes: +4 to checks to end ongoing harmful events

feats.name: Quick Recovery (Yaoguai)
feats.notes: You use your command over your form to repair lifethreatening wounds.
feats.trigger: Your turn begins, and you have the wounded condition.

feats.name: Quick Repair
feats.notes: Repair items quickly

feats.name: Quick Reversal
feats.notes: You turn your foes’ flanking against them with a quick reverse.

feats.name: Quick Root
feats.notes: You react instinctively, sprouting roots from your legs and plunging them deep into the ground to keep your footing.
feats.trigger: A creature successfully Shoves or Trips you, or you fail a saving throw against an effect that would move you or knock you prone .

feats.name: Quick Setup
feats.notes: You have learned to setup simple crafting jobs with ease.

feats.name: Quick Shape
feats.notes: Your instincts kick in and you take on an aggressive stance.
feats.trigger: You roll initiative.

feats.name: Quick Shield Block
feats.notes: You can bring your shield into place with hardly a thought.

feats.name: Quick Shot
feats.notes: You draw your bow and attack with the same action.

feats.name: Quick Snares
feats.notes: You can rig a snare in only moments.

feats.name: Quick Spring
feats.notes: Ishii Bunji is a skilled tumbler, and learning his technique allows you to propel yourself across the battlefield faster than your enemies can react.
feats.access: Members of the Firebrands at the rank of second mark or higher have access to this feat.

feats.name: Quick Squeeze
feats.notes: Move swiftly as you Squeeze

feats.name: Quick Stow
feats.notes: You Interact to store one item you're holding in your cheek pouches (provided it fits).

feats.name: Quick Stow (Swordmaster)
feats.notes: You know that situations can change rapidly and might leave you needing to change equipment in the middle of combat.

feats.name: Quick Study
feats.notes: During your daily preparations, you can study a particular subject to gain the trained proficiency rank in one Lore skill of your choice.

feats.name: Quick Swim
feats.notes: Swim quickly

feats.name: Quick Unlock
feats.notes: Pick a Lock with 1 action

feats.name: Quick Vengeance
feats.notes: Indignant at any who would strike you or your allies, you get your revenge.

feats.name: Quicken Heartbeat
feats.notes: You’ve replaced your heart with one made of animated quicksilver and living adamantine.

feats.name: Quickened Attunement
feats.notes: If your next action is to cast a spell that would grant your terrain attunement bonus, reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (to a minimum of 1 action).

feats.name: Quickened Casting
feats.notes: If your next action is to cast a cantrip or a spell that is at least 2 ranks lower than the highest-rank spell slot you have, reduce the number of actions to cast it by 1 (minimum 1 action).
feats.source: Player Core, Player Core 2, Impossible Magic

feats.name: Quickening Banner
feats.notes: The sight of your banner urges your allies to strike now.

feats.name: Quicksoul
feats.notes: The elemental metal in your bloodline literally courses through your veins.

feats.name: Quiet Allies
feats.notes: Roll a single Stealth check when sneaking with allies

feats.name: Quietus Strikes
feats.notes: Your connection to the Boneyard empowers you to bring death to all forms of life and unlife, exploiting their weaknesses.

feats.name: Quill Spray
feats.notes: You can launch a mass of quills at opponents.
feats.prerequisite: Quillcoat Shisk heritage or quill unarmed attack

feats.name: Rabid Sprint
feats.notes: You run on all fours as fast as you can.

feats.name: Radiant Armament
feats.notes: Your blessed armament radiates power, further enhancing your chosen weapon.

feats.name: Radiant Burst
feats.notes: Your skin glows with intensity.

feats.name: Radiant Circuitry
feats.notes: Your biological circuitry emits light like a torch, casting bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for the next 20 feet).

feats.name: Radiate Glory
feats.notes: Your inherent glory radiates into the world with all the divine power of the celestial planes for 1 minute.

feats.name: Ragdya's Dance
feats.notes: Even when faced with deadly danger, you fight with the rapturous laughter of Ragdya in your heart and can play impossible tricks.
feats.trigger: An adjacent observed creature succeeds at an attack roll against you.

feats.name: Ragdya's Revelry
feats.notes: You dart away from your foe's attack with a casual laugh, using the opening to cause mischief.
feats.trigger: An adjacent creature you can see fails an attack roll against you.

feats.name: Raging Athlete
feats.notes: Physical obstacles can't hold back your fury.

feats.name: Raging Intimidation
feats.notes: Your fury fills your foes with fear.

feats.name: Raging Stories
feats.notes: When you Offer a Story about wild chances and fighting against all odds, you can wrap yourself in spectral flame in place of the normal benefits.

feats.name: Raging Thrower
feats.notes: Thrown weapons become especially deadly in your fury.

feats.name: Rain of Bolts
feats.notes: Throughout the day, your body produces powerful projectiles within your chassis.

feats.name: Rain of Embers Stance
feats.notes: You enter the stance of an enraged phoenix, holding your fingers as rigid as deadly talons while moving with quick, flickering gestures that dance with biting flames.
feats.source: PFS Guide, PFS Quest #2: Unforgiving Fire

feats.name: Rain of Razors
feats.notes: Razor-sharp slivers of metal fall from the sky.

feats.name: Rain of Rust
feats.notes: You conjure a red raincloud in a 10-foot burst within 60 feet, which pours rust-colored rain directly below it.

feats.name: Rain-Scribe Mobility
feats.notes: You surround yourself in a mantle of Rain-Scribe magic and Stride twice; difficult terrain does not reduce your Speed, even if the difficult terrain has been manipulated by magic.

feats.name: Rain-Scribe Sustenance
feats.notes: You use the power of your Rain-Scribe magic to draw on a stream of primal power for sustenance.

feats.name: Raise a Tome
feats.notes: You can flip open a book to simultaneously study and deflect attacks.

feats.name: Raise Haft
feats.notes: You know how to use the haft of larger weapons to block your enemies' attacks.

feats.name: Raise Island
feats.notes: You churn the sea and fish up stone so your enemies together can receive their punishment.
feats.prerequisite: born of the bones of the earth or restless as the tides

feats.name: Raise Menhir
feats.notes: You raise a druidic monument, such as a standing stone or warding tree, from the ground, creating a powerful primal ward that blocks other types of magic.

feats.name: Raise Symbol
feats.notes: You present your religious symbol emphatically.

feats.name: Rakshasa Magic
feats.notes: You remember the secrets of your rakshasa forebears and know how to apply those memories to get results.

feats.name: Rakshasa Ravaged
feats.notes: You and your family know well the ravages of rakshasa predations, and you know how to best defend yourself against their growing corruption in the world.

feats.name: Rally Support
feats.notes: You often rely on the local populace for supplies and shelter.
feats.prerequisite: Guerrilla Dedication; trained in either Diplomacy or Intimidation

feats.name: Rallying Anthem
feats.notes: You learn the rallying anthem composition cantrip, which protects you and allies.

feats.name: Rallying Banner
feats.notes: Your banner waves high, reminding your allies that the fight can still be won.

feats.name: Rallying Charge
feats.notes: Your fearless charge into battle reinvigorates your allies to carry on the fight.

feats.name: Rallying Charge
feats.notes: When you lead your allies to the front lines, you leave no one behind.

feats.name: Rallying Cry
feats.notes: You call out to your allies and push them to give their all in combat.

feats.name: Rampaging Ferocity
feats.notes: You lash out viciously even as you fend off death.
feats.trigger: You use Orc Ferocity

feats.name: Rampaging Form
feats.notes: Once per day, when you Change Shape into a fox, you can instead gain the effects of both the canine form of 5th-level animal form and 7th-level fiery body for 1 minute or until you shift back, whichever comes first.
feats.prerequisite: Change Shape with a fox alternate form

feats.name: Ranged Combatant
feats.notes: Spines, flame jets, and holy blasts are just some of the ways your eidolon might strike from a distance.

feats.name: Ranged Disarm
feats.notes: When using a simple firearm, you can shoot objects right out of your enemy's hands.

feats.name: Ranger Dedication
feats.notes: You become trained in Survival; if you were already trained in Survival, you instead become trained in another skill of your choice.

feats.name: Ranger Resiliency
feats.notes: You gain 3 additional Hit Points for each ranger archetype class feat you have.
feats.prerequisite: Ranger Dedication; class granting no more Hit Points per level than 8 + your Constitution modifier

feats.name: Rapid Affixture
feats.notes: You take only 1 minute to Affix a Talisman .

feats.name: Rapid Assessment
feats.notes: You quickly evaluate your enemies.
feats.trigger: You roll initiative.

feats.name: Rapid Hybridization
feats.notes: When danger threatens, your instincts kick in, and you can assume a different shape at a moment's notice.
feats.trigger: You roll initiative.

feats.name: Rapid Manifestation
feats.notes: Your unwavering soul brings up your defenses as soon as you’re in danger.
feats.trigger: You roll initiative or a hazard attacks you.

feats.name: Rapid Mantel
feats.notes: Pull yourself onto ledges quickly

feats.name: Rapid Pheromone Recovery
feats.notes: Your supply of pheromones replenish very quickly.

feats.name: Rapid Reattunement
feats.notes: You spend 10 minutes realigning your elemental connections in an elemental trance.

feats.name: Rapid Recharge
feats.notes: You tap into an arcane trick to recover your ability to meld spells and attacks.

feats.name: Rapid Response
feats.notes: You work quickly in emergencies.
feats.trigger: An ally is reduced to 0 Hit Points

feats.name: Rapid Retraining
feats.notes: Some feel trapped by their choices and have a tough time reinventing themselves.

feats.name: Rapid Spark
feats.notes: Your spark shifts to where it needs to be.
feats.trigger: Your turn begins.

feats.name: Rapid Switch
feats.notes: You’ve honed your control over your spellsurge aura and can rapidly alter its effects.

feats.name: Rat Familiar
feats.notes: You have a pet rat that has become magically bonded to you.

feats.name: Rat Form
feats.notes: You can transform into an innocuous-looking rat.

feats.name: Rat Magic
feats.notes: There always seems to be a little rat around to carry messages for you.

feats.name: Ratfolk Lore
feats.notes: Years of experience among ratfolk communities have made you nimble, and you've learned to run and hide when enemies threaten.

feats.name: Ratfolk Roll
feats.notes: You roll up into a ball and move up to four times your Speed in a straight line down an incline.

feats.name: Ratspeak
feats.notes: You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with rodents, including beavers, mice, porcupines, rats, and squirrels, but not with other mammals, such as dogs or bats.

feats.name: Rattle The Earth
feats.notes: Striking the ground with the gravity of the deepest rocks, you cause an earthquake .

feats.name: Ravel of Thorns
feats.notes: Thorny vines grow in geometric patterns on surfaces in your kinetic aura.

feats.name: Ravening's Desperation
feats.notes: Your study of the Beast of Gluttondark has taught you how to make do in the most trying of circumstances rather than succumb to weakness.

feats.name: Ravenous Charge
feats.notes: Hungry for the flesh of the living, you hurl yourself into the fray, teeth gnashing.

feats.name: Razmiran Priest Dedication
feats.notes: You have earned entry to the priesthood of Razmir, either at the Exalted Lodge or another temple where Razmir’s holy masks are forged.
feats.prerequisite: Trained in Crafting; Trained in Deception

feats.name: Razor's Edge
feats.notes: Your curse and your power are one and the same, and you accept both equally.

feats.name: Razorsharp Bite
feats.notes: You have long, sharp teeth designed to shred flesh.

feats.name: Razzle-Dazzle
feats.notes: You've spent considerable time practicing the manipulation of light, weaponizing your blade's reflection or bolstering the luminosity of magical displays to unconventional heights.
feats.trigger: You blind or dazzle a creature

feats.name: Reach Beyond
feats.notes: You've learned to move your spiritual energy past yourself to attack spirits where others can't.

feats.name: Reach for Immortality
feats.notes: Your divine spark is now a bonfire in your soul, bringing you to the very cusp of undying immortality.

feats.name: Reach for the Sky
feats.notes: You command the room, firing a gun into the air and ordering everyone to surrender and put their hands in the air.

feats.name: Reach for the Stars
feats.notes: The sky's the limit, as long as you've got enough black powder.

feats.name: Reach of the Dead
feats.notes: You channel your necrotic magic through a thrall, expending it in the process.

feats.name: Reach Spell
feats.notes: You can extend your spells’ range.

feats.name: Reactive Charm
feats.notes: You’re so charming and distracting that when pressed, you can cast a simple charm in time to foil an attacker.
feats.trigger: You are the target of a spell or attack.

feats.name: Reactive Dismissal
feats.notes: You abruptly dismiss your eidolon to reduce the damage they take, though this makes summoning them again more difficult.
feats.trigger: Your eidolon would take damage.

feats.name: Reactive Distraction
feats.notes: You reactively switch with your decoy to foil your foe.
feats.trigger: You would be hit by an attack or targeted by an effect, or you are within an effect’s area

feats.name: Reactive Interference
feats.notes: Grabbing a sleeve, swiping with your weapon, or creating another obstruction, you reflexively foil an enemy’s response.
feats.trigger: An adjacent enemy begins to use a reaction

feats.name: Reactive Pursuit
feats.notes: You keep pace with a retreating foe.
feats.trigger: An adjacent foe moves away from you, and you can reach at least one space adjacent to the foe with a Stride action

feats.name: Reactive Resilience
feats.notes: Your power blunts blades and weakens spells like the hardiest of dragon scales.
feats.trigger: You take damage.

feats.name: Reactive Shield
feats.notes: You can snap your shield into place just as you would take a blow, avoiding the hit at the last second.
feats.trigger: An enemy hits you with a melee Strike

feats.name: Reactive Spellshift
feats.notes: You can reflexively shift a spell even as it’s being cast.
feats.trigger: A creature within 30 feet casts a spell.

feats.name: Reactive Strike
feats.notes: You lash out at a foe that leaves an opening.
feats.trigger: A creature within your reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it’s using.

feats.name: Reactive Striker
feats.notes: You gain the Reactive Strike reaction.

feats.name: Reactive Tangle
feats.notes: You wrap the net around the creature’s feet to prevent it from escaping.
feats.trigger: A Medium or smaller creature within your reach uses a move action or leaves a square during a move action it’s using.

feats.name: Reactive Transformation
feats.notes: You transform reflexively when in danger.
feats.prerequisite: Untamed Form; Dragon Shape, Elemental Shape, Plant Shape, or Soaring Shape
feats.trigger: varies

feats.name: Read Disaster
feats.notes: You spend 10 minutes and open yourself to the divine mysteries of the world, peering into the most sinister portents of the future.

feats.name: Read Lips
feats.notes: Read the lips of people you can see

feats.name: Read Psychometric Resonance
feats.notes: With a touch, you can read the psychic impressions left on objects by their previous owners.

feats.name: Read Shibboleths
feats.notes: All communication is filled with slight tells and signals.

feats.name: Read the Dust
feats.notes: You watch the creature or hazard as it collapses, careful for any sign it may return.
feats.trigger: An undead creature is reduce to zero Hit Points or a haunt is disabled withing 60 feet of you

feats.name: Read the Land
feats.notes: You've learned how to commune with the land to learn information.

feats.name: Read the Roots
feats.notes: The root systems of trees are a far-reaching network of information, and you know how to access them and extract their secrets.

feats.name: Read the Stars
feats.notes: You're incredibly skilled in iruxi astrology, and you can gain useful (if cryptic) hints from the stars' alignment.
feats.prerequisite: Trained in Astrology Lore or Trained in Occultism

feats.name: Read The Wind
feats.notes: You can derive meaning from the tiniest details when tracking an enemy.

feats.name: Reading the Signs
feats.notes: You have a knack for drawing the right card, be it from a harrow deck, in a game of cards, or even when drawing from a Deck of Many Things .
feats.access: This feat is available to all players in a Stolen Fate campaign

feats.name: Realm Strider
feats.notes: You can teleport across the battlefield, disappearing and appearing in a burst of hellfire and brimstone, a flash of lightning, a cloud of caustic gas, or other environmental hazard common within your planned realm.

feats.name: Reanimate Foe
feats.notes: You attempt to bring a creature back to life to fight by your side.

feats.name: Reanimating Spark
feats.notes: The magic that animates you strains to keep you alive.
feats.trigger: You have the dying condition and are about to attempt a recovery check.

feats.name: Reanimator Dedication
feats.notes: You have dedicated your studies to the art of raising and commanding undead.
feats.prerequisite: able to cast _animate dead_ with a spell slot

feats.name: Reaper of Repose
feats.notes: Your skill and fervor allow you to pierce undead defenses and exploit their weaknesses.
feats.prerequisite: Knight Reclaimant Dedication; master proficiency in a weapon

feats.name: Rearing Display
feats.notes: You've trained your mount to make an impressive attack and can leverage its presence to terrify your enemies.

feats.name: Reason Rapidly
feats.notes: Your mind works through clues at an unbelievable speed.

feats.name: Reassuring Presence
feats.notes: You serve as an anchor to your close companions, calming them in times of stress.
feats.trigger: An ally within 30 feet gains the frightened condition

feats.name: Rebel's Map
feats.notes: Rebellions require an intricate knowledge of one's surroundings—because you might need to escape at any moment.
feats.prerequisite: Horizon Walker Dedication or Scout Dedication
feats.trigger: You roll initiative.
feats.access: Members of the Firebrands at the rank of second mark or higher have access to this feat.

feats.name: Rebellious Existence
feats.notes: You have tied yourself so absolutely to the cause of liberty that your very existence is an act of rebellion.

feats.name: Rebirth in Living Stone
feats.notes: Rock overflows from within you to consume your form before cracking open to reveal your body transformed into living stone.

feats.name: Rebounding Assault
feats.notes: You hurl your melee weapon at an opponent, then fire a bullet into the weapon's hilt, making it deal additional damage and bounce back to your grasp.

feats.name: Rebounding Smite
feats.notes: The energy from your smite persists for a moment, allowing you to pass it to a new target.
feats.trigger: You miss with your Strike during Channel Smite

feats.name: Rebounding Toss
feats.notes: You bounce your weapon off one foe to strike another.

feats.name: Receive Prayers
feats.notes: You open your senses so the prayers of mortals can better reach your ears.

feats.name: Recharging Flurry
feats.notes: The clash of steel fuels your magic, preparing you to unleash another magic-infused assault.

feats.name: Recharging Transference
feats.notes: You can break your spells down into raw magical potential and transfer it to an ally.

feats.name: Reckless Abandon (Goblin)
feats.notes: Despite a lifetime filled with questionable decisions, you've managed to survive, as though you have uncanny luck that lets you avoid the consequences of your own actions.

feats.name: Reclaim Power
feats.notes: You use your thralls to restore yourself.

feats.name: Reclaim Spell
feats.notes: You have learned to manipulate reflections of magic, similar to the resonant reflections.

feats.name: Reclaimant Plea
feats.notes: You call on the power of the Crimson Oath to gain magical aid.
feats.prerequisite: Knight Reclaimant Dedication; ability to cast divine spells

feats.name: Recognize Ambush
feats.notes: Your combat training has honed you to be ready for an attack at all times.
feats.trigger: You roll initiative.

feats.name: Recognize Spell
feats.notes: Identify a spell as a reaction as it’s being cast
feats.prerequisite: Trained in Arcana, Trained in Nature, Trained in Occultism, or Trained in Religion
feats.trigger: A creature within line of sight casts a spell that you don’t have prepared or in your spell repertoire, or a trap or similar object casts such a spell. You must be aware of the casting.

feats.name: Recognize Threat
feats.notes: You quickly assess the threat so you can relay the information to your team.
feats.prerequisite: master in a Recall Knowledge skill; Pathfinder Agent Dedication
feats.trigger: Your first turn of an encounter begins, and you can see a creature.
feats.access: A character who is a member of the Pathfinder Society has access to this option.

feats.name: Recoiling Relocation
feats.notes: Your innovation contains a chamber to store a small amount of compressed exhaust gas from your Launches.
feats.trigger: You launch your light mortar .

feats.name: Recollect Studies
feats.notes: You paid attention during your studies and remember the right way to attack various creatures.
feats.prerequisite: Swordmaster Dedication; expert in a skill used to Recall Knowledge

feats.name: Reconstruct The Scene
feats.notes: You spend 1 minute surveying a small location (such as a single room) to get an impression of events that occurred there in the last day.

feats.name: Recover Spell
feats.notes: You recover the energy of a recently disrupted spell, allowing you to cast it again as long as you do so immediately before the energy dissipates.

feats.name: Recurring Nightmare
feats.notes: You summon a lingering spirit that just won’t stay dead.

feats.name: Recycled Cogwheel
feats.notes: You're able to scavenge the cogwheels from your daily quick-deploy snares that use gears.

feats.name: Red Mantis Assassin Dedication
feats.notes: You have learned how to stalk your foes and slay them with a sawtooth saber.
feats.prerequisite: trained in sawtooth sabers; worshipper of Achaekek; member of the Red Mantis assassins
feats.access: You are from Mediogalti Island.

feats.name: Red Mantis School Spell
feats.notes: You gain the Red Mantis magic school’s initial school spell.

feats.name: Red-Gold Mortality
feats.notes: By channeling your divinity into a creature along with a strike, you can disrupt their ability to recover.

feats.name: Redirect Attention
feats.notes: Through your strong connection with your progenitor, you're able to redirect those attempting to spy on you.

feats.name: Redirect Elements
feats.notes: You seize the elemental essence of an incoming spell and redirect the spell to a creature of your choice within the spell's area.
feats.trigger: The spell attack roll for a foe's spell with an elemental trait targeting you fails or critically fails, and the elemental trait is in your elemental philosophy.

feats.name: Redirect Spell
feats.notes: You can alter the flow of magic around you, moving a spell effect from one target to another.

feats.name: Redirect Teleportation
feats.notes: You’re able to intercept a teleportation effect and change where a creature appears.
feats.trigger: A creature teleports into a space within 60 feet of you.

feats.name: Redirecting Draft
feats.notes: You flap your wings to blow arrows off course.
feats.trigger: You or an ally within 10 feet of you is the target of a ranged physical Strike.

feats.name: Redirecting Shot
feats.notes: Seeing your ally's attack about to go astray, you fire your weapon to right its course.
feats.trigger: An ally misses with a ranged attack that uses a thrown weapon or ammunition. The ally must be willing to accept your assistance, you must see the attack's target, and the attack's target must be within the first range increment of your firearm or crossbow.

feats.name: Reel 'Em In
feats.notes: You’ve developed combat techniques inspired by the methods fishermen use to catch large fish.

feats.name: Refined Motion in Darkness
feats.notes: The ability to move elegantly and undetected through darkness aided your people as they fled the Netherworld.

feats.name: Reflect Foe
feats.notes: You create a copy of a foe by calling them forth from a nearby reflection.

feats.name: Reflect Harm
feats.notes: You can wrap your magic around you like a cloak that causes those who dare to target you with spells to suffer a similar fate.

feats.name: Reflect Spell
feats.notes: When you successfully use Counterspell to counteract a spell that affects targeted creatures or an area, you can turn that spell’s effect back on its caster.

feats.name: Reflecting Riposte
feats.notes: You attempt to counteract the triggering spell using powerful magical techniques observed in the Kortos Mounts.
feats.prerequisite: Dueling Riposte, Mirror Shield, or Twin Riposte
feats.trigger: An opponent casts a spell and you critically succeed at a saving throw against it.

feats.name: Reflective Defense
feats.notes: Your body's natural luster has been polished to a gleaming shine.
feats.trigger: A creature within 30 feet of you targets you, and you can see the attacker.

feats.name: Reflective Pocket
feats.notes: You've formed a connection with a small hand mirror, allowing you to use it as an extradimensional storage space.

feats.name: Reflective Ripple Stance
feats.notes: You enter a stance of fluid grace as small amounts of water flow with your movements and attacks.

feats.name: Reflexive Catch
feats.notes: Grab an item thrown at you.
feats.source: Pathfinder #151: The Show Must Go On
feats.trigger: An item falls within your reach or an attacker fails an attack roll to hit you or a creature within your reach with a thrown weapon.

feats.name: Reflexive Courage
feats.notes: You bellow a ferocious call to arms, inspiring yourself to lash out at a foe.
feats.trigger: A creature within your reach uses an auditory effect, manipulate action, or move action; makes a ranged attack; or leaves a square during its move action

feats.name: Reflexive Devotion
feats.notes: The power of dragons flows through you at the merest thought.
feats.trigger: You roll initiative.

feats.name: Reflexive Grapple
feats.notes: You've honed your reflexes so well that your lash can begin closing around a target as soon as it makes contact.

feats.name: Reflexive Grip
feats.notes: You keep hold of your weapons even when knocked out.

feats.name: Reflexive Riposte
feats.notes: You can riposte almost without a thought.

feats.name: Reflexive Shield
feats.notes: You can use your shield to fend off explosions and the like.

feats.name: Reflexive Stance
feats.notes: You enter a stance without a thought.
feats.trigger: You roll initiative.

feats.name: Regional Specialty
feats.notes: You can create dishes that reflect the food sources endemic to your environment and medicinal food techniques utilizing the cycle of the five elements.

feats.name: Regrowth
feats.notes: Your command over your vital essence allows you or an ally to recover from grievous wounds.

feats.name: Regurgitate Mutagen
feats.notes: You redirect a mutagen within your body to spit a stream of stomach acid at a foe.

feats.name: Rehydration
feats.notes: You surround your body with a thin layer of water drawn from the moisture in the air.

feats.name: Reimagine
feats.notes: You can cast dreaming potential as an innate occult spell.

feats.name: Reincarnated Companion
feats.notes: You’re not alone in having a legendary past life—so too does your companion.
feats.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star
feats.prerequisite: Heroic Scion Dedication; familiar or nimble or savage animal companion

feats.name: Reincarnated Ridiculer
feats.notes: You’ve practiced the art of taunting an enemy, ensuring they know death will only make you stronger.

feats.name: Reinforce Eidolon
feats.notes: You buffer your eidolon.

feats.name: Reinforced Chassis
feats.notes: Your body is designed to be particularly resilient.

feats.name: Reinforced Skeleton
feats.notes: You take on the toughness and lightness of bone. You gain resistance equal to half your level to two damage types; one is your choice of cold , electricity , or fire , and the other is your choice of slashing or piercing. You also gain a +5- foot status bonus to your Speeds. Whenever you destroy a thrall, this bonus to your Speeds increases to +10 feet for 1 round.

feats.name: Rejoice in Solstice Storm
feats.notes: You hold your arms out, and the fury of the seasons comes to your jubilant embrace.
feats.prerequisite: whose cry is thunder or dancer in the seasons

feats.name: Rejuvenating Embrace
feats.notes: You rejuvenate your spirit by taking your rest where Mother Earth embraces Father Moon.

feats.name: Rejuvenating Touch
feats.notes: Your healing energies linger after you cast, providing continual benefits.

feats.name: Rejuvenation
feats.notes: The call of your unfinished business recreates you after destruction.

feats.name: Rejuvenation Token
feats.notes: You tie yourself to the Material Plane by implanting a piece of your consciousness into a weapon, piece of armor, or other item that's precious to you.

feats.name: Rekindled Light
feats.notes: You temporarily drain your star orb familiar’s energy to save an ally.
feats.trigger: You or an ally within 30 feet of your star orb familiar would be reduced to 0 Hit Points but not immediately killed.

feats.name: Release Me!
feats.notes: Your retribution against one who would detain you is swift and dangerous.

feats.name: Release Spores
feats.notes: You create a miasma of spores.

feats.name: Release the Light
feats.notes: Many people report seeing a bright light before their death.

feats.name: Relentless Disarm
feats.notes: You have been trained to disarm foes.
feats.prerequisite: Zephyr Guard Dedication; Trained in Athletics

feats.name: Relentless Stalker
feats.notes: Stay adjacent to your prey when they attempt to move away.
feats.trigger: An adjacent creature you are hunting attempts to move away from you using an action that has the move trait.

feats.name: Reliable Luck
feats.notes: You survive danger with surprising regularity.

feats.name: Reliable Magic
feats.notes: Magic stored in written form or within wands is more reliable in your capable hands.
feats.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star

feats.name: Reliable Squire
feats.notes: You know the path to victory isn't traveled alone, and you lend aid to your companions whenever you can.
feats.access: Knights of Lastwall have access to this feat.

feats.name: Relinquish Control
feats.notes: Your apparition takes over and shields you from outside influence.
feats.trigger: Your turn begins.

feats.name: Reloading Trick
feats.notes: You can fire off a single shot even when it seems like you are unprepared.

feats.name: Remake the World
feats.notes: For the briefest of moments, you can reach into the realm of true gods, gaining the power to shape reality to your will.

feats.name: Remediate
feats.notes: If your next action is to use your divine font to cast a 3-action heal or harm spell, you can harness the residual energy to counterbalance opposing forces.

feats.name: Remember thy Names
feats.notes: You peer into the eyes of a target of your Ultimatum of Liberation , as you say aloud the names of their victims, searing them into the oppressor’s mind, cursing them to feel their victims’ pain.

feats.name: Remember Your Training
feats.notes: You were schooled on a wide variety of creatures you might encounter.

feats.name: Reminder of the Greater Fear
feats.notes: You give a target a stern glower to remind them that it is you, and no one else, they should truly fear.
feats.trigger: Another creature within 30 feet of you that can see you would gain the frightened condition.

feats.name: Remnants of the Past
feats.notes: Memories of your first life are strong and continually return to you, even after several incarnations.

feats.name: Remorseless Lash
feats.notes: You're skilled at beating an enemy when their morale is already breaking.

feats.name: Remote Detonation
feats.notes: Brastlewark snarecrafters know that sometimes it's more advantageous to magically destroy a snare before it's triggered.

feats.name: Remote Detonation
feats.notes: You whisper an invocation over your ammunition as you shoot it, and the hissing of the projectile sounds just like your murmured voice.

feats.name: Remote Trigger
feats.notes: You've learned how to trigger snares from afar, creating ranged hazards to assail your opponents and allowing you to disarm enemies' snares harmlessly.

feats.name: Remove Presence
feats.notes: Your spell reaches into the mind of a creature and removes you from it.

feats.name: Rend Armor
feats.notes: Your enemies' defenses are no match for you as you wrench your weapon to compromise their armor.

feats.name: Rend Mimicry
feats.notes: Taking advantage of the brutal efficiency of hacking away at a target with two slashing attacks, you've mastered the art of punishing a foe caught between your slices.
feats.prerequisite: Wild Mimic Dedication; you have seen a creature use Rend or have identified a creature that has Rend in combat

feats.name: Renewed Vigor
feats.notes: Through the haze of battle, you quickly recover your raging vigor.

feats.name: Renewing Cycle
feats.notes: The first time each round that you Cycle Elemental Stance, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to half your level that last until the start of your next turn.

feats.name: Renewing Quills
feats.notes: Your spines grow back much faster than other shisks.

feats.name: Repair Module
feats.notes: You trigger your body's repair programming, causing your body's nanites to heal your wounds.

feats.name: Repeat Lesson
feats.notes: Upon seeing your student falter, you demonstrate the proper technique.
feats.trigger: Your student fails or critically fails an Athletics check to Disarm , Grapple , Reposition , Shove , or Trip a target within your reach.

feats.name: Repeating Hand Crossbow Training
feats.notes: The specific needs of your organization or mission warrant your use of the latest in ingenious crossbow technology.

feats.name: Repel Assault
feats.notes: Your Calling demands that you defy danger and injury to yourself or those who rely on you while allowing you to respond to the originators of such aggression with ferocious and unrivaled fury.
feats.trigger: An enemy’s attack would deal damage equal to or greater than your level to you or an adjacent ally.

feats.name: Repel Darkness
feats.notes: Your stoicism and courage seem to drive off darkness and shadow.

feats.name: Repelling Enforcer
feats.notes: Your conviction reflects damage from the divine.

feats.name: Replenishing Consumption
feats.notes: When you devour corpses and satiate your hunger, you also recover from some of your wounds, your necrotized blue flesh knitting back together almost immediately as soon as you begin shoveling the chunks of dead flesh down your throat.

feats.name: Replenishing Hydration
feats.notes: You draw life from the water around you.
feats.source: Absalom, City of Lost Omens, Azarketi Ancestry Web Supplement

feats.name: Replenishment of War
feats.notes: Striking out against your enemies draws praise and protection from your deity.
feats.prerequisite: expert in your deity’s favored weapon

feats.name: Replicate
feats.notes: You've learned to reshape your malleable form.

feats.name: Repositioning Block
feats.notes: As you absorb a blow from an enemy, you can use their attack's momentum against them.
feats.trigger: You used Shield Block to prevent damage from an adjacent creature’s attack.

feats.name: Reprepare Spell
feats.notes: You’ve discovered how to reuse some of your spell slots over and over.

feats.name: Reprisal of the Fallen
feats.notes: You can feel the sorrow, pain, and rage of those fallen to oppression, peering from just behind the veil of death, and you can bring them forth to exact their revenge.

feats.name: Reptile Rider
feats.notes: To you, crocodilians, giant lizards, and dinosaurs are loyal steeds, not monsters.

feats.name: Reptile Speaker
feats.notes: You hear the sounds of reptiles as language.

feats.name: Repulse the Wicken
feats.notes: You use your foe's failure as an opening to push them away.
feats.trigger: An undead within your reach critically fails an attack roll targeting you.

feats.name: Repurposed Parts
feats.notes: You are familiar with the fittings and cogwheels of your snares and can repurpose parts from prepared quick-deploy snares to assemble a new creation on the fly.

feats.name: Rescuer's Press
feats.notes: Any shield you wield gains the shove trait.

feats.name: Reset the Past
feats.notes: You manipulate time to recharge one of your temporal techniques—by revising your past so you never used it in the first place.

feats.name: Resilient Chassis
feats.notes: You are tough enough to draw on your own internal stores of energy when you get injured.
feats.trigger: You would take damage.

feats.name: Resilient Mind
feats.notes: You're firm in your convictions and have girded your mind against outside influence.
feats.access: Knights of Lastwall have access to this feat.

feats.name: Resilient Physiology
feats.notes: Your ordered physiology rejects unwelcome elements, allowing you to reject the negative effects of poisons and diseases or shrug off other lasting negative effects.

feats.name: Resilient Shell
feats.notes: Your eidolon is resilient against attacks.

feats.name: Resilient Touch
feats.notes: Your healing energies create an aura of protection that defends your allies against more than just blades and arrows.

feats.name: Resist Ruin
feats.notes: Your duskwalker heritage allows you to extend protection against void energy.

feats.name: Resolute
feats.notes: You've tempered your mind and become resolute against effects that strain your willpower.

feats.name: Resolute Defender
feats.notes: You hold your shield together with the power of your faith and conviction, refusing to let wood splinter and steel shatter until the day's battles are won.

feats.name: Resounding Blow
feats.notes: You strike your enemy in the head with such force that its ears ring.

feats.name: Resounding Bravery
feats.notes: Even your fears serve as fuel for your fighting spirit.

feats.name: Resounding Cascade
feats.notes: The magical reinforcement from your Arcane Cascade extends to nearby allies.

feats.name: Resounding Finale
feats.notes: You bring your performance to a sudden, dramatic finish, drowning out other sounds.
feats.trigger: You or an ally benefiting from your composition spell would take sonic damage

feats.name: Resourceful Ritualist
feats.notes: You can cast difficult rituals that might otherwise be just beyond your skill.

feats.name: Resplendent Spellhorn
feats.notes: Your magic continues to flourish.

feats.name: Restitch
