feats.notes: You've learned how to sew even the most terrible tears and wounds together.

feats.name: Restorative Channel
feats.notes: You can remove conditions with divine grace.

feats.name: Restorative Strike
feats.notes: You balance both sides of the scales, restoring yourself while striking a foe.

feats.name: Restore Omen
feats.notes: You spend 10 minutes meditating with your harrow deck, then draw a card.
feats.access: This feat is available to all players in a Stolen Fate campaign

feats.name: Restoring Blood
feats.notes: Your body can process an alternative to your venom that heals wounds.

feats.name: Resurrectionist
feats.notes: You can cause a creature you bring back from the brink of death to thrive and continue healing.

feats.name: Resuscitate
feats.notes: You resuscitate the dead.

feats.name: Retain Absorbed Spell
feats.notes: When you absorb a spell using the Absorb Spell reaction, you utilize secret, techniques that allow you to retain the power and knowledge necessary to cast the spell repeatedly—potentially for a greater period of time.

feats.name: Retaliating Rescue
feats.notes: When an ally is in danger, you can hustle to reach them and punish the foe threatening them.

feats.name: Retaliatory Cleansing
feats.notes: You twist your hand in front of the blow, ensuring the enemy's attack shatters the required holy water or bomb.
feats.trigger: You would take damage from an adjacent creature's Strike.
feats.frequency: You're holding holy water or a bomb that deals positive damage in one of your hands.
feats.access: Knights of Lastwall have access to this feat.

feats.name: Retch Rust
feats.notes: You exhale tendrils formed from flakes of rusted metal.

feats.name: Retractable Claws
feats.notes: You gain a claw unarmed attack that deals 1d4 slashing damage.

feats.name: Retreating Finisher
feats.notes: You make a calculated attack without letting down your guard.

feats.name: Retributive Focus
feats.notes: Your enemy’s offenses fuel your righteous power.

feats.name: Return Fire
feats.notes: Snatching an arrow out of the air, you instantly put it to your bow and return fire.

feats.name: Return to the Pit!
feats.notes: You can send the fiends who have vexed you back to their home plane where they belong.

feats.name: Return to the Sea
feats.notes: You adapt a creature to living and moving in water.

feats.name: Return to the Seed
feats.notes: Once per month, when you die, you can instead choose to fade away.

feats.name: Return Unto Runes
feats.notes: You attempt to deconstruct an incoming spell into its individual magical components, storing them temporarily as a rune.
feats.trigger: An enemy targets you with a spell attack or other magical attack against your AC.

feats.name: Returning Throw
feats.notes: You have mastered the technique of arcing a projectile so that it returns to your hand after being thrown, though this requires a moment to precisely calculate the trajectory and possible ricochets.

feats.name: Reveal Hidden Self
feats.notes: While hidden, you manifest a version of your animalistic nature.

feats.name: Reveal Machinations
feats.notes: You convince a creature that you played a minor but recurring role in its life.

feats.name: Reveal True Name
feats.notes: You attempt to get a creature to do as you wish by threatening them with your knowledge of their true name.
feats.prerequisite: trained in Intimidation and at least one of Arcana, Nature, Occult, and Religion

feats.name: Revealing Stab
feats.notes: You drive your piercing weapon into an imperceptible foe, revealing its location to your allies.

feats.name: Revelation's Focus
feats.notes: The further extents of your mystery provide an endless wellspring of magic.

feats.name: Reverberate
feats.notes: You can manipulate the acoustics around you to deflect sonic damage back at its source.
feats.trigger: A creature or hazard would deal sonic damage to you

feats.name: Reverberating Spell
feats.notes: Your spell disorients your targets with a metallic clangor.
feats.prerequisite: Elementalist Dedication; metal is in your elemental philosophy

feats.name: Reverse Curse
feats.notes: When you counter a curse or misfortune effect, you send it back to destroy its originator.

feats.name: Reverse Engineer
feats.notes: You are incredibly skilled at reverse engineering items to learn their formulas, or disassembling them just to disable them.

feats.name: Reverse Engineering
feats.notes: Your nigh-constant tinkering and fiddling with objects means you are able to reverse engineer items into formulas more effectively than most.

feats.name: Reversing Charge
feats.notes: You dive into the fray before rewinding yourself to safety. Stride up to your Speed.

feats.name: Revitalizing Finisher
feats.notes: Your swagger instills confidence in you and your allies.

feats.name: Revivification Protocol
feats.notes: Your nanites are programmed to automatically revive you.
feats.trigger: You have the dying condition and are about to attempt a recovery check.

feats.name: Revivifying Mutagen
feats.notes: You metabolize a mutagen to heal yourself.

feats.name: Ricochet Feint
feats.notes: While in Ricochet Stance, you can bounce a thrown weapon off a foe to distract them.

feats.name: Ricochet Legend
feats.notes: The more obstacles between you and your target, the deadlier your shots become, as you ricochet off multiple surfaces to hit them.

feats.name: Ricochet Master
feats.notes: You have an eye for angles and can find shots that others believe are impossible.

feats.name: Ricochet Shot
feats.notes: You bounce your shot off a nearby surface to strike your opponent from an unexpected angle.

feats.name: Ricochet Stance (Fighter)
feats.notes: You adopt a stance to rebound your thrown weapons toward you.

feats.name: Ricochet Stance (Rogue)
feats.notes: You adopt a stance to rebound your thrown weapons toward you.

feats.name: Ricocheting Leap
feats.notes: You quickly use your momentum to topple and spring off of foes.

feats.name: Riddle the Sphinx
feats.notes: You’ve learned the secrets of the sphinx’s riddles and empowered your ikon with them.
feats.source: Pathfinder #217: Death Sails a Wine-Dark Sea

feats.name: Ride
feats.notes: Automatically succeed at commanding your mount to move

feats.name: Ride On
feats.notes: Even when tired, you refuse to give up, pushing yourself to extreme feats of endurance.
feats.trigger: You would gain the fatigued condition.

feats.name: Ride the Tsunami
feats.notes: Booming, crashing walls of water, enough to fill a harbor, smash out ahead of you, overwhelming all in their path.

feats.name: Riftmarked
feats.notes: Long ago, qlippoth marked someone in your lineage, most likely through their ancient runestones that dot Golarion's surface.

feats.name: Right Where you Want Them
feats.notes: Whether with a weapon or your bare hands, you keep your opponents in their place.

feats.name: Right-hand Blood
feats.notes: It's said that the flesh of the right side of a hyena can heal diseases, but that the flesh of the left side is deadly and poisonous.

feats.name: Rimesoul
feats.notes: The water inside you is cold and frozen, like sheets of ice and frigid glaciers.

feats.name: Ring their Bell
feats.notes: Using your armor, you pummel a foe that isn't focused on you in the head or face to stagger them.

feats.name: Ringmaster's Introduction
feats.notes: You announce the triggering ally with a litany of their legendary achievements, spurring them to action.
feats.trigger: An ally's turn begins.

feats.name: Rip and Tear
feats.notes: You've learned to debilitate your enemies in the same way a hunter tears at their prey.

feats.name: Rippling Spin
feats.notes: After the triggering attack is done, Step
feats.trigger: You’re hit by a physical melee attack by an attacker you can see that’s in reach.

feats.name: Riptide
feats.notes: Drag a grabbed creature into nearby water
feats.source: Absalom, City of Lost Omens, Azarketi Ancestry Web Supplement
feats.trigger: You successfully Grapple a creature of the same size as you or smaller.

feats.name: Riptide
feats.notes: You swirl water around you to make a current that pulls creatures closer.

feats.name: Riptide Mount
feats.notes: After working with aquatic beasts of burden for years, you have learned how to easily mount and dismount them.

feats.name: Rise Up!
feats.notes: Sometimes, you must even slip the chains of gravity to rebel.

feats.name: Rise, My Creature!
feats.notes: You have created life! You have usurped the power of the gods themselves!

feats.name: Rising Blood Magic
feats.notes: The power within your blood grows.

feats.name: Rising Hurricane
feats.notes: A hurricane lifts your enemies into the air before bringing them crashing down in a bloody rain.

feats.name: Risky Reload
feats.notes: You've practiced a technique for rapidly reloading your firearm, but attempting to use this technique is a dangerous gamble with your firearm's functionality.

feats.name: Risky Surgery
feats.notes: Your surgery can bring a patient back from the brink of death, but might push them over the edge.

feats.name: Rites of Convocation
feats.notes: Your patron grants you the power to summon other creatures to aid you.

feats.name: Rites of Liberation
feats.notes: You learn the freedom ritual.

feats.name: Rites of Transfiguration
feats.notes: You can adapt your patron’s power to transform other creatures into forms more befitting their behavior or your whims.

feats.name: Ritual Researcher
feats.notes: Careful research into the art of rituals has made you better at performing them.

feats.name: Ritual Reversion
feats.notes: You can temporarily revert to a less conspicuous form without diminishing your senses.

feats.name: Ritualist Dedication
feats.notes: You have begun to master the difficult art of casting rituals .
feats.prerequisite: Expert in Occultism, Expert in Arcana, Expert in Nature, or Expert in Religion

feats.name: River Adaptation
feats.notes: Webbing sprouts on your legs and tail as you shift to a more aquatic form.

feats.name: Rivethun Adept
feats.notes: Your ability to wield spirit magic has increased.

feats.name: Rivethun Devotion
feats.notes: Through study, dedication, and introspection, you’ve learned to wield magic that affects the spirit.
feats.access: Followers of Rivethun have access to this feat.

feats.name: Rivethun Disciple
feats.notes: By studying with the dwarven shamans of Highhelm, you have become aware of the friction between your body and spirit.
feats.access: Rivethun Adherent background or you are a member of the Rivethun

feats.name: Rivethun Emissary Dedication
feats.notes: You’re a practicing Rivethun emissary, skilled at interacting and bonding with the spirits of living creatures.
feats.prerequisite: Trained in Diplomacy; Trained in Religion
feats.access: Followers of Rivethun have access to this feat.

feats.name: Rivethun Invoker Dedication
feats.notes: You’re a practicing Rivethun invoker, able to enter a trance that connects you physically and mentally to surrounding spirits.
feats.prerequisite: Trained in Athletics; Trained in Religion
feats.access: Followers of Rivethun have access to this feat.

feats.name: Rivethun Involutionist Dedication
feats.notes: You’re a practicing Rivethun involutionist, with a deep well of inner power.
feats.prerequisite: Trained in Nature; Trained in Religion
feats.access: Followers of Rivethun have access to this feat.

feats.name: Rivethun Spiritual Attunement
feats.notes: Your time spent among the Rivethun has heightened your awareness of animate spirits around you, giving you the ability to sense them briefly.
feats.access: Rivethun Adherent background or you are a member of the Rivethun

feats.name: Roadkill
feats.notes: In your hands, any vehicle is a weapon.

feats.name: Roar Mimicry
feats.notes: You unleash a roar so loud that it's felt as deeply as it's heard.
feats.prerequisite: Wild Mimic Dedication; you have been targeted by a creature’s auditory ability that effects an area or have identified a creature with an auditory ability that effects an area

feats.name: Roaring Heart
feats.notes: You surge forward inexorably.

feats.name: Robust Health
feats.notes: Your physiology responds well to first aid.

feats.name: Robust Recovery
feats.notes: Greater benefits from Treat Disease and Treat Poison

feats.name: Rock Rampart
feats.notes: Drawing on your connection to the Plane of Earth , you form a wall of rock and earth.

feats.name: Rock Runner
feats.notes: Your innate connection to stone makes you adept at moving across uneven surfaces.

feats.name: Rock the Boat
feats.notes: You know how easy it is for a falling person to cause another to lose their footing at the same time, and how to use that to your advantage.
feats.trigger: A creature within your reach causes you to fall or knocks you prone .
feats.access: You're from the Shackles

feats.name: Rockslide Spell
feats.notes: You enhance your spell with elemental earth, causing chunks of stone to litter the ground.
feats.prerequisite: Elementalist Dedication; earth is in your elemental philosophy

feats.name: Rocky Flesh
feats.notes: Your flesh takes on the hardness of stone.

feats.name: Rod of Rule
feats.notes: Your personal rune is connected more closely to your arcane bond.

feats.name: Rogue Dedication
feats.notes: You gain a skill feat and the rogue’s surprise attack class feature.

feats.name: Roiling Mudslide
feats.notes: You form water and earth into a mudslide that smashes your opponents and coats them in mud.

feats.name: Rokoan Arts
feats.notes: Ancestral spirits have begun to bond themselves to you, granting you powers characteristic of a rokoa.

feats.name: Roll the Bones of Fate
feats.notes: You roll a handful of bones to learn (or perhaps influence) the future course of events.

feats.name: Roll with It (Goblin)
feats.notes: When you take a big hit, your foe bounces you around like a rubber ball, but you escape the worst of the blow.
feats.trigger: A foe hits you with a melee weapon or unarmed attack.

feats.name: Roll with It (Ranger)
feats.notes: You can dodge attacks from giants.
feats.trigger: Your hunted prey, which must be a giant , hits you with a melee attack.

feats.name: Rolling Landing
feats.notes: You land with quick rolls that help you keep your momentum.

feats.name: Rolling White Bottle Form
feats.notes: As you fall to the ground, you transform into a white bottle, gourd, or sake jar, then roll away before anyone can pick you up.
feats.trigger: You Drop Prone or othwerwise become prone

feats.name: Root Magic
feats.notes: Your talismans ward against foul magic.

feats.name: Root to Life
feats.notes: Marigold, spider lily, pennyroyal—many primal traditions connect flowers and plants with the boundary between life and death, and you can leverage this association to keep an ally on this side of the line.

feats.name: Rope Mastery
feats.notes: Ropes are your tool of choice, and you deploy them in versatile ways.
feats.prerequisite: Golden League Xun Dedication; Expert in Athletics

feats.name: Rope Runner
feats.notes: You run and climb across ropes and rigging almost as easily as on the ground.
feats.prerequisite: Pirate Dedication; Trained in Acrobatics; Trained in Athletics

feats.name: Rose Warden Dedication
feats.notes: As a follower of the Everbloom, you stand up against tyranny and oppression, understanding that revolution against an unjust ruler must sometimes be enacted in secret.
feats.prerequisite: Trained in Stealth; you worship Milani

feats.name: Rotten Slurry
feats.notes: You expel a glob of rotten, foul-smelling slurry from your torso, hand, or mouth at a foe.

feats.name: Rough Rider
feats.notes: You are especially good at riding traditional goblin mounts.

feats.name: Rough Terrain Stance
feats.notes: You enter a stance that makes it difficult to move around you.

feats.name: Round Ears
feats.notes: Your elven lineage is subtle enough that you look barely different from other humans, and you’ve learned to use that to your advantage.

feats.name: Rouse the Dreaming Relic
feats.notes: The spirit within your pusaka resonates with other magical items in your possession.

feats.name: Rouse the Forest's Fury
feats.notes: Terrifying trees attack your enemies.

feats.name: Ru-Shi
feats.notes: You were born to a jiang-shi, one of the so-called hopping vampires found most often in Tian-Xia.

feats.name: Rubbery Skin
feats.notes: Your skin develops a malleable, rubbery quality.

feats.name: Ruby Resurrection
feats.notes: In a burst of flame, you return to health like a phoenix rising from the ashes.
feats.trigger: You would be reduced to 0 Hit Points.

feats.name: Rugged Survivalist
feats.notes: You've studied survival skills with the School of Swords experts and are comfortable spending long periods of time in the wilderness.

feats.name: Rule of Three
feats.notes: Heroes learn from their previous failures, often succeeding on the third attempt.
feats.source: Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind
feats.trigger: The villain of the tale you've spun makes an attack roll with a given weapon or unarmed attack, uses a particular special ability (such as a Breath Weapon), or Casts a Spell against the hero, and they used that same attack, special ability, or spell against the hero on the previous turn.

feats.name: Rune Ward
feats.notes: You quickly sketch a rune in the air to gain a modicum of protection against the triggering magic.
feats.trigger: You are targeted by a spell.

feats.name: Rune-Singer
feats.notes: You practice the lost art of using music to guide your runecarving, singing the runes into existence as much as crafting them.

feats.name: Runelord Dedication
feats.notes: Your connection to your sin suffuses all magic you use.

feats.name: Runescarred Dedication
feats.notes: Overwhelming magic has branded your body with powerful runes.
feats.access: You are from the Saga Lands.

feats.name: Runesight
feats.notes: It is impossible for those bearing runes to hide from you.

feats.name: Runesmith Dedication
feats.notes: You become trained in runesmith class DC and Crafting .

feats.name: Runic Correspondence
feats.notes: You can write a message that travels long distances at the speed of thought.
feats.prerequisite: Master in Nature; Master in Occultism; Master in Religion; Master in Religion

feats.name: Runic Expertise
feats.notes: You become an expert in runesmith class DC.

feats.name: Runic Impression
feats.notes: You can temporarily replicate the effects of a property rune for your weapon or unarmed attacks.

feats.name: Runic Mind Smithing
feats.notes: You focus your mind on thoughtforms of fundamental magical forces, shaping them into a property rune that you mentally etch onto your mind weapon.

feats.name: Runic Reprisal
feats.notes: When you Raise your Shield , you can bury a runic trap into it, which is set off by the clash of an enemy weapon.

feats.name: Runic Tattoo
feats.notes: By drawing your favorite rune in your flesh, you know you’ll never be without it.

feats.name: Running Kick
feats.notes: Your companion weaves in and out of combat, swiftly attacking before getting to a better position.
feats.prerequisite: Beastmaster Dedication; animal companion with a foot, hoof, or talon unarmed attack

feats.name: Running Recharge
feats.notes: Preparing in every way for your next assault, you both relocate yourself and ready your Spellstrike .

feats.name: Running Reload
feats.notes: You can reload your weapon on the move.

feats.name: Running Tackle
feats.notes: You charge, throwing your body at your foe in a vicious tackle.

feats.name: Runtsage
feats.notes: Unlike most of your kind, who dismiss goblins as embarrassments or expendable annoyances, you have studied the methodology behind their irresponsible and incomprehensible actions.

feats.name: Rupture Stomp
feats.notes: Every dwarf knows that the rock they walk upon can be either a best friend or a treacherous path.

feats.name: Rushing Boar
feats.notes: You embrace the pain of the triggering attack, allowing it to drive you into a violent rush.
feats.trigger: An attack from a creature that isn’t adjacent to you damaged you.

feats.name: Rushing Goat Stance
feats.notes: You enter the stance of an unruly goat, lowering your body and preparing to butt heads with your foes.

feats.name: Ruthless Orator
feats.notes: You were once cast in the role of Daronlyr XII, one of Taldor’s most ambitious rulers who slew his cousin to seize the crown, yet somehow still managed to convince the entire Ulfen Guard to swear loyalty to him simply through his powers of oration.

feats.name: Saber Teeth
feats.notes: You have long fangs, natural or augmented.

feats.name: Sabotage
feats.notes: You subtly damage others’ equipment.

feats.name: Sacral Lord
feats.notes: By right of ritual or sheer stubbornness, you have claimed rulership of the land.
feats.prerequisite: Trained in Occultism or Trained in Religion

feats.name: Sacral Monarch
feats.notes: You have come into your full powers and are truly a monarch of your realm, by your own definition at least.
feats.prerequisite: Sacral Lord; Master in Occultism or Master in Religion

feats.name: Sacred Armaments
feats.notes: Through the power of your faith or the blessing of a priest, your weapons are fully effective against incorporeal creatures.

feats.name: Sacred Defender
feats.notes: You are a great warrior that can stand strong against the fiercest opponents to your cause.

feats.name: Sacred Defense
feats.notes: You call upon your deity to grant you their protective blessing
feats.prerequisite: Master in Religion; you follow a deity

feats.name: Sacred Ground
feats.notes: You pray continuously for 1 minute to call a subtle shadow of your deity’s realm over a 30-foot burst centered on you.

feats.name: Sacred Ki
feats.notes: The power of your faith suffuses your ki
feats.prerequisite: Ki Strike; you follow a deity

feats.name: Sacred Spells
feats.notes: Add chill touch , death ward , disrupt undead , disrupting weapons , holy cascade , magic stone , and sunburst to your spell list.

feats.name: Sacred Weapon
feats.notes: You’re a living weapon honed to destroy fiends .

feats.name: Sacred Wilds Oath
feats.notes: You’ve sworn an oath to protect the holy places within nature and the spirits that dwell within, from ancient trees to primordial wild guardians.

feats.name: Sacrifice Armor
feats.notes: With divine awareness, you twist your body to lessen the impact of an attack.
feats.trigger: You are hit by a Strike that deals physical damage.

feats.name: Safe Elements
feats.notes: Elements are wild and dangerous, but you've found ways to reduce their risk.

feats.name: Safe House
feats.notes: You establish a safe house—a secure space in which to hide your secrets from the outside world.

feats.name: Safeguard Soul
feats.notes: You've girded your soul against outside interference.

feats.name: Safeguard Spell
feats.notes: You are inured to the effects of your own spells.

feats.name: Safety Measures
feats.notes: You're often careful to be sure you're not hoisted on your own petard, or anyone else's, for that matter.

feats.name: Sage of Scattered Leaves
feats.notes: The epics of your people’s tragic yet proud history blaze like burning leaves in the forests of ancestral memory.

feats.name: Sailfish Strike
feats.notes: You've learned how to convert your upward momentum into a powerful attack.
feats.trigger: You reach the top of your Propelled Leap.

feats.name: Salt Kissed
feats.notes: You have a supernatural ability to survive at sea and keep your companions from drowning.

feats.name: Samsaran Lore
feats.notes: You have untold ages of knowledge beneath your belt, focused on the pursuit of enlightenment.

feats.name: Samsaran Weapon Memory
feats.notes: The training of your past lives and even of those of samsarans who came before is deep-seated and guides your movements in combat.

feats.name: Sanctified Relic
feats.notes: You fill an item with your divine power, granting the wearer your blessings.

feats.name: Sanctified Soul
feats.notes: You’ve drawn a line in the sand in the cosmic struggle between good and evil and chosen a side.

feats.name: Sanctify Armament
feats.notes: You touch a weapon and bring it into concordance with your deity.

feats.name: Sanctify Water
feats.notes: You imbue water with your deity's blessing.
feats.prerequisite: Expert in Religion; you follow a deity with “holy” or “unholy” sanctification

feats.name: Sand Snatcher
feats.notes: A figure of sand with grasping arms arises in an unoccupied square within 30 feet.

feats.name: Sanguimancer Dedication
feats.notes: You can draw and manipulate energy from blood. You store life energy in the form of special temporary Hit Points and spend it to manifest powerful effects.

feats.name: Sanguine Evasion
feats.notes: You avoid death by turning into a spray of red mist.
feats.trigger: You’re reduced to 0 Hit Points and are not already wounded .
feats.access: member of the Red Mantis assassins

feats.name: Sanguine Mastery
feats.notes: Your mastery over the intricacies of your fascination has allowed you to infuse your own blood with additional healing properties while increasing your ability to bleed out any foes that stand against you.

feats.name: Sanguine Tenacity
feats.notes: Your blood carries permanent regenerative properties.

feats.name: Sanguine Transference
feats.notes: You transfer your blood and soul into a thrall.

feats.name: Sanguivolent Roots
feats.notes: Blood-drinking vines grow from the ground in a 15-foot burst within 120 feet.

feats.name: Saoc Astrology
feats.notes: The ancient Saoc Brethren were the masters of astrology, and while your knowledge may be but a pale shadow of their wisdom, it still comes in handy.
feats.access: Lirgeni nationality

feats.name: Sap Life
feats.notes: You draw the life force out of your enemies.

feats.name: Sapping Symbol
feats.notes: Your religious symbol glows with sacred energy, turning the attacker’s strength to weakness.
feats.trigger: While you have your symbol raised, you are about to take damage from a melee attack

feats.name: Sarangay Lore
feats.notes: You listened carefully to the tales passed down among your community.

feats.name: Sash of the Wind
feats.notes: At your request, the nature spirits of the air and wind spin themselves into an iridescent sash loosely draped around your shoulders that buoys you through the sky.
feats.access: Tian Xia origin

feats.name: Savage Critical
feats.notes: The wounds you inflict are grievous.

feats.name: Saving Slash
feats.notes: You quickly whirl your blade, trying to deflect enough momentum to avoid the worst of the attack.
feats.trigger: An opponent critically hits you with a melee attack.

feats.name: Sawtooth Grapple
feats.notes: Your sawtooth saber training enables you to pin down an enemy using your twin blades.
feats.access: member of the Red Mantis assassins

feats.name: Say that Again!
feats.notes: The world is full of obnoxious weasels who think they can pull one over on you—put them in their place! When an adjacent creature attempts to Lie to you or to Demoralize you and gets a critical failure on the roll, you can use your reaction to make a Shove attempt against that opponent.
feats.trigger: An opponent gets a critical failure when attempting to Demoralize you or Lie to you.

feats.name: Scalding Spit
feats.notes: Your bodily fluids burn with surprising volatility, as if you ran on oil instead of blood.

feats.name: Scales of Steel
feats.notes: Your scales are hard as armor, ensuring you always have some protection in the dangerous world.

feats.name: Scales of the Dragon
feats.notes: Scales grow across your body, protecting you against physical and magical threats.

feats.name: Scaling Poppet
feats.notes: Your construction integrates ropes, hooks, or other tools to help you move across steep surfaces.

feats.name: Scalpel's Point
feats.notes: Your stratagems benefit from your precise knowledge of anatomy.

feats.name: Scaly Hide
feats.notes: You were born with a layer of scales across your entire body that resemble those of your draconic progenitor.

feats.name: Scamper
feats.notes: You Stride up to your Speed, with a +5-foot status bonus to your Speed, and you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to AC against reactions triggered by this movement.

feats.name: Scamper Underfoot
feats.notes: You are used to ducking under foes and can scurry around the battlefield with ease.

feats.name: Scapegoat Parallel Self
feats.notes: You've realized a way to manipulate the effects of your oracular curse.
feats.trigger: Your turn starts or your oracular curse would advance.

feats.name: Scar-Thick Skin
feats.notes: Glorious, storied scars cover and protect much of your body, girding you in fleshly armor that resists any wound weaker than those you have already survived.

feats.name: Scare to Death
feats.notes: Scare a target so much, they might die

feats.name: Scarecrow
feats.notes: You fight fiercely to protect your crop.

feats.name: Scarlet Strands
feats.notes: The innate magic in your blood turns your signature crimson tresses into more than just a stylish coiffure.

feats.name: Scarred Hide
feats.notes: Your hide is an impenetrable mass of scars, accrued over countless bloody conflicts.

feats.name: Scars of Steel
feats.notes: When you are struck with the mightiest of blows, you can flex your muscles to turn aside some of the damage.
feats.trigger: An opponent critically hits you with an attack that deals physical damage.

feats.name: Scatter Blast
feats.notes: You pack your weapon with additional shot and powder, creating a risky but devastating wave of destruction.

feats.name: Scatter Swarm
feats.notes: Your patron reaches through your familiar to magically disperse a group of smaller threats.

feats.name: Scattered Fire
feats.notes: When you cast fireball , you can modify its area to be two non-overlapping 10-foot bursts.
feats.prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _fireball_

feats.name: Scattering Charge
feats.notes: You charge into a group of enemies to send them flying.

feats.name: Scattering in Spring
feats.notes: You evade an incoming attack by twisting your enemy’s tactics in your favor.
feats.trigger: An enemy within your reach targets you with a melee attack, and you're aware of the attack.

feats.name: Scattering Shout
feats.notes: With a flex of your mighty thews and a guttural bellow that can make ears bleed, you drive back any enemies surrounding you.

feats.name: Scavenger's Search
feats.notes: You're always on the lookout for supplies and valuables.

feats.name: Scholar's Hunch
feats.notes: Scholarly debates have taught you to think on your feet.
feats.trigger: You fail a Lore or Occultism skill check.

feats.name: Scholar's Inheritance
feats.notes: Your parents devoted themselves to alchemical experiments involving elemental energy.

feats.name: Scholarly Defense
feats.notes: Your knowledge of strange creatures and their bizarre anatomy allows you to anticipate their physical attacks and reduce the damage you take from them.

feats.name: Scholastic Identification
feats.notes: You have the knowledge needed to understand ancient texts and cultural artifacts.

feats.name: School Counterspell
feats.notes: Your intricate knowledge of your school lets you easily negate spells from that school.

feats.name: School Spell Redirection
feats.notes: When you Counterspell a spell with a school matching your specialization, if you critically succeed at your counteract check, or if you succeed while using a spell of a higher level than the spell you countered, you can redirect the spell you countered.

feats.name: Schooled in Secrets
feats.notes: Gather Information about and Impersonate members of secret societies

feats.name: Scintillating Spell
feats.notes: Your spells become a radiant display of light and color.

feats.name: Scion of Domora Dedication
feats.notes: You gain a spirit guide ally.
feats.prerequisite: Familiar Master Dedication; you have befriended a spirit guide and it bonded with you using its Bond to Mortal ability.

feats.name: Scion of Many Planes
feats.notes: The long and complicated history of your bloodline manifests in your ability to draw power from more planar sources than most other nephilim.

feats.name: Scion Transformation
feats.notes: You go into hibernation for twenty-four hours and perform a ritual dedicated to your ancestors, undergoing a one-time metamorphosis.

feats.name: Scorched on the Crackling Mountain
feats.notes: By ritualistically marking your fur with fire, like an infamous tanuki of legend, you protect yourself against future flames.

feats.name: Scorching Column
feats.notes: With an upward gesture, you shape a vertical column of extreme heat.

feats.name: Scorching Disarm
feats.notes: You make a weapon unbearable to hold.

feats.name: Scoundrel's Surprise
feats.notes: You drop your disguise at the right moment and surprise your target.

feats.name: Scour the Library
feats.notes: Seeing an enemy's attack, you quickly consult multiple scraps of lore in your mind, synthesizing them into the perfect plan.

feats.name: Scouring Rage
feats.notes: You emit a powerful surge of instinctual energy when you unleash your anger.
feats.prerequisite: an instinct that allows you to change your additional damage from Rage to a different damage type
feats.trigger: You Rage.

feats.name: Scouring Spark
feats.notes: When you unleash your divine spark, you become a being of living light that scours away the darkness.

feats.name: Scout Dedication
feats.notes: You are a highly skilled scout, capable of guiding your allies, detecting imminent threats, and avoiding the attention of dangerous enemies.
feats.prerequisite: Trained in Stealth; Trained in Survival

feats.name: Scout's Charge
feats.notes: You meander around unpredictably, and then ambush your opponents without warning.

feats.name: Scout's Pounce
feats.notes: You leap from the shadows to strike at your foes.

feats.name: Scout's Speed
feats.notes: You move faster, especially when traveling, allowing you to scout out ahead and report back without slowing your allies.

feats.name: Scout's Warning
feats.notes: You visually or audibly warn your allies of danger, granting them each a +1 circumstance bonus to their initiative rolls.
feats.trigger: You are about to roll a Perception or Survival check for initiative

feats.name: Scrap Barricade
feats.notes: Ragged pieces of metal weld together into a ramshackle structure.

feats.name: Scroll Adept
feats.notes: During your daily preparations, you can create two temporary scrolls containing arcane spells from your spellbook.

feats.name: Scroll Esoterica
feats.notes: Your esoterica includes scraps of scriptures, magic tomes, druidic markings, and the like, which you can use to create temporary scrolls.

feats.name: Scroll Thaumaturgy
feats.notes: Your multidisciplinary study of magic means you know how to activate the magic in scrolls with ease.

feats.name: Scroll Trickster Dedication
feats.notes: You've studied scrolls in depth.
feats.prerequisite: Trained in Nature, Trained in Arcana, Trained in Occultism, or Trained in Religion

feats.name: Scrollmaster Dedication
feats.notes: Your experience chronicling adventures and discoveries grants you heightened discernment and memory.
feats.prerequisite: expert in any Lore skill; member of the Pathfinder Society affiliated with the School of Scrolls
feats.access: A character who is a member of the Pathfinder Society has access to this option.

feats.name: Scrounger Dedication
feats.notes: While others need specialized tools and a dedicated space, you have found a way to build just about anything, anywhere.

feats.name: Scrutinizing Gaze
feats.notes: Your family's traditions of defending against Geb's undead have granted you a sixth sense for detecting spirits, haunts, and other restless dead, no matter their form or the strength of their presence.
feats.access: You are from Dongun Hold or Alkenstar.

feats.name: Sculpt Shadows
feats.notes: You coax nearby shadows into the shape of a simple weapon or a simple tool or item, using a tiny piece of your shadow to make it solid; in doing so, you lose 1 Hit Point.

feats.name: Scurry!
feats.notes: Your instincts to move to safety are strong.
feats.trigger: You roll initiative.

feats.name: Scuttle Up
feats.notes: Your environment requires you to climb cave walls or tree trunks with great regularity.

feats.name: Sea Glass Guardians
feats.notes: Eerily beautiful elemental water beings race around you, eager to protect and heal you and your allies.

feats.name: Sea Legs
feats.notes: You are comfortable on the water for short bursts.
feats.prerequisite: You don't have a swim Speed.

feats.name: Sea Swarmer
feats.notes: You’ve learned how to hunt with others, whether above or below the surface.

feats.name: Sea Witch
feats.notes: You've studied the waves, and they obey your will as extensions of your own fin.

feats.name: Seal of the Golden Dragon
feats.notes: Your familiar coils around you, protecting you with its magical resistance.
feats.prerequisite: Familiar Sage Dedication; Golden Dragon's Bounty
feats.trigger: You would take acid , cold , electricity , poison , fire , or sonic damage.

feats.name: Sealed Poppet
feats.notes: You've reinforced your interior parts with sealant or other flame-retardant materials, protecting you from fire.

feats.name: Searing Restoration
feats.notes: They told you there was no way that explosions could heal people, but they were fools… Fools who didn't understand your brilliance! You create a minor explosion from your innovation, altering the combustion to cauterize wounds using vaporized medicinal herbs.

feats.name: Seasoned
feats.notes: +1 to Craft food and drink, including elixirs and potions
feats.prerequisite: Trained in Alcohol Lore, Trained in Cooking Lore, or Trained in Crafting

feats.name: Seasoned Command
feats.notes: Allies intuitively follow your orders.
feats.prerequisite: Master in Diplomacy or Master in Intimidation

feats.name: Seasong
feats.notes: Sound carries far beneath the waves, and your people have strong, enchanting voices.

feats.name: Seat of Power
feats.notes: Your sheer determination has created a demiplane that houses a grand residence which will serve as the heart of your planned realm.

feats.name: Second Blessing
feats.notes: Your continued service grants you another boon.

feats.name: Second Ikon
feats.notes: You gain an additional ikon, selected from those listed here.

feats.name: Second Shield
feats.notes: You're used to your shield breaking in the middle of battle, and you're prepared to use a backup or any convenient nearby object to defend yourself.
feats.trigger: Your Shield Block causes your shield to break or be destroyed.

feats.name: Second Sight
feats.notes: You peer into the next several seconds to watch the potential timelines around a nearby creature unfold.
feats.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star

feats.name: Second Sting
feats.notes: You read your prey’s movements and transform them into openings, so failures with one weapon set up glancing blows with the other.

feats.name: Second Thoughts
feats.notes: When your target proves resilient to your magical deceptions, you can try them again on someone else.
feats.trigger: You cast a mental spell that targets one creature, and it critically succeeds at its Will save

feats.name: Second Wind
feats.notes: You can enter a second rage, but afterward you need to catch your breath.

feats.name: Secondary Adaptation
feats.notes: You've continued to adapt to the rigors of your environment by continuing your metamorphosis, even as an adult.

feats.name: Secondary Detonation Array
feats.notes: You divert some of your spell’s energy into an unstable runic array.

feats.name: Secret Eater
feats.notes: You have discovered and found favor with the cult within the church of Kabriri known as the Secret Eaters.

feats.name: Secret Eyes
feats.notes: You can call forth an invisible eye to let you peek on secrets.

feats.name: Secret Speech
feats.notes: Learn the secret language of a society.

feats.name: Secrets of Shadow
feats.notes: Your shadow's voice grows ever clearer; it whispers secrets of true power to you and shields your flesh from harm.

feats.name: Secrets of Steel
feats.notes: As your prowess with weapons increases, so does the ferocity of magic you channel through those weapons.

feats.name: Secrets of the Past
feats.notes: You’ve established a stronger connection with your past selves and can play out the memories of your lifetimes in an instant, helping you draw on knowledge that lives deep within your mind.

feats.name: Security
feats.notes: Those you shield can benefit from your lasting protection.

feats.name: See the Unseen
feats.notes: You notice things that others can't see at all.

feats.name: See You in Hell
feats.notes: You aren’t sure if you’ll be reincarnated again, so you might as well take this foe with you.
feats.trigger: You’re reduced to 0 Hit Points by a creature but not immediately killed.

feats.name: Seedpod
feats.notes: Your body produces a nearly endless supply of hard seedpods.

feats.name: Seek the Hidden Glyphs
feats.notes: You are well-versed in the use of magical runes in traps and hazards.

feats.name: Seeker of Truths
feats.notes: Your devotion to discovering and hoarding abstruse truths borders on the fanatical, and you can bring this devotion to bear.

feats.name: Seize
feats.notes: You seize your foe and pull it close.

feats.name: Seize Advantage
feats.notes: You take the openings granted by your student's success to reposition yourself.
feats.trigger: Your student critically succeeds at a Strike or spell attack roll.

feats.name: Seize an Advantage
feats.notes: You take any momentary advantage you can when fighting dirty.
feats.access: You're from the Shackles

feats.name: Selective Energy
feats.notes: As you call down divine power, you can prevent some enemies from benefiting or some allies from being hurt.

feats.name: Self-Destruct
feats.notes: You've installed a self-destruct device within your construct companion, which you can trigger with a special device from up to 60 feet away.
feats.trigger: Your reanimated clockwork companion is reduced to 0 Hit Points.

feats.name: Selfless Parry
feats.notes: You protect those near to you with a flash of steel and a stroke of good luck.

feats.name: Semblance of Life
feats.notes: You draw the moisture you've drained from others into your own flesh, temporarily taking on the appearance of life.
feats.trigger: You deal damage to a living creature with your fist Strike or with Desiccating Inhalation.

feats.name: Seneschal Spell
feats.notes: You can channel even complex spells through your connection to your charge.

feats.name: Seneschal Witch Dedication
feats.notes: As you work to understand the connection with your missing patron, it’s increasingly easy to form bonds with those around you.

feats.name: Sense Alignment
feats.notes: You read the body language of an intelligent creature within 30 feet and pick up on subtle cues to detect its general propensity for good or evil and law or chaos.
feats.source: Pathfinder #157: Devil at the Dreaming Palace

feats.name: Sense Allies
feats.notes: Like many humans raised in a close-knit community, you have always been strongly attuned to the presence of others.

feats.name: Sense for Trouble
feats.notes: You can tell when something's off.

feats.name: Sense Holiness
feats.notes: The presence of goodness sickens you with its saccharine self-righteousness.

feats.name: Sense Iniquity
feats.notes: Your Hellknight training gives you the ability to focus your senses and root out those who would attempt to deceive or hide from you.

feats.name: Sense Ki
feats.notes: You can read the presence of ki in your area.

feats.name: Sense the Strike
feats.notes: You sense how an incoming attack moves through ambient primal energy, predicting how best to dodge.
feats.prerequisite: Verduran Shadow Dedication; Master in Survival
feats.trigger: A creature targets you with an attack and you can see the attacker.

feats.name: Sense the Unseen
feats.notes: When you look for foes, you can catch even the slightest cues, such as their minute movements or the shifting of air currents on your skin.
feats.trigger: You fail a check to Seek

feats.name: Sense Thoughts
feats.notes: You have an even stranger knack for knowing what other people are thinking.

feats.name: Sense Unholiness
feats.notes: You sense the truly wicked as a queasy or foreboding feeling.

feats.name: Senses of the Bear
feats.notes: While in ursine form, you gain low-light vision and scent ( imprecise ) 30 feet.

feats.name: Sensitive Nose
feats.notes: Your large black nose isn't just for show.

feats.name: Sentinel Dedication
feats.notes: You have trained carefully to maximize the protective qualities of your armor.

feats.name: Sentinel's Orbit
feats.notes: Just as your constellation traverses the sky, so too can you.

feats.name: Sepulchral Sublimation
feats.notes: You repurpose the negative energy that flows through your minions at a moment's notice.
feats.prerequisite: ability to create or control undead; cleric with a negative font, oracle of bones, or necromancer wizard

feats.name: Sequestered Spell
feats.notes: You consumed so much of a type of magic as a larva that you can now cast it purely on instinct.

feats.name: Serpent's Tongue
feats.notes: You subconsciously flick your tongue through the air to taste the world around you.

feats.name: Serpentcoil Slam
feats.notes: Your people's ancient and storied rivalry with garudas led you to develop special techniques against flying foes.

feats.name: Serpentine Swimmer
feats.notes: You undulate your body in a series of sinuous serpentine motions as you swim, drastically improving the speed at which you move through the water.

feats.name: Set-up Strike
feats.notes: Your attack makes it difficult for your enemy to defend themselves against your allies' attacks.

feats.name: Settlement Scholastics
feats.notes: Your studies open up new horizons.

feats.name: Seven Changes Performance
feats.notes: While kitsune are known for their magical illusion powers, you’re skilled at stage magic, especially costuming and quick changes.

feats.name: Seven-Colored Cosmic Bridge
feats.notes: Your divine spark shines in a riot of shimmering colors, capable of carrying you through the world as fast as light itself.

feats.name: Seven-Part Link
feats.notes: By exchanging pieces of a seven-part set of esoterica, you create a magical web by which your allies can affect each other at a distance.

feats.name: Sever Magic
feats.notes: You apply a frayed thread, a pinch of fulu ash, or a similar undone charm to your weapon, and swing to break a spell.

feats.name: Sever Space
feats.notes: You destroy the space between you and your targets, allowing you to strike with your melee weapons at great range.

feats.name: Sever the Dreaming Shadow
feats.notes: As you whisper to your pusaka, it attempts to cut away an enemy’s shadow, leaving them in an eternal sleep.

feats.name: Shackleborn
feats.notes: Your lineage shows the signs of velstrac tampering, including some curious quirk bequeathed by those shadowy surgeons of flesh and souls.

feats.name: Shades of Meaning
feats.notes: As the gap between your intention and your words becomes almost nothing, you find that you don’t need to consciously draw the diacritic marks that would embellish or modify your runes.

feats.name: Shadow Blending
feats.notes: You draw shadows close to create a shroud.
feats.trigger: A creature attempts a flat check to target you while you're concealed or hidden due to dim light or darkness.

feats.name: Shadow Hunter
feats.notes: You blend in to your surroundings so well that others have trouble telling you apart from the terrain.

feats.name: Shadow Illusion
feats.notes: With an artful eye, you shape shadows into illusory forms.

feats.name: Shadow Magic
feats.notes: You gain the ability to fuse and play with shadows by using focus spells specific to shadowdancers.

feats.name: Shadow Mark
feats.notes: You have learned special tricks that help you follow individuals without them noticing you.

feats.name: Shadow Master
feats.notes: The shadows protect you better than any armor can, and they give you power to plunge others into darkness.

feats.name: Shadow of Death
feats.notes: Strikes you make with your deity’s favored weapon against a creature with the doomed condition have the death trait, causing the target to be instantly killed when reduced to 0 Hit Points.

feats.name: Shadow of the Wilds
feats.notes: It’s difficult to notice your passage through wild areas.

feats.name: Shadow Pact
feats.notes: Thousands of years ago, your ancestors made a pact with Zon-Kuthon.

feats.name: Shadow Power
feats.notes: You can focus the shadows into a powerful blast.

feats.name: Shadow Reservoir
feats.notes: Your own shadow speaks to you, providing knowledge of spells and a reservoir of magical power.
feats.prerequisite: ability to cast spells from spell slots; Shadowcaster Dedication

feats.name: Shadow Self
feats.notes: You slip from your adversaries' notice and appear to be somewhere else.
feats.trigger: You successfully use Stealth to Hide and become hidden from all your current foes, or use Stealth to Sneak and become undetected to all your current foes

feats.name: Shadow Sight
feats.notes: You draw on your connection with the Shadow Plane to see through all but the deepest darkness.

feats.name: Shadow Sneak Attack
feats.notes: You gain the sneak attack class feature, except you deal 1d6 precision damage regardless of your level.

feats.name: Shadow Spell
feats.notes: You attach a piece of your shadow to a spell to cloud the senses and cause mischief.

feats.name: Shadow Spells
feats.notes: Hidden darkness whispers to you, teaching you secrets of shadow beyond other spellcasters of your tradition.

feats.name: Shadow Tempo
feats.notes: As your ally moves past you, you match your movements to their rhythm, following them across the battlefield.
feats.trigger: An ally within your reach uses a move action or leaves a square during a move action they're using.

feats.name: Shadow's Assault
feats.notes: Your shadow assaults your foes.

feats.name: Shadow's Web
feats.notes: You can launch a wave of shadowy qi outward from your body, damaging your opponents and potentially binding them in place.

feats.name: Shadowcaster Dedication
feats.notes: You've sacrificed a piece of your spirit, allowing the powers of shadow into your being and changing the nature of your magic.

feats.name: Shadowdancer Dedication
feats.notes: You dedicate yourself to the shadows.
feats.prerequisite: Master in Stealth; Expert in Performance

feats.name: Shadowpiercing Charge
feats.notes: You charge into the fray on horseback, and those that lurk in the shadows will feel your wrath.

feats.name: Shadowplay
feats.notes: As your blow lands, you detach from your shadow to get the drop on your enemy.

feats.name: Shadows Within Shadows
feats.notes: Your apparition possesses a furtive and elusive nature that can influence and blend with your spiritual energy to form a protective and nearly impenetrable shroud of nondetection around you.
feats.trigger: You would be detected by an enemy Seeking you, or an enemy would succeed at a counteract check against a spell making you hidden , concealed , or undetected .

feats.name: Shadowy Disguise
feats.notes: You wrap yourself in shadow to change your appearance.

feats.name: Shaitan Magic
feats.notes: The magic of shaitans runs through your blood.

feats.name: Shaitan Skin
feats.notes: When in danger, you can harden the stone in your skin into armor, much like a shaitan.

feats.name: Shake It Off
feats.notes: You concentrate on your rage, overcoming fear and fighting back sickness.

feats.name: Shake Off the Gods
feats.notes: Your trust in the Pure Legion rushes forth as you fight off the influence of a god.

feats.name: Shall Not Falter, Shall Not Rout
feats.notes: You gain the shall not falter, shall not rout focus spell.

feats.name: Shamble
feats.notes: You may be slower than you were in life, but your pace is unfaltering.

feats.name: Shambling March
feats.notes: Your horde is swifter, marching in time to your command.

feats.name: Shame the Sin
feats.notes: Your conviction against the sins that all demons grow from is so strong that you can force a demon to suffer from its sins when you strike a sound blow against them.
feats.trigger: You critically hit a demon with a Strike .

feats.name: Shameless Request
feats.notes: Make Requests of others with lesser consequences

feats.name: Shape of the Cloud Dragon
feats.notes: You've discovered how to transform yourself into a cloud dragon.

feats.name: Shape of the Dragon
feats.notes: You've discovered how to transform yourself into a dragon.

feats.name: Shapechanger's Intuition
feats.notes: A lifetime of experience helps you see through disguises.

feats.name: Shaped Contaminant
feats.notes: Through a combination of careful manipulation and precise breath control, you can deploy inhaled toxins precisely.

feats.name: Shard Strike
feats.notes: Jagged metal shards form in the air and lash out from you.

feats.name: Share Burden
feats.notes: You draw the misfortune or curse into yourself, potentially enabling you to enter your curse maelstrom state.
feats.trigger: An ally within 60 feet would be affected by a curse or misfortune effect, and you wouldn't be affected but are an eligible target for the effect.

feats.name: Share Eidolon Magic
feats.notes: Your eidolon shares innate spells with you.

feats.name: Share Rage
feats.notes: You stoke an ally's fury.

feats.name: Share Thoughts
feats.notes: You have an uncanny knack of communicating with other elves without speaking, though this habit that is often uncomfortable to observers.
feats.prerequisite: Mualijae ethnicity, Ilverani ethnicity, or Vourinoi ethnicity

feats.name: Share Tincture
feats.notes: You use Quick Tincture , and the item you create remains potent until the start of your next turn.

feats.name: Share Weakness
feats.notes: You select an object from your esoterica that has great personal value to you, such as a locket or treasured ring, and you grant it to an adjacent ally, establishing a personal link that allows your ally to affect an enemy as if they were you.

feats.name: Shared Assault
feats.notes: In the triumph of battle, you can share the glory with another ally.

feats.name: Shared Attunement
feats.notes: When you would gain a benefit from your terrain attunement, you can grant it to one ally within 30 feet instead of yourself.

feats.name: Shared Avoidance
feats.notes: You can project your premonitions of danger to your allies.

feats.name: Shared Clarity
feats.notes: You can project your premonitions of clarity to your allies.

feats.name: Shared Dream
feats.notes: You've learned to create a shared dreamscape to communicate with others.

feats.name: Shared Focus
feats.notes: Your magical expertise allows you to perform a metaphorical sleight of hand to manifest a Focus Point.

feats.name: Shared Luck (Halfling)
feats.notes: You are evidence that it’s lucky to travel with a halfling.

feats.name: Shared Mind, Shared Heart
feats.notes: Your thoughts and dreams are your student's thoughts and dreams, and vice versa.

feats.name: Shared Overdrive
feats.notes: You've experimented enough on your teammates to transfer a substantial number of powered-up gizmos to them, enabling one of your allies to benefit from the full effects and duration of your Overdrive.

feats.name: Shared Prey
feats.notes: Hunting as a duo, you and your ally both single out your prey.

feats.name: Shared Replenishment
feats.notes: When your deity blesses your warlike acts, you can extend that favor to your allies.

feats.name: Shared Sight
feats.notes: You bestow the mystical vision granted to you by your muse upon your allies.
feats.access: Knights of Lastwall have access to this feat.

feats.name: Shared Stratagem
feats.notes: The plans you make include your allies as well as yourself.

feats.name: Shared Synergy
feats.notes: You can grant the benefit from Dualistic Synergy to an ally within 30 feet instead of yourself, either allowing that ally to Recall Knowledge, granting that ally temporary Hit Points, or both, depending on the spell’s tradition.

feats.name: Shared Tide
feats.notes: You Swim up to twice the normal distance.
feats.prerequisite: Werecreature Dedication; your animal shape has a swim Speed

feats.name: Shared Warding
feats.notes: You ward your allies from the attacks of your foes whenever you apply those protections to yourself.

feats.name: Shark Attack
feats.notes: Your swimming skills enable you to lunge through the water in a sudden attack.

feats.name: Sharkskin Grip
feats.notes: You served on nephilim pirate Ila “Sharkskin” Clare’s ship, the Scorched Shark , and have adopted xir practice of embellishing clothing and armor with sharkskin.
feats.access: You're from the Shackles

feats.name: Sharpened Senses
feats.notes: Your senses have become so sharp that you notice changes subconsciously.

feats.name: Shatter Defenses
feats.notes: Your offense exploits your enemy’s fear.

feats.name: Shatter Space
feats.notes: The sheer power of your magic fractures reality.

feats.name: Shattered Sacrament
feats.notes: When Vigil fell to Tar-Baphon’s Radiant Fire, that lost innocence brought you a deeper understanding of what faith means in the context of your own magic.
feats.prerequisite: Halcyon Speaker Dedication; Cascade Bearer's Spellcasting

feats.name: Shattering Blows
feats.notes: Your forceful blows shatter objects with ease.

feats.name: Shattering Shot
feats.notes: You fling a bomb into the air and then shoot it with your gun before it falls, raining destruction down over a wide area.

feats.name: Shattering Spellstrike
feats.notes: You intentionally channel a rampaging cascade of magic through your weapon, breaking it to deal more damage.

feats.name: Shattering Strike (Monk)
feats.notes: The force of your considered blow shatters objects and defenses alike.

feats.name: Shattering Strike (Weapon Improviser)
feats.notes: The improvised weapon shatters, destroying it completely but dealing an additional 3d6 piercing damage to the creature you hit with the Improvised Pummel.
feats.trigger: An improvised weapon you are wielding becomes broken as a result of a critical success on an Improvised Pummel.

feats.name: Shattershields
feats.notes: Four plates of pitted metal float around you to intercept attacks.

feats.name: Shed Tail
feats.notes: You can shed a portion of your tail to escape.
feats.trigger: You become grabbed .

feats.name: Sheltering Cave
feats.notes: You spend 10 minutes communing with spirits of earth and stone, requesting shelter.

feats.name: Sheltering Hand
feats.notes: Animals, plants, and the earth itself rush to protect you from harm, interposing themselves between you and danger.

feats.name: Sheltering Jewel
feats.notes: Your head gem has accessed the power of the full moon through your determination to heal and protect your loved ones.

feats.name: Sheltering Pulse
feats.notes: You thrust your hand or weapon into the ground and release a pulse that creates a sheltering nexus of energy for you and your allies.

feats.name: Sheltering Slab
feats.notes: The stone around you is your ally, and you have learned to use it to shore up your weaknesses.

feats.name: Sheltering Wing
feats.notes: You raise your fledgling wings to protect you from attack, gaining a +1 circumstance bonus to AC and to saving throws against spells that target you until the start of your next turn.

feats.name: Shepherd of Desolation
feats.notes: You know how to keep others alive in the Gravelands' murkiest shadows.
feats.prerequisite: Knight Reclaimant Dedication; Survivor of Desolation

feats.name: Shield Block
feats.notes: Ward off a blow with your shield
feats.trigger: While you have your shield raised, you would take physical damage (bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing) from an attack.

feats.name: Shield from Arrows
feats.notes: You place your shield in the path of an oncoming projectile.
feats.trigger: An adjacent ally is the target of a physical ranged Strike.

feats.name: Shield from Spells
feats.notes: Your prowess with a shield allows you to block magic and more.

feats.name: Shield of Faith
feats.notes: Residual energy from your domain spells bolsters your defenses.

feats.name: Shield of Grace
feats.notes: You protect an ally with both your shield and your body.

feats.name: Shield of Reckoning
feats.notes: When you shield your ally against an attack, you call upon your power to protect your ally further.
feats.prerequisite: Shield Warden; blessed shield, champion's reaction
feats.trigger: An enemy’s attack against an ally matches the trigger for both your Shield Block reaction and your champion’s reaction.

feats.name: Shield of Stone
feats.notes: You stole a gorgon’s gaze and trapped it in your ikon.
feats.source: Pathfinder #217: Death Sails a Wine-Dark Sea

feats.name: Shield Paragon
feats.notes: Your shield is a vessel of divine protection.

feats.name: Shield Salvation
feats.notes: You can save your shield from total destruction, even after a devastating attack.

feats.name: Shield Spell Reinforcement
feats.notes: You can empower your defensive magic by channeling it through a physical shield.
feats.prerequisite: War Mage Dedication; you can cast the _shield_ cantrip

feats.name: Shield the Faithful
feats.notes: You and those closest to you are protected by your deity’s power.

feats.name: Shield Wall
feats.notes: You use your shield in tandem with an ally's, forming a barricade.
feats.trigger: Your shield is raised and an adjacent ally Raises a Shield .
feats.access: Knights of Lastwall have access to this feat.

feats.name: Shield Wallop
feats.notes: Attacks with your shield knock the sense out of your foes.

feats.name: Shield Warden
feats.notes: When you have a shield raised, you can use your Shield Block reaction when an attack is made against an ally adjacent to you.

feats.name: Shield Warfare
feats.notes: You know how to use shields offensively far better than most.

feats.name: Shield your Eyes
feats.notes: You reflexively place your shield between your eyes and visual dangers.

feats.name: Shielded Attrition
feats.notes: You provoke attacks from foes that might otherwise stop your allies from moving.

feats.name: Shielded Recovery
feats.notes: You can bandage wounds with the same hand you use to hold your shield.

feats.name: Shielded Stride
feats.notes: When your shield is up, your enemies’ blows can’t touch you.

feats.name: Shielded Tome
feats.notes: You can magically fuse a shield into your favorite book during your daily preparations or as a 10-minute activity with the manipulate trait.

feats.name: Shielding Formation
feats.notes: You have mastered unique magical techniques designed to protect your allies from harm.

feats.name: Shielding Taunt
feats.notes: By banging loudly on your shield, you get the attention of even the most stubborn of foes.

feats.name: Shieldmarshal Dedication
feats.notes: Your elite shieldmarshal training makes you equally at home in the squalor of Smokeside and the splendor of Skyside.
feats.access: Characters from Alkenstar have access to this archetype

feats.name: Shift Horde
feats.notes: With a wave of your hand, your risen undead horde collapses and another one rises to take its place.

feats.name: Shift Spell
feats.notes: You move an active spell's area to a new location.
feats.access: member of the Magaambya

feats.name: Shift the Little Ones
feats.notes: With your large size, you need to be careful around your smaller friends.

feats.name: Shifting Faces
feats.notes: You wear many faces, even those that don't belong to you.

feats.name: Shifting Terrain
feats.notes: You slam your fist into the ground or twirl your arms about to cause the terrain around you to shift and ripple, potentially throwing others off balance.
feats.prerequisite: Rough Terrain Stance; Master in Nature

feats.name: Shining Arms
feats.notes: When you cast light , you can modify its target to be 1 melee weapon.
feats.prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _light_

feats.name: Shining Glory
feats.notes: With a righteous word, your divine aura inspires your allies to great heroics and causes foes to tremble.

feats.name: Shining Runes
feats.notes: Whenever you Cast a Spell that requires more than one action to cast, the signature Thassilonian runes you trace in the air flicker with light and command attention.
feats.source: Pathfinder #219: Lord of the Trinity Star

feats.name: Shinstabber
feats.notes: As long as you're Small or smaller, you can end your movement in the same square as an ally of any size.

feats.name: Shiny Button Eyes
feats.notes: You've polished your eyes to reflect the smallest details in dimmest light.

feats.name: Ship's Shadow
feats.notes: After extensive training around and on board ships, you've learned how to use their size and contours to conceal yourself.
feats.prerequisite: Undersea Privateer Dedication; Expert in Stealth

feats.name: Shisk Lore
feats.notes: You hoard knowledge like a dragon hoards gold.

feats.name: Shoki's Argument
feats.notes: You feel a connection to shokis, the rambling collectors of wayward souls, and might have found old texts written by one.

feats.name: Shoony Lore
feats.notes: Growing up in shoony society, you learned the value of honesty, friendship, and hard work, even during trying times.

feats.name: Shooter's Camouflage
feats.notes: You specialize in blending into a particular type of environment, able to disappear after taking your shot.

feats.name: Shooting Stars Stance
feats.notes: You enter a stance that lets you throw shuriken with lightning speed.

feats.name: Shore Gift
feats.notes: Using old magic, you slip off your tail like an item of clothing and walk on two feet, resembling a humanoid ancestry, usually human but possibly elf, half-elf, or something stranger.

feats.name: Shore Step
feats.notes: The shallows and tide pools have always called to you and let you pass unhindered.

feats.name: Shorthanded
feats.notes: You can operate a siege weapon with fewer than the minimum number of crew, at an increasing penalty.

feats.name: Shory Aerialist
feats.notes: Unique in Golarion’s history, the Shory people developed fighting styles dedicated to combat in the air.
feats.prerequisite: Garundi ethnicity, Mauxi ethnicity, or Tian-Yae ethnicity; Shory Aeromancer or ability to cast _fly_

feats.name: Shory Aeromancer
feats.notes: Your ancestors hailed from the flying cities of the Shory, and a few simple tricks have come down through the ages to you.
feats.prerequisite: Garundi ethnicity, Mauxi ethnicity, or Tian-Yae ethnicity

feats.name: Shoulder Catastrophe
feats.notes: You’ve trained to protect your allies by diverting the worst attacks to yourself.
feats.trigger: An enemy critically succeeds at a Strike against an adjacent ally.

feats.name: Shoulder Check
feats.notes: You hit a foe with your armor to throw them off balance.

feats.name: Shove Down
feats.notes: You leverage your weight to topple foes that you move.

feats.name: Shoving Sweep
feats.notes: You swing your weapon at your foe, rebuffing them back.
feats.trigger: An enemy within your reach leaves a square during a move action it’s using.

feats.name: Show-Off
feats.notes: As is the tradition with many Firebrands, you call your shot and look to impress with an extra bit of panache or a greater stunt.
feats.trigger: You succeed at an Acrobatics or Athletics check deemed suitably challenging and meaningful by the GM.
feats.access: Members of the Firebrands at the rank of second mark or higher have access to this feat.

feats.name: Showstopper
feats.notes: Your twirling weapons create a grand distraction that's difficult to look away from.

feats.name: Shrink Down
feats.notes: Your eidolon can shrink to fit into small spaces.

feats.name: Shrink Spell
feats.notes: You’ve learned to manipulate space to narrow the impact of other spells.

feats.name: Shroud of Ghosts
feats.notes: Your ikon is connected to the world of the spirits, allowing you to partially fade into their realm.

feats.name: Shroud of the Seas
feats.notes: You've learned to camouflage yourself among the shadows and currents of the ocean so you're hard to see from above.

feats.name: Shrouded Magic
feats.notes: Choose one cantrip from the occult spell list.

feats.name: Shrouded Mien
feats.notes: You're used to dealing with dangerous situations and sinister creatures.

feats.name: Sickening Bite
feats.notes: Your saliva causes severe nausea and mild fever in the living, weakening them so that you can more easily finish them off.

feats.name: Side by Side (Druid)
feats.notes: You and your animal companion fight in tandem, distracting your foes and keeping them off balance.

feats.name: Side by Side (Ranger)
feats.notes: You and your animal companion fight in tandem.

feats.name: Sidestep
feats.notes: You deftly step out of the way of an attack, letting the blow continue.
feats.trigger: The attack roll for a Strike targeting you fails or critically fails

feats.name: Siege Celerity
feats.notes: You push yourself and your light mortar beyond your limits.
feats.trigger: Your turn begins.

feats.name: Siege Ritualist
feats.notes: Sometimes, magical warfare requires the application of more complex arcana.

feats.name: Sign Language
feats.notes: Learn sign languages

feats.name: Signature Crafting
feats.notes: Magic items you create bear a stamp specific to your handiwork.

feats.name: Signature Spell Expansion
feats.notes: Your innate connection to magic lets you cast more spells with greater freedom.

feats.name: Signature Weapon
feats.notes: Your energy saturates one of your weapons; it might be one inherited or one tied to your history.

feats.name: Signifer's Sight
feats.notes: The magic flowing through your signifer's mask allows you to see in the dark, and the mask dampens the distraction caused by sudden flashes of bright light.

feats.name: Silence the Profane (Avenger)
feats.notes: Your training included instruction on how to prevent enemy priests from using their magic against you, a technique you have now mastered and adapted.
feats.trigger: A creature you can observe within reach of your deity’s favored weapon casts a spell.

feats.name: Silence the Profane (Vindicator)
feats.notes: Your training included instruction on how to prevent enemy spellcasters from using their prayers against you.
feats.trigger: A creature you can observe within reach of your deity’s favored weapon casts a spell .

feats.name: Silencing Strike
feats.notes: A quick strike to the face or mouth silences your opponent.

feats.name: Silent Step
feats.notes: You Step, then Hide or Sneak .

feats.name: Silent Sting
feats.notes: You quickly hide your weapon to make it difficult to pin the attack on you.
feats.prerequisite: Golden League Xun Dedication; Expert in Stealth
feats.trigger: You make a Strike with a weapon of light bulk.

feats.name: Silent Stone
feats.notes: You've lived in the shadow of the Shattered Range, and the patience of those ancient mountains expresses itself in your stillness.

feats.name: Silk Bracelet
feats.notes: Taking inspiration from Desna’s image as a giant silk moth in Tian Xia, you’ve attached a bracelet to your innovation that generates ultra-strong silk strands mixed with venom.
feats.prerequisite: armor innovation, construct innovation, or weapon innovation
feats.access: Tian Xia origin

feats.name: Silver's Refrain
feats.notes: Learn the silver's refrain composition cantrip.

feats.name: Simple Crystal Magic
feats.notes: You are capable of seeing magic as flowing runes and can scribe a personal rune that represents you.
feats.source: Pathfinder #148: Fires of the Haunted City

feats.name: Simple Mastery
feats.notes: Other casters’ never-ending hunger for new magic prevents them from truly understanding just how far simple magic can be pushed when truly mastered.

feats.name: Simultaneous Strike
feats.notes: Moving in unison, you and your student unleash an attack against a foe.

feats.name: Sin Counterspell
feats.notes: Your deep connection to a specific sin allows you to easily negate spells that sin opposes.

feats.name: Sin Reservoir
feats.notes: During your daily preparations, you can indulge in your associated sin or meditate on its values (and risks).

feats.name: Sinbladed Spell
feats.notes: You punctuate your spellcasting with a flourish of your weapon, imparting physical force to your magic.

feats.name: Sing to the Steel
feats.notes: You strike magical tones that can turn the tide of combat.
feats.source: Pathfinder #170: Spoken on the Song Wind

feats.name: Sinister Appearance
feats.notes: You possess horns, a tail, or red eyes, or could otherwise be mistaken for a tiefling.

feats.name: Sink and Swim
feats.notes: Your body looks like it's made of flowing water, clear and pristine, providing a natural grace to all your movements
feats.prerequisite: You've been brought to 0 Hit Points by an enemy that has the water trait or an enemy's ability that has the water trait.

feats.name: Sinking Jaws
feats.notes: Like how a constrictor wraps itself around its next meal, your companion tightens its teeth around its constrained prey to squeeze the life out of it.
feats.prerequisite: Beastmaster Dedication; animal companion with a jaws or fangs unarmed attack

feats.name: Siphon Life
feats.notes: Experiences with necromantic energy have left a permanent mark on you.
feats.prerequisite: You've been reduced to 0 Hit Points by an enemy with the void trait.

feats.name: Siphon Magic
feats.notes: You gorge upon the magical energies of your foe’s blood.

feats.name: Siphon Power
feats.notes: You draw upon the reservoir of your patron’s magic that resides within your familiar.
feats.trigger: once per day

feats.name: Siphon Torment
feats.notes: Your progenitors suffered greatly at the hands of a curse, a fate you willingly take upon yourself rather than let fall upon others.

feats.name: Siphoning Touch
feats.notes: When you cast vampiric touch , you can modify its standard effects as follows: Instead of gaining the temporary Hit Points yourself, you can grant the temporary Hit Points to an ally within 30 feet.
feats.prerequisite: Spell Trickster Dedication; ability to cast _vampiric touch_

feats.name: Siren Song
feats.notes: You can beguile and bewitch with your song.

feats.name: Sister of the Golden Erinys Dedication
feats.notes: The fighting style of the Sisterhood of the Golden Erinys is rooted in their understanding of devils.
feats.prerequisite: You're from Isger or a member of the Sisterhood of the Golden Erinys.
feats.access: You're from Isger or a member of the Sisterhood of the Golden Erinys.

feats.name: Six Pillars Stance
feats.notes: You stand firm, steeling your mind and body, allowing you to use your magic unperturbed.
feats.source: Fists of the Ruby Phoenix Hardcover, Pathfinder #167: Ready? Fight!

feats.name: Sixth Pillar Dedication
feats.notes: You use your physical discipline to channel your magic.
feats.source: Fists of the Ruby Phoenix Hardcover, Pathfinder #167: Ready? Fight!
feats.prerequisite: Dexterity 14; Expert in Acrobatics; ability to cast spells

feats.name: Sixth Pillar Mastery
feats.notes: You align your magical and physical potential.
feats.source: Fists of the Ruby Phoenix Hardcover, Pathfinder #167: Ready? Fight!

feats.name: Sixth Sense
feats.notes: Your psychic abilities also allow you to detect the lingering thoughts of spirits and similar entities.

feats.name: Skeletal Extension
feats.notes: You make use of what remains of a thrall to extend your limbs to unnatural lengths.

feats.name: Skeletal Lancers
feats.notes: You create a myriad of swift skeletal warriors.

feats.name: Skeletal Resistance
feats.notes: Your body becomes resistant, your hardened bones deflecting weapons and other forms of damage.

feats.name: Skeletal Transformation
feats.notes: You rearrange your bones into a bestial shape.

feats.name: Skeleton Commander
feats.notes: You gain the ability to summon your own skeletal minions.

feats.name: Skeptic's Defense
feats.notes: You don't believe in any mental twaddle, and you're certainly not afraid of it.
feats.trigger: You are targeted by or are in the area of a mental spell or effect.

feats.name: Skill Mastery
feats.notes: Increase your proficiency rank in one of your skills from expert to master and in another of your skills from trained to expert.
feats.prerequisite: Investigator Dedication; trained in at least one skill and expert in at least one skill

feats.name: Skill Mastery (Rogue)
feats.notes: Increase your proficiency rank in one of your skills from expert to master and in another of your skills from trained to expert.
feats.prerequisite: Rogue Dedication; trained in at least one skill and expert in at least one skill

feats.name: Skill Training
feats.notes: Become trained in a skill

feats.name: Skill Training (Kingdom)
feats.notes: Become trained in a Kingdom skill

feats.name: Skilled Climber
feats.notes: You can navigate vertical surfaces with ease.

feats.name: Skilled Herbalist
feats.notes: You've been taught how to craft healing remedies with a variety of herbs and plants.

feats.name: Skilled Partner
feats.notes: Your eidolon gains a 1st-level skill feat and a 2nd-level or lower skill feat.

feats.name: Skilled Swimmer
feats.notes: You move through the water with ease, mastering your movements with years of practice.

feats.name: Skillful Climber
feats.notes: You can scamper up or down surfaces as nimbly as a monkey.

feats.name: Skillful Tail
feats.notes: You’ve always had a tail, but with practice, you’ve learned to use it for more than signaling your mood.

feats.name: Skim Scroll
feats.notes: You can activate the magic of a scroll with a cursory read as you draw it from your belt.

feats.name: Skin Split
feats.notes: You claw open the top layer of your scales and peel off the premature shed in order to remove harmful substances from your skin.

feats.name: Skirmish Strike
feats.notes: Your feet and weapon move in tandem.

feats.name: Skirt the Light
feats.notes: You can travel the border between the Material and Shadow Planes and even bring others along.

feats.name: Skitter
feats.notes: Crawl up to half your Speed.

feats.name: Skittering Scuttle
feats.notes: You can scuttle farther and faster when maneuvering alongside allies.

feats.name: Skittering Sneak
feats.notes: You squish, slink, and skitter from cover to cover with great speed and stealth.

feats.name: Skittertalk
feats.notes: You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with spiders and other arachnids.

feats.name: Skull Creeper
feats.notes: You wear skulls to demoralize foes.

feats.name: Sky and Heaven Stance
feats.notes: You enter a stance allowing you to make jagged strikes like flashes of lightning through the sky.

feats.name: Sky and Heaven Stance
feats.notes: You enter a stance perfected by past champions of the Challenge of Sky and Heaven, allowing you to make jagged strikes like flashes of lightning through the sky.

feats.name: Sky Master Mask
feats.notes: Your mask holds the legacy of Black Heron, the Wings of Knowledge, who united the aeromancers of the Shory Empire.

feats.name: Skyseeker
feats.notes: You Leap toward an opponent.

feats.name: Skyseeker
feats.notes: You Leap toward an opponent.

feats.name: Slag May
feats.notes: Your mother was an iron hag known for physical prowess, and you have one violet or steel-gray eye.

feats.name: Slam Down
